mandārakośaviśrāntabhramaradvandvanādinī .
madirāmodasaundaryamuditonmadamānavā ..1.31.14..

vyomavātavinunneva tārakāṇāṃ paramparā .
patiteva dharāpīṭhaṃ svargastrīhasitacchaṭā ..1.31.15..

vṛṣṭiṣvekaśaranmeghalavāvaliriva cyutā .
haiyyaṅgavīnapiṇḍānāmīriteva paramparā ..1.31.16..

himavṛṣṭirivodārā muktāhāracayopamā .
aindavī raśmimāleva kṣīrormīṇāmivātatiḥ ..1.31.17..

kiñjalkāmodavalitā bhramadbhṛṅgakadambakā .
sītkāragāyadāmodamadhurāniladolitā ..1.31.18..

prabhramatketakavyūhā prasaratkairavotkarā .
prapatatkundavalayā valatkuvalayālayā ..1.31.19..

āpūritāṅganārāmagṛhacchādanacatvarā .
udgrīvapuravāstavyavaranārīvilokitā ..1.31.20..

nirabhrotpalasaṅkāśavyomavṛṣṭiranākulā .
adṛṣṭapūrvā sarvasya janasya janitasmayā ..1.31.21..

adṛṣṭapūrvā siddhaughakarotkarasamīritā .
sā muhūrtacaturbhāge puṣpavṛṣṭiḫ papāta ha ..1.31.22..

āpūritasabhāloke śānte kusumavarṣaṇe .
imān siddhagaṇālāpāñ śuśruvus te sabhāsadaḥ ..1.31.23..

ākalpaṃ siddhasenāsu bhramadbhirabhito divam .
apūrvamadya tvasmābhiś śrutaṃ śrutirasāyanam ..1.31.24..

yadanena kilodāramuktaṃ raghukulendunā .
vītarāgatayā tad dhi vākpaterapyagocaram ..1.31.25..

aho vata mahat puṇyamadyāsmābhiridaṃ śrutam .
vaco rāmamukhodbhūtamamṛtāhlādakaṃ dhiyaḥ ..1.31.26..

upaśamāmṛtasundaramādarād
adhigatottamatāpadameṣa yat .
kathitavānucitaṃ raghunandanas
sapadi tena vayaṃ pratibodhitāḥ ..1.31.27..

pāvanasyāsya vacasaḫ proktasya raghuketunā .
nirṇayaṃ śrotumucitaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ maharṣibhiḥ ..1.32.1..

nāradavyāsapulahapramukhā munipuṅgavāḥ .
āgacchatāśvavighnena sarva eva maharṣayaḥ ..1.32.2..

patāmaḫ paritaḫ puṇyāmetāṃ dāśarathīṃ sabhām .
nīrandhrakanakāmbhojāṃ nalinīmiva ṣaṭpadāḥ ..1.32.3..

ityuktvā sā samastaiva vyomāvāsanivāsinī .
āpapāta sabhāṃ tatra divyā muniparamparā ..1.32.4..

agrasthitamarutpṛṣṭharaṇadvīṇamunīśvarā .
payaḫpīnaghanaśyāmavyāsamecakitāntarā ..1.32.5..

bhṛgvaṅgiraḫpulastyādimunināyakamaṇḍitā .
cyavanoddālakośīraśaralomādipālitā ..1.32.6..

parasparaparāmarśād dussaṃsthānamṛgājinā .
lolākṣamālāvalayā sukamaṇḍaludhāriṇī ..1.32.7..

tārāvalirivānyo'nyaṃ kṛtaśobhātiśāyinī .
kausumī vṛṣṭiranyeva dvitīyevārkamaṇḍalī ..1.32.8..

tārājāla ivāmbhodo vyāso hyatra vyarājata .
tāraugha iva śītāṃśur nārado 'tra vyarājata ..1.32.9..

deveṣviva surādhīśaḫ pulastyo 'tra vyarājata .
āditya iva devānāmaṅgirāś ca vyarājata ..1.32.10..

athāsyāṃ siddhasenāyāṃ patantyāṃ nabhaso rasāt .
uttasthau munisampūrṇā tadā dāśarathī sabhā ..1.32.11..

miśrībhūtā virejus te nabhaścaramahīcarāḥ .
parasparavṛtāṅgābhā bhāsayanto diśo daśa ..1.32.12..

veṇughaṇṭāvṛtakarā līlākamaladhāriṇaḥ .
dūrvāṅkurākrāntaśikhās sacūḍāmaṇimūrdhajāḥ ..1.32.13..

jaṭākaṭaprakapilā maulimālitamastakāḥ .
prakoṣṭhagākṣavalayā māṇikyavalayānvitāḥ ..1.32.14..

cīravalkalasaṃvītās srakkauśeyāvaguṇṭhitāḥ .
vilolamekhalāpāśāś calanmuktākalāpinaḥ ..1.32.15..

vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrau tān pūjayāmāsatuẖ kṣaṇāt .
arghyaiḫ pādyair vacobhiś ca nabhaścaramahāgaṇān ..1.32.16..

sarvācāreṇa siddhaughaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ .
siddhaugho bhūpatiṃ caiva kuśalapraśnavārttayā ..1.32.17..

tais taiḫ praṇayasaṃrambhairanyo'nyaṃ prāptasatkriyāḥ .
upāviśan viṣṭareṣu nabhaścaramahīcarāḥ ..1.32.18..

vacobhiḫ puṣpavarṣeṇa sādhuvādena cābhitaḥ .
rāmaṃ taṃ pūjayāmāsuḫ puraḫ praṇatamāsthitam ..1.32.19..

āsāṃ cakre ca tatrāsau rājalakṣmyā virājitaḥ .
viśvāmitro vasiṣṭhaś ca vāmadevaś ca mantriṇaḥ ..1.32.20..

nārado devaputraś ca vyāsaś ca munipuṅgavaḥ .
marīciratha durvāsā munirāṅgirasas tathā ..1.32.21..

kratuḫ pulastyaḫ pulahaś śaralomā munīśvaraḥ .
vātsyāyano bharadvājo vālmīkir munipuṅgavaḥ ..1.32.22..

uddālaka ṛcīkaś ca śaryātiś cyavanas tathā .
ūṣmapāś ca ghṛtārciś ca śāluḍir vāluḍis tathā ..1.32.23..

ete cānye ca bahavo vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ .
jñātajñeyā mahātmānas saṃsthitās tatra nāyakāḥ ..1.32.24..

vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrābhyāṃ saha te nāradādayaḥ .
idamūcuranūcānā rāmamānamitānanam ..1.32.25..

aho vata kumāreṇa kalyāṇaguṇaśālinī .
vāguktā paramodāravirāgarasagarbhiṇī ..1.32.26..

pariniṣṭhitavākyārthasubodhamucitaṃ sphuṭam .
udāraṃ priyacaryārhamavihvalamaviplutam ..1.32.27..

abhivyaktapadaspaṣṭamiṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ ca tuṣṭimat .
karoti rāghavaproktaṃ vacaẖ kasya na vismayam ..1.32.28..

śatādekatamasyaiva sarvodāracamatkṛteḥ .
īpsitārthārpaṇaikāntadakṣā bhavati bhāratī ..1.32.29..

kumāra tvāṃ vinā kasya vivekaphalaśālinī .
evaṃ vikāsamāyāti prajñāvanalatā navā ..1.32.30..

prajñādīpaśikhā yasya rāmasyeva hṛdi sthitā .
prajvalatyalamālokakāriṇī sa pumān smṛtaḥ ..1.32.31..

raktamāṃsāsthiyantrāṇi bahūnyatitatāni ca .
padārthānapakarṣanti nāsti teṣu sacetanam ..1.32.32..

janmamṛtyujarāduẖkhamanuyānti punaḫ punaḥ .
vimṛśanti na saṃsāraṃ paśavaḫ parimohitāḥ ..1.32.33..

kathañcit kvacidevaiko dṛśyate vimalāśayaḥ .
pūrvāparavicārārho yathāyamarisūdanaḥ ..1.32.34..

anuttamacamatkāraphalās subhagamūrtayaḥ .
bhavyā hi viralā loke sahakāradrumā iva ..1.32.35..

samyagdṛṣṭir jagajjātau svavivekacamatkṛtiḥ .
asmin bhavyamatāvantariyamanyeva dṛśyate ..1.32.36..

sulabhās subhagā lokāḫ phalapallavaśālinaḥ .
jāyante taravo deśe na tu candanapādapāḥ ..1.32.37..

vṛkṣāḫ prativane santi satyaṃ suphalapallavāḥ .
na tvapūrvacamatkāro lavaṅgas sulabhas sadā ..1.32.38..

jyotsneva śītamahasas sutaroriva mañjarī .
puṣpādāmodalekheva dṛṣṭā rāmāc camatkṛtiḥ ..1.32.39..

asmāduddāmadaurātmyadaivanirmāṇanirmiteḥ .
dvijendrā dagdhasaṃsārāt sāro hyatyantadurlabhaḥ ..1.32.40..

yatante sārasamprāptau ye yaśonidhayo dhiyā .
dhanyā dhuri satāṃ gaṇyās ta eva puruṣottamāḥ ..1.32.41..

na rāmeṇa samo 'stīha triṣu lokeṣu kaścana .
vivekavānudārātmā mahātmā ceti no matiḥ ..1.32.42..

sakalalokacamatkṛtikāriṇo
'pyabhimataṃ yadi rāghavacetasaḥ .
phalati no tadime vayameva hi
sphuṭataraṃ munayo hatabuddhayaḥ ..1.32.43..

nāradeneti mahatā vacasyukte sabhāgataḥ .
rāmamagragataṃ prītyā viśvāmitro 'pyuvāca ha ..2.1.1..

tava rāghava nāstyanyaj jñeyaṃ jñānavatāṃ vara .
svayaiva sūkṣmayā buddhyā sarvaṃ vijñātavānasi ..2.1.2..

kevalaṃ mārjanāmātraṃ manāgevopayujyate .
svabhāvavimale nityaṃ subuddhimakure tava ..2.1.3..

bhagavadvyāsaputrasya śukasyeva matis tava .
viśrāntimātramevāntar jñātajñeyāpyapekṣate ..2.1.4..

bhagavadvyāsaputrasya śukasya bhagavan katham .
dhiyāpyādau na viśrāntaṃ viśrāntaṃ ca dhiyā punaḥ ..2.1.5..

ātmodantasamaṃ rāma varṇyamānamimaṃ mayā .
śṛṇu vyāsātmajodantaṃ janmanāmantakāraṇam ..2.1.6..

yo 'yamañjanavarṇābho niviṣṭo hemaviṣṭare .
pārśve tava pitur vyāso bhagavān bhāskaradyutiḥ ..2.1.7..

asyābhūdinduvadanas tanayo nayakovidaḥ .
śuko nāma mahāprājño yajño mūrtyeva saṃsthitaḥ ..2.1.8..

pravicārayato lokayātrāmalamimāṃ hṛdi .
taveva kila tasyāpi viveka udabhūd bhṛśam ..2.1.9..

tenāsau svavivekena svayameva mahāmate .
vicārya suciraṃ cāru yat satyaṃ tadavāptavān ..2.1.10..

svayaṃ prāpte pare vastunyaviśrāntamanās tataḥ .
nedaṃ vastviti viśvāsaṃ nāsāvātmanyupāyayau ..2.1.11..

kevalaṃ virarāmāsya ceto vigatacāpalam .
bhogebhyo bhūribhaṅgebhyo dharādbhya iva cātakaḥ ..2.1.12..

ekadā so 'malaprajño merāvekāntasaṃsthitam .
papraccha pitaraṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim ..2.1.13..

saṃsārāḍambaramidaṃ kathamabhyutthitaṃ mune .
kathaṃ ca praśamaṃ yāti kiyat kasya kadeti ca ..2.1.14..

iti pṛṣṭena muninā vyāsenākhilamātmaje .
yathāvadamalaṃ proktaṃ vaktavyaṃ viditātmanā ..2.1.15..

ajñāsiṣaṃ pūrvametadahamityatha tatpituḥ .
sa śukaś śuddhayā buddhyā na vākyaṃ bahvamanyata ..2.1.16..

vyāso 'pi bhagavān buddhvā putrābhiprāyamīdṛśam .
pratyuvāca punaḫ putraṃ nāhaṃ jānāmi tattvataḥ ..2.1.17..

janako nāma bhūpālo vidyate vasudhātale .
yathāvad vettyasau vedyaṃ tasmāt sarvamavāpsyasi ..2.1.18..

pitretyuktaś śukaḫ prāyāt sumeror vasudhātalam .
videhanagarīṃ prāpa janakenābhipālitām ..2.1.19..

āvedito 'sau yāṣṭīkair janakāya mahātmane .
dvāri vyāsasuto rājañ śuko 'tra sthitavāniti ..2.1.20..

jijñāsārthaṃ śukasyāsāvāstāmevetyavajñayā .
uktvā babhūva janakas tūṣṇīṃ saptadinānyapi ..2.1.21..

tataḫ praveśayāmāsa janakaś śukamaṅganam .
tatrāhāni sa saptaiva tathaivāvasadunmanāḥ ..2.1.22..

atha praveśayāmāsa janako 'ntaḫpuraṃ śukam .
rājā na dṛśyate tāvaditi saptadināni tam ..2.1.23..

tatronmadābhiẖ kāntābhir bhojanair bhogasañcayaiḥ .
janako lālayāmāsa śukaṃ śaśisamānanam ..2.1.24..

te bhogās tāni duẖkhāni vyāsaputrasya tan manaḥ .
na jahrur mandapavano baddhapīṭham yathācalam ..2.1.25..

kevalaṃ saśamas svaccho maunī muditamānasaḥ .
atiṣṭhadatra sa śukas sampūrṇa iva candramāḥ ..2.1.26..

parijñātasvabhāvaṃ taṃ śukaṃ sa janako nṛpaḥ .
ānīya muditātmānamavalokya nanāma ha ..2.1.27..

niśśeṣitajagatkārya prāptākhilamanoratha .
kimīpsitaṃ tavetyāśu kṛtasvāgatamāha tam ..2.1.28..

saṃsārāḍambaramidaṃ kathamabhyutthitaṃ guro .
kathaṃ praśamamāyāti yathāvat kathayāśu me ..2.1.29..

janakeneti pṛṣṭena śukasya kathitaṃ tathā .
tadeva yat purā proktaṃ tasya pitrā mahātmanā ..2.1.30..

svayameva mayā pūrvametaj jñātaṃ vivekataḥ .
etāvadeva pṛṣṭena pitrā me samudāhṛtam ..2.1.31..

bhavatāpyeṣa evārthaẖ kathito vāgvidāṃ vara .
eṣa eva ca vākyārthaś śāstreṣu paridṛśyate ..2.1.32..

yathāyaṃ svavikalpotthas svavikalpaparikṣayāt .
kṣīyate dagdhasaṃsāro nissāra iti niścayaḥ ..2.1.33..

tat kimetan mahābāho satyaṃ brūhi mamāmalam .
tvatto viśrāmamāpnoti ceto mā bhramatāj jagat ..2.1.34..

nātaḫ parataraẖ kaścin niścayo 'styaparo mune .
svayametat tvayā jñātaṃ gurutaś ca punaś śrutam ..2.1.35..

avyucchinnaś cidātmaikaḫ pumānastīha netarat .
sa saṅkalpavaśād baddho nissaṅkalpaś ca mucyate ..2.1.36..

yena tvetat sphuṭaṃ jñātaṃ jñeyaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ .
bhogebhyo viratir jātā dṛśyād vā sakalādiha ..2.1.37..

tava cālaṃ mahāvīra matir viratimāgatā .
bhogebhyo dīrgharogebhyaẖ kimanyat paripṛcchasi ..2.1.38..

na tathā pūrṇatā jātā sarvajñānamahānidheḥ .
tiṣṭhatas tapasi sphāre pitus tava yathā tava ..2.1.39..

vyāsādadhika evāhaṃ vyāsaśiṣyo 'pi tatsutaḥ .
bhogecchātānaveneha matto 'pyabhyadhiko bhavān ..2.1.40..

prāptaṃ prāptavyamakhilaṃ bhavatā pūrṇacetasā .
na dṛśye patasi brahman muktas tvaṃ bhrāntimutsṛja ..2.1.41..

anuśiṣṭas sa ityevaṃ janakena mahātmanā .
viśaśrāma śukas tūṣṇīṃ svacche paramavastuni ..2.1.42..

vītaśokabhayāyāso nirīhaś chinnasaṃśayaḥ .
jagāma śikharaṃ meros samādhyarthamaninditam ..2.1.43..

tatra varṣasahasrāṇi nirvikalpasamādhinā .
daśa sthitvā śaśāmāsāvātmanyasnehadīpavat ..2.1.44..

vyapagatakalanākalaṅkaśuddhas
svayamamalātmani pāvane pade 'sau .
salilakaṇa ivāmbudhau mahātmā
vigalitabhedamathaikatāṃ jagāma ..2.1.45..

tasya vyāsatanūjasya matimātrāpamārjanam .
yathopayuktaṃ te rāma tāvadevopayujyate ..2.2.1..

jñeyametena vijñātamaśeṣeṇāvanīśvara .
svadante 'smai na yad bhogā rogā iva sumedhase ..2.2.2..

jñātajñeyasya manaso nūnametad dhi lakṣaṇam .
na svadante samagrāṇi bhogavṛndāni yat punaḥ ..2.2.3..

bhogabhāvanayā yāti bandho dārḍhyamavastujaḥ .
tayaiva śāntayā yāti bandho jagati tānavam ..2.2.4..

vāsanātānavaṃ rāma mokṣa ityucyate budhaiḥ .
padārthavāsanādārḍhyaṃ bandha ityabhidhīyate ..2.2.5..

ātmatattvābhigamanaṃ bhavati prāyaśo nṛṇām .
punar viṣayavairasyaṃ kadarthādupajāyate ..2.2.6..

samyak paśyati yas tajjño jñātajñeyas tu paṇḍitaḥ .
na svadante balādeva tasmai bhogā mahātmane ..2.2.7..

yaśaḫprabhṛtinā yasmai hetunaiva vinā punaḥ .
bhuvi bhogā na rocante sa jīvanmukta ucyate ..2.2.8..

jñeyaṃ yāvan na vijñātaṃ tāvat tāta na jāyate .
viṣayeṣvaratir jantor marubhūmau latā yathā ..2.2.9..

ata eva hi vijñātajñeyaṃ viddhi raghūdvaha .
yadenaṃ rañjayantyetā na ramyā bhogabhūmayaḥ ..2.2.10..

rāmo yadetaj jānāti tad vastvityeva sanmukhāt .
ākarṇya cittaviśrāmo rāghavasyopajāyate ..2.2.11..

kevalaṃ kevalībhāvaviśrāntiṃ samapekṣate .
rāmabuddhiś śarallakṣmīr jalaviśramaṇaṃ yathā ..2.2.12..

atrāsya cittaviśrāntyai rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ .
yuktiṃ kathayatu śrīmān vasiṣṭho bhagavānayam ..2.2.13..

raghūṇāmeṣa sarveṣāṃ prabhuẖ kulagurus sadā .
sarvajñas sarvadarśī ca trikālāmaladarśanaḥ ..2.2.14..

vasiṣṭha bhagavan pūrvaṃ kaccit smarasi yat svayaṃ .
āvayor vairaśāntyarthaṃ śreyase ca mahātmanām ..2.2.15..

niṣadhādrer munīnāṃ ca sānau saralasaṅkule .
upadiṣṭaṃ bhagavatā jñānaṃ padmabhuvā bahu ..2.2.16..

yena yuktimatā brahmañ jñāneneyaṃ hi vāsanā .
saṃsārī nūnamāyāti śamaṃ śyāmeva bhāsvatā ..2.2.17..

tadeva yuktimaj jñeyaṃ rāmāyāntenivāsine .
brahmannupadiśāśu tvaṃ yena viśrāntimeṣyati ..2.2.18..

kadarthanā ca naivaiṣā rāmo hi gatakilbiṣaḥ .
nirmale makure vaktramayatnenaiva bimbati ..2.2.19..

taj jñānaṃ sa ca śāstrārthas tad vaidagdhyamakhaṇḍitam .
sacchiṣyāya viraktāya sādho yadupadiśyate ..2.2.20..

aśiṣyāyāviraktāya yat kiñcidupadiśyate .
tat prayātyapavitratvaṃ gokṣīraṃ śvadṛtāviva ..2.2.21..

vītarāgabhayakrodhā nirmamā galitainasaḥ .
vadanti tvādṛśā yat tu tatra viśrāmyatīha dhīḥ ..2.2.22..

ityukte gādhiputreṇa vyāsanāradapūrvakāḥ .
munayas te tamevārthaṃ sādhu sādhvityapūjayan ..2.2.23..

athovāca mahātejā rājñaḫ pārśve vyavasthitaḥ .
brahmeva brahmaṇaḫ putro vasiṣṭho bhagavān muniḥ ..2.2.24..

mune yadādiśasi me tadavighnaṃ karomyaham .
kas samarthas samartho 'pi satāṃ laṅghayituṃ vacaḥ ..2.2.25..

ahaṃ hi rājaputrāṇāṃ rāmādīnāṃ manastamaḥ .
jñānenāpanayāmyadya dīpeneva niśātamaḥ ..2.2.26..

smarāmyakhaṇḍitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃsārabhramaśāntaye .
niṣadhādrau purā proktaṃ yaj jñānaṃ padmajanmanā ..2.2.27..

iti nigaditavānasau mahātmā
parikarabandhagṛhītavandyatejāḥ .
akathayadidamajñatopaśāntyai
paramapadaikavibodhanaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ ..2.2.28..

pūrvamuktaṃ bhagavatā yaj jñānaṃ padmajanmanā .
sargādau lokaśāntyarthaṃ tadidaṃ kathayāmyaham ..2.3.1..

kathayiṣyasi vistīrṇāṃ bhagavan mokṣasaṃhitāṃ .
imaṃ tāvat kṣaṇaṃ jātaṃ saṃśayaṃ me nivāraya ..2.3.2..

pitā śukasya sarvajño gurur vyāso mahāmuniḥ .
videhamukto na kathaṃ kathaṃ muktas suto 'sya saḥ ..2.3.3..

paramārkaprakāśāntas trijagattrasareṇavaḥ .
utpatyotpatya līnā ye na saṅkhyāmupayānti te ..2.3.4..

vartamāne ca yās santi trailokyagaṇakoṭayaḥ .
śakyante naiva saṅkhyātuṃ tāś ca kāścana kenacit ..2.3.5..

bhaviṣyanti parāmbhodhau jagatsargataraṅgakāḥ .
ye tāṃś ca parisaṅkhyātuṃ saṅkathaiva na vidyate ..2.3.6..

yā bhūtā yā bhaviṣyantyo jagatsargaparamparāḥ .
tāsāṃ vicāraṇaṃ yuktaṃ vartamānāsu kā kathā ..2.3.7..

tiryakpuruṣadevāder yo yo rāma vinaśyati .
tasminneva pradeśe 'sau tadaivedaṃ prapaśyati ..2.3.8..

ātivāhikanāmnāntas svahṛdyeva jagattrayam .
vyomni cittaśarīreṇa vyomātmānubhavatyajaḥ ..2.3.9..

evaṃ mṛtā mriyante ca mariṣyanti ca koṭayaḥ .
bhūtānāṃ yā jagantyāsāmuditāni pṛthak pṛthak ..2.3.10..

durvātabhūkampa iva piśācatrastabālavat .
muktālīvāmale vyomni nauspandataruyānavat ..2.3.11..

svapnasaṃvittipuravat smṛtijātakhavṛkṣavat .
jagatsaṃsaraṇaṃ svāntar mṛto 'nubhavati svayam ..2.3.12..

tatrātipariṇāmena tadeva ghanatāṃ gatam .
iha loko 'yamityeva jīvākāśe vijṛmbhate ..2.3.13..

punas tatraiva janmehāmaraṇādyanubhūtimān .
paralokaṃ kalpayati mṛtas tatra tathā punaḥ ..2.3.14..

tadantaranye puruṣās teṣāmantas tathā pare .
saṃsārā iti bhāntīme kadalīdalapīṭhavat ..2.3.15..

na pṛthvyādimahābhūtagaṇā na ca jagatkramāḥ .
mṛtānāṃ santi tatrāpi tathāpyeṣāṃ jagadbhramāḥ ..2.3.16..

avidyaivamananteyaṃ nānāprasavaśālinī .
jaḍānāṃ saridādīrghā jagatsargataraṅgiṇī ..2.3.17..

paramārthāmbudhau sphāre rāma sargataraṅgakāḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo vivartante ta evānye ca bhūriśaḥ ..2.3.18..

sarvatas sadṛśāẖ kecit kulakramamanoguṇaiḥ .
kecidardhena sadṛśāẖ kecic cātivilakṣaṇāḥ ..2.3.19..

imaṃ vyāsamuniṃ tatra dvātriṃśaṃ saṃsmarāmyaham .
yathāsambhavayā jñānadṛśā darśasamānayā ..2.3.20..

dvādaśānyadhiyas tatra kulākārehitais samāḥ .
daśa sarvasamākārāś śiṣṭāẖ kulavilakṣaṇāḥ ..2.3.21..

adyāpyanye bhaviṣyanti vyāsavālmīkayas tathā .
bhṛgvaṅgiraḫpulastyāś ca tathaivāthānya eva ca ..2.3.22..

nānāsurarṣidevānāṃ gaṇās sambhūya bhūriśaḥ .
utpadyante vilīyante kadācic ca pṛthak pṛthak ..2.3.23..

brahmadvāsaptates tretā āsīdasti bhaviṣyati .
sa evānyaś ca lokaś ca tvaṃ cāhaṃ ceti vedmyaham ..2.3.24..

krameṇāsya muneritthaṃ vyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ .
saṃlakṣyate 'vatāro 'yaṃ daśamo dīrghadarśinaḥ ..2.3.25..

abhūma vyāsavālmīkiyuktā vayamanekaśaḥ .
abhūma vayameveme nānākārās samāśayāḥ ..2.3.26..

bhāvyamadyāpyaneneha nanu vārāṣṭakaṃ punaḥ .
bhūyo 'pi bhārataṃ nāma svetihāsaṃ kariṣyati ..2.3.27..

kṛtvā vedavibhāgaṃ ca nītvānena kulaṃ prathām .
brahmatvaṃ ca tato gatvā bhāvyaṃ vaidehamokṣiṇā ..2.3.28..

vītaśokabhayaś śānto nirvāṇo gatakalpanaḥ .
jīvanmukto jitamanā vyāso 'yamiti varṇitaḥ ..2.3.29..

vittabandhuvayaẖkarmavidyāvijñānaceṣṭitaiḥ .
samāni santi bhūtāni sarge sarge punaḫ punaḥ ..2.3.30..

kvacit sargaśatais tāni bhavanti na bhavanti vā .
kadācidapi māyeyamitthamantavivarjitā ..2.3.31..

gacchatīyaṃ viparyāsaṃ bhūribhūtaparamparā .
bījarāśirivājasraṃ upyamānaḫ punaḫ punaḥ ..2.3.32..

tenaiva sanniveśena tathānyena punaḫ punaḥ .
sargākārāḫ pravartante taraṅgāẖ kālavāridheḥ ..2.3.33..

āśvastāntaẖkaraṇaẖ kṣīṇavikalpas svarūpasāramayaḥ .
paramaśamāmṛtatṛptas tiṣṭhati vidvān nirāvaraṇaḥ ..2.3.34..

saumyāmbutve taraṅgatve salilasyāmbutā yathā .
samaivābdhau tathādehasadehatvavimuktatā ..2.4.1..

sadehā vāstvadehā vā muktatā viṣayena vaḥ .
anāsvāditabhojyasya kuto bhojyānubhūtayaḥ ..2.4.2..

jīvanmuktaṃ muniśreṣṭha kevalaṃ hi padārthavat .
paśyāmaḫ purato nāsya punar vidmo 'ntarāśayam ..2.4.3..

sadehādehamuktānāṃ bhedaẖ ko 'bhedarūpiṇām .
yadevāmbu taraṅgatve saumyatve 'pi tadeva tat ..2.4.4..

na manāgapi bhedo 'sti sadehādehamuktayoḥ .
saspando 'stvatha vāspando vāyureva kilānilaḥ ..2.4.5..

sadehā vā videhā vā muktatā na pramāspadam .
asmākamasyās tu yadā svaikatāstyavibhāginī ..2.4.6..

tasmāt prakṛtamevedaṃ śṛṇu śravaṇabhūṣaṇam .
mayopadiśyamānaṃ tvaṃ jñānamajñāndhyanāśanam ..2.4.7..

sarvameveha hi sadā saṃsāre raghunandana .
samyakprayuktāt sarveṇa pauruṣāt samavāpyate ..2.4.8..

iha hīndorivodeti śītalāhlādanaṃ hṛdi .
parispandaphalaprāptau pauruṣādeva nānyataḥ ..2.4.9..

pauruṣaspandaphalavad dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣato na yat .
kalpitaṃ mohibhir mandair daivaṃ kiñcin na vidyate ..2.4.10..

sādhūpadeśaśāstreṇa yan mano'ṅgaviceṣṭitam .
tat pauruṣaṃ tat saphalamanyadunmattaceṣṭitam ..2.4.11..

yo 'yamarthaṃ kāmayate tadarthaṃ cehate kramāt .
avaśyaṃ tamavāpnoti na cedardhān nivartate ..2.4.12..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena trailokyaiśvaryasundarīm .
kaścit prāṇiviśeṣo hi śakratāṃ samupāgataḥ ..2.4.13..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena sahasāmbhoruhāspadām .
kaścideva cidullāso brahmatāmadhigacchati ..2.4.14..

sāreṇa puruṣārthena svenaiva garuḍadhvajām .
kaścideva pumāneṣa puruṣottamatāṃ gataḥ ..2.4.15..

pauruṣeṇaiva yatnena lalanāvalanākṛtim .
śarīrī kaścideveha gataś candrārdhacūḍatām ..2.4.16..

prāktanaṃ caihikaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ viddhi pauruṣam .
prāktano 'dyatanenāśu puruṣārthena jīyate ..2.4.17..

yatnavadbhir dṛḍhābhyāsaiḫ prajñotsāhasamanvitaiḥ .
meravo 'pi nigīryante kaiva prākpauruṣe kathā ..2.4.18..

śāstraniyantritapauruṣaparamā puruṣasya puruṣatā yā syāt .
abhimataphalabharasiddhyai bhavati hi sānyā tvanarthāya ..2.4.19..

kasyāñcit svayamātmadussthitivaśāt puṃso daśāyāṃ śanair
aṅgulyagranipīḍitaikaculukādācāma bindur bahuḥ .
kasyāñcij jalarāśiparvatapuradvīpāntarālaṅkṛtā
kartavyocitasaṃvibhāgakaraṇe pṛthvī na pṛthvī bhavet ..2.4.20..

pravṛttirevaṃ prathamaṃ yathāśāstraṃ vihāriṇām .
prabheva varṇabhedānāṃ sādhanī sarvakarmaṇām ..2.5.1..

manasā vāñchyate yat tu yathāśāstraṃ na karmaṇā .
sādhyate mattalīlāsau mohanī nārthasādhanī ..2.5.2..

yathā sañcetyate yena tathā tenānubhūyate .
svakarmaiveti vāstvanyā vyatiriktā na daivadṛk ..2.5.3..

ucchāstraṃ śāstritaṃ ceti pauruṣaṃ dvividhaṃ smṛtam .
tatrocchāstramanarthāya paramārthāya śāstritam ..2.5.4..

dvau huḍāviva yudhyete puruṣārthau samāsamau .
ātmīyaś cānyadīyaś ca jayatyatibalas tayoḥ ..2.5.5..

anarthaḫ prāpyate yatra śāstritādapi pauruṣāt .
anarthakartur balavat tatra jñeyaṃ svapauruṣam ..2.5.6..

paraṃ pauruṣamāśritya dantair dantān vicūrṇayan .
śubhenāśubhamudyuktaḫ prāktanaṃ pauruṣaṃ jayet ..2.5.7..

prāktanaḫ puruṣārtho 'sau māṃ niyojayatīti dhīḥ .
balādadhaspadīkāryā pratyakṣādadhikā na sā ..2.5.8..

tāvat tāvat prayatnena yatitavyaṃ svapauruṣam .
prāktanaṃ pauruṣaṃ yāvadaśubhaṃ śāmyati svayam ..2.5.9..

doṣaś śāmyatyasandehaṃ prāktano 'dyatanair guṇaiḥ .
dṛṣṭānto 'tra hyastanasya doṣasyādyaguṇaiẖ kṣayaḥ ..2.5.10..

asaddaivamadhaẖ kṛtvā nityamudyuktayā dhiyā .
saṃsārottaraṇaṃ bhūtyai yatetādhātumātmani ..2.5.11..

na gantavyamanudyogais sāmyaṃ puruṣagardabhaiḥ .
udyogas tu yathāśāstraṃ lokadvitayasiddhaye ..2.5.12..

saṃsārakuharādasmān nirgantavyaṃ svayaṃ balāt .
pauruṣaṃ yatnamāśritya hariṇevāripañjarāt ..2.5.13..

pratyahaṃ pratyavekṣeta naraś caritamātmanaḥ .
santyajet paśubhis tulyaṃ śrayet satpuruṣocitam ..2.5.14..

kiñcit kāntānnapānādikalilaṃ komalaṃ gṛhe .
vraṇe kīṭa ivāsvādya vayaẖ kāryaṃ na bhasmasāt ..2.5.15..

śubhena pauruṣeṇāśu śubhamāsādyate phalam .
aśubhenāśubhaṃ nityaṃ daivaṃ nāma na kiñcana ..2.5.16..

pratyakṣadṛṣṭamutsṛjya yo 'numānamanās tvasau .
svabhujābhyāmimau sarpāviti prekṣya palāyatām ..2.5.17..

daivaṃ samprerayati māmiti mugdhadhiyāṃ mukham .
adṛṣṭaśreṣṭhadṛṣṭīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmīr nivartate ..2.5.18..

tasmāt puruṣayatnena vivekaṃ pūrṇamāśrayet .
ātmajñānamayārthāni śāstrāṇi pravicārayet ..2.5.19..

citte cintayatāmarthaṃ yathāśāstraṃ nijehitaiḥ .
asaṃsādhayatāmeva mūḍhānāṃ dhig durīpsitam ..2.5.20..

pauruṣaṃ ca na cānantaṃ na yan nāmābhivāñchyate .
na yatnenāpi mahatā tailamāsādyate 'śmanaḥ ..2.5.21..

yathā ghaṭaḫ parimito yathā parimitaḫ paṭaḥ .
niyataḫ parimāṇasthaḫ puruṣārthas tathaiva vaḥ ..2.5.22..

sa ca śāstrārthasatsaṅgasamācārair nijaṃ phalam .
dadātīti svabhāvo 'yamanyathānarthasiddhaye ..2.5.23..

svarūpaṃ pauruṣasyaitadevaṃ vyavaharan naraḥ .
yāti niṣphalayatnatvaṃ na kadācana kaścana ..2.5.24..

dainyadāridryaduẖkhārtā apyanye puruṣottamāḥ .
pauruṣeṇaiva yatnena yātā devendratulyatām ..2.5.25..

ā bālyāc caivamabhyastaiś śāstrasatsaṅgamādibhiḥ .
guṇaiḫ puruṣayatnena svo 'rthas samprāpyate hi taiḥ ..2.5.26..

iti pratyakṣato dṛṣṭamanubhūtaṃ śrutaṃ kṛtam .
daivotthamiti manyante ye hatās te kubuddhayaḥ ..2.5.27..

ālasyaṃ yadi na bhavej jagatyanarthaẖ
ko na syād bahudhaniko bahuśruto vā .
ālasyādiyamavanis sasāgarāntā
sampūrṇā narapaśubhiś ca nirdhanaiś ca ..2.5.28..

bālye gate 'viratakalpitakelilole
paugaṇḍamaṇḍanavayaḫprabhṛti prayatnāt .
satsaṅgamaiḫ padapadārthavibuddhabuddhiẖ
kuryān naras svaguṇadoṣavicāraṇāni ..2.5.29..

ityuktavatyatha munau divaso jagāma
sāyantanāya vidhaye 'stamino jagāma .
snātuṃ sabhā kṛtanamaskaraṇā jagāma
śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiś ca sahājagāma ..2.5.30..

tasmāt prākpauruṣaṃ daivaṃ nānyat tat projjhya dūrataḥ .
sādhusaṅgamasacchāstrair jīvamuttārayed balāt ..2.6.1..

yathā yathā prayatnas syād bhavedāśu phalaṃ tathā .
iti pauruṣamevāsti daivamastu tadeva vaḥ ..2.6.2..

duẖkhād yathā duẖkhakāle hā kaṣṭamiti kathyate .
hākaṣṭaśabdaparyāyas tathā hā daivamityapi ..2.6.3..

prāksvakarmetarākāraṃ daivaṃ nāma na vidyate .
bālaḫ prabalapuṃseva taj jetumiha śakyate ..2.6.4..

hyastano duṣṭa ācāra ācāreṇādya cāruṇā .
yathāśu śubhatāṃ yāti prāktanaṃ kukṛtaṃ tathā ..2.6.5..

tajjayāya yatante ye na lābhalavalampaṭāḥ .
te mūḍhāḫ prākṛtā dīnās sthitā daivaparāyaṇāḥ ..2.6.6..

pauruṣeṇa kṛtaṃ karma daivād yadabhinaśyati .
tatra nāśayitur jñeyaṃ pauruṣaṃ balavattaram ..2.6.7..

yadekavṛntaphalayorapyekaṃ śūnyakoṭaram .
tatra prayatnas sphuritas tathā tadrasasaṃvidaḥ ..2.6.8..

yat prayānti jagadbhāvās saṃsiddhā api saṅkṣayam .
kṣayakārakayatnasya tatra jñeyaṃ mahad balam ..2.6.9..

bhikṣuko maṅgalebhena nṛpo yat kriyate balāt .
tadamātyebhapaurāṇāṃ prayatnasya mahat phalam ..2.6.10..

pauruṣeṇānnamākramya yathā dantair vicūrṇyate .
alpaṃ pauruṣamākramya tathā śūreṇa cūrṇyate ..2.6.11..

anubhūtaṃ hi mahatāṃ lāghavaṃ yatnaśālinām .
yatheṣṭaṃ viniyujyante te taiẖ karmasu loṣṭavat ..2.6.12..

śaktasya pauruṣaṃ dṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vāpi yad bhavet .
tad daivamityaśaktena buddhamātmanyabuddhinā ..2.6.13..

bhūtānāṃ balavadbhūtayatno daivamiti sthitam .
tasthuṣāmapyadhiṣṭhātṛvatāmetat sphuṭaṃ mithaḥ ..2.6.14..

śāstrāmātyebhapaurāṇāmavikalpyā svabhāvadhīḥ .
sā yā bhikṣukarājyasya kartrī dhartrī prajāsthiteḥ ..2.6.15..

aihikaḫ prāktanaṃ hanti prāktano 'dyatanaṃ balāt .
sarvadā puruṣaspandas tatrānudvegavāñ jayī ..2.6.16..

dvayoradyatanasyaiva pratyakṣād balitā bhavet .
daivaṃ jetumato yatnair bālo yūneva śakyate ..2.6.17..

meghena nīyate yad vā vatsaropārjitā kṛṣiḥ .
meghasya puruṣārtho 'sau jayatyadhikayatnavān ..2.6.18..

krameṇopārjite 'pyarthe naṣṭe kāryā na kheditā .
na balaṃ yatra me śaktaṃ tatra kā paridevanā ..2.6.19..

yan na śaknomi tasyārthe yadi duẖkhaṃ karomyaham .
tadamānitamṛtyor me yuktaṃ pratyaharodanam ..2.6.20..

deśakālakriyādravyavaśato visphurantyamī .
sarva eva jagadbhāvā jayatyadhikayatnavān ..2.6.21..

tasmāt pauruṣamāśritya sacchāstrais satsamāgamaiḥ .
prajñāmamalatāṃ nītvā saṃsārāmbunidhiṃ tara ..2.6.22..

prāktanaś caihikaś cemau puruṣārthau phaladrumau .
aihikaḫ puruṣārthaś ca jayatyabhyadhikas tayoḥ ..2.6.23..

karma yaḫ prāktanaṃ tucchaṃ na nihanti śubhehitaiḥ .
ajño janturanīśo 'sau vāṅmanassukhaduẖkhayoḥ ..2.6.24..

yas tūdāracamatkāras sadācāravihāravān .
sa niryāti jaganmohān mṛgendraḫ pañjarādiva ..2.6.25..

kaścin māṃ prerayatyevamityanarthakukalpane .
yas sthito dṛṣṭamutsṛjya tyājyo 'sau dūrato 'dhamaḥ ..2.6.26..

vyavahārasahasrāṇi yānyupāyānti yānti ca .
yathāśāstraṃ vihartavyaṃ teṣu tyaktvā sukhāsukhe ..2.6.27..

yathāśāstramanucchinnāṃ maryādāṃ svāmanujjhataḥ .
upatiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi ratnānyambunidheriva ..2.6.28..

svārthaprāpakakāryaikaprayatnaparatā budhaiḥ .
proktā pauruṣaśabdena sā siddhyai śāstrayantritā ..2.6.29..

kriyāyās spandadharmiṇyās svārthasādhakatā svayam .
sādhusaṅgamasacchāstratīkṣṇayābhyūhyate dhiyā ..2.6.30..

anantaṃ samatānandaṃ paramārthaṃ vidur budhāḥ .
sa yebhyaḫ prāpyate 'tyantaṃ te sevyāś śāstrasādhavaḥ ..2.6.31..

prāktanaṃ pauruṣaṃ tac ced daivaśabdena kathyate .
tad yuktametadetasmin nāmni nāpavadāmahe ..2.6.32..

mūḍhaiḫ prakalpitaṃ daivamanyad yais te kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .
nityaṃ svapauruṣādeva lokadvayahitaṃ bhavet ..2.6.33..

hyastanī duṣkriyābhyeti śobhāṃ satkriyayā yathā .
adyaivaṃ prāktanī tasmād yatnāt satkāryavān bhava ..2.6.34..

karāmalakavad dṛṣṭaṃ pauruṣādeva yat phalam .
mūḍhaḫ pratyakṣamutsṛjya daivamohe nimajjati ..2.6.35..

sakalakāraṇakāryavivarjitaṃ
nijavikalpabalādupakalpitam .
tadanapekṣya hi daivamasanmayaṃ
śraya śubhāśaya pauruṣamātmanaḥ ..2.6.36..

śāstrais sadācaritajṛṃbhitadeśadharmair
yat kalpitaṃ phalamatīva ciraprarūḍham .
tasmin hṛdi sphurati no 'parameti cittam
aṅgāvalī tadanu pauruṣametadāhuḥ ..2.6.37..

buddhvaiva pauruṣaphalaṃ puruṣatvametad
ātmaprayatnaparataiva sadaiva kāryā .
neyā tatas saphalatāṃ paramāmathāsau
sacchāstrasādhujanapaṇḍitasevanena ..2.6.38..

daivapauruṣavicāracārubhiś
cetasā caritamātmapauruṣam .
nityameva jayatīti bhāvitaiẖ
kārya āryajanasevanodyamaḥ ..2.6.39..

janmaprabandhamayamāmayameṣa jīvo
buddhvaihikaṃ sahajapauruṣameva siddhyai .
śāntiṃ nayatvavitathena varauṣadhena
pṛṣṭena tuṣṭiparapaṇḍitasevanena ..2.6.40..

prāpya vyādhivinirmuktaṃ dehamalpādhivedhitam .
tathātmānaṃ samādadhyād yathā bhūyo na jāyate ..2.7.1..

daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa yo 'tivartitumicchati .
iha cāmutra ca jayet sa sampūrṇābhivāñchitam ..2.7.2..

ye samudyogamutsṛjya sthitā daivaparāyaṇāḥ .
te dharmamarthakāmau ca nāśayantyātmavidviṣaḥ ..2.7.3..

saṃvitspando manasspanda indriyaspanda eva ca .
etāni puruṣārthasya rūpāṇyebhyaḫ phalodayaḥ ..2.7.4..

yathā saṃvedanaṃ cetas tathāntasspandamṛcchati .
tathaiva kāyaś calati tathaiva phalabhoktṛtā ..2.7.5..

ābālyametat saṃsiddhaṃ yatra tatra yathā tathā .
daivaṃ tu na kvacid dṛṣṭamato jayati pauruṣam ..2.7.6..

puruṣārthena deveśagurureṣa bṛhaspatiḥ .
śukro daityendragurutāṃ puruṣārthena cāsthitaḥ ..2.7.7..

dainyadāridryaduẖkhārtā api sādho narottamāḥ .
pauruṣeṇaiva yatnena yātā devendratulyatām ..2.7.8..

mahānto vibhavāḍhyā ye nānāścaryasamāśrayāḥ .
pauruṣeṇaiva doṣeṇa narakātithitāṃ gatāḥ ..2.7.9..

bhāvābhāvasahasreṣu daśāsu vividhāsu ca .
svapauruṣavaśādeva vivṛttā bhūtajātayaḥ ..2.7.10..

śāstrato gurutaś caiva svataś ceti trisiddhatā .
sarvatra puruṣārthasya na daivasya kadācana ..2.7.11..

aśubheṣu samāviṣṭaṃ śubheṣvevāvatārayet .
yatnena cittamityāśu sarvaśāstrārthasaṅgrahaḥ ..2.7.12..

yac chreyo yadatucchaṃ ca yadapāyavivarjitam .
tat tadācara yatnena putreti guravas sthitāḥ ..2.7.13..

yathā yathā prayatno me phalamāśu tathā tathā .
ityahaṃ pauruṣādeva phalabhāṅ na tu daivataḥ ..2.7.14..

pauruṣād dṛśyate siddhiḫ pauruṣo dhīmatāṃ kramaḥ .
daivamāśvāsanāmātraṃ duẖkhe pelavabuddhiṣu ..2.7.15..

pratyakṣapramukhān nityaṃ pramāṇāt pauruṣaẖ kramaḥ .
phalato dṛśyate loke deśāntaragamādikaḥ ..2.7.16..

bhoktā tṛpyati nābhoktā gantā gacchati nāgatiḥ .
vaktā vakti na cāvaktā pauruṣaṃ saphalaṃ nṛṇām ..2.7.17..

pauruṣeṇa durantebhyas saṅkaṭebhyas subuddhayaḥ .
samuttarantyayatnena na tu mūkatayānayā ..2.7.18..

yo yo yathā prayatate sa sa tadvat phalaikabhāk .
na tu tūṣṇīṃ sthiteneha kenacit prāpyate phalam ..2.7.19..

śubhena puruṣārthena śubhamāsādyate phalam .
aśubhenāśubhaṃ rāma yathecchasi tathā kuru ..2.7.20..

puruṣārthaphalaprāptir deśakālavaśādiha .
prāptā cireṇa śīghraṃ vā yāsau daivamiti smṛtā ..2.7.21..

na daivaṃ dṛśyate dṛṣṭyā na ca lokāntare sthitam .
uktaṃ daivābhidhānena svaṃ loke karmaṇaḫ phalam ..2.7.22..

puruṣo jāyate loke vardhate kṣīyate punaḥ .
na tatra dṛśyate daivaṃ jarāyauvanabālyavān ..2.7.23..

deśād deśāntaraprāptir hastasthadravyadhāraṇam .
vyāpāraś ca tathāṅgānāṃ pauruṣeṇa na daivataḥ ..2.7.24..

arthaprāpakakāryaikaprayatnaparatā budhaiḥ .
proktā pauruṣaśabdena sarvamāsādyate 'nayā ..2.7.25..

anarthaprāptikāryaikaprayatnaparatā tu yā .
soktā pronmattaceṣṭeti na kiñcit prāpyate 'nayā ..2.7.26..

kriyāyās spandadharmiṇyās svārthasādhakatā svayam .
sādhusaṅgamasacchāstratīkṣṇayonnīyate dhiyā ..2.7.27..

anantaṃ samatānandaṃ paramārthaṃ svakaṃ viduḥ .
tad yebhyaḫ prāpyate yatnāt te sevyāś śāstrasādhavaḥ ..2.7.28..

sacchāstrādiguṇo matyā sacchāstrādiguṇān matiḥ .
vardhete te mitho 'bhyāsāt sarobdāviva kālataḥ ..2.7.29..

ābālyādalamabhyastaiś śāstrasatsaṅgamādibhiḥ .
guṇaiḫ puruṣayatnena svo 'rthas samprāpyate hitaḥ ..2.7.30..

pauruṣeṇa jitā daityās sthāpitā bhuvanakriyāḥ .
racitāni jagantīha viṣṇunā na tu daivataḥ ..2.7.31..

jagati puruṣakārakāraṇe 'smin
kuru raghunātha ciraṃ tathā prayatnam .
vrajasi tarusarīsṛpābhidhānāṃ
subhaga yathā na daśāmaśaṅka eva ..2.7.32..

nākṛtir na ca karmāṇi nāspadaṃ na parākramaḥ .
tan mithyājñānavat prauḍhaṃ daivaṃ nāma kimucyate ..2.8.1..

svakarmaphalasamprāptāvidamitthamitīva yāḥ .
giras tā daivanāmnaitāḫ prasiddhiṃ samupāgatāḥ ..2.8.2..

tathaiva mūḍhamatibhir daivamastīti niścayaḥ .
ātto duravabodhena rajjāviva bhujaṅgamaḥ ..2.8.3..

hyastanī duṣkriyābhyeti śobhāṃ satkriyayā yathā .
adyaivaṃ prāktanī tasmād yatnāt satkāryavān bhava ..2.8.4..

mūḍhānumānasaṃsiddhaṃ daivaṃ yasyāsti durmateḥ .
daivād dāho 'stu mā veti vaktavyaṃ tena pāvake ..2.8.5..

daivameveha cet karma puṃsaẖ kimiva ceṣṭayā .
snānadānāśanācāraṃ daivameva kariṣyati ..2.8.6..

kiṃ vā śāstropadeśena mūko 'yaṃ puruṣaẖ kila .
sañcāryate tu daivena kiṃ kasyehopadiśyate ..2.8.7..

na ca nisspandatā loke dṛṣṭeha śavatāṃ vinā .
spandāś ca phalasamprāptis tasmād daivaṃ nirarthakam ..2.8.8..

na cāmūrtena daivena mūrtasya sahakartṛtā .
hastādīnīhataś caiva na daivena kvacit kṛtam ..2.8.9..

manobuddhivadapyetad daivaṃ nehānubhūyate .
āgopālaṃ kila prājñais tena daivamasat sadā ..2.8.10..

buddheś cet pṛthaganyo 'rthas saiva cet kānyatā tayoḥ .
kalpanā vā pramāṇaṃ cet pauruṣaṃ kiṃ na kalpyate ..2.8.11..

nāmūrtes tena saṅgo 'sti nabhaseva vapuṣmataḥ .
mūrtaṃ ca dṛśyate lagnaṃ tasmād daivaṃ na vidyate ..2.8.12..

viniyoktātha bhūtānāmastyanyas taj jagattraye .
śeratāṃ bhūtavṛndāni daivaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati ..2.8.13..

daivenetthaṃ niyukto 'smi kiṃ karomīdṛśaṃ sthitam .
samāśvāsanavāgeṣā na daivaṃ paramārthataḥ ..2.8.14..

mūḍhaiḫ prakalpitaṃ daivaṃ tatparās te kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .
prājñās tu puruṣārthena padamuttamamāgatāḥ ..2.8.15..

ye śūrā ye ca vikrāntā ye prājñā ye ca paṇḍitāḥ .
tais taiẖ kairiva loke 'smin vada daivaṃ pracakṣyate ..2.8.16..

kālavidbhir vinirṇītā yasyāsti cirajīvitā .
sa cej jīvati sañchinnaśirās tad daivamuttamam ..2.8.17..

kālavidbhir vinirṇītaṃ pāṇḍityaṃ yasya rāghava .
anadhyāpita evāsau tajjñaś ced daivamuttamam ..2.8.18..

viśvāmitreṇa muninā daivamutsṛjya dūrataḥ .
pauruṣeṇaiva samprāptaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ rāma nānyathā ..2.8.19..

amībhiraparai rāma puruṣair munitāṃ gataiḥ .
pauruṣeṇaiva samprāptā ciraṃ gaganagāmitā ..2.8.20..

utsādya devasaṅghātāṃś cakrus tribhuvanodare .
pauruṣeṇaiva yatnena sāmrājyaṃ dānaveśvarāḥ ..2.8.21..

ālūnaśīrṇamābhogi jagadājahrurojasā .
pauruṣeṇaiva yatnena dānavebhyas sureśvarāḥ ..2.8.22..

rāma pauruṣayuktyaiva salilaṃ dhāryate na vā .
ciraṃ karaṇḍake yuktyā na daivaṃ tatra kāraṇam ..2.8.23..

haraṇādānasaṃrambhavibhramabhramabhūmiṣu .
śaktatā dṛśyate rāma na daivasyauṣadheriva ..2.8.24..

sakalakāraṇakāryavivarjitaṃ
nijavikalpavaśādupakalpitam .
tvamanavekṣya hi daivamasanmayaṃ
śraya śubhāśaya pauruṣamuttamam ..2.8.25..

bhagavan sarvadharmajña pratiṣṭhāmalamāgatam .
yal loke tad vada brahman daivamevaṃ kimucyate ..2.9.1..

pauruṣaṃ sarvakāryāṇāṃ kartṛ rāghava netarat .
phalabhoktṛ ca sarvatra na daivaṃ tatra kāraṇam ..2.9.2..

daivaṃ na kiñcit kurute na ca bhuṅkte na vidyate .
na dṛśyate nādriyate kevalaṃ kalpanedṛśī ..2.9.3..

siddhasya pauruṣeṇeha phalasya phalaśālinām .
śubhāśubhā vā sampattir daivaśabdena kathyate ..2.9.4..

pauruṣopanatā nityamiṣṭāniṣṭasya vastunaḥ .
prāptiriṣṭāpyaniṣṭā vā daivaśabdena kathyate ..2.9.5..

bhāvī tvavaśyamevārthaḫ puruṣārthaikasādhanaḥ .
yas so 'smiṃl lokasaṅghāte daivaśabdena kathyate ..2.9.6..

na tu rāghava lokasya kasyacit kiñcideva hi .
daivamākāśakalpaṃ hi karoti na karoti vā ..2.9.7..

puruṣārthasya siddhasya śubhāśubhaphalodaye .
idamitthaṃ sthitiriti yoktis tad daivamucyate ..2.9.8..

itthaṃ mamābhavad buddhiritthaṃ me niścayo hyabhūt .
iti karmaphalāvāptir yoktis tad daivamucyate ..2.9.9..

iṣṭāniṣṭaphalāvāptāvevamityarthavācakam .
āśvāsanāmātravaco daivamityeva kathyate ..2.9.10..

bhagavan sarvadharmajña prāg yat karmopasañcitam .
tadetad daivamityuktamapamṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ tvayā ..2.9.11..

sādhu rāghava jānāsi śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te 'khilam .
daivaṃ nāstīti te yena sthirā buddhir bhaviṣyati ..2.9.12..

yā magnā vāsanā pūrvaṃ babhūva kila bhūriśaḥ .
saiveyaṃ karmabhāvena nṝṇāṃ pariṇatiṃ gatā ..2.9.13..

jantur yadvāsano nāma tatkarmā bhavati kṣaṇāt .
anyakarmānyabhāvaś cetyetan naivopapadyate ..2.9.14..

grāmago grāmamāpnoti pattanārthī ca pattanam .
yo yo yadvāsanas tat tat sa sa prayatate tathā ..2.9.15..

yadeva tīvrasaṃvegādiha karma kṛtaṃ purā .
tadeva daivaśabdena paryāyeṇa hi kathyate ..2.9.16..

evaṃ daivaṃ svakarmāṇi karma prauḍhā svavāsanā .
vāsanā manaso nānyā mano hi puruṣas smṛtaḥ ..2.9.17..

yad daivaṃ tāni karmāṇi karma sādho mano hi tat .
mano hi puruṣas tasmād daivaṃ nāstīti niścayaḥ ..2.9.18..

ekameva mano jantor yathā prayatate hi yat .
nūnaṃ tat tadavāpnoti svata eva na daivataḥ ..2.9.19..

manaś cittaṃ vāsanā ca karma daivaṃ svaniścayaḥ .
rāma puṃniścayasyaitās sañjñās sadbhirudāhṛtāḥ ..2.9.20..

evaṃnāmā hi puruṣo dṛḍhabhāvanayā yathā .
nityaṃ prayatate rāma phalamāpnotyalaṃ tathā ..2.9.21..

evaṃ puruṣakāreṇa sarvameva raghūdvaha .
prāpyate netareṇeha tasmāt sa śubhado 'stu te ..2.9.22..

prāktanaṃ vāsanājālaṃ niyojayati māṃ yathā .
mune tathaiva tiṣṭhāmi kṛpaṇaẖ kiṃ karomyaham ..2.9.23..

ata eva hi he rāma śreyaḫ prāpnoṣi śāśvatam .
svaprayatnopanītena pauruṣeṇaiva nānyathā ..2.9.24..

dvividho vāsanāvyūhaś śubhaś caivāśubhaś ca te .
prāktano vidyate rāma dvayorekataro 'tha vā ..2.9.25..

vāsanaughena śuddhena tatra cedadya nīyase .
tat krameṇa śubhenaiva padaṃ prāpnoṣi śāśvatam ..2.9.26..

atha cedaśubho bhāvas tvāṃ yojayati saṅkaṭe .
prāktanas tadasau yatnāj jetavyo bhavatā balāt ..2.9.27..

prājña cetanamātraṃ tvaṃ na dehas tvaṃ jaḍātmakaḥ .
tadeva cetasyanyena cet tat tvaṃ kveva vidyase ..2.9.28..

anyas tvāṃ cetayati cet tat tvayyasati ko 'paraḥ .
kamimaṃ cetayet tasmādanavasthā na vāstavī ..2.9.29..

śubhāśubhābhyāṃ mārgābhyāṃ vahantī vāsanāsarit .
pauruṣeṇa prayatnena yojanīyā śubhe pathi ..2.9.30..

aśubheṣu samāviṣṭaṃ śubheṣvevāvatārayet .
svamanaḫ puruṣārthena balena balināṃ vara ..2.9.31..

aśubhāc calitaṃ yāti śubhaṃ tasmādapītarat .
jantoś cittaṃ tu paśuvat tasmāt tat pālayet sadā ..2.9.32..

samatāsāntvanenāśu na drāgiti śanaiś śanaiḥ .
pauruṣeṇa prayatnena pālayec cittabālakam ..2.9.33..

vāsanaughas tvayā pūrvamabhyāsena ghanīkṛtaḥ .
śubho vāpyaśubho rāma śubhamadya ghanīkuru ..2.9.34..

prāgabhyāsavaśād yātā yadā te vāsanodayam .
tadābhyāsasya sāphalyaṃ viddhi tvamarimardana ..2.9.35..

idānīmapi te yāti ghanatāṃ vāsanānagha .
abhyāsavaśatas tasmāc chubhābhyāsamupāhara ..2.9.36..

pūrvaṃ ced ghanatāṃ yātā nābhyāsāt tava vāsanā .
vardhiṣyate tu nedānīmapi tāta sukhī bhava ..2.9.37..

sandigdhāyāmapi bhṛśaṃ śubhameva samāhara .
asyāṃ tu vāsanāvṛddhau śubhād doṣo na kaścana ..2.9.38..

yad yadabhyasyate loke tanmayenaiva bhūyate .
ityākumāraṃ prājñeṣu dṛṣṭaṃ sandehavarjitam ..2.9.39..

śubhavāsanayā yuktas tadatra bhava bhūtaye .
paraṃ pauruṣamāśritya vijityendriyapañcakam ..2.9.40..

avyutpannamanā yāvad bhavānajñātatatpadaḥ .
guruśāstrapramāṇais tu nirṇītaṃ tāvadācara ..2.9.41..

tataẖ kaṣāyapākena nūnaṃ vijñātavastunā .
śubho 'pyasau tvayā tyājyo bhāvanaugho nirādhinā ..2.9.42..

yadatisubhagamāryasevitaṃ tac
chubhamanusṛtya manojñabhāvabuddhyā .
adhigamaya padaṃ sadā viśokaṃ
tadanu tadapyavamucya sādhu tiṣṭha ..2.9.43..

ataḫ pauruṣamāśritya śreyase nityabāndhavam .
ekāgraṃ kuru cittaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama ..2.10.1..

avāntarābhipātīni svārūḍhāni manoratham .
pauruṣeṇendriyāṇyāśu saṃyamya samatāṃ naya ..2.10.2..

ihāmutra ca siddhyarthaṃ puruṣārthaphalapradām .
mokṣopāyamayīṃ vakṣye saṃhitāṃ sārasammitām ..2.10.3..

apunargrahaṇāyāntas tyaktvā saṃsāravāsanām .
sampūrṇau śamasantoṣāvādāyodārayā dhiyā ..2.10.4..

sapūrvāparavākyārthavicāraviṣayādṛtam .
manas samarasaṃ kṛtvā sānusandhānamātmani ..2.10.5..

sukhaduẖkhakṣayakaraṃ mahānandaikasādhanam .
mokṣopāyamito rāma vakṣyamāṇaṃ imaṃ śṛṇu ..2.10.6..

imāṃ mokṣakathāṃ śrutvā saha sarvair vivekibhiḥ .
padaṃ yāsyasi nirduẖkhaṃ nāśo yatra na vidyate ..2.10.7..

idamuktaṃ purākalpe brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā .
sarvaduẖkhakṣayakaraṃ paramāśvāsanaṃ dhiyaḥ ..2.10.8..

kenoktaṃ kāraṇenedaṃ brahman pūrvaṃ svayambhuvā .
kathaṃ ca bhavatā prāptametat kathaya me prabho ..2.10.9..

astyanantavilāsātmā sarvagas sarvasaṃśrayaḥ .
cidākāśo 'vināśātmā pradīpas sarvavastuṣu ..2.10.10..

spandāspandasamākārāt tato viṣṇurajāyata .
spandamānarasāpūrāt taraṅgas sāgarādiva ..2.10.11..

sumerukarṇikāt tasya digdalād dhṛdayāmbujāt .
tārakākesaravataḫ parameṣṭhī vyajāyata ..2.10.12..

vedavedārthadeveśamunimaṇḍalamālitam .

jambudvīpasya koṇe 'smin varṣe bhāratanāmani .

bhāvābhāvaviṣaṇṇārthamutpātadhvaṃsatatparam .

janasya tasya duẖkhaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā sakalalokakṛt .

ka eteṣāṃ hatāśānāṃ duẖkhasyānto hatāyuṣām .
syāditi kṣaṇamekāgraś cintayāmāsa bhūtapaḥ ..2.10.17..

iti sañcintya bhagavān sasarja punarīśvaraḥ .
tapo dharmaṃ ca dānaṃ ca satyaṃ tīrthāni caiva ha ..2.10.18..

etat sṛṣṭvā punar devaś cintayāmāsa bhūtakṛt .
puṃsāṃ nānena sarvasya duẖkhasyānta iti svayam ..2.10.19..

nirvāṇaṃ nāma paramaṃ sukhaṃ yena punar janaḥ .
na jāyate na mriyate taj jñānādeva labhyate ..2.10.20..

saṃsārottaraṇe jantorupāyo jñānameva hi .
tapo dānaṃ tathā tīrthamaṇūpāyaḫ prakīrtitaḥ ..2.10.21..

tat tāvad duẖkhamokṣārthaṃ janasyāsya mahātmanaḥ .
pratyagraṃ taraṇopāyamāśu prakaṭayāmyaham ..2.10.22..

iti sañcintya bhagavān brahmā kamalasaṃsthitaḥ .
manasā parisaṅkalpya māmutpāditavānimam ..2.10.23..

kuto 'pyutpanna evāśu tato 'haṃ samupasthitaḥ .
pitus tasya puraś śīghramūrmerūrmirivānagha ..2.10.24..

kamaṇḍaludharo nāthas sakamaṇḍalunā mayā .

mṛgakṛttiparīdhāno mṛgakṛttinijāmbaram .

muhūrtamātraṃ te putra ceto vānaracañcalam .
ajñānamabhyāviśatu śaśaś śaśadharaṃ yathā ..2.10.28..

iti tenāśu śaptas san vicārasamanantaram .
ahaṃ vismṛtavān sarvaṃ svarūpamamalaṃ dvijaḥ ..2.10.29..

athāhaṃ dīnatāṃ yātas sthitas sambuddhayā dhiyā .
duẖkhaśokābhisantapto jāto jana ivādhamaḥ ..2.10.30..

kaṣṭaṃ saṃsāranāmāyaṃ doṣaẖ kathamivāgataḥ .
iti cintitavānantas tūṣṇīmeva vyavasthitaḥ ..2.10.31..

athābhyadhāt sa māṃ tātaḫ putra kiṃ duẖkhavānasi .
duẖkhopaghātaṃ māṃ pṛccha sukhī nityaṃ bhaviṣyasi ..2.10.32..

tataḫ pṛṣṭas sa bhagavān mayā sakalalokakṛt .
haimapadmadalasthena saṃsāravyādhibheṣajam ..2.10.33..

kathaṃ nāma mahad duẖkhamayaṃ saṃsāra āgataḥ .
kathaṃ ca kṣīyate jantoriti pṛṣṭena tena me ..2.10.34..

taj jñānaṃ subahu proktaṃ yaj jñātvā pāvanaṃ param .
ahaṃ piturapi prāyaẖ kilādhika iva sthitaḥ ..2.10.35..

tato viditavedyaṃ māṃ nijaprakṛtimāsthitam .
sa uvāca jagatkartā vaktā sakalakāraṇam ..2.10.36..

śāpenājñapadaṃ nītvā pṛcchakas tvaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .
putrāsya jñānasārasya samastajanasiddhaye ..2.10.37..

idānīṃ śāntaśāpas tvaṃ paraṃ bodhamupāgataḥ .
saṃsthito 'hamivaikātmā kanakaṃ kanakādiva ..2.10.38..

gacchedānīṃ mahīpīṭhe jambudvīpāntarasthitam .
sādho bhāratavarṣaṃ tvaṃ lokānugrahahetunā ..2.10.39..

tatra kriyākāṇḍaparās tvayā putra mahādhiyaḥ .
upadeśyāẖ kriyākāṇḍakrameṇa kramaśālinaḥ ..2.10.40..

viraktacittāś ca tathā mahāprajñā virāgiṇaḥ .
upadeśyās tvayā sādho jñānenānandadāyinā ..2.10.41..

iti tena niyukto 'haṃ pitrā kamalayoninā .
iha rāghava tiṣṭhāmi yāvad bhūtaparamparā ..2.10.42..

kartavyamasti mama neha hi kiñcideva
sthātavyamityabhimanā bhuvi saṃsthito 'smi .
saṃśāntayā satatasuptadhiyeva vṛttyā
kāryaṃ karomi na ca kiñcidahaṃ karomi ..2.10.43..

etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jñānāvataraṇaṃ bhuvi .
mayā svamīhitaṃ caiva kamalodbhavakalpitam ..2.11.1..

tadidaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ śrotumadya tavānagha .
bhṛśamutkaṇṭhitaṃ ceto mahatas sukṛtodayāt ..2.11.2..

kathaṃ brahman bhagavato loke jñānāvatāraṇe .
sargādanantaraṃ buddhiḫ pravṛttā parameṣṭhinaḥ ..2.11.3..

parame brahmaṇi brahmā svabhāvavaśatas svayam .
jātas spandamayo nityamūrmirambunidhāviva ..2.11.4..

sṛṣṭvaivamātataṃ sargaṃ sargasya sakalā gatīḥ .
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyatsthā dadarśa parameśvaraḥ ..2.11.5..

satkriyākramakālasya kṛtādeẖ kṣaya āgate .
mohamālokya lokānāṃ kāruṇyamagamat prabhuḥ ..2.11.6..

tato māmīśvaras sṛṣṭvā jñānenāyojya cāsakṛt .
visasarja mahīpīṭhe lokasyājñānaśāntaye ..2.11.7..

yathāhaṃ prahitas tena tathānye 'pi maharṣayaḥ .
sanatkumārapramukhā nāradādyāś ca bhūriśaḥ ..2.11.8..

kriyākrameṇa puṇyena tathā jñānakrameṇa ca .
manomahāmayottabdhamuddhartuṃ lokamīritāḥ ..2.11.9..

maharṣibhis tatas tais tu kṣīṇe kṛtayuge purā .
kramāt kriyākrame śuddhe pṛthivyāṃ tanutāṃ gate ..2.11.10..

kriyākramavidhānārthaṃ maryādāniyamāya ca .
pṛthagdeśavibhāgena bhūpālāḫ parikalpitāḥ ..2.11.11..

bahūni smṛtiśāstrāṇi yajñaśāstrāṇi cāvanau .
dharmakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ kalpitānyuditānyatha ..2.11.12..

kālacakre vahatyasmiṃs tato vigalite krame .
pratyahaṃ bhojanapare jane śālyarjanonmukhe ..2.11.13..

dvandvāni sampravṛttāni viṣayārthaṃ mahībhujām .
daṇḍyatāṃ samprayātāni bhūtāni bhuvi bhūriśaḥ ..2.11.14..

tato yuddhaṃ vinā bhūpā mahīṃ pālayituṃ kramāt .
asamarthās tadāyātāḫ prajābhis saha dīnatām ..2.11.15..

teṣāṃ dainyāpanodārthaṃ samyaksṛṣṭikramāya ca .
tato 'smadādibhiḫ proktā mahatyo jñānadṛṣṭayaḥ ..2.11.16..

adhyātmavidyā teneyaṃ pūrvaṃ rājasu varṇitā .
tadanu prasṛtā loke rājavidyetyudāhṛtā ..2.11.17..

rājavidyā rājaguhyamadhyātmagranthamuttamam .
jñātvā rāghava rājānaḫ parāṃ nirduẖkhatāṃ gatāḥ ..2.11.18..

atha rājasvatīteṣu bahuṣvamalakīrtiṣu .
asmād daśarathād rāma jāto 'dya tvamihāvanau ..2.11.19..

tava cātiprasanne 'smiñ jātaṃ manasi pāvanam .
nirnimittamidaṃ cāru vairāgyamarimardana ..2.11.20..

sarvasyaiva hi bhavyasya sādhorapi vivekinaḥ .
nimittapūrvaṃ vairāgyaṃ jāyate rāma rājasam ..2.11.21..

idaṃ tvapūrvamutpannaṃ camatkārakaraṃ satām .
tavānimittaṃ vairāgyaṃ sāttvikaṃ svavivekajam ..2.11.22..

bībhatsaṃ viṣamaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko nāma na virajyate .
satāṃ tūttamavairāgyaṃ vivekādeva jāyate ..2.11.23..

te mahānto mahāprajñā nimittena vinaiva hi .
vairāgyaṃ jāyate yeṣāṃ ta evāmalamānasāḥ ..2.11.24..

svavivekacamatkāraparāmarśaviraktayā .
rājate hi dhiyā jantur yuveva vanamālayā ..2.11.25..

parāmṛśya vivekena saṃsāraracanāmimām .
virāgaṃ ye 'dhigacchanti ta eva puruṣottamāḥ ..2.11.26..

svavivekavaśādeva vicāryedaṃ punaḫ punaḥ .
indrajālaṃ parityājyaṃ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ balāt ..2.11.27..

śmaśānamāpadaṃ dainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko na virajyate .
tad vairāgyaṃ paraṃ śreyas svato yadabhijāyate ..2.11.28..

akṛtrimavirāgas tvaṃ mahattāmalamāgataḥ .
yogyo 'si jñānasārasya bījasyeva mṛdusthalam ..2.11.29..

prasādāt parameśasya nāthasya paramātmanaḥ .
tvādṛśasya śubhā buddhir vivekamanudhāvati ..2.11.30..

kriyākrameṇa mahatā tapasā niyamena ca .
dānena tīrthayātrābhiś cirakālavivekataḥ ..2.11.31..

duṣkṛte kṣayamāpanne paramārthavicāraṇe .
kākatālīyayogena buddhir jantoḫ pravartate ..2.11.32..

kriyāparās tāvadalaṃ cakrāvṛttibhirādṛtāḥ .
bhramantīha janā yāvan na paśyanti paraṃ padam ..2.11.33..

yathābhūtamimaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsāraṃ tanmayīṃ dhiyam .
parityajya paraṃ yānti nirālānā gajā iva ..2.11.34..

viṣameyamanantehā rāma saṃsārasaṃsṛtiḥ .
dehamuktā mahātantur vinā jñānaṃ na naśyati ..2.11.35..

jñānayuktiplavenaiva saṃsārābdhiṃ sudustaram .
mahādhiyas samuttīrṇā netareṇa raghūdvaha ..2.11.36..

tāmimāṃ jñānayuktiṃ tvaṃ saṃsārāmbhodhitāriṇīm .
śṛṇuṣvāvahito buddhyā nityāvahitayānayā ..2.11.37..

yasmādanantasaṃrambhā jagato duẖkharītayaḥ .
cirāyāntar dahantyetā vinā yuktimanindita ..2.11.38..

śītavātātapādīni dvandvaduẖkhāni rāghava .
jñānayuktiṃ vinā kena sahyatāṃ yānti sādhuṣu ..2.11.39..

āpatanti pratipadaṃ yathākālaṃ dahanti ca .
duẖkhacintā naraṃ mūḍhaṃ tṛṇamagniśikhā iva ..2.11.40..

prājñaṃ vijñātavijñānaṃ samyagdarśinamādhayaḥ .
na dahanti vanaṃ varṣadabdamagniśikhā iva ..2.11.41..

ādhivyādhiparāvarte saṃsāramarumārute .
kṣubhite 'pi na tattvajño bhajyate kalpavṛkṣavat ..2.11.42..

tattvaṃ jñātumato yatnād dhīmāneva hi dhīmatā .
prāmāṇikaḫ prabuddhātmā praṣṭavyaḫ praṇayānvitaṃ ..2.11.43..

prāmāṇikasya pṛṣṭasya vakturuttamacetasā .
yatnena vacanaṃ grāhyamaṃśukeneva kuṅkumam ..2.11.44..

atattvajñamanādeyavacanaṃ vāgvidāṃ vara .
yaḫ pṛcchati naraṃ tasmān nāsti mūḍhataro 'paraḥ ..2.11.45..

prāmāṇikasya tajjñasya vaktuḫ pṛṣṭasya yatnataḥ .
nānutiṣṭhati yo vākyaṃ nānyas tasmān narādhamaḥ ..2.11.46..

tajjñatātajjñate pūrvaṃ vaktur nirṇīya kāryataḥ .
yaẖ karoti naraḫ praśnaṃ pṛcchakas sa mahāmatiḥ ..2.11.47..

anirṇīya pravaktāraṃ bālaḫ praśnaṃ karoti yaḥ .
adhamaḫ pṛcchakas sa syān na mahārthasya bhājanam ..2.11.48..

pūrvāparasamādhānakṣamabuddhāvanindite .
pṛṣṭaṃ prājñena vaktavyaṃ nādhame paśudharmiṇi ..2.11.49..

prāmāṇikārthayogyatvaṃ pṛcchakasyāvicārya vā .
yo vakti tamiha prājñāḫ prāhur mūḍhatamaṃ naram ..2.11.50..

tvamatīva guṇādhāraḫ pṛcchako raghunandana .
ahaṃ ca vaktuṃ jānāmi sa ca yogo 'yamāvayoḥ ..2.11.51..

yadahaṃ vacmi tad yatnāt tvayā śabdārthakovida .
etad vastviti nirṇīya hṛdi kāryamakhaṇḍitaṃ ..2.11.52..

mahānasi virakto 'si tajjño 'si janatāsthitau .
tvayi vastu lagatyantaẖ kuṅkumāmbu yathāṃśuke ..2.11.53..

suktāvadhānaparamā paramārthavivecanī .
viśatyarthaṃ tava prajñā jalamadhyamivārkabhā ..2.11.54..

yad yad vacmi tavādeyaṃ hṛdi kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ .
na cet praṣṭavya evāhaṃ na tvayeha nirarthakam ..2.11.55..

mano hi capalaṃ rāma saṃsāravanamarkaṭam .
saṃrodhya hṛdi yatnena śrotavyā paramārthadhīḥ ..2.11.56..

avivekinamajñānamasajjanaratiṃ janam .
ciraṃ dūrataraṃ kṛtvā pūjanīyā hi sādhavaḥ ..2.11.57..

nityaṃ sajjanasamparkād viveka upajāyate .
vivekapādapasyaite bhogamokṣau phale smṛte ..2.11.58..

mokṣadvāre dvārapālāś catvāraḫ parikīrtitāḥ .
śamo vicāras santoṣaś caturthas sādhusaṅgamaḥ ..2.11.59..

ete sevyāḫ prayatnena catvāro dvau trayo 'tha vā .
dvāramudghāṭayantyete mokṣarājagṛhe balāt ..2.11.60..

ekaṃ vā sarvayatnena prāṇāṃs tyaktvā samāśrayet .
etasmin vaśage yānti catvāro 'pi vaśaṃ yataḥ ..2.11.61..

saviveko hi śāstrasya jñānasya tapaso dyuteḥ .
bhājanaṃ bhūṣaṇākāro bhāskaras tejasāmiva ..2.11.62..

ghanatāmupayātaṃ hi prajñāmāndyamacetasām .
yāti sthāvaratāmambu jāḍyāt pāṣāṇatāmiva ..2.11.63..

tvaṃ tu rāghava saujanyaguṇaśāstrārthadṛṣṭibhiḥ .
vikāsitāntaẖkaraṇas sthitaḫ padma ivodaye ..2.11.64..

imāṃ jñānadṛśaṃ śrotumavaboddhuṃ ca sanmate .
arhasyuddhṛtakarṇas tu jantur vīṇādhvaniṃ yathā ..2.11.65..

vairāgyābhyāsayogena samasaujanyasampadā .
tat padaṃ prāpyate rāma yatra nāśo na vidyate ..2.11.66..

śāstrais sujanasamparkapūrvakais sutapodamaiḥ .
ādau saṃsāramuktyarthaṃ prajñāmevābhivardhayet ..2.11.67..

saṃsāraviṣavṛkṣograsekamāspadamāpadām .
añjanaṃ mohayāminyā maurkhyaṃ yatnena nāśayet ..2.11.68..

etadeva ca maurkhyasya paramaṃ viddhi nāśanam .
yadidaṃ prekṣyate śāstraṃ kiñcitsaṃskṛtayā dhiyā ..2.11.69..

durāśāsarpagartena maurkhyeṇa hṛdi valgatā .
cetas sañkocamāyāti carmāgnāviva yojitam ..2.11.70..

prājñe yathārthabhūteyaṃ vastudṛṣṭiḫ prasīdati .
dṛgivendau nirambhodasakalāmalamaṇḍale ..2.11.71..

pūrvāparavicārārthacārucāturyaśālinī .
savikāsā matir yasya sa pumāniti kathyate ..2.11.72..

vikasitena sitena manomuṣā
varavicāraṇaśītalarociṣā .
guṇavatā hṛdayena virājase
tvamamalena nabhaś śaśinā yathā ..2.11.73..

paripūrṇamanā mānyaḫ praṣṭuṃ jānāsi rāghava .
vetsi coktaṃ ca tenāhaṃ pravṛtto vaktumādarāt ..2.12.1..

rajastamobhyāṃ rahitāṃ śuddhasattvānupātinīm .
matimātmani saṃsthāpya jñānaṃ śrotuṃ sthiro bhava ..2.12.2..

vidyate tvayi sarvaiva pṛcchakasya guṇāvalī .
vaktur guṇālī ca mayi ratnaśrīr jaladhau yathā ..2.12.3..

āttavānasi vairāgyaṃ vivekāsaṅgajaṃ mune .
candrakānta ivārdratvaṃ lagnacandrakarotkaraḥ ..2.12.4..

ciramā śaiśavādeva tavābhyāso 'sti sadguṇaiḥ .
śuddhaiś śuddhasya dīrghaiś ca padmasyevātisantataiḥ ..2.12.5..

ataś śṛṇu kathāṃ vakṣye tvamevāsyā hi bhājanam .
na hi candraṃ vinā śuddhā savikāsā kumudvatī ..2.12.6..

ye kecana samārambhā yāś ca kāścana dṛṣṭayaḥ .
te ca tāś ca pade dṛṣṭe niśśeṣaṃ yānti vai śamam ..2.12.7..

yadi vijñānaviśrāntir na bhaved bhavyacetasaḥ .
tadasyāṃ saṃsṛtau sādhuś cintāṃ soḍhuṃ saheta kaḥ ..2.12.8..

paraprāptyā vilīyante sarvā mananavṛttayaḥ .
kalpāntārkagaṇāsaṅgāt kulaśailaśilā iva ..2.12.9..

dussahā rāma saṃsāraviṣāveśaviṣūcikā .
yogagāruḍamantreṇa pāvanena praśāmyati ..2.12.10..

sa ca yogas sujanena saha śāstrārthavicārāt . paramārthajñānamayo labhyate eva . ..2.12.11..

avaśyamiha hi vicāre kṛte sakaladuẖkhaparikṣayo bhavatīti mantavyam . ..2.12.12..

nāto vicāradṛṣṭayo 'vahelayā draṣṭavyāḥ . vicāravaśataḫ puruṣeṇa sakalamidamādhipañjaraṃ sarpeṇa tvacamiva paripakvāṃ parityajya vigatajvareṇa śītalāntaẖkaraṇena vinoda iva jagadakhilamālokyate samyagdarśanavatā . ..2.12.13..

asamyagdarśanavato hi paraṃ duẖkhamidam . viṣamo hyayamatitarāṃ saṃsārarogo bhogīva daśati . asiriva cchinatti . śara iva vedhayati . rajjuriva veṣṭayati . pāvaka iva dahati . rātririvāndhayati . aśaṅkitaparipātitaparuṣapāṣāṇa iva vivaśīkaroti . harati prajñām . nāśayati sthitim . pātayati mohāndhakūpe . tṛṣṇayā jarjarīkaroti . na tadasti kiñcid duẖkhaṃ saṃsārī yan nāpnoti . ..2.12.14..

duranteyaṃ kila viṣayaviṣamaviṣaviṣūcikā . yadi na cikitsyate tadatitarāṃ narakanagaranikaraphalānubandhinī tat tat karoti . yatra śitāsiśatapāta utpalatāḍanam . agnidāho himāvaseko . 'ṅgavikartanaṃ candanacakrakaracanā . ghūrṇadvātāntaḫ paripeṣo 'ṅgaparimālanam . anavaratānalajvālāvicalitacāmaranārācanikaranipāto nidāghavinodanadhārāgṛhaśīkaravarṣaṇam . śiraśchedas sukhanidrā . mūkīkaraṇaṃ pāṭavamudrā mahānupacayaḥ . ..2.12.15..

tadevaṃvidhe kaṣṭaceṣṭāsahasradāruṇe saṃsāracapalayantre 'smin rāghava nāvahelā kartavyā . avaśyamidaṃ hi vicāraṇīyam . ..2.12.16..

evaṃ cāvaboddhavyam yathā kilāsti vicārāc chreyo'vāptiriti . ..2.12.17..

anyac ca raghukulendo . yadi naite mahānto munayo maharṣayaś ca viprāś ca rājānaś ca jñānakavacenāvaguṇṭhitaśarīrās tat kathamaduẖkhakṣamā api duẖkhamayīṃ tamovṛttipūrvakaṃ saṃsārakadarthanāmanubhavantas satatameva muditamanasas tiṣṭhanti . ..2.12.18..

iha hi .
vikautukā vigatavikalpaviplavā
yathā sthitā hariharapadmajādayaḥ .
narottamās samadhigatātmadīpakās
tathā sthitā jagati vibuddhabuddhayaḥ ..2.12.19..

tathā ca .
parikṣīṇe mohe galati ca ghane 'jñānajalade
parijñāte tattve samadhigata ātmanyabhimate .
vicāryāryais sārdhaṃ galitavapuṣor vā sadasator
dhiyā dṛṣṭe tattve ramaṇamaṭanaṃ jāgatamidam ..2.12.20..

anyac ca rāghava .
prasanne cittattve hṛdi savibhave valgati pare
samābhogībhūtāsvakhilakalanādṛṣṭiṣu puraḥ .
śamaṃ yāntīṣvantaẖkaraṇaghaṭanāsvāhitarasaṃ
dhiyā dṛṣṭe tattve ramaṇamaṭanaṃ jāgatamidam ..2.12.21..

anyac ca .
rathas sphāro dehas turagaracanā cendriyagatiḥ
parispando vātādahamakalitānantaviṣamaḥ .
paro vārvāg dehī jagati viharāmītyanaghayā
dhiyā dṛṣṭe tattve ramaṇamaṭanaṃ jāgatamidam ..2.12.22..

etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya puṣṭātmānas subuddhayaḥ .
vicarantyasamunnaddhā mahānto 'bhyuditā iva ..2.13.1..

na śocanti na yācante na vāñchanti śubhāśubham .
sarvameva ca kurvanti kurvanti na ca kiñcana ..2.13.2..

svasthamevāvatiṣṭhanti svasthaṃ kurvanti yānti ca .
heyopādeyatāpakṣarahitās svātmani sthitāḥ ..2.13.3..

āyānti ca na cāyānti vanaṃ yānti na yānti ca .
na kurvantyapi kurvanti na vadanti vadanti ca ..2.13.4..

ye kecana samārambhā yāś ca kāścana dṛṣṭayaḥ .
heyādeyadṛśo yās tāẖ kṣīyante 'dhigate pade ..2.13.5..

parityaktasamastehaṃ mano madhuravṛttimat .
sarvatas sukhamabhyeti candrabimba iva sthitam ..2.13.6..

api nirmananārambhamapyastākhilakautukam .
ātmanyeva na mātyantarindāviva rasāyanam ..2.13.7..

na karotīndrajālāni nānudhāvati vāsanām .
bālacāpalamutsṛjya pūrṇameva virājate ..2.13.8..

evaṃvidhā hi vṛttaya ātmatattvāvalokanāl labhyante . nānyataḥ . tasmād vicāreṇātmānveṣṭavyaḥ upāsanīyo jñātavyo yāvajjīvaṃ puruṣeṇa netaraditi . ..2.13.9..

svānubhūtes suśāstrasya guroś caivaikavākyatā .
yatrābhyāsena tenātmā santatenāvalokyate ..2.13.10..

avahelitaśāstrārthairavajñātamahājanaiḥ .
kaṣṭāmapyāpadaṃ prāpto na mūḍhais samatāmiyāt ..2.13.11..

na vyādhir na viṣaṃ nāpat tathā nāmāsti bhūtale .
khedāya svaśarīrasthaṃ maurkhyameva yathā nṛṇām ..2.13.12..

kiñcitsaṃskṛtabuddhīnāṃ śravyaṃ śāstramidaṃ yathā .
maurkhyāpahaṃ tathā śāstramanyadasti na kiñcana ..2.13.13..

idaṃ śravyaṃ sukhakaraṃ kathādṛṣṭāntasundaram .
aviruddhamaśeṣeṇa śāstravākyārthabandhunā ..2.13.14..

āpado yā duruttārā yāś ca tucchāẖ kuyonayaḥ .
tās tā maurkhyāt prasūyante khadirāt kaṇṭakā iva ..2.13.15..

varaṃ śarāvahastasya caṇḍālāgāravīthiṣu .
bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ rāma na maurkhyahatajīvitam ..2.13.16..

imamālokamāsādya mokṣopāyamayaṃ janaḥ .
andhatāmeti na punaẖ kaścin mohatamasyapi ..2.13.17..

tāvan nayati saṅkocaṃ tṛṣṇāśyāmā narāmbujam .
yāvad vivekasūryasya noditā vimalā prabhā ..2.13.18..

saṃsāraduẖkhamokṣārthaṃ mādṛśais saha bandhubhiḥ .
svarūpamātmano jñātvā guruśāstrapramāṇataḥ ..2.13.19..

jīvanmuktāś carantīha yathā hariharādayaḥ .
yathā brahmarṣayaś cānye tathā vihara rāghava ..2.13.20..

anantānīha duẖkhāni sukhaṃ kṣaṇalavopamam .
nātas sukheṣu badhnīyād dṛṣṭiṃ duẖkhānubandhiṣu ..2.13.21..

yadanantamanāyāsaṃ tat padaṃ sārasiddhaye .
sādhanīyaṃ prayatnena puruṣeṇa vijānatā ..2.13.22..

ta eva puruṣārthasya bhājanaṃ puruṣottamāḥ .
anuttamapadālambi mano yeṣāṃ gatajvaram ..2.13.23..

sambhogāśanamātreṣu rājyādiṣu sukheṣu ye .
santuṣṭā duṣṭamanaso viddhi tānandhaḍuṇḍubhān ..2.13.24..

ye śaṭheṣu duranteṣu duṣkṛtārambhaśāliṣu .
dviṣatsu mitrarūpeṣu bhaktā vai bhogabhogiṣu ..2.13.25..

te yānti durgamād durgaṃ duẖkhād duẖkhaṃ bhayād bhayam .
narakān narakaṃ mūḍhā mohamantharabuddhayaḥ ..2.13.26..

parasparavināśotke śreyasyau na kadācana .
sukhaduẖkhadaśe rāma taḍitprasarabhaṅgure ..2.13.27..

ye viraktā mahātmānas suviviktā bhavādṛśaḥ .
puruṣān viddhi tān vandyān bhogamokṣaikabhāginaḥ ..2.13.28..

vivekaṃ paramāśritya vairāgyābhyāsayogataḥ .
saṃsārasaritaṃ ghorāmimāmāpadamuttaret ..2.13.29..

na suptavyaṃ tu saṃsāramāyāsviha vijānatā .
viṣamūrchanasammohadāyinīṣu vivekinā ..2.13.30..

saṃsāramimamāsādya yas tiṣṭhatyavahelayā .
jvalitasya gṛhasyoccaiś śete tārṇasya so 'ntare ..2.13.31..

yat prāpya na nivartante yadāsādya na śocyate .
tat padaṃ śemuṣīlabhyamastyevātra na saṃśayaḥ ..2.13.32..

nāsti cet tad vicāreṇa doṣaẖ ko bhavatāṃ bhavet .
asti cet tat samuttīrṇā bhaviṣyatha bhavārṇavāt ..2.13.33..

pravṛttiḫ puruṣasyeha mokṣopāyavicāraṇe .
yadā bhavatyāśu tadā mokṣabhāgī sa ucyate ..2.13.34..

anapāyi nirāśaṅkaṃ svāsthyaṃ vigatavibhramam .
na vinā kevalībhāvaṃ vidyate bhuvanatraye ..2.13.35..

tatprāptāvuttamaprāptau na kleśa upayujyate .
na mitrāṇyupakurvanti na dhanāni na bandhavaḥ ..2.13.36..

na hastapādacalanaṃ na deśāntarasaṅgamaḥ .
kleśātiśayasādhyo vā na tīrthāyatanāśrayaḥ ..2.13.37..

puruṣārthaikasādhyena vāsanaikārthakarmaṇā .
kevalaṃ tan manomātrajayenāsādyate padam ..2.13.38..

vivekamātrasādhyaṃ tadvicāraikāntaniścayam .
tyajatā duẖkhajālāni nareṇa tadavāpyate ..2.13.39..

sukhasevyāsanasthena tad vicārayatā svayam .
na śocyate padaṃ prāpya na ca bhūyo 'bhijāyate ..2.13.40..

tat samastasukhāsārasīmāntaṃ sādhavo viduḥ .
tadanuttamaniṣṣyandaṃ paramāhū rasāyanam ..2.13.41..

kṣayitvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ svargamānuṣyayor dvayoḥ .
sukhaṃ nāstyeva salilaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇāsvivaitayoḥ ..2.13.42..

ato manojayaś cintyaś śamas santoṣasādhanaḥ .
anantaśamasambhogas tasmādānanda āpyate ..2.13.43..

jīvatā gacchatā caiva bhramatā patatā tathā .
rakṣasā dānavenāpi devena puruṣeṇa vā ..2.13.44..

manaḫpraśamanodbhūtaṃ tat prāpya paramaṃ sukham .
vikāsiśamapuṣpasya vivekoccataroḫ phalam ..2.13.45..

vyavahārapareṇāpi kāryavṛndamacinvatā .
bhānunevāmbarasthena nojjhyate na ca vāñchyate ..2.13.46..

manaḫ praśāntamatyacchaṃ viśrāntaṃ gatavibhramam .
anīhaṃ vigatābhīṣṭaṃ nābhivāñchati nojjhati ..2.13.47..

mokṣadvāre dvārapālānimāñ śṛṇu yathākramam .
yeṣāmekatamāsaktyā mokṣadvāre praviśyate ..2.13.48..

duẖkhadoṣadaśā dīrghā saṃsāramarumaṇḍalī .
jantoś śītalatāmeti śītalena śamāmbunā ..2.13.49..

śamenāsādyate śreyaś śamo hi paramaṃ padam .
śamaś śivaṃ śamaś śāntiś śamo bhrāntinivāraṇam ..2.13.50..

puṃsaḫ praśamatṛptasya śītalācchatarātmanaḥ .
śamatoṣitacittasya śatrurapyeti mitratām ..2.13.51..

śamacandramasā yeṣāmāśayas samalaṅkṛtaḥ .
kṣīrābdhīnāmivodeti teṣāṃ paramaśuddhatā ..2.13.52..

hṛtkuśeśayakośeṣu yeṣāṃ śamakuśeśayam .
satāṃ vikasitaṃ te hi dvihṛtpadmās samā hareḥ ..2.13.53..

śamaśrīś śobhate yeṣāṃ mukhendāvakalaṅkite .
te 'mī kulendavo vandyās saundaryavijitendavaḥ ..2.13.54..

trailokyodaravartinyo nānandāya tathā śriyaḥ .
sāmrājyasampatpratimā yathā śamavibhūtayaḥ ..2.13.55..

yāni duẖkhāni yās tṛṣṇā dussahā ye durādhayaḥ .
tat sarvaṃ śāntacetassu tamo 'rkeṣviva naśyati ..2.13.56..

mano hi sarvabhūtānāṃ prasādamanugacchati .
na tathendau yathā śānte jane janitakautukam ..2.13.57..

śamaśālini sauhārdavati sarveṣu jantuṣu .
sujane paramaṃ tattvaṃ svayameva prasīdati ..2.13.58..

mātarīva paraṃ yānti viṣamāṇi mṛdūni ca .
viśvāsamiha bhūtāni sarvāṇi śamaśālini ..2.13.59..

na rasāyanapānena na lakṣmyāliṅganena ca .
tathā sukhamavāpnoti śamenāntar yathā janaḥ ..2.13.60..

sarvādhivyādhivalitaṃ krāntaṃ tṛṣṇāvaratrayā .
manaś śamāmṛtāsekais samāśvāsaya rāghava ..2.13.61..

yat karoṣi yadaśnāsi śamaśītalayā dhiyā .
tat te 'tisvadate svādu netarat tāta mānase ..2.13.62..

śamāmṛtarasasnātaṃ mano yāmeti nirvṛtim .
chinnānyapi tayāṅgāni manye rohanti rāghava ..2.13.63..

na piśācā na rakṣāṃsi na daityā na ca śatravaḥ .
na ca vyāghrabhujaṅgādyā dviṣanti śamaśālinam ..2.13.64..

susannaddhasamastāṅgaṃ praśamāmṛtavarmaṇā .
vedhayanti na duẖkhāni śarā vajraśilāmiva ..2.13.65..

na tathā rājate rājāmātyāntaḫpurasaṃsthitaḥ .
samayā svasthayā vṛttyā yathopaśamaśobhitaḥ ..2.13.66..

prāṇāt priyataraṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭimeti na tāṃ janaḥ .
yāmāyāti janaṃ śāntamavalokya samāśayam ..2.13.67..

samayā śamaśālinyā vṛttyā yas sādhu vartate .
abhinanditayā loke jīvatīha sa netaraḥ ..2.13.68..

anuddhatamanāś śāntas sādhu karma karoti yat .
tat sarvamabhinandanti tasyemā bhūtajātayaḥ ..2.13.69..

śrutvā spṛṣṭvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ghrātvā śubhāśubham .
na hṛṣyati glāyati yas sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.70..

yas samas sarvabhāveṣu nābhivāñchati nojjhati .
jitvendriyāṇi yatnena sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.71..

tuṣārakarabimbācchaṃ mano yasya nirākulam .
maraṇotsavayuddheṣu sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.72..

sthito 'pi na sthita iva na hṛṣyati na kupyati .
yas suṣuptamanās svasthas sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.73..

amṛtasyandasubhagā yasya sarvajanaṃ prati .
dṛṣṭiḫ prasarati prītā sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.74..

spaṣṭāvadātayā buddhyā yathaivāntas tathā bahiḥ .
dṛśyante yasya kāryāṇi sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.75..

apyāpatsu durantāsu kalpānteṣu dahatsvapi .
tucchehaṃ na mano yasya sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.76..

antaśśītalatāṃ yāto yo bhāveṣu na majjati .
vyavahārī na sammūḍhas sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.77..

ākāśasadṛśī yasya nityaṃ svavyavahāriṇaḥ .
kalaṅkameti na matis sa śānta iti kathyate ..2.13.78..

tapasviṣu bahujñeṣu yājakeṣu nṛpeṣu ca .
balavatsu guṇāḍhyeṣu śamavāneva rājate ..2.13.79..

śamasaṃsaktamanasāṃ mahatāṃ guṇaśālinām .
udeti nirvṛtiś cittāj jyotsneva himarociṣaḥ ..2.13.80..

sīmānto guṇapūgānāṃ pauruṣaikāntabhūṣaṇam .
saṅkaṭeṣvabhayasthānaṃ śamaś śrīmān virājate ..2.13.81..

śamamamṛtamahāryamāryajuṣṭaṃ
paramavalambya padaṃ paraṃ prayātāḥ .
raghutanaya yathā mahānubhāvāḥ
kramamanupālaya siddhaye tameva ..2.13.82..

śāstrāvabodhāmalayā dhiyā paramapūtayā .
kartavyaẖ kāraṇajñena vicāro niyatātmanā ..2.14.1..

vicārāt tīkṣṇatāmetya dhīḫ paśyati paraṃ padam .
dīrghasaṃsārarogasya vicāro hi mahauṣadham ..2.14.2..

āpadvanamanantehāparipallavitākṛti .
vicārakrakacacchinnaṃ naiva bhūyaḫ prarohati ..2.14.3..

moheṣu bandhunāśeṣu saṅkaṭeṣu bhrameṣu ca .
sarveṣveva mahāprājña vicāro hi satāṃ gatiḥ ..2.14.4..

na vicāraṃ vinā kaścidupāyo 'sti vipacchame .
vicārādaśubhaṃ tyaktvā śubhamāyāti dhīs satām ..2.14.5..

balaṃ buddhiś ca tejaś ca pratipattiẖ kriyāphalam .
phalantyetāni sarvāṇi vicāreṇaiva dhīmataḥ ..2.14.6..

yuktāyuktamahādīpamabhivāñchitasādhakam .
sphāraṃ vicāramāśritya saṃsārajaladhiṃ taret ..2.14.7..

ālūnahṛdayāmbhojaṃ mahāmohamataṅgajam .
vidārayati śuddhātmā vicārodārakesarī ..2.14.8..

mūḍhāẖ kālavaśeneha yad gatāḫ paramaṃ padam .
tad vicārapradīpasya vijṛmbhitamanuttamam ..2.14.9..

rājyāni sampadas sphāro bhogo mokṣaś ca śāśvataḥ .
vicārakalpavṛkṣasya phalānyetāni rāghava ..2.14.10..

yā vivekavilāsinyo matayo mahatāmiha .
na tā vipadi majjanti tumbakānīva vāriṇi ..2.14.11..

vicārodayahāriṇyā dhiyā vyavaharanti ye .
phalānāmatyudārāṇāṃ bhājanaṃ hi bhavanti te ..2.14.12..

mūrkhahṛtkānanasthānāmāśāprasararodhinām .
avicārakarañjānāṃ mañjaryo duẖkharītayaḥ ..2.14.13..

kajjalakṣodamalinā madirāmodadharmiṇī .
avicāramayī nidrā yātu te rāghava kṣayam ..2.14.14..

mahāpadyapi dīrgheṣu sadvicāraparo naraḥ .
na nimajjati moheṣu tejorāśis tamassviva ..2.14.15..

mānase sarasi svacche vicārakamalotkaraḥ .
nūnaṃ vikasito yasya himavāniva bhāti saḥ ..2.14.16..

vicāravikalā yasya matir māndyamupeyuṣaḥ .
tasyodetyaśaniś candrān mudhā yakṣaś śiśoriva ..2.14.17..

duẖkhaṣaṇḍakavalmīkaṃ vipannavalatāmadhuḥ .
rāma dūre parityājyo nirviveko narādhamaḥ ..2.14.18..

ye kecana durārambhā durācārā durādhayaḥ .
avicāreṇa te bhānti vetālās tamasā yathā ..2.14.19..

avicāriṇamekāntajaraddrumasadharmiṇam .
akṣamaṃ sādhukāryeṣu dūre kuru raghūdvaha ..2.14.20..

viviktaṃ hi mano jantorāśāvaivaśyavarjitam .
parāṃ nirvṛtimabhyeti pūrṇaś candra ivātmani ..2.14.21..

vivekitoditā dehaṃ sarvaṃ śītalayatyalam .
alaṅkaroti cātyantaṃ jyotsneva bhuvanam navā ..2.14.22..

paramārthapatākāyā dhiyo dhavalacāmaram .
vicāro rājate janto rajanyāmiva candramāḥ ..2.14.23..

vicāracāravo bhāvā bhāsayanto diśo daśa .
bhānti bhāskaravad bhagnabhūyobhavabhayāmayāḥ ..2.14.24..

bālasya svamanomohakalpitaḫ prāṇahārakaḥ .
rātrau tamasi vetālo vicāreṇa vilīyate ..2.14.25..

sarva eva jagadbhāvā avicāraṇacāravaḥ .
avidyamānasadbhāvā vicāraviśarāravaḥ ..2.14.26..

puṃso nijamanomohakalpito 'nalpaduẖkhadaḥ .
saṃsāraciravetālo vicāreṇa vilīyate ..2.14.27..

samasvacchaṃ nirābādhamanantamanapāśrayam .
viddhīmaṃ kevalībhāvaṃ vicārogrataroḫ phalam ..2.14.28..

acalasthitinodāraprakaṭābhogatejasā .
tena niṣkāmatodeti śītatevoditendunā ..2.14.29..

cintājvaramahauṣadhyā sādhucittaniṣaṇṇayā .
tayottamatvapradayā nābhivāñchati nojjhati ..2.14.30..

tat sadālambanaṃ cetas sphāramābhāsamāgatam .
nāstameti na codeti khamivātitatāntaram ..2.14.31..

na jahāti na cādatte na tāmyati na śāmyati .
kevalaṃ sākṣivat paśyañ jagadātmani tiṣṭhati ..2.14.32..

na ca śāmyati nāpyantar nāpi bāhye 'vatiṣṭhati .
na ca naiṣkarmyamādatte na ca karmaṇi majjati ..2.14.33..

upekṣate gataṃ vastu samprāptamanuvartate .
na kṣubdho nāti cākṣubdho bhāti pūrṇa ivārṇavaḥ ..2.14.34..

evaṃrūpeṇa manasā mahātmāno mahāśayāḥ .
jīvanmuktā jagatyasmin viharanti hi yoginaḥ ..2.14.35..

uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ dhīrās te yāvadīpsitam .
tanumante parityajya yānti kevalatāṃ tatām ..2.14.36..

ko 'haṃ kasya ca saṃsāra ityāpadyapi dhīmatā .
cintanīyaṃ prayatnena sapratīkāramātmanā ..2.14.37..

kāryasaṅkaṭasandehaṃ rājā jānāti rāghava .
niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ vāpi vicāreṇaiva nānyathā ..2.14.38..

vedavedāntasiddhāntasthitayas sthitikāraṇam .
nirṇīyante vicāreṇa dīpeneva bhuvo niśi ..2.14.39..

anaṣṭamandhakāreṣu bahutejassvajihmitam .
paśyatyapi vyavahitaṃ vicārac cārulocanam ..2.14.40..

vivekāndho hi jātyandhaś śocyaś sarvasya durmatiḥ .
divyacakṣur vivekātmā jayatyakhilavastuṣu ..2.14.41..

paramātmamayī pālyā mahānandaikasādhanī .
kṣaṇamekaṃ parityājyā na vicāracamatkṛtiḥ ..2.14.42..

vicāracāruḫ puruṣo mahatāmapi rocate .
paripakvaṃ camatkāri sahakāraphalaṃ yathā ..2.14.43..

vicārakāntamatayo nānekeṣu punaḫ punaḥ .
patanti duẖkhagarteṣu jñātordhvagatayo narāḥ ..2.14.44..

na virauti tathā rogī nānarthaśatajarjaraḥ .
avicāravinaṣṭātmā yathājñaḫ pariroditi ..2.14.45..

varaṃ kardamakīṭatvaṃ śvabhrakaṇṭakatā varam .
varamandhaguhāhitvaṃ na narasyāvicāritā ..2.14.46..

sarvānarthanijāvāsaṃ sarvasādhutiraskṛtam .
sarvadaussthityasīmāntamavicāraṃ parityajet ..2.14.47..

nityaṃ vicārayuktena bhavitavyaṃ mahātmanā .
bhavāndhakūpe patatāṃ vicāro hyavalambanam ..2.14.48..

svayamevātmanātmānamavaṣṭabhya vicārataḥ .
saṃsāramohajaladhes tārayet svamanomṛgam ..2.14.49..

ko 'haṃ kathamayaṃ doṣas saṃsārākhya upāgataḥ .
nyāyeneti parāmarśo vicāra iti kathyate ..2.14.50..

andhāndhamohamukharaṃ ciraṃ duẖkhāya kevalam .
kṛtaṃ śilāyā hṛdayaṃ durmateś cāvicāriṇaḥ ..2.14.51..

bhāvābhāvagrahotsargadṛśāmiha hi rāghava .
na vicārādṛte tattvaṃ jñāyate sādhu kiñcana ..2.14.52..

vicārāj jñāyate tattvaṃ tattvād viśrāntirātmani .
tato manasi śānte tu sarvaduẖkhaparikṣayaḥ ..2.14.53..

saphalatā phalate bhuvi karmaṇāṃ
prakaṭatāṃ kila gacchata uttamāt .
sphuṭavicāradṛśaiva vicāritā
śamavate bhavate 'pi virocatām ..2.14.54..

santoṣo hi paraṃ śreyas santoṣas sukhamucyate .
santuṣṭaḫ paramabhyeti viśrāmamarisūdana ..2.15.1..

santoṣaiśvaryasukhināṃ ciraviśrāntacetasām .
sāmrājyamapi sādhūnāṃ jarattṛṇalavāyate ..2.15.2..

santoṣaśālinī buddhī rāma saṃsāravṛttiṣu .
viṣamāsvapyanudvignā na kadācana dūyate ..2.15.3..

santoṣāmṛtapānena ye parāṃ tṛptimāgatāḥ .
bhogaśrīratulā teṣāmeṣā prativiṣāyate ..2.15.4..

na tathā tarpayantyetāḫ pīyūṣarasavīcayaḥ .
yathā hi madhurāsvādas santoṣo doṣanāśanaḥ ..2.15.5..

aprāptavāñchāmutsṛjya samprāpte samatāṃ gataḥ .
adṛṣṭakhedākhedo 'ntas sa santuṣṭa ihocyate ..2.15.6..

ātmanātmani santoṣaṃ yāvad yāti na mānasam .
udbhavantyāpadas tāval latā iva manovanāt ..2.15.7..

santoṣaśītalaṃ cetaś śuddhavijñānadṛṣṭibhiḥ .
bhṛśaṃ vikāsamāyāti sūryāṃśubhirivāmbujam ..2.15.8..

āśāvaivaśyavivaśe citte santoṣavarjite .
mlāne vaktramivādarśe na jñānaṃ pratibimbati ..2.15.9..

viśeṣeṇa mahābuddhe saṃsārottaraṇe nṛṇām .

paraṃ vivardhanaṃ buddherajñānataruśātanam .

puruṣayatnajavena manovane

varamate nijabhāvamahānadīm
iha hi tena manāgapi nohyase ..2.16.35..

evamāttaviveko yas sa bhavāniva rāghava .
yogyo jñānagiraś śrotuṃ rājeva nayabhāratīḥ ..2.17.1..

tvametayākhaṇḍitayā guṇalakṣmyā samāśritaḥ .
manomohaharaṃ vākyaṃ vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ śṛṇu ..2.17.3..
