ātivāhikadehoktibhājanaṃ tad vidur budhāḥ .
antassthayā brahmaśaktyā jñarūpaṃ svātmanātmadṛk ..6.45.36..

sampadyamāna evāsmiṃś cetasīmā hi śaktayaḥ .
paścādiva sahaivāsya prodyantyanuditā api ..6.45.37..

vātasattā spandasattā sparśasattā tathaiva ca .
tvaksattā taijasī sattā tathā sattā prakāśinī ..6.45.38..

dṛksattā jalasattā ca svādasattā tathāpi ca .
tathaiva rasasattā ca gandhasattā tathaiva ca ..6.45.39..

bhūsattā dehasattā ca piṇḍasattā ca pīvarī .
deśasattā kālasattā sarvās tvākāravarjitāḥ ..6.45.40..

evaṃ sattāgaṇaṃ cetaẖ kroḍīkṛtya kharūpadhṛt .
sphuratyāśritapattrādi bījavaj jīvatāṃ gatam ..6.45.41..

etat puryaṣṭakaṃ viddhi deho 'yaṃ cātivāhikaḥ .
aparābodhametat tat sphuratyaṃśavibhāgavat ..6.45.42..

etad yadaṅgasampannaṃ sampannaṃ tan na kiñcana .
na jātaṃ na ca sadrūpaṃ na cidādi na cetarat ..6.45.43..

pare paraṃ prasphurati kevalaṃ kevalātma sat .
jalapīṭhasya jaṭhare jaladravavilāsavat ..6.45.44..

saṃvitsaṃvedanaikātma pṛthagetadacetitam .
sampadyate parijñātaṃ saṅkalpanagaropamam ..6.45.45..

saṃvedanaparijñānāc chivatāmeva gacchati .
ajātameva vā yat tat kathaṃ gacchati vastutām ..6.45.46..

athaitad vindate svāntaṃ saṅkalpādaṇutāṃ svataḥ .
tanmātrasattās tasyāṇoretāḫ paśyanti dehakam ..6.45.47..

aṇusthūlatvamāpannaṃ tadevāśu prapaśyati .
tasya tanmātrarandhrāṇi yathādeśaṃ ca paśyati ..6.45.48..

tataḫ puruṣarūpaikabhāvanāt puruṣākṛtim .
kākatālīyavad dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ bhavatyalam ..6.45.49..

jīva etadavastho 'tha sthitaṃ paśyati dehakam .
asantameva gandharvapuraṃ svapnapuraṃ yathā ..6.45.50..

gandharvanagarākāramapi svapnapuropamam .
jagad duẖkhāya duẖkhasya kātra yuktiḫ parikṣaye ..6.45.51..

vāsanāvaśato duẖkhaṃ vidyamāne ca sā bhavet .
avidyamānaṃ ca jagan mṛgatṛṣṇāmbubhaṅgavat ..6.45.52..

ataẖ kiṃ vāsyate kena kasya vā vāsanā kutaḥ .
kathaṃ svapnanareṇāṅga mṛgatṛṣṇāmbu pīyate ..6.45.53..

sasraṣṭari tu sāhante samanomananādike .

yatra no vāsanā naiva vāsakaṃ na ca vāsyatā .

yasya satyo 'pyasatyo vā śūnya eva hi yakṣakaḥ .

śūnya eva hi vetāla ivetthaṃ cittavāsanā .

ajñān praśāsti kila yaẖ kanakāvadātāṃ

tatas sa jīvo bhagavan dṛṣṭavān dehasambhramam .
ādisarge nabhassaṃsthaẖ kāmavasthāmupaiti hi ..6.46.1..

na tad dūre na nikaṭe nordhve nādho na te na me .

anubhavakalanādṛte 'sya mātā

yathāpṛṣṭaṃ mune proktaṃ tvayi kalyāṇamastu te .

ityuktvā nīlakaṇṭho 'sau tyaktapuṣpāñjalau mayi .

tasmin gate tribhuvanādhipatāvumeśe

bāhyārthavedane nityaṃ sambandho 'kṣasya kāraṇam .
samanvitasya cittena na muktasya kadācana ..6.54.28..

yad yadacchatare tasminnagrasthaṃ pratibimbati .
jīvena bhavati śliṣṭaṃ bahir jīvo 'tha jīvati ..6.54.29..

nighṛṣṭanavaratnābhe yadā nayanatārake .
tadaitayor bāhyagataḫ padārthaḫ pratibimbati ..6.54.30..

jīvena bhavati śliṣṭaḫ pratibimbavaśāt tataḥ .
jīvajñeyatvamāyāti bāhyaṃ vastviti rāghava ..6.54.31..

yat saṃśleṣamupāyāti tad bālo 'pi hi vindate .
paśur vā sthāvaro vāpi jīvaẖ kasmān na vetsyati ..6.54.32..

anyac ca nāyanās sādho raśmayo jīvaveṣṭitāḥ .
kroḍīkurvantyalaṃ dṛśyaṃ jīvas tat tena vindate ..6.54.33..

eṣa eva kramas sparśe sambandhapratyayodbhavaḥ .
rase gandhe ca kathito jīvasaṃsparśasambhavaḥ ..6.54.34..

śabdas tvākāśaniṣṭhatvāt karṇākāśagataẖ kṣaṇāt .
jīvākāśaṃ viśatyantarevamindriyasaṃvidaḥ ..6.54.35..

dṛśyate nirmalādarśaratnavāryādikeṣu yat .
pratibimbanametan me brūhi brahman kimātmakam ..6.54.36..

kākatālīyavad bhātaṃ tad brahmavyomni yac ciram .
kiñcidāste kṣaṇaṃ kiñcit tadevedaṃ jaganti vaḥ ..6.54.37..

svasattāmātrakaṃ svapne ivārtha iti bhāvayat .
sthitamekamanekātma cidvyoma svapnavṛkṣavat ..6.54.38..

bāhyārthāstitvabodho yo yā brahmātmajaganmatiḥ .
sa ca sā ceti sat sarvaṃ yathāsaṃvedanaṃ sthiteḥ ..6.54.39..

prathamaṃ paramāṇutve buddhe 'ṇutve tataś ca khe .
tā vido vetti vidvyoma karākṣādikamadya yāḥ ..6.54.40..

sargāditaḫ prabhṛtyeva nirmale 'rthaḫ prabimbate .
vidātteti sthitis tvaikyāt sarvabimbyanubimbayoḥ ..6.54.41..

cidvyomnā kacatā tad yadayamartha iti sthitam .
sargādau cetitā saṃsthā yāsau sthitimupāgatā ..6.54.42..

asatāmeva bhāvānāṃ cidvyomakacanābalāt .
guṇārpaṇaṃ mitho rūḍhaṃ nirmale pratibimbanam ..6.54.43..

atyantajaḍayoreva jīvayoriva yan mithaḥ .
sattārpaṇaṃ svabhāvena pratibimbaṃ taducyate ..6.54.44..

cidātmanor vā jaḍayor mahāsattājaḍātmanoḥ .
ādyasvabhāvaniyamād bimbasattārpaṇaṃ mithaḥ ..6.54.45..

pratibimbaṃ dṛśor bhrāntiṃ viddhi vedyavidāṃ vara .
tāvanmātraṃ jagat tena viśvāso mā tavāstviha ..6.54.46..

ahamityāditaraṅgas sargādyāvartavān parāmbhodhau .
nāstyeva deśakālakriyākṛtas tanmayaikatayā ..6.54.47..

nityamasaktamatir muditātmā
śāntasukhāsukhasaṃvidanantaḥ .
tiṣṭha niviṣṭamatis samatāyām
astasamastabhavāmayamāyaḥ ..6.54.48..

navādudbhavataḫ pūrvaṃ sampannāś cakṣurādayaḥ .
yathā kamalajasyaitat sarvameva tvayā śrutam ..6.55.1..

brahmapuryaṣṭakasyādāvakṣasaṃvid yathoditā .
puryaṣṭakasya sarvasya tathaivodeti sarvadā ..6.55.2..

viddhi puryaṣṭakaṃ jīvaṃ sa garbhasthendriyodayaḥ .
yad yathā bhāvayatyāśu tat tathā paripaśyati ..6.55.3..

indriyāṇīndriyārthākhyaṃ viddhi saṃvedanaṃ svakam .
sampannaṃ ca yathā tat te proktamādyamanassthitau ..6.55.4..

śuddhā saṃvit saṃvidantī saṃvedanamaninditam .
ato 'haṃvedanādantar jīvaṃ puryaṣṭakaṃ tvitā ..6.55.5..

na tvekatvādanantatvādavedyatvādanāmayā .

cetyādi budhyate kiñcin na manastāṃ ca gacchati .

yataẖ kutaścit sampanne tvavidyāmaya āmaye .

yatrodyadācāramapi sadapyasadavasthitam .
jagaj jñaviṣayaṃ paṅkādiva tiṣṭhati nirmitam ..6.55.12..

asanmayamavidyāyā rūpametāvadeva hi .

apyatyantamasatyāyāẖ kalpanā kalpitātmani ..6.55.16..

jīvatvamiva samprāptā puryaṣṭakapade sthitā .

yad yathā bhāvayatyāśu tat tathānubhavatyalam .

pañcatanmātrakalanās sā bhāvayati yatra yāḥ .
tatrātmani tathārandhrās tāḫ paśyati tathoditāḥ ..6.55.20..

tābhya eva samutpannaṃ bahissthaṃ bhūtapañcakam .

idamantaridaṃ bāhyamiti niścayavāṃs tataḥ .
jīvo yathā yadādatte tat tathā draḍhayatyalam ..6.55.22..

raśmijālamivendor yadātmanaḫ pratibhāsanam .
bāhyasparśatayā tena tadevāśūrarīkṛtam ..6.55.23..

maricasyeva yat taikṣṇyaṃ śūnyatvamiva khasya yat .
ātmano vedanaṃ tena tadevānyadivāśritam ..6.55.24..

atraiva niścayaṃ buddhvā niyamas sudṛḍhīkṛtaḥ .
anenetthamanenetthaṃ bhāvyamityavikhaṇḍitam ..6.55.25..

svabhāvetaranāmāsau svasaṅkalpaniyāmakaḥ .
kvacit kadācid bhavati svabhāvenaiva nānyathā ..6.55.26..

ātmanaivedamakhilaṃ sampannaṃ dvaitamadvayam .
ṣaṇḍo madhuraseneva mṛdeva ca mahāghaṭaḥ ..6.55.27..

sanniveśavikārādi deśakālādisambhavāt .
sambhavatyatra na tvīśe deśakālādyasambhavāt ..6.55.28..

itaḫ puṣpamitaḫ pattramahamityudito yathā .
ṣaṇḍe svātmani vāsanto raso 'dvitve dvitāṃ haran ..6.55.29..

itaḫ paṭamitaẖ kuḍyamahamityuditas tathā .
sargātmanyātmani brahma nirdvandve dvitvamāharat ..6.55.30..

adyāṅkuro 'hamadyārkarugahaṃ tvadya vāridaḥ .
yatheti tiṣṭhatyabbhāgas tathātmā sadasadvapuḥ ..6.55.31..

iti bhāvyamanenetthamiti sarveśvareritam .
kramaṃ khaṇḍayituṃ loke kasya nāmāsti śaktatā ..6.55.32..

ādarśe svaccha ākāro naiva svaḫ pratibimbati .
vyatirekāsambhavataẖ kacatyeva tu kevalam ..6.55.33..

brahmaṇi tvātmanātmaiva sthitaẖ kacati bimbati .

yad yathaivātmakacanaṃ cetitaṃ kacatātmanā .
asatyamapi tan neha vyabhicāri kadācana ..6.55.35..

hematvakaṭakatve dve satyāsatyasvarūpiṇī .
hemni bhāṇḍamatau yadvac cittvācittve tathātmani ..6.55.36..

sarvagatvāc citeś cittvaṃ nityaṃ manasi vidyate .

cittvajāḍyātmakaṃ cittaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhāvayati svayam .
yadā yathaiva yadbhāvaṃ tadā bhavati tat tathā ..6.55.38..

kāle kāle citā jīvas tvanyo 'nyo bhavati svayam .
bhāvitākāravānantar vāsanākaṇikodayāt ..6.55.39..

svapne dṛṣṭo yathā grāmo yāti satyātmatāṃ kṣaṇam .

pratibhāso yathā svapne naraẖ kuḍyaṃ paṭaṃ bhavet .
bhavatyasatyamevaivaṃ dehād dehāntaraṃ sa naḥ ..6.55.41..

asatyameva mriyate tvasatyaṃ jāyate punaḥ .
jīvas svapratibhāsena svapnavat svānyarūpavat ..6.55.42..

kālenaitāvatā rūpamidaṃ tyājyaṃ mayetyasau .
prākṛtaṃ niścayaṃ rūḍhaṃ bhavatyanubhavat svataḥ ..6.55.43..

vastu dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca svapne samanubhūyate .
jīvasvapnaṃ jagadrūpaṃ viddhi vedyavidāṃ vara ..6.55.44..

ajāgraddraṣṭṛdṛśyo yas so 'bhidhānādinā vinā .

anyapūrvābhidhabṛhatsvapnaṃ paśyati nā yathā .
aprāgdṛṣṭaṃ tathaiṣā svaṃ cetanaṃ cit prapaśyati ..6.55.46..

prākkṛtā vāsanādyāśu pauruṣeṇaiva jīyate .
hyaẖkukarmādya yatnena prayāti hi sukarmatām ..6.55.47..

mokṣādṛte na śāmyanti jīvānāṃ cakṣurādayaḥ .
unmajjanti nimajjanti kevalaṃ deśakālataḥ ..6.55.48..

cittvasya kalanāt tasya deho 'gra iva tiṣṭhati .

mano buddhirahaṅkāras tathā tanmātrapañcakam .

amūrta eva cittātmā khatvamasyātipīnatā .

dviravasthaẖ krameṇaiṣa niravasthas tu muktibhāk .

svapnatāsyetarāvasthā dehapratyayaśālinī .

kadācid dhi suṣuptasthaẖ kadācit svapnasaṃsthitaḥ .

yadā suṣuptabhāvastho bhāviduẖkhaprabodhanaḥ .

sthāvarādyāsvavasthāsu kalpavṛkṣadaśāsu ca .

suṣuptatāsya jaḍatā svapno 'syeyaṃ tu saṃsṛtiḥ .

jīvaprabodho muktir hi sā ceha dvividhocyate .
ekā jīvanmuktateti dvitīyādehamuktatā ..6.55.58..

jīvanmuktir hi turyatvaṃ turyātītaṃ paraṃ tataḥ .

jñānapramāṇo jīvo 'ntar yaj jānāti hi tanmayaḥ .
jānātu jñaptimevāto bhavatyāśu sa tanmayaḥ ..6.55.60..

paśyatīmamayaṃ jīvas sudīrghaṃ svapnavibhramam .

jīvāṇorantarastyasya na kiñcic citkalāṃ vinā .
tāmevānyatayā paśyan mudhaiva pariśocati ..6.55.62..

jīvāṇorantarastyasya na kiñcit paramādṛte .
yatra tatra jagad dṛṣṭamaho māyāvijṛmbhitam ..6.55.63..

sthālyantaẖ kvathadambūnāṃ yathānnānāṃ bhramodayaḥ .
jīvāṇūnāṃ tathā svāntar mithyā saṃsaraṇodayaḥ ..6.55.64..

bandho 'sya vāsanāvattvaṃ mokṣas syād vāsanākṣayaḥ .
vāsanāto 'sya sauṣuptī svāpnī ca sphurati sthitiḥ ..6.55.65..

ghanavāsanamoho 'yaṃ suṣuptātmā jaḍas smṛtaḥ .
tadantarbhāvinā svapnenāvaśyambhāvinānvitaḥ ..6.55.66..

vāsanāveśanidrālur jīvaḫ paśyati vibhramam .
yadāsya vāsanānidrā kṣīyate budhyate tadā ..6.55.67..

vāsanoktā dṛśyaratir dṛśyatvaṃ ca na vidyate .
hemnīva kaṭakāditvaṃ sarvātmanyātmanā kvacit ..6.55.68..

abodhādetadabhavad vilīnaṃ cet prabodhataḥ .

ghanaṃ svavāsanāmohaṃ kṣapayitvā suṣuptagaḥ .

ghanavāsanamoho 'yaṃ jīvas sthāvaratādibhāk .

ātmanātmā samālīḍho bahirantar yadā citā .

trijagac ciccamatkāras tvalaṃ bhedavikalpanaiḥ .

abdher yathāmalamapāstasamastabhedaṃ

sarvaṃ tathedamapahastitabhedajātam
ādyaṃ paraṃ padamanāmayameva buddham ..6.55.76..

yo jīvasyoditas svapno nānākalanakomalaḥ .
tamimaṃ viddhi saṃsāraṃ na satyaṃ nāpyasanmayam ..6.56.1..

tasyādya yāvadanagha pravāhāpatite nije .

vasudevasutas tveko vāsudeva iti śrutaḥ .

yudhiṣṭhira iti khyāto dharmaputro bhaviṣyati .

duryodhana iti khyātas tasya bhrātā pitṛvyajaḥ .

anyo'nyaṃ haratorurvīṃ tayos saṅgrāmalālasāḥ .
aṣṭādaśākṣauhiṇyo hi ghaṭiṣyantyatra bhīṣaṇāḥ ..6.56.33..

tatkṣayeṇa vibhāratvaṃ bhuvo viṣṇuẖ kariṣyati .
rāghavārjunadehena bṛhadgāṇḍīvadhanvanā ..6.56.34..

viṣṇorarjunanāmāsau prākṛtaṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ .
harṣāmarṣānvito deho naradharmā bhaviṣyati ..6.56.35..

senādvayagatān dṛṣṭvā svajanān maraṇonmukhān .
viṣādameṣyatyudyogaṃ yuddhāya na kariṣyati ..6.56.36..

tamarjunābhidhaṃ dehaṃ prāptakāryaikasiddhaye .
harir buddhena dehena bodhayiṣyati rāghava ..6.56.37..

tvaṃ mānuṣeṇopahatāntarātmā
viṣādamohābhibhavād visañjñaḥ .
naṣṭas svamutsṛjya paraṃ prakāśaṃ
tadātmatattvaṃ nanu rājasiṃha ..6.56.38..

anantamavyaktamanādimadhyam
ātmānamālokaya saṃvidātman .
saṃvidvapus sphāramalagnadoṣam
ajo 'si nityo 'si nirāmayo 'si ..6.56.39..

na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin
nāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ .
ajo nityaś śāśvato 'yaṃ purāṇo
na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre ..6.56.40..

ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaś cainaṃ manyate hatam .
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate ..6.57.1..

anantasyaikarūpasya satas sūkṣmasya khādapi .
ātmanaḫ parameśasya kiṃ kathaṃ kena hanyate ..6.57.2..

nārjunas tvaṃ na hantā tvamabhimānamalaṃ tyaja .
jarāmaraṇanirmuktas svayamātmāsi śāśvataḥ ..6.57.3..

yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvo yasya buddhir na lipyate .
hatvāpi sa imāṃl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate ..6.57.4..

yaiva sañjāyate saṃvidantas saivānubhūyate .
ayaṃ so 'hamidaṃ tan me ityatas saṃvidaṃ tyaja ..6.57.5..

anayaiva ca yukto 'smi naṣṭo 'smīti ca bhārata .
abhitas sukhaduẖkhābhyāmavaśaḫ parikṛṣyase ..6.57.6..

svātmāṃśaiẖ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiẖ karmāṇi bhāgaśaḥ .
ahaṅkāravimūḍhātmā kartāhamiti manyate ..6.57.7..

cakṣuḫ paśyatu karṇaś ca śṛṇotu tvak spṛśatviyam .
rasanā ca rasaṃ yātu ko 'traiko 'hamiti sthitaḥ ..6.57.8..

kalanākarmanirate manasyapi mahāmate .
na kaścidatrāhamiti kleśabhāgī ka eva te ..6.57.9..

bahubhis samavāyena yat kṛtaṃ tatra bhārata .
eko 'bhimānaduẖkhena hāsāyaiva hi gṛhyate ..6.57.10..

kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi .
yoginaẖ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmasiddhaye ..6.57.11..

ahantvaviṣacūrṇena yeṣāṃ kāyo na bhāvitaḥ .
kurvanto 'pi haranto 'pi ta ete nirviṣūcikāḥ ..6.57.12..

na kvacid rājate kāyo mamatvāmedhyadūṣitaḥ .
prājño 'pyatibahujño 'pi duśśīla iva mānavaḥ ..6.57.13..

nirmamo nirahaṅkāras samaduẖkhasukhaẖ kṣamī .
yas sa kāryamakāryaṃ vā kurvannapi na lipyate ..6.57.14..

idaṃ ca te pāṇḍusuta svakarma kṣātramuttamam .
atikrūramapi śreyas sukhāyaivodayāya ca ..6.57.15..

api kutsitamapyantyamapyadharmamayaṃ kṛśam .
śreyase svaṃ yathā karma na tathehāmṛtāsavaḥ ..6.57.16..

mūrkhasyāpi svakarmaiva śreyase kimu sanmateḥ .
matir galadahaṅkārā patitāpi na lipyate ..6.57.17..

yogasthaẖ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanañjaya .
nissaṅgas tvaṃ yathāprāptakarmāsi cen na badhyase ..6.57.18..

śāntabrahmavapur bhūtvā karma brahmamayaṃ kuru .
brahmārpitasamācāro brahmaiva bhavasi kṣaṇāt ..6.57.19..

īśvarārpitasarvārtha īśvarātmā nirāmayaḥ .
īśvaras sarvabhūtātmā bhava bhūṣitabhūtalaḥ ..6.57.20..

sannyastasarvasaṅkalpas samaś śāntamanā muniḥ .
sannyāsayogayuktātmā kurvan muktamatir bhava ..6.57.21..

saṅgatyāgasya bhagavaṃs tathā brahmārpaṇasya ca .
īśvarārpaṇarūpasya sannyāsasya ca sarvaga ..6.57.22..

tathā jñānasya yogasya vibhāgaẖ kīdṛśaḫ prabho .
krameṇa kathayaitan me mahāmohanivṛttidam ..6.57.23..

sarvasaṅkalpasaṃśāntāvekāntaghanavedanam .
nakiñcidbhāvanākāraṃ yat tad brahma paraṃ viduḥ ..6.57.24..

tadudyogaṃ vidur jñānaṃ yogaṃ ca kṛtabuddhayaḥ .
brahma sarvaṃ jagadahaṃ ceti brahmārpaṇaṃ viduḥ ..6.57.25..

antaśśūnyaṃ bahiśśūnyaṃ pāṣāṇahṛdayopamam .
śāntamākāśakośācchaṃ na śūnyaṃ na dṛṣat param ..6.57.26..

tata īṣad yadutthānamīṣadanyatayodaye .
sa jagatpratibhāso 'yamākāśa iva śūnyatā ..6.57.27..

bhāgo 'hamiti ko 'pyeṣa pratyekamuditaś citeḥ .
koṭikoṭyaṃśakalitaẖ ka ivainaṃ prati grahaḥ ..6.57.28..

vikalpabhede sphurite saṃvitsāramayātmani .
vaicitryeṇāvicitre 'pi kimekatrāpi vo grahaḥ ..6.57.29..

apṛthagbhūta evaiṣa pṛthagbhūta iva sthitaḥ .
pṛthagabdhiraparyanto nāhamityavagacchati ..6.57.30..

yathehāhaṃ tathehāsi ghaṭādīhāsti markaṭaḥ .
khamihaivaṃ tathāmbvādi kimahantāṃ prati grahaḥ ..6.57.31..

iti jñānād vibhāgasya yo dvaitasya parikṣayaḥ .
tyāgas saṅkalpajālānāmasaṃsaṅgas sa kathyate ..6.57.32..

samastakalpanājālasyeśvaraikatvabhāvanam .
galitadvaitanirbhāsametadeveśvarārpaṇam ..6.57.33..

abhedavaśato bhedo nāmnaivaiṣāṃ cidātmani .
bodhātmākhilaśabdārthaṃ jagadekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..6.57.34..

ahamāśā jagadahaṃ khamahaṃ karma cāpyaham .
kālo 'hamahamadvaitaṃ dvaitaṃ cāhamahaṃ jagat ..6.57.35..

manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru .
māmevaiṣyasi matvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ ..6.57.36..

dve rūpe tava deveśa paraṃ cāparameva ca .
kīdṛśaṃ tat kadā rūpaṃ tiṣṭhāmyāśritya siddhaye ..6.57.37..

sāmānyaṃ paramaṃ caiva dve rūpe viddhi me 'nagha .
pāṇyādiyuktaṃ sāmānyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam ..6.57.38..

paraṃ rūpamanādyantaṃ yan mamaikamanāmayam .
brahmātmaparamātmādiśabdairetadudīryate ..6.57.39..

yāvadapratibuddhas tvamanātmajñatayā sthitaḥ .
tāvac caturbhujākāradevapūjāparo bhava ..6.57.40..

tatkramāt samprabuddhas tvaṃ tato jñāsyasi tat param .
mama rūpamanādyantaṃ yena bhūyo na jāyase ..6.57.41..

yadi vā vedyavijñāto bhavāṃs tadarimardana .
taṃ mamātmānamātmānamātmanaś cāśu saṃśraya ..6.57.42..

idaṃ cāhamidaṃ cāhamiti yat pravadāmyaham .
tadetadātmatattvaṃ tan muhur vyapadiśāmyalam ..6.57.43..

manye sādho prabuddho 'si pade viśrāntavānasi .
saṅkalpairavamukto 'si satyaikātmamayo bhava ..6.57.44..

sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani .
paśya tvaṃ yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ..6.57.45..

sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ yo bhajatyaikyamāsthitaḥ .
sarvathā vartamāno 'pi na sa bhūyo 'bhijāyate ..6.57.46..

ekatvaṃ sarvaśabdārtha ekaśabdārtha ātmatā .
ātmāpi ca na san nāsad gato yasyāśu tat sa sat ..6.57.47..

trailokyacetasāmantarāloko yaḫ prakāśajaḥ .
anubhūtimupārūḍhas so 'yamātmeti niścayaḥ ..6.57.48..

trailokyapayasāmantar yo rasānubhavas sthitaḥ .
gavyānāmabdhijānāṃ ca so 'yamātmāsmi bhārata ..6.57.49..

antas sarvaśarīrāṇāṃ yas sūkṣmo 'nubhavas sa ca .
mukto 'nubhavanīyena so 'yamātmāsmi sarvagaḥ ..6.57.50..

samagrapayasāmantar yathā ghṛtamavasthitam .
tathā sarvapadārthānāṃ dehānāṃ ca sthitaḫ paraḥ ..6.57.51..

sarvāmbhonidhiratnānāṃ sabāhyābhyantare yathā .
tejas tathāsmi dehānāmasaṃsthita iva sthitaḥ ..6.57.52..

yathā kumbhasahasrāṇāṃ sabāhyābhyantare nabhaḥ .
jagattrayaśarīrāṇāṃ tathātmāhamavasthitaḥ ..6.57.53..

muktāphalaśataughānāṃ tantuḫ protavapur yathā .
tathāhaṃ dehalakṣāṇāṃ sthita ātmāsmyalakṣitaḥ ..6.57.54..

brahmādau tṛṇaparyante padārthanikurumbake .
sattāsāmānyametad yat tamātmānamajaṃ viduḥ ..6.57.55..

tadīṣatsphuritākāraṃ brahma brahmaiva tiṣṭhati .
ahantādi jagattādi krameṇa bhramakāriṇā ..6.57.56..

ātmaivedaṃ jagadrūpaṃ hanyate hanti cātra kim .
śubhāśubhair jagadduẖkhaiẖ kimasyārjuna lipyate ..6.57.57..

pratibimbeṣvivādarśaṃ samaṃ sākṣivadāsthitam .
naśyatsu na vinaśyantaṃ yaḫ paśyati sa paśyati ..6.57.58..

idaṃ cāhamidaṃ cāhamitīdaṃ kathyate mayā .
evamātmāsi sarvātmā māmevaṃ viddhi pāṇḍava ..6.57.59..

imās sarvāḫ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ .
ātmatantoś cito 'ntassthāḫ payasspandā ivāmbudhau ..6.57.60..

yathopalatvaṃ śailānāṃ dārutvaṃ ca mahīruhām .
taraṅgāṇāṃ jalatvaṃ ca padārthānāṃ tathātmatā ..6.57.61..

sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani .
yaḫ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati ..6.57.62..

nānākāravikāreṣu taraṅgeṣu yathā payaḥ .
kaṭakādiṣu vā hema bhūteṣvātmā tathārjuna ..6.57.63..

nānātaraṅgavṛndāni yathā lolāni vāriṇi .
kaṭakādīni vā hemni tathā bhūtāni cātmani ..6.57.64..

padārthajātaṃ bhūtādi bṛhad brahma ca bhārata .
ekamevākhilaṃ viddhi pṛthaksthaṃ na manāgapi ..6.57.65..

kiṃ tadbhāvavikārāṇāṃ gamyamasti jagattraye .
kva te vāpi jagat kiṃ vā kiṃ mudhā parimuhyasi ..6.57.66..

iti śrutvāvagamyāntar bhāvayitvā suniścitam .
jīvanmuktāś carantīha santas samarasāśayāḥ ..6.57.67..

nirmānamohā jītasaṅgadoṣā
adhyātmavidyā vinivṛttakāmāḥ .
dvandvair vimuktās sukhaduẖkhasañjñair
gacchantyamūḍhāḫ padamavyayaṃ tat ..6.57.68..

bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ .
yat te 'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā ..6.58.1..

mātrāsparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇasukhaduẖkhadāḥ .
āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṃs titikṣasva bhārata ..6.58.2..

te tu naikātmanaś cānye kvāto duẖkhaṃ kva vā sukham .
anādyante 'navayave kutaḫ pūraṇakhaṇḍane ..6.58.3..

saṃsthitā sparśamātrākhyā kalāsmin paramātmani .
anante 'sanniveśādau hemnīva kaṭakāditā ..6.58.4..

yaṃ hi na vyathayantyete mātrāsparśā bhramātmakāḥ .
samaduẖkhasukho dhīras so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate ..6.58.5..

sarvatvādātmanas tvete ābhāsās saṃsthitā iva .
asadrūpās tvasadrūpaṃ kathaṃ soḍhuṃ na śakyate ..6.58.6..

manāgapi na vidyete sukhaduẖkhe asarvage .
sarvatvādātmatattvasya sattā kathamivānayoḥ ..6.58.7..

nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ .
nāstyeva sukhaduẖkhādi paramātmāsti sarvagaḥ ..6.58.8..

sattvāsattvamatī tyaktvaivaitayor jagadātmanoḥ .
tyaktvā nakiñcin madhyaṃ ca śeṣe baddhapado bhava ..6.58.9..

na hṛṣyati sukhenātmā duẖkhair glāyati nārjuna .
dṛṣadvac cetanātmāpi śarīrāntargato 'pi san ..6.58.10..

jaḍaṃ cittādi duẖkhasya bhājanaṃ dehatāṃ gatam .
na caitasmin kṣate kṣīṇe kiñcidevātmanaẖ kṣatam ..6.58.11..

jaḍaṃ dehādi duẖkhāder yadidaṃ bhoktriti sthitam .
tan māyābhramamevāṅga viddhyabodhavaśotthitam ..6.58.12..

na kiñcideva dehādi na ca duẖkhādi vidyate .
ātmano yat pṛthagbhūtaṃ kiṃ kenāto 'nubhūyate ..6.58.13..

yadidaṃ kathayāmyatra tenaiṣā te vinaśyati .
bhrāntir duravabodhotthā samyagbodhena bhārata ..6.58.14..

yathā rajjvāmahibhayaṃ bodhān naśyatyabodhajam .
tathā dehādi duẖkhādi bodhān naśyatyabodhajam ..6.58.15..

viṣvag viśvamajaṃ brahma na naśyati na jāyate .
iti satyaṃ paraṃ viddhi bodhaḫ parama eṣa saḥ ..6.58.16..

brahmārṇavataraṅgas tvaṃ kiñcid bhūtvā vilīyase .
brahmāvarte sphurasyadya brahmaivāsi nirāmayam ..6.58.17..

jagat kālaẖ kriyā deśas tvamahaṃ sainikā iti .
brahmaṇyevaṃ parispando nātra stas sadasatkramau ..6.58.18..

jahi mānaṃ madaṃ śokaṃ bhayamīrṣyāṃ sukhāsukhe .
dvaitametadasadrūpamekas sadrūpavān bhava ..6.58.19..

puruṣākṣauhiṇīnāṃ tvaṃ kṣayeṇānubhavātmanā .
brahmaṇā bṛṃhitaṃ yuddhaṃ brahma brahmamayaṃ kuru ..6.58.20..

asaṃvidan sukhaṃ duẖkhaṃ lābhālābhau jayājayau .
yuddhabrahmaikatāṃ gaccha brahmādistambha bhārata ..6.58.21..

lābhālābhasamo bhūtvā bhūtvā nūnaṃ nakiñcana .
jaḍo vāta iva spandī prasṛtaṃ kāryamācara ..6.58.22..

yat karoṣi yadaśnāsi yaj juhoṣi dadāsi yat .
yat kariṣyasi kaunteya tadātmeti sthiro bhava ..6.58.23..

yanmayo yo bhavatyantas sa tadāpnotyasaṃśayam .

anapekṣya phalaṃ brahma bhūtvā brahmeti bhāvitam .
kriyate kevalaṃ karma brahmajñena yathāgatam ..6.58.25..

karmaṇyakarma yaḫ paśyatyakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ .

mā karmaphalahetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stvakarmaṇi .

karmāsaktimanāśritya tathā nāśritya mūḍhatām .

āsaktimāhuẖ kartṛtvamakarturapi tad bhavet .

paraṃ tajjñatvamāśritya nirāsakter mahātmanaḥ .

akartṛtvādabhoktṛtvamabhoktṛtvāt samaikatā .

nānātāmalamutsṛjya paramātmaikatāṃ gataḥ .

yasya sarve samārambhāẖ kāmasaṅkalpavarjitāḥ .
jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tamāhuḫ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ ..6.58.34..

samas somyas sthiras svasthaś śāntas sarvārthanisspṛhaḥ .

nirdvandvo nityasattvastho niryogakṣema ātmavān .

karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran .

yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate 'rjuna .
karmendriyaiẖ karmayogamasaktas sa viśiṣyate ..6.58.38..

āpūryamāṇaṃ tvacalapratiṣṭhaṃ
samudramāpaḫ praviśanti yadvat .
tadvat kāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve
sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī ..6.58.39..

na kuryād bhogasantyāgaṃ na kuryād bhogabhāvanam .
sthātavyaṃ susamenaiva yathāprāptānuvartinā ..6.59.1..

anātmanyātmatāṃ dehe mā bhāvaya bhavātmani .
ātmanyevātmatāṃ satye bhāvayābhāvarūpiṇi ..6.59.2..

dehanāśe mahābāho na kiñcidapi naśyati .
ātmanāśe hi nāśas syān na cātmā naśyati kvacit ..6.59.3..

avināśamanādyantamātmānamajaraṃ viduḥ .
naśyatyātmeti durbodho mā tavāstvatiduẖkhadaḥ ..6.59.4..

na kadācana naśyanti viditātmāna uttamāḥ .
naśyantyaviditātmāno hyanātmanyātmamāninaḥ ..6.59.5..

evaṃ cet taj jagannātha mūḍhānāmapi mānada .
dehanāśe samutpanne manye naṣṭaṃ na kiñcana ..6.59.6..

evameva mahābāho na kiñcin naśyati kvacit .
ātmaivāstyavināśātmā kiṃ tasya kva vinaśyati ..6.59.7..

idaṃ naṣṭamidaṃ yuktamiti mohād bhramādṛte .
anyat tathā na paśyāmi vandhyāstrītanayaṃ yathā ..6.59.8..

nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ .
ubhayorapi dṛṣṭo 'ntas tvanayos tattvadarśibhiḥ ..6.59.9..

avināśi tu tad viddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam .
vināśamavyayasyāsya na kaścit kartumarhati ..6.59.10..

antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāś śarīriṇaḥ .
anāśino 'prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata ..6.59.11..

ātmaivaiko 'sti na dvitvamasatas sambhavaẖ kutaḥ .
avināśas tvananto 'sau sato nāśo na vidyate ..6.59.12..

dvaitaikatvaparityāge yac cheṣamavaśiṣyate .
śāntaṃ sadasator madhyaṃ tadastīha paraṃ padam ..6.59.13..

tan mṛto 'smīti bhagavan kiṃrūḍheha nṛṇāṃ sthitiḥ .
kathaṃ sthitau vā lokānāṃ tau svarganarakau prabho ..6.59.14..

bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyuẖ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca .
etattanmātrajātātmā jīvo deheṣu tiṣṭhati ..6.59.15..

sa kṛṣyate vāsanayā rajjveva paśupotakaḥ .
sa tiṣṭhati śarīrāntaḫ pañjare vihago yathā ..6.59.16..

sa kālavaśato dehāj jarjaratvamupāgatāt .
vāsanāvaśato yāti vṛkṣaparṇād raso yathā ..6.59.17..

śrotraṃ cakṣus sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca .
gṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyur gandhānivāśayāt ..6.59.18..

vāsanāvattvamevāsya deho netarayuktijaḥ .
kṣīyate vāsanātyāge kṣīṇe bhavati tat padam ..6.59.19..

vāsanāvān purā puṣṭo bhūtvā bhrāmyati yoniṣu .
jīvo bhramabharākāro māyāpuruṣako yathā ..6.59.20..

akṣasvabhāvānakhilāñ śarīrād vāsanāvaśaḥ .
jīvo gṛhītvā saṃyāti puṣpād gandhānivānilaḥ ..6.59.21..

deho nisspandatāmeti jīve kaunteya nirgate .
nisspandāvayavābhogaś śāntavāta iva drumaḥ ..6.59.22..

aceṣṭaś chedabhedādidoṣairāyātyadṛśyatām .
mṛta ityucyate loke deho vigatajīvitaḥ ..6.59.23..

sa jīvaḫ prāṇamūrtiẖ khe yatra yatrāvatiṣṭhate .
tatra svavāsanābhyāsāt paśyatyākāramātatam ..6.59.24..

ayaṃ deho hi jīvena tvasannevāvalokitaḥ .
asya nāśe 'nyamapyevaṃ paśyatyevāśu svapnavat ..6.59.25..

yathaiva paśyatyākārāṃs teṣāṃ nāśāṃs tathaiva saḥ .
ādisarge bhāvanayā kilaivaṃ saṃvibhāvitaḥ ..6.59.26..

jhagityudbhavakāle tu yad yathā dṛśyate puraḥ .
ānirvāṇaṃ tadevāsyā avinābhāvisaṃvidaḥ ..6.59.27..

prāktanaṃ vāsanājālaṃ puruṣārthena jīyate .
yatnenādyatanenāśu yatanaṃ hyastanaṃ yathā ..6.59.28..

ya eva puruṣārthena dṛṣṭo balavatā kṣaṇāt .
pūrvottaranimeṣāṃśas sa eva jayati sphuṭam ..6.59.29..

api sphuṭati vidhyaṇḍe vāti vā pralayānile .
pauruṣaṃ hi yathāśāstramatas tyājyaṃ na dhīmatā ..6.59.30..

narakasvargasargādi vāsanāvaśato 'bhitaḥ .
prapaśyati cirābhyastaṃ jīvo jaraḍhamohadhīḥ ..6.59.31..

narakasvargasargādisambhrameṣu jagatpate .
kimasya kāraṇaṃ brūhi jīvasya janitasthiteḥ ..6.59.32..

vāsanātmānamenaṃ tvaṃ jīvaṃ viddhi śarīrakam .
svavāsanātmikaivāsya sattā saṃsṛtikāraṇam ..6.59.33..

dhriyate saṃsṛtis tāvad yāvat sphurati vāsanā .
svapnopamānā teneha śreyase vāsanākṣayaḥ ..6.59.34..

cirābhyāsavaśāt prauḍhā saṃsārabhramakāriṇī .
kimutthā devadeveśa vāsanā kṣīyate katham ..6.59.35..

maurkhyamohasamucchrāyādanātmanyātmabhāvanāt .
ajñānādātmanas sādho sattāmāyāti vāsanā ..6.59.36..

bhāvitātmāsi kaunteya satyaṃ vijñātavānasi .
ayaṃ so 'haṃ janā ete mameti tyaja vāsanāḥ ..6.59.37..

vāsanāvilaye jīvo vilīno bhavati svayam .
yo hi yatsattayocchūnas tannāśāt sa vilīyate ..6.59.38..

dehe vilayamāyāte deśakālānyatākṛteḥ .
ko 'sau bhājanatāmeti janmano maraṇasya ca ..6.59.39..

svayaṃ kalpitasaṅkalpamātmarūpaṃ yadābilam .
tadeva vāsanākāraṃ jīvaṃ viddhi mahāmate ..6.59.40..

anāyattamasaṅkalpamātmarūpaṃ yadavyayam .
prabodhād vāsanāmuktaṃ taṃ mokṣaṃ viddhi bhārata ..6.59.41..

jīvanneva mahābāho tattvaṃ prekṣya yathāsthitam .
vāsanāvāgurāmukto mukta ityabhidhīyate ..6.59.42..

yo na nirvāsano nūnaṃ sarvadharmaparo 'pi saḥ .
sarvajño 'pyabhito baddhaḫ pañjarastho yathā khagaḥ ..6.59.43..

durdarśanasya gagane śikhipiñchikeva
sūkṣmāpi visphurati yasya na vāsanāntaḥ .
muktas sa eva bhavatīha hi vāsanaiva
bandho 'naghasya nanu tatkṣaya eva mokṣaḥ ..6.59.44..

iti nirvāsanatvena jīvanmuktatayātmani .
antaśśītalatāmetya bandhuduẖkhamalaṃ tyaja ..6.60.1..

jarāmaraṇaniśśaṅka ākāśaviśadāśayaḥ .
tyakteṣṭāniṣṭasaṅkalpo vītarāgo bhavānagha ..6.60.2..

pravāhāpatitaṃ kāryamidaṃ kiñcid yathāgatam .
kuru kāryamakārpaṇyaṃ na kiñcidiha naśyati ..6.60.3..

pravāhāpatitaṃ karma svameva kriyate hi yat .
jīvanmuktasvabhāvo 'sāvajīvanmuktatānyathā ..6.60.4..

idaṃ karma tyajāmīdamāśrayāmītyanirmalam .
mūḍhasya manaso rūpaṃ jñamanas tu samasthiti ..6.60.5..

pravāhāpatitaṃ kāryaṃ kurvantaś śāntacetasaḥ .
jīvanmuktās suṣuptasthās sphurantyardhaprabuddhavat ..6.60.6..

sthirāṃ saṃhṛtimāyānti kūrmāṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ .
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo hṛdi jñasya svabhāvataḥ ..6.60.7..

cinmātre vitate tantau dṛḍhe sragiva saṃsthitam .
sadasadgrathitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvāṅge viśvakarmaṇi ..6.60.8..

prasārite prasarati tvantardhiṃ yāti saṃvṛte .
vicitraracanājālamananyac cidvitānake ..6.60.9..

ananyadapyanyadiva svāṅgarūpamanaṅgavat .
citraṃ vitānaka iva sthitaṃ jagadidaṃ citi ..6.60.10..

yathaivāracitaṃ citraṃ sthitaṃ citrakṛdīhite .
tathā jātamajātaṃ ca viśvaṃ saṃsthitamātmani ..6.60.11..

yathā sphurati kartavyaṃ citraṃ citrakṛtaś citi .
viśvātmani tathā viśvaṃ kālatrayamayodayam ..6.60.12..

abhitti trijagaccitraṃ kurute cittacitrakṛt .
vyomni vyomātmakamapi prasphuṭaṃ vṛttivartibhiḥ ..6.60.13..

cittacitrakareṇādau citraṃ citraṃ vitānitam .
paścād bhittiẖ kṛtā vyomarūpā cāsāvaho bhramaḥ ..6.60.14..

apūrvaivātimāyeyaṃ kila yatra khakuḍyayoḥ .
na manāgapi bhedo 'sti sphuṭamapyupalabdhayoḥ ..6.60.15..

imā yā upalakṣyante bhittayaś cittacitrajāḥ .
vyomnaś śūnyatayā viddhi tās tāmarasalocana ..6.60.16..

kṣaṇena cetasi yathā bhāto lokakṣayodayau .
khātmā jagat tathaivedaṃ sabāhyābhyantaraṃ nabhaḥ ..6.60.17..

cirantanamanorājyamātre 'smin kila satyatā .
kathamālokite 'pi syāt satyaṃ nāstyeva vibhrame ..6.60.18..

bhrameṇālokitas satyamālokena vilīyate .
dṛśyamānamapi kṣāmaṃ śaradīvābhramambare ..6.60.19..

cittacitrakṛtaś citte saṃsthitāś citraputrikāḥ .
bhittyabhāvādanādhārā bahis tribhuvanādikāḥ ..6.60.20..

naitās santi na cāsi tvaṃ kiṃ kena parirudhyate .
rodhyarodhakasammohaṃ tyaktvā khavimalo bhava ..6.60.21..

pravṛttireva kā vyomnaḫ pravṛttiś caiva khātmikā .
ataẖ kālakriyākuḍyakalādi vimalaṃ nabhaḥ ..6.60.22..

cittasaṃsthaṃ yathā citraṃ sadrūpamapi khātmakam .
vyomnaś śūnyatamaṃ viddhi tathedamakhilaṃ jagat ..6.60.23..

cittabhittau kṛtaṃ citraṃ yac ciccitrakareṇa tat .
sarvaṃ śūnyatayā vyomno manāgapi na bhidyate ..6.60.24..

yathā prakacataś citte jagannirmāṇasaṅkṣayau .
kṣaṇenaiva tathaivemau bahissthāviti viddhi he ..6.60.25..

ādyakṣaṇamanorājye nānābhuvananāmani .
kṣaṇabhāvini mohena kalpatā parikalpitā ..6.60.26..

asadeva manorājyaṃ kartuṃ śaktaṃ yathā manaḥ .
kṣaṇasya kalpīkaraṇe tathaiva balavan manaḥ ..6.60.27..

kṣaṇaṃ kalpīkarotyetat tathālpaṃ kurute bahu .
asat sat kurute kṣipramitīyaṃ bhrāntirutthitā ..6.60.28..

kṣaṇamādimanorājyaṃ pratibhātaṃ svabhāvataḥ .
yad vicitrātma tadidaṃ jagajjālamiti sthitam ..6.60.29..

sargo nirvāṇaniṣṭhatvān nimeṣamayamutthitaḥ .
pratibhāmātrato 'traiva kalpitā vajrasāratā ..6.60.30..

cittacitrakṛtaś citsthaṃ jagaccitraṃ kacat sthitam .
akuḍyamapyaraṅgāḍhyamidaṃ sphāramivāgrataḥ ..6.60.31..

aho nu citraṃ nirbhitti citramujjvalamutthitam .
surañjanaṃ jagaditi sthitaṃ dṛṣṭivilobhanam ..6.60.32..

nānātamomaṣīlekhaṃ nānātejo'ṃśarañjanam .
nānākalaṅkāvayavaṃ nānārāgānurañjitam ..6.60.33..

nānādṛṣṭivilāsāḍhyaṃ nānānubhavalocanam .
nānābhrakograracanaṃ nānākārāgrapaścimam ..6.60.34..

vyomanīlasaraḫphullatārācandrārkapaṅkajam .
vicitraracanodyuktameghālīpattramañjari ..6.60.35..

svakoṣṭhakābhilikhitasurāsuranṛputrikam .
paramālokamakkoladhavalākāśakuḍyakam ..6.60.36..

ākāśa eva racitā pratibhaikaraṅgā
mugdhā jagattrayamanoharaputrikeyam .
cinmātravaktraparirañjitasarvalokā
līlākulā capalacittakacitrakartrā ..6.60.37..

hemācalāṅgalatikā ghanakeśapāśā
candrārkalocanavicālanadṛṣṭalokā .
dharmārthakāmatrikayantritaśāstravastrā
pātālatālacaraṇonnatabhūnitambā ..6.60.38..

brahmendrarudraharibāhucatuṣṭayogrā
satyānṛtonnatakucā kakubaṅgayaṣṭiḥ .
abdhyantraveṣṭitamahītalapadmapīṭha-
pattrīkṛtācalamahābhuvanodarī ca ..6.60.39..

rātryandhakāracapalabhrurahassmitoccais
tārākarālapulakā grahadantapaṅktiḥ .
cañcaccaturdaśavidhākulabhūtajāta-
romā dhvanatpralayavāridakambupūgā ..6.60.40..

jīvānvitā gagana eva kṛtā vicitrā
vyomātmikāciravilakṣaṇacitrakartrā .
cittena citraparikarmavidā trilokī
nānāvilāsavalitā varaputriketi ..6.60.41..

idaṃ viddhi mahāścaryamarjuneha hi yat kila .
pūrvaṃ sañjāyate citraṃ paścād bhittirudeti hi ..6.61.1..

abhittāvutthite citre dṛśyate bhittirātatā .
aho nu citrā māyeyaṃ magnaṃ tumbu śilā plutā ..6.61.2..

cittasthacitrasadṛśe vyomātmani jagattraye .
vyomātmanas te kimiyamahantā vyomatoditā ..6.61.3..

sargavyoma kṛtaṃ vyomnā vyomni vyoma vilīyate .
bhujyate vyomani vyoma vyoma vyomani cātatam ..6.61.4..

veṣṭitaṃ vāsanārajjvā dīrghasaṃsṛtidāma yat .
vāsanodveṣṭanenaiva tadihodveṣṭyate 'rjuna ..6.61.5..

pratibimbaṃ yathādarśe tathedaṃ brahmaṇi svayam .
agamyaṃ chedabhedāderādhārānanyatāvaśāt ..6.61.6..

ananyac chedabhedādi brahmaṇi brahma cāmbaram .
kiṃ kathaṃ kasya kenaitac chidyate vā kva bhidyate ..6.61.7..

brahmatā brahmatāpūre jale jalamiva sphurat .
sthitā samasamā vyoma nirmalā śāntamātmani ..6.61.8..

vāsyavāsakabhāvo 'to manāgapi na bhidyate .
tenehāvāsanībhāvo bodhāt sampanna eva te ..6.61.9..

yo na nirvāsano nūnaṃ sarvadharmaparo 'pi saḥ .
sarvajño 'pyatibaddhātmā tapasvyapi sa rāgavān ..6.61.10..

yasyāsti vāsanābījamatyalpaṃ citibhūmigam .
bṛhat sañjāyate tasya punas saṃsṛtikānanam ..6.61.11..

abhyāsād dhṛdi rūḍhena satyasambodhavahninā .
nirdagdhaṃ vāsanābījaṃ na bhūyaḫ parirohati ..6.61.12..

dagdhaṃ tu vāsanābījaṃ na nimajjati vastuṣu .
sukhaduẖkhādiṣu svacchaṃ tumbīpattramivāmbhasi ..6.61.13..

śāntātmā vigatabhavāmayo 'si jāto
nirvāṇo dalitamahāmanovimohaḥ .
samyagjñaś śrutamavagamya pāvanaṃ tat
tiṣṭhātmavyavahṛtirekaśāntarūpaḥ ..6.61.14..

naṣṭo mohas smṛtir labdhā tvatprasādān mayācyuta .
sthito 'smi gatasandehaẖ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava ..6.62.1..

vṛttayo yadi bodhena saṃśāntā hṛdaye sphuṭam .
tac cittaṃ śāntamevāśu viddhi sattvamupāgatam ..6.62.2..

atra tac cetyarahitaṃ pratyakcetananāmakam .
vastu śiṣṭaṃ vinirmuktaṃ yat sarvaṃ sarvataś ca yat ..6.62.3..

na kecana prabādhante tat padaṃ jagadādhayaḥ .
bhūtalād gaganoḍḍīnaṃ vihaṅgamamivotavaḥ ..6.62.4..

pratyakcetanamābhāsaṃ śuddhaṃ saṅkalpavarjitam .
agamyamenamātmānaṃ viddhi duṣṭadṛśāmiha ..6.62.5..

sarvātītapadasthasya citā śuddhasya vāsanā .
na śaknoti padaṃ draṣṭuṃ janadṛṣṭiraheriva ..6.62.6..

yatprāptau sarva eveme kṣīṇā ghaṭapaṭādayaḥ .
varākī vāsanā tatra kiṃ karoti pare pade ..6.62.7..

yathānalagiriṃ prāpya himaleśo vilīyate .
śuddhamāsādya cittattvamavidyā līyate tathā ..6.62.8..

kva varākī rajastucchā vāsanā bhogabandhanī .
kvāpūritajagajjālaś cittattvavipulānilaḥ ..6.62.9..

tāvat sphuratyavidyeyaṃ nānākāravikāriṇī .
yāvan na samparijñātaś śuddhas svātmāyamātmanā ..6.62.10..

sarvā dṛśyadṛśaẖ kṣīṇāś śuddhataivoditātatā .
nabhasīva pade tasmin svātmanyakhilapūraṇe ..6.62.11..

samagrākārarūpaṃ tat samagrākāravarjitam .
vāgatītaṃ paraṃ vastu kena nāmopamīyate ..6.62.12..

viṣayaviṣaviṣūcikāmatas tvaṃ
nipuṇamahaṃsthitivāsanāmapāsya .
abhimataparihārayatnayuktyā
bhava virujo bhuvanaikanāthamūrtiḥ ..6.62.13..

iti gaditavati trilokanāthe
kṣaṇamiva maunamavasthite purastāt .

vacanamupaiṣyati tatra pāṇḍuputraḥ ..6.62.14..

parigalitasamastaśokabhāvā
paramudayaṃ bhagavan matir gateyam .

dinapatinā paribodhitābjinīva ..6.62.15..

ityuktvotthāya gāṇḍīvadhanvā sa harisārathiḥ .
arjuno gatasandeho raṇalīlāṃ kariṣyati ..6.62.16..

kariṣyati kṣatagajavājisārathi-

śarotkaraprasaramayābhramaṇḍalī-
tirohitadyumaṇivilocanāṃ divam ..6.62.17..

etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya rāghavāghavighātinīm .
tiṣṭha nissaṅgasannyāsabrahmārpaṇamayātmikām ..6.63.1..

yasmin sarvaṃ yatas sarvaṃ yas sarvaṃ sarvataś ca yaḥ .
yaś ca sarvamayo nitya ātmānaṃ viddhi taṃ param ..6.63.2..

dūrasthamapyadūrasthaṃ sarvagaṃ tvaṃ svameva ca .
tatsthas tattāmavāpnoṣi tadevāsyastasaṃśayam ..6.63.3..

yat saṃvedyavinirmuktaṃ saṃvedanamaninditam .
cetyamuktacidābhāsaṃ tad viddhi paramaṃ padam ..6.63.4..

sā parāt paramā kāṣṭhā sā dṛśāṃ dṛganuttamā .
sa mahimnāṃ ca mahimā gurūṇāṃ sa gurur guruḥ ..6.63.5..

sa ātmā tac ca vijñānaṃ tac chūnyaṃ brahma tat param .
tac chreyas sa śivaś śāntas sā vidyāparamā sthitiḥ ..6.63.6..

yo 'yamantaścetanātmā sarvānubhavarūpakaḥ .
yatra svadante sarvāṇi dravyāṇi svātmasattayā ..6.63.7..

sa jagattilatailātmā sa jagadgṛhadīpakaḥ .
sa jagatpādaparasas sa jagatpaśupālakaḥ ..6.63.8..

sa tantur bhūtamuktānāṃ pariprotahṛdambaraḥ .
sa bhūtamaricaughānāṃ paramā tiktatātatā ..6.63.9..

sa padārthe padārthatvaṃ sa tucchatvamavastunaḥ .

jagadgṛhakriyābhāṇḍopaskarāṇāṃ sa dīpakaḥ .
candrārkatārakātejas tenedaṃ prakaṭīkṛtam ..6.63.11..

sarvaṃ prasṛtametasmāc cetanāt paramātmanaḥ .
svasaṃvittivicāreṇa svayamātmaiṣa labhyate ..6.63.12..

sarva eva jagadbhāvā avicāraṇacāravaḥ .
avidyamānasadbhāvā vicāraviśarāravaḥ ..6.63.13..

ahamādau jagajjāle mithyābhramabharātmani .
ko bhūtvā kvānubadhnāmi dhṛtiṃ kathamavāstavīm ..6.63.14..

ādimadhyāntamananasaṅkalpakalanāsvaham .
brahmākāśamanādyantaṃ keveyattā mamātmanaḥ ..6.63.15..

itiniścayavān yo 'ntas samavyavahṛtir bahiḥ .

nāstameti na codeti sāmyaṃ samamavasthitam .
yasya khasyeva śūnyatvaṃ sa mahātmeha sadvapuḥ ..6.63.17..

bhāvādvaitapadārūḍhas suṣuptaparayā dhiyā .
vyavahāryapi hṛtkṣobhaṃ naityādarśanaro yathā ..6.63.18..

ādarśapuruṣasyeva vyavahāravato 'pi ca .
na yasya hṛdayollekho manāgapi sa muktibhāk ..6.63.19..

avibhāgamatāveva jñamaṇau pratibimbati .
citeḫ paramavaimalyād vyavahāro yathāgataḥ ..6.63.20..

ciccamatkṛtireveyaṃ jagadityavabhāsate .
nehāstyaikyaṃ na ca dvitvamupadeśo 'pi tanmayaḥ ..6.63.21..

vācyavācakaśiṣyehāgurvākhyais svacamatkṛtaiḥ .
ātmanātmani śāntaiva cic camatkurute citi ..6.63.22..

citpraspando hi saṃsāras tadaspandaḫ paraṃ padam .
citspandaśamaneneyaṃ pariśāmyati saṃsṛtiḥ ..6.63.23..

mahāciter nañarthāṃśabhāvo yo 'bhāvanakṣayaḥ .
asanniva svabhāvena sa citspanda udāhṛtaḥ ..6.63.24..

śūnyatvamajaḍaṃ yat tat paramāhuś citer vapuḥ .
nañarthābhāvanā yātra saṃsṛtis sānubhūyate ..6.63.25..

abhāvanāmātralayā sā ca nissārarūpiṇī .
kevalaṃ kevalībhāvas svas sadrūpo 'vaśiṣyate ..6.63.26..

citspanda eva saṃsāracakrapravahaṇaṃ viduḥ .
mātṛmānaprameyādi kaṭakādīva hemani ..6.63.27..

pṛthagasti na ca spandaś citer yas saṃsṛtir bhavet .
cittvameva cites spandas tadabodho hi saṃsṛtiḥ ..6.63.28..

abodhamātraṃ citspandaẖ kaṭakatvamivotthitam .
bodhamātravilīne 'smiñ śuddhaṃ ciddhema śiṣyate ..6.63.29..

satyāvabodhamātreṇa kṣīyate bhogabhāvanā .
bhogābhāvanameveha paramaṃ jñatvalakṣaṇam ..6.63.30..

ime 'nabhimatās sarve jñasya bhogās svabhāvataḥ .
bhavanti ko 'titṛpto hi durannaṃ kila vāñchati ..6.63.31..

etadeva paraṃ viddhi jñatvasya paralakṣaṇam .
svabhāvenaiva bhogānāṃ yat kilānabhivāñchanam ..6.63.32..

cidaspandaiva sarvātmarūpiṇyastīti niścayaḥ .
yo 'ntaḫ prarūḍhas svābhyāsāj jñatvaśabdena sa smṛtaḥ ..6.63.33..

yo na bhuṅkte bhujyamānānapi bhogānabuddhimān .
lokānurodhasiddhyarthaṃ sa hanti laguḍair nabhaḥ ..6.63.34..

vinākṛtrimayā yuktyā na siddhiradhigamyate .
kvacidātmani loke vā svāṅgāvadalanairapi ..6.63.35..

cic cetyacaityakoṭisthā tāvat paśyati vibhramam .
iyaṃ yāvadabodhātmā spandate spandarūpiṇī ..6.63.36..

samyagbodhodaye tvasyās spandāspandadaśākramāḥ .
kvāpi yāntīva saṃśāntadīpavat sābhidhānakāḥ ..6.63.37..

citaḫ prakāśarūpāyā dīpikāyās svabhāvataḥ .
spandāspandamayī neha kathaivāsti manāgapi ..6.63.38..

yadaspandasya maruto na san nāsan na madhyagam .
rūpaṃ tadeva saṃvittispandatā praśamocitā ..6.63.39..

abhinno 'syāś cites spandaś śuddhacitsārarūpadhṛt .
na bandhāya na mokṣāya sthita ātmani kevalam ..6.63.40..

cic cen nañarthasaṃvittiṃ nirvāṇeva na vindate .
tad bandhamokṣapakṣāder nāmāpi hi na vidyate ..6.63.41..

mokṣo 'stvityeva bandho 'ntaḫpūrṇatākṣayakāraṇaṃ .
māstvitītyapi bandhas te śreyase 'vedanaṃ param ..6.63.42..

yadanābhāsamajaḍaṃ tad viddhi paramaṃ padam .
citas svarūpasaṃsthānamacetyonmukhatātmakam ..6.63.43..

yas saṅkalpanaśabdārtharūpas spando mahāciteḥ .
bandhamokṣādikārho 'sau prekṣyamāṇaḫ praśāmyati ..6.63.44..

prekṣaṇādeva saṃśānte tvahambhāve nirāspade .
na vidmaẖ kena kiṃ kasya badhyate vātha mucyate ..6.63.45..

saṅkalpa eva ca citer buddhaś cedavibhāgavān .
tadasaṅkalpamaspandaṃ sarvaṃ jātamavāritam ..6.63.46..

spande 'spandatayaivātte tanmayatvāt sadā citā .
saṅkṣīṇa eva saṃsāro nisspande cidghane sthite ..6.63.47..

citteja eva citspanda iti buddhe nirantaram .
vyatiriktaś citas spando na kaścidavaśiṣyate ..6.63.48..

asmin dṛśyamaye dīrghasvapne svapnāntaraṃ vrajan .
na jño mohamupādatte sarvagatvāt svasaṃvidaḥ ..6.63.49..

yatrodeti prasabhamaniśaṃ sarvasaṃvittisattā

utpadyante svadanasubhagaṃ yatra sarvopalambhā
dhyānenainaṃ tamavagamaya pratyagātmānamantaḥ ..6.63.50..

enamāhuḫ paraṃ tattvaṃ viddhyenaṃ paramaṃ padam .
vedmyenamekamevāhameṣa evāsti netaraḥ ..6.64.1..

ya eṣa pratyagātmāntas sarvasattaikadarpaṇaḥ .
etasmādidamutpannaṃ jagad bījādiva drumaḥ ..6.64.2..

buddhyahaṅkāracittādi varjayitvā jaḍātmakam .
yatrānubhavitāntas te tad viddhi paramaṃ padam ..6.64.3..

śuddhānubhavamātraṃ yan manobuddhyādivarjitam .
mahācidabhidhaṃ puṇyaṃ tadetat paramaṃ padam ..6.64.4..

tatsthā ete mahārūpā brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ .
vibhūtibhis sphurantyuccair janās tuṣṭanṛpā iva ..6.64.5..

ākāśagamanādyābhiẖ krīḍābhiẖ krīḍyate ciram .
tatsthenaiva janeneha svarge svargaukasā yathā ..6.64.6..

tat prāpya nāṅga mriyate tat prāpyāṅga na śocyate .
tat prāpya kṣīyate nāṅga tat prāpyāṅga na badhyate ..6.64.7..

apāraparamākāśarūpiṇaḫ paramātmanaḥ .
sattāsāmānyarūpaṃ cen manāgapi vibhāvyate ..6.64.8..

tat tannimeṣamātreṇa jantur muktamanā muniḥ .
kurvan saṃsārakarmāṇi na bhūyaḫ paritapyate ..6.64.9..

mano buddhirahaṅkāra iti yatra kṣayaṃ gatam .
sattāsāmānyamābhānaṃ kiṃ tat kīdṛśamucyate ..6.64.10..

yad brahma sarvadehasthaṃ bhuṅkte pibati valgati .
ādatte vinihantyatti saṃvitsaṃvedyavarjitam ..6.64.11..

tat sarvagatamādyantarahitaṃ sthitamūrjitam .
sattāsāmānyamakhilaṃ vastutattvamihocyate ..6.64.12..

tat sthitaṃ khatayā vyomni śabde śabdatayā sthitam .
sparśe sthitaṃ sparśatayā tvaci tat tvaktayā sthitam ..6.64.13..

rase līnaṃ rasatayā rasanāyāṃ ca tattayā .
rūpe rūpatayā dṛṣṭaṃ netre līnaṃ ca dṛktayā ..6.64.14..

ghrāṇe ghrāṇatayā dṛṣṭaṃ gandhe gandhatayoditam .
puṣṭaṃ kāyatayā kāye bhūmāvapi ca bhūtayā ..6.64.15..

payastayā ca payasi vāyau vāyutayā sthitam .
tejastayā tejasi ca buddhau buddhitayā gatam ..6.64.16..

manastayā manasyantarahaṅkṛtyāpyahaṅkṛtau .
rūḍhaṃ saṃvidi saṃvittyā citi cittvena cotthitam ..6.64.17..

vṛkṣe vṛkṣatayā lagnaṃ paṭe paṭatayā sthitam .
ghaṭe ghaṭatayā rūḍhaṃ vaṭe vaṭatayā sthitam ..6.64.18..

sthāvare sthāvaratvena jaṅgamatvena jaṅgame .
pāṣāṇatvena pāṣāṇe cetanatvena cetane ..6.64.19..

amareṣvamaratvena naratvena nareṣu ca .
tiryaktvena ca tiryakṣu krimitvena krimisthitau ..6.64.20..

kālakrame kālatayā ṛtāvṛtutayānayā .
tuṭikṣaṇanimeṣādau saṃsthitas tattayā vibhuḥ ..6.64.21..

śukle śuklatayā jātaṃ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇatayā sthitam .
kriyāsu spandarūpeṇa niyatau niyamena ca ..6.64.22..

saṃsthitas saṃsthitau sthityā nāśe nāśatayā sthitaḥ .
utpattirūpeṇotpattāvāsthitaḫ parameśvaraḥ ..6.64.23..

bālye bālyena viśrānto yauvane yauvanena ca .
jarasā ca jarārūpe maraṇe maraṇena ca ..6.64.24..

iti sarvapadārthānāmabhinnaḫ parameśvaraḥ .
kallolaśīkarormīṇāmabdhāviva payobharaḥ ..6.64.25..

nānātaiṣā tvasatyaiṣā satyenānena caiva hi .
kalpitā citsvabhāvena vetālaś śiśunā yathā ..6.64.26..

sarvatra saṃsthitimatā vigatāmayena
vyāptaṃ mayedamakhilaṃ vividhair vilāsaiḥ .
cidrūpiṇaiva kalitākalitātmaneti
sarvopaśāntamatirāssva sukhaṃ mahātman ..6.64.27..

ityuktavatyatha munau divaso jagāma
sāyantanāya vidhaye 'stamino jagāma .
snātuṃ sabhā kṛtanamaskaraṇā jagāma
śyāmākṣaye ravikaraiś ca sahājagāma ..6.64.28..

yathāsmākaṃ mune svapnapurapattanamaṇḍalam .
tathaiva padmajādīnāṃ yadi dehaparigrahaḥ ..6.65.1..

tathaivedaṃ ca sañjātaṃ yadi sarvamasanmayam .
tadasmākaṃ dṛḍhataraḫ pratyayaẖ kathamutthitaḥ ..6.65.2..

asmatsargavadābhāti pūrvasargaprajāpatiḥ .
svajīvapratibhāsātmā vidyate na tu vāstavaḥ ..6.65.3..

sarvagatvāc cites sarvaṃ jīvas sarvatra saṃsṛtiḥ .
sā cāsatyā darśanotthā samyagdarśananāśinī ..6.65.4..

svapnābhaḫ pratibhāso 'sya ya eṣa svayamutthitaḥ .
ahantāpratyayaikātmā sa evātidṛḍhas sthitaḥ ..6.65.5..

svapne kṣaṇavināśitvaṃ yathā puṃsā na dṛśyate .
sargasvapne tathaivaitad brahmaṇāpi na lakṣyate ..6.65.6..

svapno 'grapuruṣasyāsya pratibhāsaś ca yo bhavet .
rāmāsmadādisargātmā bhavet tādṛśa eva saḥ ..6.65.7..

yat svapnapuruṣāj jātaṃ tat svapnapuruṣātmakam .
bhavatītyanubhūtaṃ hi yad bījaṃ tat phalaṃ yathā ..6.65.8..

asatyameva tad viddhi yadasatyena sādhyate .
asatyarthe samarthe 'pi na yuktaṃ bhāvabandhanam ..6.65.9..

asatyarthe samarthe 'pi sattā bhāvanasambhavā .
yatas tena parityājyamasadbhāvanabhāvanam ..6.65.10..

dṛḍhapratyayinas svapnapuruṣād yat samutthitam .
bhavatyātmani sargādi dṛḍhapratyayameva tat ..6.65.11..

nimeṣamātramevāyaṃ sargasvapnas sphuran sthitaḥ .
tasmin nimeṣa evāsmatkalpatā parikalpitā ..6.65.12..

sudīrghasvapnaṣaṇḍo 'yaṃ yathodeti prajāpateḥ .
sargādyās sarvabhūtānāṃ pratyekamuditās tathā ..6.65.13..

cittattvasyaiva bhāvena sargasvapnaparamparāḥ .
sphurantyambho dravatvena yathāvartavivartanaiḥ ..6.65.14..

yadā svapnātmikaiveyaṃ sargalakṣmīr na vāstavī .

yad yathā yādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tat tādṛg vidyate tathā .
na hi paryanuyujyante svapnavibhramanītayaḥ ..6.65.16..

na tadasti jagatyasmin yan na sambhavati bhrame .
vicitrās triṣu lokeṣu dṛśyante vastudṛṣṭayaḥ ..6.65.17..

jalamadhye jvalatyagnir yathābdhau vaḍavānalaḥ .
nagarāṇyambare santi yathā vaimānikāśrayāḥ ..6.65.18..

śilāsvabjāni jāyante hemādrāviva pādapāḥ .
ekāge sarvapuṣpāṇi santi kalpatarau yathā ..6.65.19..

śilāḫ phalanti phalavad yathā ratnagulucchakāḥ .
śilāntaḫ prāṇinas santi bhekā iva śilāntare ..6.65.20..

dṛṣado vāri niryāti candrakāntopalādiva .
nimeṣeṇa ghaṭo yāti paṭatāṃ śāpavāniva ..6.65.21..

svāsattāmapi budhyante svapne svamaraṇaṃ yathā .
adhogāmi jalaṃ vyomni ḍīyate 'bhragataṃ yathā ..6.65.22..

vitānamiva khe vāri tiṣṭhati svarnadī yathā .
uḍḍīyante śilās sthūlāḫ pakṣavanto 'drayo yathā ..6.65.23..

śilātaḫ prāpyate sarvaṃ nanu cintāmaṇeriva .
cintitāni phalantyāśu devodyānāntareṣviva ..6.65.24..

tānyeva na phalantyāśu mokṣādīnīva rāghava .
acetano 'pi kurute karma yantrapumāniva ..6.65.25..

evamādis tathānyaś ca vicitrārambhavibhramaḥ .
dṛṣṭaś śambaragandharvavilāsairapyasambhavaḥ ..6.65.26..

deśakālakriyādravyaratnaśambaraśāpajāḥ .
mayagandharvajanitā anantās satyasambhavāḥ ..6.65.27..

asambhavas sambhavānāmapīhābhyupapadyate .
sambhavāsambhavāṃśasya siddhayas svapnavibhramāḥ ..6.65.28..

na tadasti na yat satyaṃ na tadasti na yan mṛṣā .
sarvaṃ sarveṇa sarvatra svapne sargābhidhānake ..6.65.29..

svapne nimagnadhīr jantuḫ paśyati sthiratāṃ yathā .
sargasvapne magnabuddhiḫ paśyati sthiratāṃ tathā ..6.65.30..

bhramād bhramāntaraṃ gacchan svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ vrajan .
atisthirapratyayabhāgiha jīvo vimuhyati ..6.65.31..

śvabhrāntaraṃ śvabhranipātadoṣāt
samprāpnuvan mugdhamṛgaḫ prayāti .
mohaṃ yathā pātamayaikarūpaṃ
jīvas tathā saṃsṛtipātamūḍhaḥ ..6.65.32..

atra rāghava vakṣye 'hamitihāsamimaṃ śṛṇu .
yad vṛttaṃ kasyacid bhikṣoẖ kvacin mananaśālinaḥ ..6.66.1..

āsīt kaścin mahābhikṣus samādhyabhyāsatatparaḥ .
nityaṃ svavyavahāreṇa kṣapayannakhilaṃ dinam ..6.66.2..

samādhyabhyāsaśuddhaṃ tat tasya cittaṃ kṣaṇena yat .
cintayatyāśu tadbhāvaṃ gacchatyambviva vīcitām ..6.66.3..

kadācit sa samādhānavirato 'tiṣṭhadekadhīḥ .
kañcit sañcintayāmāsa svāsanasthaẖ kriyākramam ..6.66.4..

tasya cintayato jātā pratibheyamatha svataḥ .
bhāvayāmyāśu līlārthaṃ sāmānyajanavṛttitām ..6.66.5..

iti sañcintya ceto 'sya sthitaṃ kiñcin narāntaram .
spandasaṃsthānasantyāgamātreṇāvartake 'mbviva ..6.66.6..

tena cittanareṇātha kṛtaṃ nāmātmanīcchayā .
jīvaṭo 'smīti sahasā kākatālīyavat sthitam ..6.66.7..

jīvaṭo vijahārātha sa svapnapuruṣaś ciram .
svapnanirmāṇanagare kasmiṃścit puravīthiṣu ..6.66.8..

tatra pānaṃ papau matto bhṛṅgaḫ padmarasaṃ yathā .
śilayeva dṛḍhaṃ piṣṭas suṣvāpa ghananidrayā ..6.66.9..

svapne dadarśa vipratvaṃ pāṭhānuṣṭhānatuṣṭimat .
pratibhāmātrasampannaṃ cittadeśāntarāptivat ..6.66.10..

kadācit sa dvijaśreṣṭhas svāharvyāpāraniṣṭhayā .
ājagāma ghanāṃ nidrāṃ bījatāmiva pādapaḥ ..6.66.11..

so 'pyapaśyat svayaṃ svapne sāmantatvamathātmani .
patākārathahastyaśvasenājaladamālitam ..6.66.12..

sa sāmantaẖ kṛtāhāraẖ kadācid ghananidrayā .
suṣvāpāntarvyavahṛtir bījatāyāmiva drumaḥ ..6.66.13..

apaśyad rājatāṃ svapne kakubvalayamālinīm .
lālitāṃ bhogapūgena puṣpaughenartutāmiva ..6.66.14..

sa kadācin nṛpas svasthas suṣvāpāstamitehitaḥ .
purobhāvinijācāras svaṃ kāryamiva kāraṇe ..6.66.15..

apaśyadātmani svapne surastrītvamaninditam .
vṛkṣaẖ kesarasollāso mañjarītvamivoditam ..6.66.16..

sā reme surasenāsu devodyānasthalīṣu ca .
kṣīrāmbhodhitaraṅgeṣu loleva harivallabhā ..6.66.17..

suṣvāpa saikadā bālā mattodyānalatāgṛhe .

dadarśātmanyatha svapne saṃsargavaśatoditam .

sā mṛgī lolanayanā kadācin nidrayāhṛtā .
svapne dadarśa vallītvaṃ svābhyāsād rūḍhamātmani ..6.66.20..

tiryañco 'pi prapaśyanti svapnaṃ cittasvabhāvataḥ .
dṛṣṭānto 'tra śukāśvebhasañjñāsmaraṇamakṣatam ..6.66.21..

sā babhūva latā puṣpaphalapallavaśālinī .
vanadevīvanodyānalatāgṛhavilāsinī ..6.66.22..

bījāntassthāṅkurākārarūpayehādhirūḍhayā .

kañcit kālaṃ suṣuptasthakalayā jaḍatāṃ ghanam .
anubhūya dadarśātha svātmānaṃ bhramaraṃ sthitam ..6.66.24..

ṣaṭpado vijahārātha vane vanalatāsvasau .
padminīṣu ca phullāsu taruṇīṣviva vallabhaḥ ..6.66.25..

bimbādharaṃ vidalayan svādayan kausumaṃ madhu .
svapan kusumaśayyāsu bhuktvā vallīvilāsinīḥ ..6.66.26..

tāmājagāma nalinīṃ pariloḍayituṃ gajaḥ .
ramyavastukṣayāyaiva mūḍhānāṃ jṛmbhate manaḥ ..6.66.28..

nalinīmathanenaiva samaṃ tena sa ṣaṭpadaḥ .
guṇavattāntare rūḍhiriva cūrṇatvamāyayau ..6.66.29..

bhramaro vāraṇālokād vāraṇālokabhāvanāt .
dadarśātmānamālolamattahastitayoditam ..6.66.30..

śuṣkasāgaragambhīre gajaẖ khāte papāta ha .
tamoghanaghane śūnye saṃsāra iva jīvakaḥ ..6.66.31..

babhūva vallabho rājño mahān parabalāntakaḥ .

kadācidarinistriṃśacchinnas so 'stamupāyayau .

paśyan gajaghaṭākumbhamaṇīn procchalitānalīn .

sevamāno vanalatāḫ punarāyāt sa padminīm .

tatra hastikhurākrāntyā punarācūrṇatāṃ yayau .

sa haṃsaḫ phullapadmāsu sarasīṣu ciraṃ caran .
kadācid bahubhir haṃsais saṅgato virarāja ha ..6.66.37..

brahmahaṃsātmikā saṃvidaśabdārthavatī manāk .

sa tāṃ vibhāvayan dūrād dṛḍhaṃ dāśeṣuṇā hataḥ .
tatsaṃvittyanusandhānāj jātaḫ padmajasārasaḥ ..6.66.39..

tatrātisantatavivekavacovilāsair
