muktas sthito nanu yugāntavidhau videha-
muktena tena kila bhāvyamavaśyameva ..6.66.40..

sa kadācid dadarśātha rudraṃ rudrapure khagaḥ .
vairiñcanalinīnālalīlālānebhalīlayā ..6.67.1..

tatra buddhirabhūt tasya rudro 'hamiti niścitā .
pratibimbaṃ varādarśe jhagityeva hi bimbati ..6.67.2..

rudrībhūtavapus tatra tanuṃ tatyāja tāmasau .
gandhaḫ pavanatāṃ gacchan kusumastabakaṃ yathā ..6.67.3..

rudro 'tha rudrabhavane vijahāra yadṛcchayā .
tais taiś śivapurācārair gaṇagoṣṭhīgariṣṭhayā ..6.67.4..

rudras tvanuttarajñānavilāsaikatayā tayā .
svamaśeṣamudantaṃ tamapaśyat prāktanaṃ dhiyā ..6.67.5..

nirāvaraṇavijñānavapus sa bhagavān haraḥ .
uvāca svayamekānte svasvapnaśatavismitaḥ ..6.67.6..

aho nu citrā māyeyaṃ bata viśvavimohinī .
asatyevāpi sadrūpā surūḍhā maruvārivat ..6.67.7..

idamprathamamākrāntacetyo 'haṃ cittatāṃ gataḥ .
pūrvasampannasargasthagaganādivibhāvanāt ..6.67.8..

yadṛcchāsthitajīvatvo bhūtatanmātrarañjitaḥ .
kasmiṃścidabhavaṃ sarge bhikṣurakṣubhito 'bhitaḥ ..6.67.9..

tenālayanibaddhena bahis svairavihāritā .
līlāvilulitākārā yadā ramyeti bhāvitā ..6.67.10..

sarvabhāvopamardena tadabhyāsavaśāt tadā .
tāmeva so 'nvabhūd bhikṣus tyaktvānyaṃ mananodayam ..6.67.11..

camatkṛtiś cetasi yā rūḍhā saiva vijṛmbhate .
vallī tyajati naidāghī pītamapyambu mādhavam ..6.67.12..

sa bhikṣur jīvaṭo bhūtvā jantur jaraḍhavāsanaḥ .
teṣu deśeṣu babhrāma randhreṣviva pipīlakaḥ ..6.67.13..

ātmani dvijabhaktatvāt so 'paśyad dvijatāmatha .
bhāvo bhāvaviparyāse balavāneva vardhate ..6.67.14..

sāmantatāmavāpāsau vipras satatacintitām .
sātatyena rasaḫ pītaḫ phalatāmeti pādape ..6.67.15..

rājyārthadharmakāryāṇāṃ kartṛtvāt so 'bhavan nṛpaḥ .
sa kāmukatayā rājā surastrītvamavāpa ha ..6.67.16..

lolalocanalobhena sā mṛgī rasaśālinī .
babhūva vāsanāmohas tvaho duẖkhāya jantuṣu ..6.67.17..

mṛgī satatacittasthā babhūva vipine latā .
avaśyambhāvi lavanaṃ latikānubabhūva ha ..6.67.18..

antassañjñācirābhyastaṃ bhramaratvamathātmani .
sāpaśyad bhāvamardena sadātadbhāvabhāvitā ..6.67.19..

sa vāraṇakhurakṣodamanubhūyātha bhāvitam .
bhūyo bhūyaḫ prababhrāma mahāsaṃsṛtivibhramān ..6.67.20..

saṃsāraśataparyante rudras so 'yamahaṃ sthitaḥ .
asmin saṃsārasaṃrambhe svamanomātrasambhṛte ..6.67.21..

evaṃ saṃśāntarūpāsu saṃsārāraṇyabhūmiṣu .
bahvīṣvahamabhibhrāntas tvaśūnyāsviva bhūriśaḥ ..6.67.22..

kasmiṃścidabhavaṃ sarge tvahaṃ jīvaṭanāmakaḥ .
kasmiṃścid brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaẖ kasmiṃścid vasudhādhipaḥ ..6.67.23..

haṃsaḫ padmavane bhūtvā vindhyakacche ca vāraṇaḥ .
hariṇo hehayādrau ca daśāmahamimāṃ gataḥ ..6.67.24..

atra varṣasahasrāṇi caturyugaśatāni ca .
samatītānyanantāni dinarturacitāni ca ..6.67.25..

mama prathamameva prāksphuritasya parāt padāt .
sattvajātitayā rūḍho bhikṣutve yo jñatākramaḥ ..6.67.26..

bhūyo bhūyo 'pyatikramya gatasya brahmahaṃsatām .
sa eva prāktano 'bhyāsaḫ phalitas saṅgamodayāt ..6.67.27..

dṛḍhābhyāso ya evāsya jīvasyodetyavighnataḥ .
yonyantaraśatenāpi tamevaiṣo 'nudhāvati ..6.67.28..

kākatālīyayogena kadācit sādhusaṅgamāt .
aśubho vāsanābhyāso jīvasya vinivartate ..6.67.29..

saṅgatyādikamevaiṣa kevalaṃ svodayaṃ prati .
prāktano vāsanābhyāso hetuṃ laghumapekṣate ..6.67.30..

yad yadabhyasyate 'jasramanyadehāntare 'pi ca .
jāgratsvapneṣvasadapi tat sadityanubhūyate ..6.67.31..

tat tadarthakriyākāri duẖkhāya ca sukhāya ca .
udeti bhāvanā tasmād bhāvanābhāvanaṃ jayaḥ ..6.67.32..

bhāvanaiva svamātmānaṃ deho 'yamiti paśyati .
svasattāmātravistāraṃ taṃ gulmatvamivāṅkuraḥ ..6.67.33..

bhāvanā prekṣyamāṇaiṣā na kiñcidapi śiṣyate .
naiva vidyata eveti tadbhrameṇālamastu naḥ ..6.67.34..

bhramasyāsanmayasyāsya jātasyākāśavarṇavat .
asaṃvedanamātraikamārjanīyasya vastutaḥ ..6.67.35..

asanmayī kharūpaiṣā varaṃ sattaiva lālanī .
pravartatāṃ vinodāya kimasan naẖ kariṣyati ..6.67.36..

tat tān sarvān svasaṃsārānutthāyālokayāmyaham .
kāṃścidālokadānena tebhya ekīkaromyaham ..6.67.37..

iti sañcintya rudro 'sau taṃ sargaṃ prajagāma ha .
yatra bhikṣur vihārasthas suptaś śava iva sthitaḥ ..6.67.38..

bodhayitvātha taṃ bhikṣuṃ cetasā cetanena ca .
yojayāmāsa sasmāra bhikṣurapyātmano bhramam ..6.67.39..

rudramātmānamālokya jīvaṭādimayaṃ tathā .
bodhādavismayārho 'pi sthityarthaṃ vismayaṃ yayau ..6.67.40..

atha rudras tathā bhikṣur dvāvevotthāya jagmatuḥ .
kvāpi jīvaṭasaṃsāraṃ cidākāśaikakoṇagam ..6.67.41..

tatra tadbhavanaṃ gatvā tad dvīpaṃ tac ca maṇḍalam .
viṣayaṃ taṃ puraṃ tac ca tac ca pānavaṇiggṛham ..6.67.42..

suptaṃ dadṛśatur naṣṭasañjñaṃ jīvaṭakaṃ śavam .
sthāpayitvā vapurbhāraṃ prabhrāntaṃ bhavabhūmiṣu ..6.67.43..

taṃ prabodhya niyojyāśu cetasā cetanena ca .
ekarūpās trirūpās te rudrajīvaṭabhikṣukāḥ ..6.67.44..

bodhavanto 'pyabuddhābhā vismitā apyavismitāḥ .
babhus tūṣṇīṃ sthitāś citre kṛtākārā iva kṣaṇam ..6.67.45..

atha jagmuś ca te sarve kvacic cidvyomani sthitam .
viprasaṃsāramārambhaparabhūtasaghuṅghumam ..6.67.46..

tatra tadbhavanaṃ gatvā tad dvīpaṃ tac ca maṇḍalam .
viṣayaṃ taṃ ca taṃ grāmaṃ prāpus te brāhmaṇālayam ..6.67.47..

vipraṃ te dadṛśus suptaṃ kalatravalitaṃ gṛhe .
kaṇṭhe gṛhītaṃ brāhmaṇyā bahirjīvamiva sthitam ..6.67.48..

taṃ prabodhya niyojyāśu cetasā cetanena ca .
tasthus te bahavo 'pyeke savismayamavismayāḥ ..6.67.49..

atha jagmuś cidākāśakacitaṃ cetitaṃ ca taiḥ .
sāmantanṛpasaṃsāramārambhabharasundaram ..6.67.50..

tatra tadbhavanaṃ prāpus tad dvīpaṃ tac ca maṇḍalam .
sāmantaṃ dadṛśur mattaṃ suptaṃ paryaṅkapaṅkaje ..6.67.51..

hemāvadātaṃ hemāṅgyā nihitaṃ kucakoṭare .
bhramaryevānvitaṃ padmakośasuptaṃ madhuvratam ..6.67.52..

kāntābhirabhyāvalitaṃ mañjarībhiriva drumam .
dīpajālakamadhyasthaṃ ratnaugha iva kāñcanam ..6.67.53..

taṃ prabodhya niyojyāśu cetasā cetanena ca .
tasthus te bahavo 'pyevaṃ savismayamavismayam ..6.67.54..

atha te rājasaṃsāraṃ jagmus tatra prabodhya tam .
tena sārdhamathānyāsu bhremus saṃsṛtibhūmiṣu ..6.67.55..

prāpya tāṃ brahmahaṃsehāṃ rudratāṃ sarva eva te .
samājagmur virejuś ca rudrāṇāmuttamaṃ śatam ..6.67.56..

ekasaṃvid bhinnatanu citraceṣṭamaceṣṭitam .
ekarūpamanekātma rūpaṃ ca parameśvaram ..6.67.57..

rudrāṇāṃ tac chatamatha nirāvaraṇacinmayam .
sarvasaṃsāragaṃ viddhi sthitaṃ sarvajagatsthiti ..6.67.58..

daśa rudraśatānīha santi rāma mahānti ca .
etadekādaśaṃ viddhi saṃsāraṃ prati saṃsthitam ..6.67.59..

yo yo hi yasya jīvasya saṃsāras samudeti hi .
tatrāprabuddhā jīvaughāḫ paśyanti na parasparam ..6.67.60..

milanti hi mitho buddhās taraṅgāmbviva vāridhau .
aprabuddhās svatāmātraniṣṭhā loṣṭavadāsthitāḥ ..6.67.61..

yathā dravatvād vīcyambūnyanyo'nyaṃ sammilantyalam .
tathā prabuddhā jīvaughā mithaś cittvān milantyalam ..6.67.62..

pratyekamuditāś caite saṃsāre jīvarāśayaḥ .
ciddhātos sarvagatvena tvasatyās satyavat sthitāḥ ..6.67.63..

yad yadākhanyate bhūmes tat tan nāma yathāṅga mṛt .
sarvagāyāś citer yad yadūhyate tat tatheha cit ..6.67.64..

sarvatra pañcabhūtāni yathānubhavasīha hi .
tatheha sarvabhūtātma cittvaṃ sarvatra vidyate ..6.67.65..

yat sālabhañjikāvṛnde śailastambhagate 'ṅgakam .
prekṣyate tat tadevāśma tathā citi jagac citaḥ ..6.67.66..

avedane pare śuddhe vedanaṃ yaj jaganti tat .
akāraṇakamevaitac chūnyatvaṃ nabhaso yathā ..6.67.67..

cidghane vedanaṃ dṛśyaṃ bandho mokṣas tvavedanaṃ .
yadeva rucitaṃ te syāt tadevāśu dṛḍhīkuru ..6.67.68..

sargāsargau bandhamokṣau vedanāvedanātmakau .
abhinnau bodhataś caitau yathecchasi tathā kuru ..6.67.69..

asaṃvittyaiva yan nāsti tannāśe kā kadarthanā .
tūṣṇīmbhāvena yat prāpyaṃ prāptamevāśu viddhi tat ..6.67.70..

yad vai vedanamātrātma tadaṅgāvedanakṣayam .
tad vedanāvedanayor yadiṣṭaṃ tat samācara ..6.67.71..

vīcir yathāmbhasi spando jagac citraṃ tathā citau .
etāvanmātra evātra bhedo yad raghunandana ..6.67.72..

deśakālakharūpeṣu satsu vīcyāditāmbhasi .
jagadādau tu deśādyā asanto nirmitāś citā ..6.67.73..

ābhāsuraṃ trijagadityavabhāti bhāsvat
saṃvedanaṃ cayanamekacites svarūpam .
vāci sthitaṃ bhavati caitadupoḍhabhedaṃ
kliṣṭaṃ praśāntavacanas tu śivaḫ parātmā ..6.67.74..

saṃvedanaṃ sarga itīha śabdāv
arthena bhinnau na kadācidetau .
vīcyambhasī dve iti nocitoktir
jñasyājñatāyāṃ tvidameva yuktam ..6.67.75..

jīvaṭabrāhmaṇādīnāṃ haṃsāntānāṃ munīśvara .
bhikṣusvapnaśarīrāṇāṃ sampannaṃ kimataḫ param ..6.68.1..

rudreṇa saha sambhūya prabuddhās sarva eva te .
mithaś ca dṛṣṭasaṃsārā rudrāṃśās sukhinas sthitāḥ ..6.68.2..

tena rudreṇa tāṃ māyāmavalokya tathoditām .
svāṃśās tāmeva saṃsārasthitiṃ te preṣitāḫ punaḥ ..6.68.3..

gacchatāśu nijaṃ sthānaṃ tatra bhuktvā kalatrakaiḥ .
kañcit kālaṃ samaṃ bhogān matsakāśamupaiṣyatha ..6.68.4..

bhaviṣyatha madaṃśā me gaṇā matpurabhūṣaṇāḥ .
tato mahāpralayato yāsyāmas tat padaṃ saha ..6.68.5..

ityuktvā bhagavān rudras teṣāṃ so 'ntaradhīyata .
anyasaṃsārasaṃsthānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ madhyamāyayau ..6.68.6..

prayayus svāspadaṃ te 'pi jīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
svakalatrais samaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayitvātha kālataḥ ..6.68.7..

rudralokaṃ samāsādya bhaviṣyanti gaṇottamāḥ .
kadācid vyomni dṛśyante tārakākāradhāriṇaḥ ..6.68.8..

bhikṣusaṅkalparūpās te jīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
kathaṃ satyatvamāyātās saṅkalpārtheṣvasatyatā ..6.68.9..

saṅkalpasatyatāstīśe saṅkalpāsatyatāstyaje .
yatra yan nāsti tan nāsti yatas sarvātma tat padam ..6.68.10..

yat svapne dṛśyate yac ca saṅkalpairavalokyate .
tat tathā vidyate tatra sarvakālaṃ tadātmakam ..6.68.11..

taddeśakālātmikayā tayaivāvasthayāpyate .
taddeśakālātmikayā gatyā deśāntaraṃ yathā ..6.68.12..

deśād deśāntaraṃ yadvad yatnagatyādikaṃ vinā .
na labhyate tathā svapno vinā tattāṃ na labhyate ..6.68.13..

sarvamasti citaẖ kośe yad yathālokayatyasau .
cit tat tathā tadāpnoti sarvātmatvādavikṣatam ..6.68.14..

saṅkalpasvapnavastvaṅga yayā ca daśayāpyate .
paramābhyāsayogābhyāṃ vinā seha na labhyate ..6.68.15..

yeṣāṃ tu yogavijñānadṛṣṭayaḫ phalitās sthitāḥ .
sarvaṃ sarvatra paśyanti ta ete śaṅkarādayaḥ ..6.68.16..

idamagragataṃ vastu tathāsaṅkalpitaṃ ca yaḥ .
prārthayatyubhayabhraṃśaṃ sa prāpnotyubhayāśrayāt ..6.68.17..

sarvaṃ hyabhimataṃ kāryamekaniṣṭhasya sidhyati .
dakṣiṇāṃ kakubhaṃ gacchan kaḫ prāpnotyuttarāṃ diśam ..6.68.18..

saṅkalpārthaparaireva saṅkalpārtho 'vagamyate .
agrasthārthaparairagrasaṃsthito 'rtho 'vagamyate ..6.68.19..

agrasthabuddhisaṃsthe 'smin kalpitaṃ prāptumicchati .
yas sa nā naikaniṣṭhatvāt tadā tan nāśayed dvayam ..6.68.20..

tasmādekārthaniṣṭhatvād bhikṣujīvena rudratām .
prāpya sarvātmano labdhaṃ padāt sarvaṃ tathāsthiteḥ ..6.68.21..

bhikṣusaṅkalpajīvānāṃ pratyekaṃ taj jagat pṛthak .
paśyanti te ca nānyo'nyaṃ rudrajñānādṛte tataḥ ..6.68.22..

aprabuddhāḫ prajāyante jīvā jīvāt prabodhinaḥ .
tadicchayāśu viduṣa iva mūrkhās sutā iva ..6.68.23..

iha vidyādharo 'haṃ syāmiha syāmahameḍikā .
ityekadhyānasāphalyadṛṣṭānto 'syāṃ kriyāsthitau ..6.68.24..

ekatvaṃ ca śatatvaṃ ca maurkhyaṃ pāṇḍityameva ca .
devatvaṃ mānuṣatvaṃ ca deśakālakriyākramaiḥ ..6.68.25..

tulyakālamalaṅkartuṃ dhāraṇādhyānayatnataḥ .
sarvaśaktyajarūpatvāj jīvasyāstyeva śaktatā ..6.68.26..

anantaś cāntayuktaś ca svabhāvo 'sya svabhāvataḥ .
savikāsas sasaṅkoco haṃsasyeva cidātmanaḥ ..6.68.27..

yadicchati tadastyaṅga nanu sampadyate svayam .
svayaṃsaṅkalpitairebhir deśakālakriyākramaiḥ ..6.68.28..

yoginyo yoginaś ceha tiṣṭhantyanyatra yānti ca .
iha cāmutra cehante dṛṣṭametadanekaśaḥ ..6.68.29..

kārtavīryo gṛhe tiṣṭhan vavarṣāmbudharo bhavan .
viṣṇuẖ kṣīrodadhau tiṣṭhañ jāyate puruṣo bhuvi ..6.68.30..

paśvarthaṃ yānti tiṣṭhantyo yoginyo yoginīgaṇe .
śakras svargāsane tiṣṭhan yāti yajñārthamurvarām ..6.68.31..

sahasramekaṃ bhavati tathāsmiñ jagadātmani .
nṛṇāṃ śatāni bhaktānāṃ yānti sāyujyatāṃ tanau ..6.68.32..

ekas sahasraṃ bhavati tathā caiṣa janārdanaḥ .
ekaẖ kāntāsahasrāṇi tulyakālaṃ niṣevate ..6.68.33..

evaṃ te bhikṣusaṅkalpajīvaṭabrāhmaṇādayaḥ .
rudravijñānavaśatas svasaṅkalpapurīr gatāḥ ..6.68.34..

tatra bhuktvā ciraṃ bhogān prāpya rudrapuraṃ tataḥ .
gaṇatāmāpnuvantas te sthāsyanti saparicchadāḥ ..6.68.35..

nityapraphultanavakalpalatālayeṣu
rudreṇa sārdhamururatnagulucchakeṣu .
nānājagatsu ca tadā purapattaneṣu
vidyādharīṣvamalamaulidharā ramante ..6.68.36..

eṣa dṛṣṭo yathānena bhikṣuṇā cetanābhramaḥ .
bhūtaṃ pratyekamevaivaṃ pṛthaṅ mṛtvā tu paśyati ..6.69.1..

sarvasya nāma jīvasya mṛtijanmamayī sthitiḥ .
bhavatyeva cidākāśarūpiṇo 'pyākṛtiṃ gatā ..6.69.2..

pṛthak pratyekamabhyeti khātmā saṃsāraṣaṇḍakaḥ .
pṛthagāmodasārthasya yathā kusumaṣaṇḍakaḥ ..6.69.3..

sarva eva mṛto jantuḫ pṛthak svapratibhātmakam .
paśyatyevaṃ kharūpo 'pi dehī cāmokṣamākulaḥ ..6.69.4..

jīva eṣa mayā tubhyaṃ kathitaẖ kathayānayā .
parāt praspanditātmeti na bhikṣū rāma kevalaḥ ..6.69.5..

mohān mohāntaraṃ yāti jīvo jaraḍhajīvitaḥ .
parvatāgraparibhraṣṭo hyadho 'dha upalo yathā ..6.69.6..

paramātmapadabhraṣṭo jīvas svapnamimaṃ dṛḍham .
paśyatyasmādapi svapnād yāti svapnāntaraṃ punaḥ ..6.69.7..

svapnāt svapne 'pi nipatan mṛṣaivedaṃ śilādṛḍham .
paripaśyati deho 'ntar māyayā jarjarīkṛtaḥ ..6.69.8..

kvacit kenacidevaiṣa kadācid vā na vā svayam .
dehena mohanidrāto mucyate samprabudhyate ..6.69.9..

aho nu viṣamo moho jīvasyāsyopajāyate .
padāc cyutasya stokena nānākāravikāradaḥ ..6.69.10..

mithyājñānograyāminyā māyayā nipuṇādidam .
aho nu khalu vaiṣamyaṃ bhīmaṃ nijapadacyuteḥ ..6.69.11..

bhagavan sarvadā sarvaṃ sarvathaiva jagatsthitau .
tvayā sambhavatītyuktaṃ mayā tac cānubhūyate ..6.69.12..

evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭātmā sumahātman sa bhikṣukaḥ .
kvacidasti na vetyantarālokya kathayāśu me ..6.69.13..

atra rātrau samādhisthas trilokīmaṭhikāmimām .
bhikṣureṣo 'sti nāstīti prekṣya prātar vadāmyaham ..6.69.14..

munāvevaṃ kathayati bahir madhyāhnadiṇḍimaḥ .
udabhūt pralayakṣubdhaghanagarjitamāṃsalaḥ ..6.69.15..

tatyajuḫ pādayos tasya puṣpāñjaliparamparāḥ .
nṛpāḫ paurā viṭapinaḫ puṣpaṃ vātayutā iva ..6.69.16..

pūjayitvā muniśreṣṭhānudatiṣṭhat sa viṣṭarāt .
muninā saha bhūpāla udayādrerivāṃśumān ..6.69.17..

sabhā tadanu sottasthau sapraṇāmaparasparam .
krameṇa hyastanenaiva jagmuẖ khecarabhūcarāḥ ..6.69.18..

svāspadeṣu yathāśāstramaharvyāpāramādṛtāḥ .
sarve sampādayāmāsur nijadharmakramocitam ..6.69.19..

cintayanto muniproktaṃ mahīcaranabhaścarāḥ .
jñānaṃ kṣapāṃ kṣaṇamiva ninyuẖ kalpamivāpi ca ..6.69.20..

prātaḫ punaḫ prasṛtakāryaparampare 'smiñ
jāte jane khacarabhūcarasiddhasaṅghaḥ .
āsthānalokaracanena tathaiva tasthāv
anyo'nyasaṃvadanapūjitapūjyalokaḥ ..6.69.21..

vasiṣṭhamunisaṃyuktā viśvāmitrādisaṃyutā .
sthitakhecarasiddhaughā viśrāntanṛpanāyakā ..6.70.1..

sarāmalakṣmaṇā saiva tathaivātha sabhā babhau .
somyā samasamābhogā śāntavātyeva padminī ..6.70.2..

anapekṣyaiva ca praśnamuvācātha munīśvaraḥ .
bodhayanti balādeva sānukampā hi sādhavaḥ ..6.70.3..

rājan raghukulākāśaśaśāṅka raghunandana .
hyo mayā dhyānanetreṇa sa bhikṣuḫ prekṣitaś ciram ..6.70.4..

dhyānenāhaṃ ciraṃ bhrāntas tādṛgbhikṣudidṛkṣayā .
dvīpāni sapta vipulāṃs tathaiva kulaparvatān ..6.70.5..

yāvat kutaścidapyeva bhikṣur labdho na tādṛśaḥ .
kathaṃ kila manorājyaṃ bahirapyupalabhyate ..6.70.6..

tatas tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau punarahaṃ dhiyā .
uttarāśāntaraṃ yāto velāvāta ivārṇavam ..6.70.7..

cīnanāmātha tatrāsti śrīmāñ janapado mahān .
valmīkopari tatrāsti vihāro jinasaṃśrayaḥ ..6.70.8..

tasmin vihāre svakuṭīkośe kapilamūrdhajaḥ .
bhikṣur dīrghaśayā nāma sthita evaṃparodayaḥ ..6.70.9..

ekaviṃśatirātraṃ ca tasyaivaṃsthitiśālinaḥ .
dṛḍhārgaḍaṃ gṛhaṃ dhyānabhaṅgabhītā viśanti no ..6.70.10..

bhṛtyāḫ prāyaẖ kila tathā sa tiṣṭhati subhikṣukaḥ .
adyaivaṃ tasya sampannaṃ niyaterīdṛśī sthitiḥ ..6.70.11..

rātrayo dhyānaniṣṭhasya gatās tasyaikaviṃśatiḥ .
sa tu varṣasahasrāṇi tathā citte 'nubhūtavān ..6.70.12..

kasmiṃścit prāktane kalpe bhikṣurevaṃ purābhavat .
adya tviha dvitīyo 'sti tṛtīyo nopalabhyate ..6.70.13..

mayā tu punaranviṣṭaś cetasā caturātmanā .
tādṛg bhikṣus tṛtīyo 'nyo jagatpadmodarālinā ..6.70.14..

asmāt sargāt tu no labdhas tṛtīyas tādṛgāśayaḥ .
athānye līlayā sargā mayā samprekṣitās tataḥ ..6.70.15..

yāvat kasmiṃścidākāśakośaśāyini sargake .
tṛtīyo vidyate bhikṣur brāhmaṇaś cedṛśakramaḥ ..6.70.16..

evaṃ tenaiva tenaiva sanniveśena bhūriśaḥ .
bhaviṣyantyabhavan santi padārthās sargasantatau ..6.70.17..

asyāṃ sabhāyāmapi ye munayo brāhmaṇā nṛpāḥ .
bhāvyamevaṃsamācārais tairanyairapyanekaśaḥ ..6.70.18..

nāradenāmunā bhāvyaṃ punaranyena cānagha .
evamevātriṇā bhāvyaṃ punaranyena cādhunā ..6.70.19..

evaṃ kalatrakarmabhyāṃ yuktenānena bhūriśaḥ .
evaṃjanmādinā bhāvyaṃ vyāsena ca śukena ca ..6.70.20..

janakena punar bhāvyaṃ kratunā pulahena ca .
agastyena pulastyena bhṛguṇāṅgirasāpi ca ..6.70.21..

eta eva tathānye ca evaṃrūpakriyāspadam .
cirāc cirād bhaviṣyanti māyeyaṃ vitatā yataḥ ..6.70.22..

sadṛśācārajanmānas ta evānye ca bhūriśaḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo vivartante sargeṣvapsviva vīcayaḥ ..6.70.23..

atyantasadṛśāẖ kecit kecidardhasamakramāḥ .
kecidīṣatsamāẖ kecin na kadācit punas tathā ..6.70.24..

evameṣātivitatā māyā manasi mohinī .
kṣaṇo nehāsti no kalpaḫ pratipattir hi jṛmbhate ..6.70.25..

kvaikaviṃśatyahorātrā anantāẖ kva kuyonayaḥ .
kva tāsāmupalambho 'lamaho bhīmā manogatiḥ ..6.70.26..

pratibhāmātramevedamitthaṃ vikasitaṃ sitam .
nānākalahakallolacalaṃ prātarivāmbujam ..6.70.27..

jātaṃ saṃvedanādeva śuddhādidamaśuddhavat .
saṃsārajālamakhilaṃ vahnir vahnikaṇādiva ..6.70.28..

pratyekamevamuditaḫ pratibhāsaṣaṇḍaṣ
ṣaṇḍāntareṣvapi ca tatra vicitraṣaṇḍāḥ .
sarve svayaṃ nanu ca te ca mitho na mithyā
sarvātmani sphurati kāraṇakāraṇe 'smin ..6.70.29..

munināyaka taṃ bhikṣuṃ gatvā sambodhayantvamī .
narā matprahitāś śīghraṃ cīnabuddhakuṭīgatam ..6.71.1..

rājaṃs tasya mahābhikṣos sa dehaḫ prāṇavarjitaḥ .
kledaṃ vaivarṇyamāyāto nāsau jīvitabhājanam ..6.71.2..

tasya bhikṣoś ca jīvo 'sau bhūtvā padmajasārasaḥ .
jīvanmuktas sthito bhūyo nāsau saṃsṛtibhājanam ..6.71.3..

tadgṛhe māsaparyante balān niṣkāsitārgaḍāḥ .
antarālokayiṣyanti bhikṣumakṣuṇṇamānasam ..6.71.4..

anyenaiva sa dehena bhikṣur mukto vyavasthitaḥ .
kathaṃ prabodhyate naṣṭaṃ tadvihāre śarīrakam ..6.71.5..

eṣā guṇamayī māyā durbodhena duratyayā .
nityaṃ satyāvabodhena sukhenaivātivāhyate ..6.71.6..

asatyaiva kṛtārambhā hemnaẖ kaṭakatā yathā .
pratibhāsaviparyāsamātrakāraṇakodayā ..6.71.7..

paramātmana eveyamitthaṃ māyeti mīyate .
taraṅgateva payasi prekṣāmātravināśinī ..6.71.8..

jño 'pi dṛśyamayād dīrghasvapnāt svapnāntaraṃ vrajan .
evaṃ nānyatvamāyāti vivekāt sarvagātmadṛk ..6.71.9..

yo yo 'sya pratibhāsas syādātmaiva sa sa bodhataḥ .
sa evodeti saṃsārakarañjavanagulmadṛk ..6.71.10..

pratyekaṃ bhūtamuditaṃ pṛthak saṃsāramaṇḍalam .
bhikṣos svapnāntaramiva parād vīcirivāmbhasaḥ ..6.71.11..

prasṛtaḫ padmajādeva jagatsvapno 'yamāditaḥ .
tathaivātha svacittotkarūḍhas sarvajanaṃ prati ..6.71.12..

āpitāmahamābhāti sargas svapnavilāsavat .
pratyekamuditas tena brahmāṇḍānīha koṭiśaḥ ..6.71.13..

sphuran parasmin pratyekaṃ jīvaḫ paśyati vibhramam .
hṛdaye 'rthasamarthaṃ ca svapnavad dīrghamāntaram ..6.71.14..

citsattāmātrasāmānyapratīticyutimātrataḥ .
jarāmaraṇaduẖkhānāṃ kaścid bhājanatāṃ gataḥ ..6.71.15..

pātālaṃ brahmalokaṃ vā cic camatkṛtiśālinī .
cittāṃśaspandamātreṇa kṛtvā kṛtvaiva saṃsthitā ..6.71.16..

cit spandarūpiṇī jīvanāmnāgatyātmanātmani .
anyatrānyeva luṭhati bhūtvā sambhramabhāriṇī ..6.71.17..

bibheṣi paramātmātmā paramātmana eva kim .
jīvadehādināmno 'smāt pratibimbādivārbhakaḥ ..6.71.18..

brahmaṇyeva paraṃ brahma jagaddṛṣṭyaiva sat sthitam .
śuddhākāśamivākāśe jale jalamivāmalam ..6.71.19..

loko brahmaṇa evāyaṃ jagadrūpeṇa tiṣṭhataḥ .
bibhetyanyatayopāttāt pratibimbādivārbhakaḥ ..6.71.20..

spande 'spandīkṛte bodhāc citas sañjñā vilīyate .
sāpyalaṃ pariṇāmena līyate 'gnau ghṛtaṃ yathā ..6.71.21..

citspanda eva citspande sarvātmātmani jṛmbhate .
spandāspandau jṛmbhaṇādi kalpitaṃ nātra vāstavam ..6.71.22..

na spando 'stīha nāspando naikatā nāpi ca dvitā .
śuddhacinmātramevāsti sarvaṃ cāsti yathāsthitam ..6.71.23..

pareṇa pariṇāmena sargāhantārthayoś śame .
cinmātramapi nāstyeva nāstītyapi na vidyate ..6.71.24..

bhedabhāvanayodeti bhedaḫ prakṛtilāñchanaḥ .
abhedabodhādakhile galite śiṣyate param ..6.71.25..

nānātehāstyabodhena so 'bodho 'styanavekṣaṇāt .
prekṣakaś caiva nāstyeva tasmān niśśaṅkatā parā ..6.71.26..

nātas svapno na jāgracchrīr na suṣuptaṃ na turyatā .
na bandho 'sti na mokṣo 'sti nānyad vā kalanātmakam ..6.71.27..

śāntirekā jagannāmnī śāntāviyamavasthitā .
abodho 'satya evātaẖ kva dṛśyadraṣṭṛdarśanam ..6.71.28..

spando 'pyaspanda evāsyā nissaṅkalpatayā citeḥ .
na spandāspandayor bhinnā saṅkalparahitaiva cit ..6.71.29..

dvitvaikyādikalārūpas saṅkalpaś cittabhāvanam .
sa cābhāvanamātreṇa galati brahma śiṣyate ..6.71.30..

ciccandrabimbe saṅkalpakalaṅkas sphuratīva yaḥ .
nāsau kalaṅkas tad viddhi cidghanasya ghanaṃ vapuḥ ..6.71.31..

cidghanaś ca na san nāsat sthīyatāṃ tat tate pade .
ityaśeṣamahābodhasārasaṅgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam ..6.71.32..

ciccandrabimbāt saṅkalpakalaṅko 'mṛtavigrahāt .
tvayā bhāvena sammṛṣṭo bhāvābhāvakṣayātmanā ..6.71.33..

bhāvābhāvādikalanāṃ nītvā cinmayatāṃ citā .
śamollāsavilāsānte samamāssva yathāsukham ..6.71.34..

spandāspandau kalpanākalpanāṃśau
cittvān nānyau cit tvanāmā niraṃśā .
sarvākārānāvṛtiś śāntasattā
sattvāpūrṇaikārṇavābhā sthiteti ..6.71.35..

suṣuptamaunavān bhūtvā dhūtvā dvitvaikarūpiṇīm .
kalanāṃ kānta cidrūpas tiṣṭhāvaṣṭabhya tat padam ..6.72.1..

vāṅmaunamakṣamaunaṃ ca kāṣṭhamaunaṃ ca vedmyaham .
suṣuptamaunaṃ mauneśaṃ brahman brūhi kimucyate ..6.72.2..

dvividhaḫ procyate rāma munir munivarairiha .
ekaẖ kāṣṭhatapasvī ca jīvanmuktas tathetaraḥ ..6.72.3..

abhāvitātmā śuṣkāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ baddhaniścayaḥ .
haṭhāj jitendriyagrāmo munis syāt kāṣṭhatāpasaḥ ..6.72.4..

yathābhūtamidaṃ buddhvā bhāvitātmātmani sthitaḥ .
lokopamo 'pi tṛpto 'ntar yas sa muktamunis smṛtaḥ ..6.72.5..

etayor yo bhaved bhāvaś śāntayor munināthayoḥ .
cittaniścayarūpātmā maunaśabdena sa smṛtaḥ ..6.72.6..

catuṣprakāramāhus tan maunaṃ maunavido janāḥ .
vāṅmaunamakṣamaunaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ sauṣuptameva ca ..6.72.7..

vāṅmaunaṃ vacasāṃ rodho balādindriyanigrahaḥ .
akṣamaunaṃ parityāgaś ceṣṭānāṃ kāṣṭhasañjñakam ..6.72.8..

manomaunaṃ pañcamaṃ yat tan mṛte kāṣṭhatāpase .
bhavet suṣuptamaunākhyaṃ jīvanmukte hi jīvati ..6.72.9..

triṣu maunaviśeṣeṣu viṣayaẖ kāṣṭhatāpasaḥ .
suṣuptamaunāvasthāyāś caturthyāś caiva muktadhīḥ ..6.72.10..

vāṅmaunaṃ maunamityeva siddhaṃ tac ca manaẖkalā- .
malinaṃ jīvabandhāya tatrasthāẖ kāṣṭhatāpasāḥ ..6.72.11..

haṭhād vā yogayuktyaiva yas svākṣāṇāṃ vinigrahaḥ .
tadakṣamaunamityāhus tatrasthāẖ kāṣṭhatāpasāḥ ..6.72.12..

asmaran saṃsmaran vāpi dṛśyaṃ vāgdvayamaspṛśan .
apaśyanneva paśyantīṃ kāṣṭhamaunī hi tiṣṭhati ..6.72.13..

prasphuraccittakalanametan maunatrayaṃ smṛtam .
sambhavatyajñamuniṣu na tu tajjñeṣu līlayā ..6.72.14..

nātropādeyatā jñānāmetan maunatrayaṃ kila .
līlayā helayā vāpi tajjñāẖ kurvanti vā na vā ..6.72.15..

idaṃ suṣuptamaunaṃ tu jīvanmuktamatisthitam .
apunarjanmane jantoś śṛṇu śravaṇabhūṣaṇam ..6.72.16..

nātra saṃyamyate vāṇī trividhā nāpi cojjhyate .
nollāsyante na jīyante samastendriyasaṃvidaḥ ..6.72.17..

nānātākalaneyaṃ hi na valgati na śāmyati .
ceto na ceto nāceto na san nāsan na khaṃ na gauḥ ..6.72.18..

avibhāgamanāyāsaṃ yadanādyantamāsitam .
dhyāyato dhāvataś caiva sauṣuptaṃ maunamaṅga tat ..6.72.19..

yathābhūtamimaṃ buddhvā jagannānātvavibhramam .
yadāsitamasaṅgehaṃ sauṣuptaṃ maunamaṅga tat ..6.72.20..

anekasaṃvidrūpātma caikamevedamātatam .
ityāsitamanantaṃ yat sauṣuptaṃ maunamaṅga tat ..6.72.21..

ākāśaṃ naiva cākāśaṃ sarvamasmi na cāsmi ca .
iti sthitaṃ samaṃ śāntaṃ yat tan maunaṃ suṣuptavat ..6.72.22..

sarvaṃ śūnyaṃ nirālambaṃ śāntaṃ vijñaptimātrakam .
na san nāsaditi svasthamāsitaṃ maunamuttamam ..6.72.23..

bhāvābhāvadaśonmeṣaviśeṣair vitathotthitaiḥ .
saṃvido yadanāmarśas tan maunaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ ..6.72.24..

asataiva satevāntaś cetasā vṛttirūpiṇā .
yadanāvartanaṃ saṃvidvṛttes tan maunamakṣayam ..6.72.25..

nāhamasmi na cānyo 'sti na mano na ca mānasam .
iti saṃvidasaṃvittiravicchinnātimaunatā ..6.72.26..

ahamasmi jagac cāsti tvastiśabdārthamātrakam .
sattāsāmānyameveti sauṣuptaṃ maunamucyate ..6.72.27..

sattvāt saṃvida evānyās svapnādikalanāẖ kutaḥ .
anantameva sauṣuptaṃ sarvaṃ maunamatas tatam ..6.72.28..

suṣuptamaunamevedamanantatvāt prabodhavat .
turyamevāmalaṃ viddhi turyātītamathāpi vā ..6.72.29..

suṣuptaikasamādhānas tathā turyasamādhikaḥ .
turyātītasamādhir vā jāgratyapi bhaveta vai ..6.72.30..

turyastha eva sakalāmalaśāntavṛttir
jāgratyapi vyavaharan nipuṇaṃ svapitvā .
nityaṃ sadeha uta vāpi videha eva
brāhmaṃ nabho bhava tadeva kilāsi sādho ..6.72.31..

omityapāstabhavavāsanamekamāssva
na tvaṃ na cāhamiti kiñcidihāsti satyam .
sarvaṃ ca vidyata itīha śilāntarābhaṃ
jñas tiṣṭha cidgaganakośakalaikaniṣṭhaḥ ..6.72.32..

kutaś śatatvamāyātaṃ rudrāṇāṃ munināyaka .
ye gaṇās te ca kiṃ rudrā uta neti vadasva me ..6.73.1..

svapnānāṃ bhikṣuṇā dṛṣṭaṃ śataṃ śataśarīrakam .
sarvamuddeśato jñātamata uktaṃ na tan mayā ..6.73.2..

yadākārāś śataṃ svapne tat tad gaṇaśataṃ smṛtam .
tadeva tad rudraśataṃ rudrā api gaṇābhidhāḥ ..6.73.3..

ekasmād bhagavaṃś cittāt kathaṃ cittaśataṃ kṛtam .
tatsvapnaśatarudreṇa dīpād dīpaśataṃ yathā ..6.73.4..

nirāvaraṇasadbhāvā yad yathā kalpayanti ye .
tat tathāśu bhavatyeva na sāvaraṇasaṃvidaḥ ..6.73.5..

sarvātmanas sarvagatvād yad yathā yatra bhāvyate .
tathānubhūyate tatra tat tat tajjñena nādhiyā ..6.73.6..

kapālamālābharaṇo bhasmasnāyī digambaraḥ .
śmaśānanilayo brahman kāmukaś ca maheśvaraḥ ..6.73.7..

maheśvarāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ jīvanmuktaśarīriṇām .
na kriyāniyamo 'stīha sa hyajñeṣveva kalpitaḥ ..6.73.8..

ajñās tvajitacittatvāt kriyāniyamanaṃ vinā .
gardhān mātsyena nyāyena paraṃ duẖkhaṃ prayānti hi ..6.73.9..

tajjñās tviṣṭeṣvaniṣṭeṣu na nimajjanti vastuṣu .
jitendriyatvād buddhatvān nirvāsanatayānayā ..6.73.10..

kākatālīyavad rūḍhāṃ kriyāṃ kurvanti te sadā .
na kurvantyapi vā kecin naiṣāṃ kvacidapi grahaḥ ..6.73.11..

kākatālīyavad viṣṇurevaṃkarmoditaḫ parāt .
evaṃkarmā trinayana evaṃkarmāmbujodbhavaḥ ..6.73.12..

na nindyamasti nānindyaṃ nopādeyaṃ na heyakam .
na cātmīyaṃ na ca paraṃ karma jñaviṣayaṃ kvacit ..6.73.13..

agnyādīnāṃ yathauṣṇyādi sargādau rūḍhimāgatam .
harādīnāṃ tathā karma dvijātīnāṃ ca jātayaḥ ..6.73.14..

sarge prarūḍhimāyāte saṅketavaśataḫ pṛthak .
anubhūtaphalais svārthāẖ kalpanāẖ kalpitās tataḥ ..6.73.15..

videhamuktaviṣayaṃ turyaṃ maunamito mayā .
noktaṃ te pañcamaṃ maunaṃ videhasya raghūdvaha ..6.73.16..

khādapyatitarāmacchamātmākāśaṃ cidātmakam .
tatra prāptiḫ paraṃ śreyas sā kathaṃ prāpyate śṛṇu ..6.73.17..

samyagjñānāvabodhena nityamekasamādhinā .
saṅkhyayaivāvabuddhā ye te sāṅkhyā yoginas smṛtāḥ ..6.73.18..

prāṇādyanilasaṃśāntau yuktā ye padamāgatāḥ .
anāmayamanādyantaṃ te smṛtā yogayoginaḥ ..6.73.19..

upādeyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ śāntaṃ padamakṛtrimam .
tat kaiścit saṅkhyayā prāptaṃ kaiścid yogena dehataḥ ..6.73.20..

ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḫ paśyati sa paśyati .
yat sāṅkhyaiḫ prāpyate sthānaṃ paraṃ yogais tadeva hi ..6.73.21..

yatra prāptā manovṛttiratyantaṃ nopalabhyate .
vāsanāvāgurākrāntā tad viddhi paramaṃ padam ..6.73.22..

vāsanāṃ cittamevāhuẖ kāraṇaṃ tad dhi saṃsṛteḥ .
tadakāraṇatāmeti vilīya bhavakarmasu ..6.73.23..

manaḫ paśyati vai dehaṃ bālo vetālakaṃ yathā .
ātmānaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā na bhūyas taṃ prapaśyati ..6.73.24..

mano mudhaivābhyuditamasadevānavekṣaṇāt .
svapne svamaraṇākāraṃ prekṣyamāṇaṃ na vidyate ..6.73.25..

mano'bhāvān na saṃsāraẖ kvāmodaẖ kusumaṃ vinā .
upadeśyopadeśādi bandhamokṣau ca tat kutaḥ ..6.73.26..

ekatattvaghanābhyāsaḫ prāṇānāṃ vilayas tataḥ .
manovinigrahaś ceti mokṣaśabdārthakāraṇam ..6.73.27..

yadi hi prāṇavilayo mune mokṣasya kāraṇam .
mṛtā eva hi mucyante tan manye sarvajantavaḥ ..6.73.28..

triṣveteṣu prayogeṣu manaḫpraśamanaṃ varam .
sādhyaṃ viddhi tadevāśu yathā bhavati tac chivam ..6.73.29..

yadā nirvāsanaṃ prāṇās tyajantīdaṃ śarīrakam .
tadā na bhūyas tanmātrair yānti vyomani saṅgamam ..6.73.30..

vāsanāṃśātmakānyeva viddhi tanmātrakāṇi vai .
tadātmakair manovadbhiḫ prāṇāś śliṣyanti netaraiḥ ..6.73.31..

savāsanās tu yadyete prāṇā muñcanti dehakam .
tad vyomavāyusaṃśleṣaṃ yānti duẖkhāya gandhavat ..6.73.32..

manas sāmburivāmbhodo na śāmyati savāsanam .
nāmanaskās sambhavanti prāṇās sūryā ivātviṣaḥ ..6.73.33..

na jahāti manaḫ prāṇān vinā jñānena karhicit .
tṛṇāntareṇaiva vinā tṛṇāgramiva tittiriḥ ..6.73.34..

jñānādavāsanībhāvaṃ svanāśaṃ prāpya vai manaḥ .
prāṇaspandaṃ ca nādatte tataś śāntir hi śiṣyate ..6.73.35..

jñānāt sarvapadārthānāmasattvaṃ samudetyalam .
tato 'ṅga vāsanānāśād viyogaḫ prāṇacetasoḥ ..6.73.36..

tato na paśyati manaḫ praśāntaṃ dehatāṃ punaḥ .
svanāśena padaṃ prāptaṃ vāsanaiva mano viduḥ ..6.73.37..

ceto hi vāsanāmātraṃ tadabhāvaḫ paraṃ padam .
tac ca sampadyate jñānāj jñānamāhur vicāraṇam ..6.73.38..

ityasyās saṃsṛte rāma paryantas sampravartate .
svayaṃ vivekamātreṇa rajjusarpabhramākṛteḥ ..6.73.39..

ekārthābhyasanaprāṇarodhacetaḫparikṣayāḥ .
ekasminneva saṃsiddhe saṃsidhyanti parasparam ..6.73.40..

tālavṛntaparispande śānte śānto yathānilaḥ .
prāṇānilaparispande śānte śāntaṃ tathā manaḥ ..6.73.41..

prāṇāś śarīravilaye prayānti vyomavāyutām .
yathāvāsitamevedaṃ manaḫ paśyanti tatra ca ..6.73.42..

yathā videhāḫ paśyanti prāṇā vyomani dehakam .
samanaskās tathācāraṃ sarvaṃ cānubhavanti te ..6.73.43..

śānte vātaparispande yathā gandhaḫ praśāmyati .
tathā śānte manasspande śāmyanti prāṇavāyavaḥ ..6.73.44..

avinābhāvinī nityaṃ jantūnāṃ prāṇacetasī .
kusumāmodavan miśre tilataile iva sthite ..6.73.45..

manasas spandanaṃ prāṇaḫ prāṇasya spandanaṃ manaḥ .
ete viharato nityamanyo'nyaṃ rathasārathī ..6.73.46..

ādhārādheyavat tvete ekābhāve vinaśyataḥ .
kurutaś ca svanāśena kāryaṃ mokṣākhyamuttamam ..6.73.47..

ekatattvaghanābhyāsāc chāntaṃ śāmyatyalaṃ manaḥ .
tallayatvāt svabhāvasya tena prāṇo 'pi śāmyati ..6.73.48..

vicārya yadanantātmatattvaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayet .
manas tatas tallayatas tadeva bhavati sthiram ..6.73.49..

yadevātitarāṃ śreyo 'nupalambhopalambhayoḥ .
dvayorapyasatos tatra śeṣe vāpi sthiro bhava ..6.73.50..

ekasmin sudṛḍhe tattve tāvad bhāvaṃ vibhāvayet .
bhāvo 'bhāvatvamāyāti svābhyāsād yāvadātatam ..6.73.51..

pratyāhāravaśāc cetas svayaṃ bhogyakṣayādiva .
vilīyate saha prāṇaiḫ paramevāvaśiṣyate ..6.73.52..

yadekatānaṃ bhavati cetas tad bhavati kṣaṇāt .
śāntāśeṣaviśeṣaughaṃ cirābhyāsasvabhāvataḥ ..6.73.53..

avidyeyaṃ tu nāstīti buddhvā yuktiyutaṃ dhiyā .
jñānādeva parāvāptis tadabhyāsas tato varam ..6.73.54..

citte śānte śāmyatīyaṃ saṃsāramṛgatṛṣṇikā .
jarāmupagate meghe mihikā mahatī yathā ..6.73.55..

cittamātramavidyeti kuru tenaiva tatkṣayam .
tadrūpanāma cittātmānubhāvo hi paraṃ padam ..6.73.56..

muhūrtameva nirvāṇaṃ yadi cetaḫ pare pade .
tat tatpariṇataṃ viddhi tatraivāsvādamāgatam ..6.73.57..

yadi sāṅkhyena viśrāntaṃ ceto yogena vā pade .
kṣaṇaṃ tat sattvatāṃ yātaṃ na bhūyaḫ parijāyate ..6.73.58..

ceto vigalitāvidyaṃ sattvaśabdena kathyate .
dagdhaṃ saṃsārabījaṃ tan na dadyādaṅkuraṃ punaḥ ..6.73.59..

jñaś cidvigalitāvidyas sattvasthaś śāntavāsanaḥ .
samaṃ śūnyopamaṃ śāntaṃ jyotiḫ paśyati śāmyati ..6.73.60..

vigalitājñapadaṃ vimalaṃ manas
subhaga sattvamitīha hi kathyate .
na punareti kalāmalinaṃ padaṃ
kanakatāmiva tāmramupāgatam ..6.73.61..

jīvo 'jīvībhavatyāśu yāti cittamacittatām .
vicārādityavidyānto mokṣa ityabhidhīyate ..6.74.1..

mṛgatṛṣṇājalamiva sargo 'hantādi dṛśyate .
asadeva manāgeva tad vicārāt pralīyate ..6.74.2..

saṃsṛtisvapnaviśrāntau vetālodāhṛtānimān .
praśnānākarṇaya śubhān prasaṅgāt smṛtimāgatān ..6.74.3..

asti vindhyamahāṭavyāṃ vetālo vipulākṛtiḥ .
sa kiñcin maṇḍalaṃ gardhādājagāma jighatsayā ..6.74.4..

sa vetālo 'vasat pūrvaṃ kasmiṃścit sajjanāspade .
bahubalyupahāreṇa nityatṛptatayā sukhī ..6.74.5..

nirnimittaṃ nirāgaskaṃ na tenāsau purogatam .
kṣudhito 'pi naraṃ hanti saṅgo hi nyāyadaiśikaḥ ..6.74.6..

sa kālenāṭavīgeho jagāma nagarāntaram .
nyāyayuktyā janaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣudhā samabhicoditaḥ ..6.74.7..

tatra prāpa sa bhūpālaṃ rātricaryāvinirgatam .
tamāha ghanaghoreṇa śabdenograniśācaraḥ ..6.74.8..

rājaṃl labdho 'si bhīmena vetālena mayādhunā .
kva gacchasi vinaṣṭo 'si bhavān bhojanamadya me ..6.74.9..

bho rātricara nirnyāyaṃ māṃ cedatsi balādiha .
tat te sahasradhā mūrdhā sphuṭiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ..6.74.10..

na tvāmadmyahamanyāyaṃ nyāyo 'yaṃ tu mayocyate .
rājāsi sakalāśāś ca pūraṇīyās tvayārthinām ..6.74.11..

mamemāmarthitāṃ rājan sambhavārthaṃ prapūraya .
praśnānimān mayoktāṃs tvaṃ samyag vyākhyātumarhasi ..6.74.12..

kasya sūryasya raśmīnāṃ brahmāṇḍānyaṇavaẖ kṛśāḥ .
kasmin sphuranti pavane mahāgaganareṇavaḥ ..6.74.13..

svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ gacchañ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ .
tyajan na tyajati svacchaṃ kas svarūpaṃ prabhāsuram ..6.74.14..

rambhāstambho yathā pattramātrameva punaḫ punaḥ .
antarantas tathāntaś ca tathā ko 'ṇus sa eva hi ..6.74.15..

brahmāṇḍākāśabhūtaughasūryamaṇḍalameravaḥ .
aparityajato 'ṇutvaṃ kasyāṇoḫ paramāṇavaḥ ..6.74.16..

kasyānavayavasyaiva paramāṇumahāgireḥ .
śilāntar nibiḍaikāntarūpo majjā jagattrayī ..6.74.17..

iti kathayasi cen na me durātmaṃs
tadiha nigīrya bhavantamātmaghātin .
phalamiva tava maṇḍalaṃ graseyaṃ
prasabhamupetya jagad yathā kṛtāntaḥ ..6.74.18..

ityuktavati vetāle vaktuṃ praśnān vihasya saḥ .
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā dantāṃśudhavalānanaḥ ..6.75.1..

asti cittiktatātmedaṃ brahmāṇḍamaricaṃ phalam .
uttarottarasaṃvṛttabhūtatvakpariveṣṭitam ..6.75.2..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi phalānāṃ yatra santi hi .
astyuccais tādṛśī śākhā vipulā calapallavā ..6.75.3..

tādṛśīnāṃ sahasrāṇi śākhānāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛśo 'sti mahāvṛkṣo durlakṣyo vipulākṛtiḥ ..6.75.4..

yatra santi sahasrāṇi tādṛśānāṃ mahīruhām .
tādṛśaṃ vanamastyuccairanantatarugulmakam ..6.75.5..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi vanānāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛgasti bṛhac chṛṅgamatyuccair bharitākṛti ..6.75.6..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi śṛṅgāṇāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛśo 'sti mahāśailaḫ pūritākhiladiktaṭaḥ ..6.75.7..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi śailānāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛśo 'styativistīrṇo deśo vipulakoṭaraḥ ..6.75.8..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi deśānāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛgasti bṛhad dvīpaṃ mahāhradanadīvṛtam ..6.75.9..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi dvīpānāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛgasti mahīpīṭhaṃ vicitraracanānvitam ..6.75.10..

tādṛśīnāṃ sahasrāṇi pṛthvīnāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛgasti jagat sphāraṃ mahābhuvanapañjaram ..6.75.11..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi jagatāṃ yatra santyatha .
tādṛgasti mahac cāṇḍaṃ caṇḍāḍambarapīṭhavat ..6.75.12..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi yatrāṇḍāṇāṃ taraṅgakaḥ .
tādṛśo 'virataspando vipulo 'styatha sāgaraḥ ..6.75.13..

tādṛksāgaralakṣyāṇi taraṅgo yatra pelavaḥ .
tādṛśas svavilāsātmā nirmalo 'sti mahārṇavaḥ ..6.75.14..

tādṛṃśyabdhisahasrāṇi yasyodarajalānyatha .
tādṛśo 'sti pumān kaścidatyuccair bharitākṛtiḥ ..6.75.15..

tādṛśānāṃ nṛṇāṃ lakṣair yasya mālorasi sthitā .
pradhānaṃ sarvasattānāṃ tādṛśo 'styaparaḫ pumān ..6.75.16..

tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi puruṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām .
sphuranti maṇḍale yasya svatanūruhajālavat ..6.75.17..

tādṛśo 'sti mahādityas sa tapatyāsu dṛṣṭiṣu .
yā etāẖ kalanās sarvās tā etās tasya dīptayaḥ ..6.75.18..

asyādityasya raśmīnāṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ trasareṇuvat .
eṣa citsūrya ityuktas sarvametat tapatyasau ..6.75.19..

vijñānātmaiṣa paramo bhāskaro bhāvibhāsanaḥ .
ime ye bhuvanābhogās tasyaiva trasareṇavaḥ ..6.75.20..

vijñānaparamārkasya bhāsā bhānti bhavanti ca .
imā jagadaharlakṣmyas tvaharlakṣmyo raveriva ..6.75.21..

vijñānamātrakacitātmani jantujāte
trailokyamaṇḍapagaṇe ca vikāsabhāji .
nirmajjanodbhavanasambhramabhāvalekhās
santīva neha hi manāgapi śāntamāssva ..6.75.22..

kālasattā nabhassattā spandasattā ca cinmayī .
śuddhacetanasattātha sarvamityādi pāvanam ..6.76.1..

paramātmamahāvāyau rajas sphurati cañcalam .
kusumāntarivāmodas tadatadrūpakaṃ svataḥ ..6.76.2..

jagadākhye mahāsvapne svapnāt svapnāntaraṃ vrajet .
rūpaṃ tyajati no śāntaṃ brahma śāntatvabṛṃhitam ..6.76.3..

saṅkalpaparibṛṃheyamanantasphuraṇā svataḥ .
yathā yathābhibṛṃhābhir bṛṃhatyābṛṃhitā tathā ..6.76.4..

saṅkalpaś ca parādasmān manāgapi na bhidyate .
cinmayatvāt tataẖ kiñcin na bṛṃhāsti na bṛṃhaṇam ..6.76.5..

rambhāstambho yathā pattramātramevāntarāntarā .
antarantas tathedaṃ hi viśvaṃ brahma vivartyatha ..6.76.6..

sabrahmātmādibhiś śabdair yadetairabhidhīyate .
śūnyamavyapadeśyaṃ tan na nakiñcin na kiñcana ..6.76.7..

yā yā vibhāvyate sattā sā sānubhavanirmitā .
rambhāstambhavadevātaś cinmātramamalaṃ tatam ..6.76.8..

sūkṣmatvādapyalabhyatvāt paramātmā paro 'ṇukaḥ .
anantatvādasāveva prokto mervādidhūlimān ..6.76.9..

aṇorapyatyanantasya puro 'sya jagadādyapi .
paramāṇuvadābhāti pramitatvādarūpavat ..6.76.10..

paro 'ṇureṣo 'labhyatvāt pūrakatvān mahāgiriḥ .
sarvāvayavarūpo 'pi nirastāvayavaḫ pumān ..6.76.11..

asya vijñaptimātrasya majjāmātraṃ jagattrayī .
vijñānamātramadhyaṃ hi sādho viddhi jagattrayam ..6.76.12..

vijñānamātramakalākalitaṃ jaganti
śāntaṃ svabhāvasukumāramanantarūpam .
vetālabālaka padaṃ tadalaṅghanīyam
evaṃsmayas samanubhāvaya śāntamāssva ..6.76.13..

iti rājamukhāc chrutvā vetālaś śāntimāyayau .
bhāvitātmatayā tatra vicāroditayā dhiyā ..6.77.1..

upaśāntavapur bhūtvā gatvaikāntamaninditaḥ .
babhūvāvicaladhyānī vismṛtya viṣamāṃ kṣudham ..6.77.2..

etad rāma mayoktaṃ te vetālapraśnajālakam .
evaṃkrameṇa cidaṇāvevedaṃ saṃsthitaṃ jagat ..6.77.3..

cidaṇoẖ kośagaṃ viśvaṃ vicāreṇa vilīyate .
kopo vetālakasyeva śiṣyate yat paraṃ tu tat ..6.77.4..

saṃhṛtya sarvataś cittaṃ stimitenāntarātmanā .
pravāhāpatitaṃ kurvan niricchas tiṣṭha śāntadhīḥ ..6.77.5..

ākāśaviśadaṃ kṛtvā manasaiva mano muniḥ .
tiṣṭhaikaśamaśāntātmā vyomavadviśadāśayaḥ ..6.77.6..

sthirabuddheramūḍhasya yathāprāptānuvartinaḥ .
rājño bhagīrathasyeva dussādhamapi sidhyati ..6.77.7..

sampūrṇaśāntamanasaḫ paritṛptavṛtter
nityaṃ same susamamātmani tiṣṭhato 'ntaḥ .
sidhyanti durlabhatarā api vāñchitārthā
gaṅgāvatāra iva sāgarakhātṛnaptuḥ ..6.77.8..

yathā cittacamatkṛtyā rājño gaṅgāvatāraṇam .
bhagīrathasya sampannaṃ tan me kathaya bhoḫ prabho ..6.78.1..

āsīd bhagīratho nāma rājā paramadhārmikaḥ .
bhuvas samudradvīpāyā maṇḍanātilakopamaḥ ..6.78.2..

saṅkalpānantaraṃ prāpur yathābhimatamarthinaḥ .
candraprasannavadanād yasmāc cintāmaṇeriva ..6.78.3..

sādhūnāṃ yo vyavasthārthaṃ dhanānyavirataṃ dadau .
tṛṇamātramupādatte karaṃ tṛṇamaṇir yathā ..6.78.4..

vajrasāramapi protamajvalanneva yo 'bhinat .
ayomaṇirayoyantramiva durjanaceṣṭitam ..6.78.5..

adhūmo hyadahañ śīto vitaikṣṇyo hārdamapyalam .
tamo 'haran nṛṇāṃ naiśaṃ yo maṇir veśmanāmiva ..6.78.6..

kirannagnikaṇāsāramabhitas svapratāpajam .
madhyāhnasūryakāntāgniriva jvalati yo 'riṣu ..6.78.7..

mṛduśītasukhasparśo yas samāhlādayan mahīm .
sve jane dravati snigdhas sendurindumaṇir yathā ..6.78.8..

jagadyajñopavītasya svargapātālavāhinaḥ .
gaṅgāvāhasya yenorvyāṃ tṛtīyaḫ pūrito guṇaḥ ..6.78.9..

agastyaśoṣito 'mbhodhir gaṅgāpūreṇa pūritaḥ .
yena duṣpūrarūpo 'pi mahāsārtho 'rthināmiva ..6.78.10..

gaṅgāsopānapaddhatyā yena pātālavāsinaḥ .
yojitā brahmaṇo loke bāndhavā lokabandhunā ..6.78.11..

brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ jahnuṃ tapasārādhayaṃś ca yaḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo yayau khedaṃ na mūrtavyavasāyavat ..6.78.12..

yauvane vartamānasya tasya bhūmipateratha .
pravicārayato lokayātrāṃ paryākulāmimām ..6.78.13..

svavirāgacamatkāravicārakaṇikodabhūt .
cetasyapi sutāruṇye daivād vallī marāviva ..6.78.14..

ekānte cintayāmāsa mahīpatirasāvatha .
jagadyātrāmimāṃ nityamasamañjasasaṅkulām ..6.78.15..

punar dinaṃ punaś śyāmā dānādānāśanaṃ punaḥ .
tadeva śuktavirasaṃ lajjyate karma kurvatā ..6.78.16..

yena prāptena loke 'smin nāprāptamavaśiṣyate .
tat kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ manye śeṣaṃ karmaviṣūcikā ..6.78.17..

punaḫ punaḫ paryuṣitaṃ karma kurvan na lajjate .
mūḍhabuddhiramūḍhas tu kaẖ kuryāt kila bālavat ..6.78.18..

athaikadodvignamanāẖ kadācit tryuttulaṃ gurum .
ekānte saṃsṛter bhītas samapṛcchad bhagīrathaḥ ..6.78.19..

antaśśūnyāsu suciraṃ bhraman saṃsāravṛttiṣu .
araṇyānīṣvivaitāsu bhṛśaṃ khinnā vayaṃ vibho ..6.78.20..

jarāmaraṇamohādirūpāṇāṃ bhavakāriṇām .
bhagavan sarvaduẖkhānāṃ kathamantaḫ prajāyate ..6.78.21..

cirasāmyātmanācchena nirvibhāgavilāsinā .
rājañ jñeyāvabodhena pūrṇena bharitātmanā ..6.78.22..

kṣīyante sarvaduẖkhāni truṭyanti granthayo 'bhitaḥ .
saṃśayāś śamamāyānti sarvakarmāṇi cānagha ..6.78.23..

jñeyaṃ tu vidurātmānaṃ saṃśuddhajñaptirūpiṇam .
sa ca sarvagato nityaṃ nāstameti na codayam ..6.78.24..

cinmātraṃ sarvagaṃ śāntamasti nirmalamacyutam .
dehādi netarat kiñciditi vedmi munīśvara ..6.78.25..

kiṃ tvatra pratipattir me sphuṭatāmeti notarām .
etāvanmātrasaṃvittis syāmahaṃ bhagavan katham ..6.78.26..

jñānena jñeyaniṣṭhatvameti ceto hṛdantare .
tatas sarvavapur bhūtvā bhūyo jīvo na jāyate ..6.78.27..

asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḫ putradāragṛhādiṣu .
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu ..6.78.28..

ātmano 'nanyayogena sadbhāvanamanāratam .
viviktadeśasevitvamaratir janasaṃsadi ..6.78.29..

adhyātmajñānaniṣṭhatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam .
etaj jñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato 'nyathā ..6.78.30..

rāgadveṣakṣayākārāt saṃsāravyādhibheṣajāt .
ahambhāvopaśāntau tu rājañ jñānamavāpyate ..6.78.31..

śarīre 'smiṃś ciraṃ rūḍho girau tarurivoccakaiḥ .
ahambhāvo mahābhogo vada me tyajyate katham ..6.78.32..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tyaktvā bhogaughabhāvanam .
gatvānviṣya citā tattvamahaṅkāro vilīyate ..6.78.33..

yantrāṇāṃ pañjaraṃ yāvad bhagnaṃ lajjādi nākhilam .
akiñcanatvaśeṣeṇa sphuṭā tāvadahaṅkṛtiḥ ..6.78.34..

sarvameva dhiyas tyaktvā yadi tiṣṭhasi niścalaḥ .
tadahaṅkāravilayī tvameva paramaṃ padam ..6.78.35..

śāntāśeṣaviśeṣaṇo vigatabhīs santyaktasarvaiṣaṇo
gatvā nūnamakiñcanatvamariṣu tyaktvā samagrāṃ śriyam .
śāntāhaṅkṛtirastadehakalanas teṣveva bhikṣāmaṭan
māmapyujjhitavānalaṃ yadi bhavasyuccais taduccairasi ..6.78.36..

atha tasya guror vaktrādityākarṇya bhagīrathaḥ .
manasyāhitakartavyas svavyāpāraparo 'bhavat ..6.79.1..

tataẖ katipayeṣveva vāsareṣu gateṣvasau .
agniṣṭomamakhaṃ cakre sarvatyāgaikasiddhaye ..6.79.2..

gobhūmyaśvahiraṇyādi dadau dhanamaśeṣataḥ .
dvijadevārtabandhubhyo guṇyaguṇyavicāravān ..6.79.3..

divasatrayamātreṇa sarvamevaṃ parityajan .
svavastramātraśeṣo 'sāvāsīd rājā bhagīrathaḥ ..6.79.4..

atha sarvārthariktaṃ taṃ khinnaprakṛtipaurakam .
sīmāntine tṛṇamiva rājyaṃ svamaraye dadau ..6.79.5..

ākrānte dviṣatā rājye pure sadmani maṇḍale .

ityalpenaiva kālena praśāntasakalaiṣaṇaḥ .

bhraman dvīpāni bhūpīṭhe kadācit kālayogataḥ .

tānevārīṃś ca tatrāsau pravāhāpatitakramam .

vividus te 'rayaḫ paurā mantriṇaś ca bhagīratham .

prabho rājyaṃ gṛhāṇeti prārthito 'pyariṇā muniḥ .
nādade 'nādṛtāśeṣas tṛṇamapyaśanādṛte ..6.79.12..

katicid divasāṃs tatra nītvānyatra jagāma saḥ .
bhagīratho 'yaṃ hā kaṣṭamiti lokena śocitaḥ ..6.79.13..

athānyatropaśāntātmā pariviśrāntadhīs sukhī .

kañcit kālamuvāsādrau vane grāme pure jane ..6.79.15..

samatāmupayātau tau guruśiṣyau samau sthitau .
kalayāmāsatus svasthau vinodaṃ dehadhāraṇam ..6.79.16..

kimayaṃ dhāryate dehaẖ kimanenojjhitena naḥ .

dhanāni nārīr vibhavānaiśvaryaṃ cāṣṭadhoditam .

svakarmaṇaiva deho 'yaṃ yāvadantamanicchayā .

abhinanandaturāgatamuttamau

samasamau khasamau śaminau svataḥ ..6.79.21..

athaikadā puraśreṣṭhe kasmiṃścin maṇḍalāntare .
anapatyaṃ nṛpaṃ mṛtyuraharat svamivāmiṣam ..6.80.1..

tatra prakṛtayaẖ khinnā naṣṭadeśakramā nṛpam .

rājannasmākamadhipo yas tvayā sa purā kṛtaḥ .

bhagīrathenātha mahīmavatārayituṃ divaḥ .

sphurattaraṅgabhaṅginī svaphenapuñjahāsinī

bhagīrathe mahīpatau yaśaḫpracāravīthikā

etāmavaṣṭabhya dṛśaṃ bhagīrathadhiyā vṛtām .
samas svastho yathāprāptaṃ kāryamāhara śāntadhīḥ ..6.81.1..

idaṃ pūrvaṃ parityajya kroḍīkṛtya tatas svayam .

tenaiva sanniveśena dampatī snigdhanāgarau ..6.81.4..

jagannirmāṇaniyaterasyā brāhmyās svasaṃvidaḥ .

tasmād rāghava bhūyo 'pi vakṣyamāṇo nareśvaraḥ .

dvāpare pūrvamabhavadatīte saptame manau .

jambudvīpe praśāntasya vindhyasyādūrasaṃsthite .

dhairyaudāryadayāyuktaẖ kṣamāśamadamānvitaḥ .

āhartā sarvayajñānāṃ jetā sarvadhanuṣmatām .

peśalas snigdhamadhuro vidagdhaḫ prītanāgaraḥ .
sundaraś śīlasubhagaḫ pratāpī dharmavatsalaḥ ..6.81.15..

veditā viditārthānāṃ dātā sakalasampadām .
bhoktā saṃsaṅgarahitas suśrotā sakalaśruteḥ ..6.81.16..

sa bhogaughānanādṛtya straiṇaṃ tṛṇavadutsṛjan .
pitari svargamāpanne bāla evottamaujasā ..6.81.17..

kṛtvā ṣoḍaśavarṣātmā kṛtvā digvijayaṃ vaśī .
nūnaṃ saurājyasampattyā bhūmaṇḍalamayojayat ..6.81.18..

atiṣṭhad vigatāśaṅkaṃ pālayan dharmataḫ prajāḥ .
dhīmān sa mantribhis sārdhaṃ yaśasā śuklayan diśaḥ ..6.81.19..

atha gacchatsu varṣeṣu vasante prollasatyalam .

mañjarījāladolāsu viṭapāntaḫpurāntare .

āmodini lasatpuṣpagulucchakavitānake .

āyāti madhure vāyau śaśiśīkaraśītale .

kāntāṃ prati babhūvāsya navaṃ cetas samutsukam .

manorājyamidaṃ cakre sa vasantamadaidhitaḥ .

kadā praṇayinīṃ mugdhāṃ bālābjamukulastanīm .
kariṣye kāminīmaṅke paryaṅke kusumāṅkitām ..6.81.26..

kadā kamalavallīnāṃ dolāsvalirivālinīm .

velopavanadolāsu līlākamalinīṣu ca .

vanopavanavinyāsavarṇanāvalitāsu ca .
śṛṅgārarasagarbhāsu kathāsvaramatonmanāḥ ..6.81.31..

hārihāsalasacchvāsavilolālakavallarīḥ .
kumārīḫ pūjayāmāsa suvarṇakalaśastanīḥ ..6.81.32..

evamasya vidur bhavyā mantriṇo navaniścayam .

atha tasya vivāhāya mantrivargo vicāravān .

cūḍāleti bhuvi khyātā nāmnā nṛpatisundarī .

nīlanīrajanetrāṃ tāṃ cūḍālāṃ sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
snehād vikāsayāmāsa śobhayārka ivābjinīṃ ..6.81.37..

avardhata tayoḫ prītiranyo'nyārpitacetasoḥ .

antaḫpureṣu dolāsu candanāguruvīthiṣu .

vaidagdhyasundaramatī sarvaśāstrārthakovidau .

snehāt prasannamadhurau samavijñānavedinau .

kalākalāpasampannau lasadrasarasāyanau .
śītalasnigdhamugdhāṅgau śaśāṅkau dvāvivoditau ..6.81.51..

reje lasannṛpatibhogavilāsakāntam
antaḫpureṣu mithunaṃ tadanuttamaśri .
brahmābjaṣaṇḍakuhareṣviva rājahaṃsa-
yugmaṃ vikāsimadamanmathamandacāri ..6.81.52..

evaṃ bahūni varṣāṇi mithunaṃ nirbharaspṛham .
reme yauvanalīlābhiranantābhir dine dine ..6.82.1..

atha yāteṣu varṣeṣu bahuṣvāvṛttiśāliṣu .
śanair galati tāruṇye bhinnakumbhādivāmbhasi ..6.82.2..

śāradasyeva parṇasya mithunasyāsya kālataḥ .
īṣadvirāgo hṛdayaṃ samyakprāgrasamaspṛśat ..6.82.3..

virāgavāsanākrāntamekāntasthamacintayat .
mithunaṃ taj jagadyātrāmimāmitthamaśāśvatīm ..6.82.4..

kiṃ nāmeha manohāri saṃsārakuharabhrame .
taraṅganikarākārabhaṅguravyavahāriṇi ..6.82.5..

pātaḫ pakvaphalasyeva maraṇaṃ durnivāraṇam .
himāśanirivāmbhoje jarā nipatanonmukhī ..6.82.6..

āyur galatyavirataṃ jalaṃ karatalādiva .
prāvṛṣīva latātumbī tṛṣṇaikā dīrghatāṃ gatā ..6.82.7..

śailanadyā raya iva samprayātyeva yauvanam .

sukhāni prapalāyante śarā iva guṇacyutāḥ .
patanti ceto duẖkhāni dhṛṣṭā gṛdhrā ivāmiṣam ..6.82.9..

budbudaḫ prāvṛṣīvāpsu śarīraṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguram .

balādaratirāyātā vairasyamiva pādapam ..6.82.11..

tadiha syāt kusaṃsāre kiṃ nāma bata śobhanam .
yadāsādya punaś ceto daśāsu na vidūyate ..6.82.12..

ātmajñānaikamantreṇa saṃsṛtyākhyā viṣūcikā .

tatraivātighanābhyāsau bodhayantau parasparam .

atha sāvirataṃ bālā ramaṇīyapadakramān .

buddhīndriyagaṇo 'pyevaṃ jaḍa eveti dṛśyate .

evaṃ cidrūpamapyetac cetyonmukhatayā svayam .

śuddhasaṃvinmahāsiṃhī seyaṃ samasamoditā .

mahācito jagac cittvādudetīvānudayyapi .

evaṃ cinmātramevāhamanahambhāvamātatam .

na nāśas sambhavatyasya cinmātranabhasaẖ kvacit .
acchedyo 'yamadāhyo 'yaṃ cidātmā nityanirmalaḥ ..6.82.46..

aho nu cirakālena śāntāsmi parinirvṛtā .
nirvāsitamatir muktamāse nirmandarābdhivat ..6.82.47..

asadābhāsamatyacchamanantamajamacyutam .
ātmākāśamanāyāsamavalambya rame ciram ..6.82.48..

anantamidamākāśaṃ bhūtaughaś cācalādikaḥ .
surāsurayutaṃ viśvametanmayamakṛtrimam ..6.82.49..

pustakarmamayī senā sarvā mṛṇmātrakaṃ yathā .
draṣṭṛdṛśyadṛśāṃ sattā cinmātraikamayī tathā ..6.82.50..

idamaikyamidaṃ dvitvamahaṃ nāhamitīti ca .
ka iha bhramasammohaẖ kathaṃ kasya kutaẖ kva vā ..6.82.51..

tadanantamanāyāsamupaśāntāsmi khaṃ sthitā .
nirvāmi parinirvāṇā satyamāse gatajvaram ..6.82.52..

acetanaṃ cetanaṃ vā yo yo nāmābhicetati .
sattāmātrātma tadrūpaṃ svaṃ mahāciti saṃsthitam ..6.82.53..

teneha nāham nānyaś ca na bhāvābhāvasambhavaḥ .
śāntaṃ sarvaṃ nirālambaṃ kevalaṃ saṃsthitaṃ param ..6.82.54..

itthaṃ vicāraṇaparā paramāvabodhād
buddhvā yathāsthitamidaṃ paramātmatattvam .
saṃśāntarāgabhayamohamanovilāsā
śāntā babhūva śaradambaralekhikeva ..6.82.55..

dinānudinameṣātha svātmārāmatayā tayā .
nityamantarmukhatayā babhūva prakṛtisthitiḥ ..6.83.1..

nīrāgā nīrujāsaṅgā nirdvandvā nissamīhitā .
na jahāti na cādatte prakṛtācāracāriṇī ..6.83.2..

paritīrṇā bhavāmbhodhiṃ śāntasandehajālikā .
paramātmamahālābhaparipūrṇatarāntarā ..6.83.3..

viśrāntā suciraśrāntā ghanalabdhapadātmani .
sarvopamātītatayā jagāmāvyapadeśyatām ..6.83.4..

iti sā mahiṣī tasya cūḍālā varavarṇinī .
svalpenaiva hi kālena yayau viditavedyatām ..6.83.5..

yathāyamāgataẖ kaścij jāgatas spandavibhramaḥ .
yathā ca līyate sarvaṃ tat taj jñātavatī babhau ..6.83.6..

adṛṣṭasakalabhrāntau pade viśrāntimetya sā .
rarāja śaradacchābhramāleva gatasambhramā ..6.83.7..

anākulasamāloke āśaśvāsātmanātmani .
jaradguriva śailāgraṃ satṛṇaṃ prāpya saṃsthitā ..6.83.8..

svavivekaghanābhyāsavaśādātmodayena sā .
śuśubhe śobhanā puṣpalatevābhinavodgatā ..6.83.9..

atha tāmanavadyāṅgīṃ kadācit sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
apūrvaśobhāmālokya smayamāna uvāca ha ..6.83.10..

bhūyo yauvanayukteva maṇḍiteva punaḫ punaḥ .
adhikaṃ rājase tanvi jagadrājyavatī yathā ..6.83.11..

prapītāmṛtasāreva labdhālabhyapadeva ca .
ānandāpūrapūrṇeva rājase 'titarāṃ priye ..6.83.12..

upaśāntaṃ ca kāntaṃ ca dadhānā sundaraṃ vapuḥ .
abhibhūyendumāyāsi śriyaṃ kāmapi kāmini ..6.83.13..

abhogakṛpaṇaṃ śāntamūrjitaṃ samatāṃ gatam .
gambhīraṃ ca prasannaṃ ca cetaḫ paśyāmi te priye ..6.83.14..

tṛṇīkṛtatribhuvanaṃ pītākhilajagattrayam .
anantodbhāsuraṃ saumyaṃ manaḫ paśyāmi te priye ..6.83.15..

na kenacin mahābhāge vibhavānandavastunā .
cetas tava tulāmeti merukṣīrābdhisundaram ..6.83.16..

taireva bālakadalīmṛṇālāṅkurakomalaiḥ .
aṅgais sthitimanujjhadbhir vṛddhiṃ yāteva lakṣyase ..6.83.17..

tathā tenaiva tenaiva sanniveśena saṃsthitā .
anyatāmupayātāsi latevartuviparyaye ..6.83.18..

kiṃ tvayā pītamamṛtaṃ prāptaṃ sāmrājyameva vā .
amṛtyave vā samprāptaḫ prayogo yogayuktibhiḥ ..6.83.19..

rājyāc cintāmaṇer vāpi trailokyād vā tvayādhikam .
aprāpyaṃ kimanuprāptaṃ nīlotpalavilocane ..6.83.20..

nakiñcit kiñcidākāramidaṃ tyaktvāhamāgatā .
nakiñcitkiñcidākāraṃ tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.21..

yat kiñcid yan nakiñcic ca taj jānāmi yathāsthitam .
yathodayaṃ yathānāśaṃ tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.22..

bhogairabhuktais tuṣyāmi bhuktairiva sudūragaiḥ .
na hṛṣyāmi na kupyāmi tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.23..

ekaivākāśasaṅkāśe kevale hṛdaye rame .
na rame rājalīlāsu tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.24..

ātmanyeva hi tiṣṭhāmi na vanodyānasadmasu .
na bhogaugheṣu śayyāsu tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.25..

jagatāṃ prabhurevāsmi nakiñcinmātrarūpiṇī .
ityātmanyeva tiṣṭhāmi tenāhaṃ śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.26..

anyaivāhamiyaṃ nāhamanyā ceyaṃ ca vāpyaham .
sarvamasmi nakiñcid vā tenāhaṃ śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.27..

yat paśyāmi na paśyāmi tat paśyāmyanyadeva yat .
iti samyak prapaśyāmi tenāhaṃ śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.28..

na sukhaṃ prārthaye nārthaṃ nānarthaṃ cetarāṃ sthitim .
yathāpraptena tuṣyāmi tenāhaṃ śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.29..

tanuvidveṣarāgābhis tajjñābhiś śāstradṛṣṭiṣu .
rame saha vayasyābhis tenāsmi śrīmatī sthitā ..6.83.30..

paśyāmi yan nayanaraśmibhirindriyair vā
cittena ceha hi tadaṅga na kiñcideva .
paśyāmi tadvirahitaṃ tu nakiñcidābhaṃ
paśyāmi samyagiti nātha cirodayāsmi ..6.83.31..

evamātmani viśrāntāṃ vadantīṃ tāṃ varānanām .
asambaddhapralāpāsi bālāsīti vadañ śanaiḥ ..6.84.1..

bhogalampaṭayā buddhyā mugdhāmāśaṅkya tāṃ priyām .
abuddhvā tadgirāmarthaṃ vihasyovāca bhūpatiḥ ..6.84.2..

asambaddhapralāpāsi bālāsi varavarṇini .
ramase vākyalīlābhī ramasvāvanipātmaje ..6.84.3..

kiñcit tyaktvā nakiñcid yo gataḫ pratyakṣasaṃsthitam .
tyaktapratyakṣasadrūpas sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.4..

bhogairabhuktais tuṣṭo 'hamiti bhogāñ jahāti yaḥ .
ruṣevāśanapānādyān sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.5..

vāhanāśanaśayyādi sarvaṃ santyajya dhīradhīḥ .
yas tiṣṭhatyātmanaivaikas sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.6..

svayaṃ nakiñcidevāhaṃ jagadīśo 'smi ceti ca .
niścayo yasya durbuddhes sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.7..

ātmanyevātmanaikānte tyaktasarvasamāgamaḥ .
yas sthitaś śvabhrataruvat sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.8..

nāhaṃ deho 'nyadevāhaṃ nakiñcit sarvameva hi .
evaṃ pralāpo yasyāsti sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.9..

yat paśyāmi na paśyāmi tat paśyāmyanyadeva yat .
pralāpa ityasan yasya sa kathaṃ kila śobhate ..6.84.10..

tasmān mugdhāsi bālāsi capalāsi vilāsini .
nānālāpavilāsena krīḍasi krīḍa sundari ..6.84.11..

pravihasyāṭṭahāsena śikhidhvaja iti priyām .
madhyāhne snātumutthāya nirjagāmāṅganāgṛhāt ..6.84.12..

kaṣṭaṃ nātmani viśrānto madvacāṃsi na buddhavān .
rājeti khinnā cūḍālā svavyāpāraparābhavat ..6.84.13..

tadā tathāṅga tatrātha tādṛśāśayayos tayoḥ .
tābhiḫ pārthivalīlābhir divasas sa jagāma ha ..6.84.14..

krameṇa māsā ṛtavo rāma saṃvatsarās tathā .
atītā bahavas tatra dampatyos snigdhayos tayoḥ ..6.84.15..

ekadā nityatṛptāyā niricchāyā api svayam .
cūḍālāyā babhūvecchā līlayā khagamāgame ..6.84.16..

khagamāgamasiddhyarthamatha sā nṛpakanyakā .
sarvabhogānanādṛtya samāgamya ca nirjanam ..6.84.17..

ekaivaikāntaniratā svāsanāvasthitāṅgakā .
ūrdhvagaprāṇapavanacirābhyāsaṃ cakāra ha ..6.84.18..

yadidaṃ dṛśyate kiñcij jagat sasthāsnujaṅgamam .
spandasya tat kriyānāmnaḫ phalamityanubhūyate ..6.84.19..

kasya spandavilāsasya ghanābhyāsasya me vada .
brahman khagamanādyetat phalaṃ yatnaikaśālinaḥ ..6.84.20..

ātmajño vāpyanātmajñas siddhyarthaṃ līlayā tathā .
kathaṃ saṃsādhayatyetad yathāvad vada me vibho ..6.84.21..

trividhaṃ sambhavatyaṅga sādhyaṃ vastviha sarvataḥ .
upādeyaṃ ca heyaṃ ca tathopekṣyaṃ ca rāghava ..6.84.22..

ātmabhūtaṃ prayatnena hyupādeyaṃ tu sādhyate .
heyaṃ santyajyate jñātvā hyupekṣyaṃ madhyametayoḥ ..6.84.23..

yad yadāhlādanakaramādeyaṃ tadasanmateḥ .
tadviruddhamanādeyamupekṣyaṃ madhyamaṃ viduḥ ..6.84.24..

sanmater viduṣo jñasya sarvamātmamayaṃ yadā .
traya eva tadā pakṣās sambhavanti na kecana ..6.84.25..

kevalaṃ sarvamevedaṃ kadācil līlayā na vā .
upekṣyamakṣinikṣiptamālokayati vā na vā ..6.84.26..

jñasyopekṣyātmakaṃ rāma mūḍhasyādeyatāṃ gatam .
heyaṃ sphāravirāgasya śṛṇu siddhikramaṃ katham ..6.84.27..

deśakālakriyādravyasādhanās sarvasiddhayaḥ .
jīvamāhlādayantīha vasanta iva bhūtalam ..6.84.28..

madhye caturṇāmeteṣāṃ kriyā prathamakalpikī .
siddhyādisādhane sādhos tanmayās te yataẖ kramāḥ ..6.84.29..

gulikāñjanakhaḍgādikriyākramanirūpaṇam .
tatrāstāṃ tāvadeṣo 'tra vistāraḫ prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.30..

ratnauṣadhitapomantrakriyākramanirūpaṇam .
tatrāstāṃ tāvadeṣo 'tra vistāraḫ prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.31..

śrīśaile siddhadeśe ca mervādau vā nivāsataḥ .
siddhirityapi vistāraẖ kriyotthā prakṛtārthahā ..6.84.32..

tasmāc chikhidhvajakathāprasaṅgapatitāmimām .
prāṇādipavanābhyāsakriyāṃ siddhiphalāṃ śṛṇu ..6.84.33..

samūlamakhilās tyaktvā sādhyārthetaravāsanāḥ .
gudādidvārasaṅkocāt sthānakādikriyākramaiḥ ..6.84.34..

bhojanāsanaśuddhyā ca sādhuśāstrārthabhāvanāt .
svācārāt sujanāsaṅgāt sarvatyāgāt sukhāsanāt ..6.84.35..

prāṇāyāmaghanābhyāsād rāma kālena kenacit .
kopalobhādisantyāgād bhogatyāgāc ca suvrata ..6.84.36..

tyāgādānanirodheṣu bhṛśaṃ yānti vidheyatām .
prāṇāḫ prabhutvatajjñasya puṃso bhṛtyā ivākhilāḥ ..6.84.37..

rājyādyā mokṣaparyantās samastā eva sampadaḥ .
dehānilavidheyatvasādhyās sarvasya rāghava ..6.84.38..

parimaṇḍalitākārā kandasthānasamāśritā .
antraveṣṭanikā nāma nāḍī nāḍīśatāśritā ..6.84.39..

vīṇāgrāvartasadṛśī salilāvartasannibhā .
lipyādyoṅkārasaṃsthānā kuntalāvartavat sthitā ..6.84.40..

devāsuramanuṣyeṣu mṛganakrakhagādiṣu .
kīṭādiṣvabjajānteṣu sarveṣu prāṇiṣūditā ..6.84.41..

śītārtasuptabhogīndrabhogavad baddhamaṇḍalā .
sitā kalpāgnivigaladinduvad baddhakuṇḍalā ..6.84.42..

manobhrūmadhyarandhrādhoviśadabvṛtticañcalā .
anārataṃ rasasyandaiḫ plavamānaiva tiṣṭhati ..6.84.43..

asyā abhyantare tasmin kadalīkośakomale .
yā vātaśaktis sphurati veṇāviva lasadgatiḥ ..6.84.44..

soktā kuṇḍalinī nāmnā kuṇḍalākāravāhinī .
prāṇinaḫ paramā śaktis sarvaśaktijavapradā ..6.84.45..

aniśaṃ niśśvasadrūpā kupiteva bhujaṅgamī .
saṃsthitordhvīkṛtamukhī spandānāṃ hetutāṃ gatā ..6.84.46..

yadā prāṇānilo yāti hṛdi kuṇḍalinīpadam .
tadā saṃvidudetyantar bhūtatanmātrabījabhūḥ ..6.84.47..

yadā kuṇḍalinī dehe sphuratyabja ivālinī .
tadā saṃvidudetyantar mṛdusparśavaśodayā ..6.84.48..

sparśena mṛdunā nāḍyā liṅgakāmātapatrayoḥ .
yathā saṃvidudetyuccais tathā kuṇḍalinī javāt ..6.84.49..

tasyāṃ samastās sambaddhā nāḍyo hṛdayakośagāḥ .
utpadyante vilīyante mahārṇava ivāpagāḥ ..6.84.50..

nityaṃ vātātmakatayā spandonmukhatayā tayā .
sā sarvasaṃvidāṃ bījamekamādyamudāhṛtam ..6.84.51..

dikkālādyanavacchinnā citsaṃvit sarvagāsti hi .
tasyāẖ kuṇḍalinīkośāt kenārthenodayas sphuṭaḥ ..6.84.52..

sarvadā sarvatas satyaṃ citsaṃvid vidyate 'nagha .
kiṃ tvasyā bhūtatanmātravaśādabhyudayaẖ kvacit ..6.84.53..

sarvatra vidyamānā cid deheṣu taralāyate .
sarvago 'pyātapas sāraratneṣvativijṛmbhate ..6.84.54..

kvacin naṣṭaṃ kvacit suptaṃ kvaciducchūnatāṃ gatam .
vastu vastuni yad dṛṣṭaṃ tat svabhāvavijṛmbhitam ..6.84.55..

etad bhūyaẖ krameṇāhaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te 'nagha .
deheṣveva yathodeti bhṛśaṃ saṃvinmayaẖ kramaḥ ..6.84.56..

cetanācetanaṃ bhūtajātaṃ vyoma tathākhilam .
sarvaṃ cinmātrasanmātraṃ śūnyamātraṃ yathā nabhaḥ ..6.84.57..

tad dhi cinmātrasanmātramavikārādyanāmayam .
kvacit sthitaṃ saṃvidaiva kṛtatanmātrapañcakam ..6.84.58..

tat pañcakaṃ gataṃ dvitvaṃ likṣādyantaṃ svasaṃvidā .
antarbhūtavikārādi dīpād dīpaśataṃ yathā ..6.84.59..

svasattāmātrakeṇaiva saṅkalpalavarūpiṇā .
pañcakāni vrajantīha devatvaṃ tāni kānicit ..6.84.60..

kānicit tiryagāditvaṃ hemāditvaṃ ca kānicit .
kānicid dṛṣadāditvaṃ dravyāditvaṃ ca kānicit ..6.84.61..

evaṃ hi pañcakaṃ spandamātraṃ jagaditi sthitam .
citsaṃvidatra sarvatra vidyate raghunandana ..6.84.62..

kevalaṃ pañcakavaśād dehādau cetanābhidhā .
jaḍaspandābhidhā vāri sthāvarādau jaḍābhidhā ..6.84.63..

yathābdhiṣvambvito vīciritas talamiti sthitam .
pañcakeṣu tathetaś cil lolarūpā jaḍā tvitaḥ ..6.84.64..

itas somya ito lolaẖ kimabdhiriti no yathā .
vikalpārhas tathaivaitat pañcakaṃ hi jaḍājaḍam ..6.84.65..

dehādipañcakaṃ jīvatspandi śailādikaṃ jaḍam .
sthāvarādyanilaspandi svabhāvavaśato 'nagha ..6.84.66..

na ca paryanuyoktavyās svabhāvā raghunandana .
śītoṣṇaṃ kiṃ himāgnyādi vakteti parihasyate ..6.84.67..

gṛhītavāsanāṃśānāṃ puṣṭabhāvavikāriṇām .
sthitayaḫ pañcakānāṃ hi yogyāḫ paryanuyojane ..6.84.68..

vāsanāṃśaviparyastā ito netumitaś ca tāḥ .
puṃsā prājñena śakyante sukhaṃ paryanuyojinā ..6.84.69..

aśubhe vā śubhe vāpi tena paryanuyojyate .
prabuddhavāsanaṃ nānyat pañcakaṃ suptavāsanam ..6.84.70..

yatra paryanuyogasya phalaṃ samanubhūyate .
tatra taṃ samprayuñjīta nākāśaṃ muṣṭibhiẖ kṣipet ..6.84.71..

tṛṇāgraniṣṭhā mervādyāḫ pañcakānāṃ hi rāśayaḥ .
viriñcaniṣṭhāẖ kīṭādyā ete sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ..6.84.72..

prasuptavāsanāẖ kecid yathā sthāvarajātayaḥ .
prabuddhavāsanāẖ kecid yathā narasurādayaḥ ..6.84.73..

svavāsanābilāẖ kecid yathā vai tiryagādayaḥ .
prakṣīṇavāsanāẖ kecid yathaite mokṣabhāginaḥ ..6.84.74..

yathāsvāsveva saṃvitsu manobuddhyādibhiẖ kṛtāḥ .
hastapādādisaṃyuktaiẖ sañjñāḫ pañcakarāśibhiḥ ..6.84.75..

tiryagādibhirapyanyairanyās sañjñāḫ prakalpitāḥ .
sthāvarādibhirapyanyairanyathā saṃvidaẖ kṛtāḥ ..6.84.76..

iti sādho sphurantīme citrāḫ pañcakarāśayaḥ .
rūpairādyantamadhyeṣu calācalajaḍājaḍaiḥ ..6.84.77..

eṣāmeko hi saṅkalpaparamāṇur mahāmate .
bījamākāśavṛkṣāṇāṃ sargāṇāṃ teṣvimāni tu ..6.84.78..

indriyāṇyaṅga puṣpāṇi viṣayāmodavanti hi .
icchābhramaryo rājantyo mañjaryaś cañcalāẖ kriyāḥ ..6.84.79..

lokāntarāṇi gucchāni gulmā malayameravaḥ .
pallavānīha jaladā latālīlā diśo daśa ..6.84.80..

vartamānāni bhūtāni bhaviṣyanti ca yāni tu .
jaganti tānyasaṅkhyāni phalāni raghunandana ..6.84.81..

evaṃbījās ta ete hi rāma pañcakapādapāḥ .
svayaṃ svabhāvāj jāyante svayaṃ naśyanti kālataḥ ..6.84.82..

svayaṃ nānātvamāyānti ciraṃ jāḍyāt sphuranti ca .
suviviktāś śamaṃ yānti taraṅgā iva toyadheḥ ..6.84.83..

yato yānti samutsedhaṃ yato yānti śamaṃ svayam .
ete jāḍyavivekābhyāṃ taraṅgā iva toyadheḥ ..6.84.84..

ye vivekavaśato layaṃ gatā
rāma pañcakavilāsarāśayaḥ .
te na bhūya iha yānti saṃsthitiṃ
prabhramanti jagatītare muhuḥ ..6.84.85..

etat pañcakabījaṃ yat kuṇḍalinyāṃ tadantare .
prāṇamārutarūpeṇa tasyāṃ sphurati sarvadā ..6.85.1..

sāntaẖ kuṇḍalinī spandasparśasaṃvitkalāmalā .
kaloktā kalanenāśu kathitā cetanena cit ..6.85.2..

jīvanāj jīvatāṃ yātā mananāc ca manas sthitā .
saṅkalpāt saiva saṅkalpo bodhād buddhiriti smṛtā ..6.85.3..

ahaṅkārakalāṃ yātā saiṣā puryaṣṭakābhidhā .
sthitā kuṇḍalinī dehe jīvaśaktiranuttamā ..6.85.4..

apānatāmupāgatya satataṃ pravahatyadhaḥ .
samānanāmnī madhyasthā udānākhyoparisthitā ..6.85.5..

adhas tvapānarūpaiva madhye somyaiva sarvadā .
pṛṣṭhādudānarūpaiva puṃsas svasthasya tiṣṭhati ..6.85.6..

sarvayatnamadho yātā yadi yatnān na dhāryate .
tat pumān mṛtimāyāti tayā nirgatayā balāt ..6.85.7..

samastaivordhvamāyātā yadi yuktyā na dhāryate .
tat pumān mṛtyumāyāti tayā nirgatayā balāt ..6.85.8..

sarvathātmani cet tiṣṭhet tyaktvordhvādhogamāgamam .
taj jantor jāyate vyādhir malamārutarodhataḥ ..6.85.9..

sāmānyanāḍīvaidhuryāt sāmānyavyādhisambhavaḥ .
pradhānanāḍīvaidhuryāt pradhānavyādhisambhavaḥ ..6.85.10..

kiṃvināśāẖ kimutpādāś śarīre 'smin munīśvara .
ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva yathāvat kathayāśu me ..6.85.11..

ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva dvayaṃ duẖkhasya kāraṇam .
tannivṛttiṃ sukhaṃ vidyāt tatkṣayo mokṣa ucyate ..6.85.12..

mithaẖ kadācij jāyete kadācit samameva tu .
paryāyeṇa kadācit tāvādhivyādhī śarīrake ..6.85.13..

dehaduẖkhaṃ vidur vyādhimādhyākhyaṃ vāsanāmayam .
maurkhyamūle hi te vidyāt tattvajñānaparikṣaye ..6.85.14..

atattvajñānavaśatas svendriyākramaṇaṃ vinā .
hṛdi tānavamujjhatsu rāgadveṣeṣvanāratam ..6.85.15..

idaṃ prāptamidaṃ neti jāḍyāndhyaghanamohadāḥ .
ādhayas sampravartante varṣāsu mihikā iva ..6.85.16..

bhṛśaṃ sphurantīṣvicchāsu maurkhyāc cetasyanirjite .
durannābhyavahāreṇa durdeśākramaṇena ca ..6.85.17..

duṣkālavyavahāreṇa duṣkriyāsphuraṇena ca .
durjanāsaṅgadoṣeṇa durbhāvodbhavanena ca ..6.85.18..

kṣīṇatvād vā prapūrṇatvān nāḍiṣvasukhasaṃsṛtau .
prāṇe vidhuratāṃ yāte kupatheva navādhvage ..6.85.19..

daussthityakāraṇaṃ doṣād vyādhir dehe pravartate .
nadyāṃ prāvṛṇnidāghābhyāmivākāraviparyayaḥ ..6.85.20..

prāktanī vaihikī vāpi śubhā vāpyaśubhā matiḥ .
yaivādhikā saiva tathā tasmin yojayati krame ..6.85.21..

ādhayo vyādhayaś caivaṃ jāyante bhūtapañcake .
kathaṃ śṛṇu vinaśyanti rāghavāṇāṃ kulodvaha ..6.85.22..

dvividho hyādhirastīha sāmānyas sāra eva ca .
vyavahāras tu sāmānyas sāro janmamayas smṛtaḥ ..6.85.23..

prāptenābhimatenaiva naśyanti vyāvahārikāḥ .
ādhikṣayeṇādhibhavāẖ kṣīyante vyādhayo 'pyalam ..6.85.24..

ātmajñānaṃ vinā sāro nādhir naśyati rāghava .
bhūyo rajjvavabodhena rajjusarpo hi naśyati ..6.85.25..

ādhivyādhivilāsānāṃ rāma sārādhisaṅkṣayaḥ .
sarveṣāṃ mūlahā prāvṛṇnadīva taṭavīrudhām ..6.85.26..

anādhijā vyādhayas tu dravyamantraśubhakramaiḥ .
cikitsakādiśāstroktair naśyantyabhrairivātapāḥ ..6.85.27..

snānamantrauṣadhopāyavaktṝṇyadhigatāni ca .
tvayā cikitsāśāstrāṇi kimanyadupadiśyate ..6.85.28..

ādheẖ kathaṃ bhaved vyādhiẖ kathaṃ ca sa vinaśyati .
dravyāditarayā yuktyā mantrapuṇyādipūrvayā ..6.85.29..

citte vidhurite dehas samyaṅ nānubhavatyayam .
yathā hi ruṣito janturagrameva na paśyati ..6.85.30..

anapekṣya yathāprāptamamārgamanudhāvati .
prakṛtaṃ mārgamutsṛjya śarārto hariṇo yathā ..6.85.31..

saṅkṣobhāt sāmyamutsṛjya vahanti prāṇavāyavaḥ .
dehe gajaghaṭārtāni payāṃsīva sarittaṭe ..6.85.32..

asamaṃ vahati prāṇe nāḍyo yānti visaṃsthitim .
asamyak saṃsthite bhūpe yathā varṇāśramakramāḥ ..6.85.33..

kāścin nāḍyaḫ prapūrṇatvaṃ yānti kāścic ca riktatām .
prāṇe vidhurite deśe sarvartau sarito yathā ..6.85.34..

kujīrṇatvamajīrṇatvamatijīrṇatvameva vā .
doṣāyaiva prayātyannaṃ prāṇasañcāraduṣkramaiḥ ..6.85.35..

yathā kāṣṭhāni nayati prāptaṃ deśaṃ saridrayaḥ .
tathānnāni nayatyantaḫ prāṇavātas svamāśrayam ..6.85.36..

yānyannāni virodhena tiṣṭhantyantaś śarīrake .
tānyeva vyādhitāṃ yānti pariṇāmasvabhāvataḥ ..6.85.37..

evamādher bhaved vyādhirādhyabhāvāc ca naśyati .
yathā mantraiś ca naśyanti vyādhayas tatkramaṃ śṛṇu ..6.85.38..

yathā virekaṃ kurvanti harītakyas svabhāvataḥ .
bhāvanāvaśataẖ kāryaṃ tathā yaralavādayaḥ ..6.85.39..

śuddhayā puṇyayā sādho kriyayā sādhusevayā .
manaḫ prayāti vaimalyaṃ nikaṣeṇeva kāñcanam ..6.85.40..

ānando vardhate dehe śuddhe cetasi rāghava .
pūrṇendāvudite vyabhre nairmalyaṃ bhuvane yathā ..6.85.41..

sattvaśuddhau vahantyete krameṇa prāṇavāyavaḥ .
jarayanti tathānnāni vyādhis tena vinaśyati ..6.85.42..

ādhivyādhyoriti proktau nāśotpattikramau tvayi .
kuṇḍalinyāẖ kathāyogādadhunā prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu ..6.85.43..

puryaṣṭakāparākhyasya jīvasya prathamāśrayam .
viddhi kuṇḍalinīmantarāmodasyeva mañjarīm ..6.85.44..

tāṃ yadā pūrakābhyāsādāpūrya sthīyate ciram .
tadaiti mairavaṃ sthairyaṃ kāyasyāpīnatā tathā ..6.85.45..

yadā pūrakapūrṇāntaramuktaprāṇamārutam .
nīyate saṃvidaivordhvaṃ soḍhagharmaklamaśramaṃ ..6.85.46..

sarpī prakupitevoccair yāti daṇḍopamāṃ gatā .
nāḍīs sarvās samādāya dehe baddhā latopamā ..6.85.47..

tadā samastamevemaṃ khaṃ plāvayati dehakam .
nīrandhrā pavanāpūrṇā bhastrevāmbugataṃ naram ..6.85.48..

ityabhyāsavilāsena yogena vyomagāmitām .
yoginaḫ prāpnuvantyuccair dīnās te sudaśāmiva ..6.85.49..

brahmanāḍipravāheṇa śaktiẖ kuṇḍalinī yadā .
bahirūrdhvapravāheṇa dvādaśāṅgulamūrdhani ..6.85.50..

recakena prayogeṇa nāḍyantaranirodhinā .
muhūrtaṃ sthitimāpnoti tadā vyomagadarśanam ..6.85.51..

darśanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ brahman nayanāṃśugaṇaṃ vinā .
anyeṣāmindriyāṇāṃ ca tattvamevaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ..6.85.52..

na kecana mahābāho bhūcareṇa nabhaścarāḥ .
adivyairāśritājñānair dṛśyante puruṣendriyaiḥ ..6.85.53..

vijñānādūrasaṃsthena buddhinetreṇa rāghava .
dṛśyante vyomagās siddhās svapnavat svārthadā api ..6.85.54..

svapnāvalokanaṃ yadvat tadvat siddhāvalokanam .
kevalo 'yaṃ viśeṣo yat siddhaprāptau sthirārthatā ..6.85.55..

mukhād bahir dvādaśānte recakābhyāsayuktitaḥ .
prāṇe ciraṃ sthitiṃ nīte praviśantyaparāṃ purīm ..6.85.56..

vada svabhāvasya kathaṃ brahman na calati sthitiḥ .
vaktāras sānukampā hi duṣpraśne 'pi na khedinaḥ ..6.85.57..

śaktir vastusvabhāvākhyā yathā sphurati yātmanaḥ .
sargādinā tathaivāsau sthitiṃ yātīti niścayaḥ ..6.85.58..

avastutvādavidyāyā vastuśaktirapi kvacit .
bhidyate dṛśyate hyaṅga vasante śāradaṃ phalam ..6.85.59..

sarvamevaṃvidhaṃ brahma nānānānātayānayā .
dṛśyate vyavahārārthaṃ kevalaṃ kalpyate sthitiḥ ..6.85.60..

sūkṣmacchidrādigatyarthaṃ pūraṇārthaṃ ca khasya vā .
aṇutāṃ sthūlatāṃ vāpi kāyo 'yaṃ nīyate katham ..6.85.61..

kāṣṭhakrakacayoś śleṣād yathā cchedaḫ pravartate .
tayos saṅgharṣaṇādagnis svabhāvāj jāyate tathā ..6.85.62..

māṃsābjayantraṃ jaṭhare sthitaṃ śliṣṭamukhaṃ mithaḥ .
ūrdhvādhassammilanmūlaṃ dyubhūmyoriva vai talam ..6.85.63..

tasya kuṇḍalinī lakṣmīr nilīnāntar nijāspade .
padmarāgasamudgasya kośe muktāvalī yathā ..6.85.64..

āvartaphenamāleva nityaṃ śalaśalāyate .
daṇḍāhateva bhujagī susannatavivartanā ..6.85.65..

dyāvāpṛthivyor madhyasthā kriyeva spandarūpiṇī .
saṃvinmadhuvibodhotthā hṛtpadmapuṭaṣaṭpadī ..6.85.66..

tat sarvaṃ śaktipadmādi bāhyairābhyantarais sadā .
hṛdi vyādhūyate vātairabhravṛndamivābhitaḥ ..6.85.67..

yad yad vyoma sphuratyaṅga svabhāvāt tatra vāyavaḥ .
pelavaṃ mṛdu yat kiñcit tat tat pracalayantyalam ..6.85.68..

vātairāhanyamānaṃ tat padmādi taralāyate .
hṛdyanyo'nyanikāṣeṇa pallavādi yathā tarau ..6.85.69..

dehoṣmakāraṇaṃ sarvarasādipacanodyatam .
janayatyagnimanyo'nyasaṅgharṣād ghanaveṇuvat ..6.85.70..

svabhāvaśītaśītātmā dehas tenauṣṇyametyalam .
uditena sa sarvāṅgaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhānunā yathā ..6.85.71..

sarvato visaradraśmi tat tejas tārakākṛti .
hṛtpadmahemabhramaro yogināṃ cintyatāṃ gatam ..6.85.72..

tat prakāśamayaṃ jñānaṃ cintitaṃ sat prayacchati .
yena yojanalakṣasthaṃ vastu niśyapi dṛśyate ..6.85.73..

tasyāgner vāḍavasyeva jalaṃ saṃśuṣkamindhanam .
māṃsapaṅkajaṣaṇḍāḍhyahṛtsaraẖ kośavāsinaḥ ..6.85.74..

yadabjaśītalatvaṃ tadapānātmendurucyate .
itīndorutthitas so 'gniragnīṣomau hi dehakaḥ ..6.85.75..

sarvamūṣmātmakaṃ kiñcit tejo'rkāgnyabhidhaṃ viduḥ .
śītātmakaṃ ca somākhyamābhyāmeva kṛtaṃ jagat ..6.85.76..

vidyāvidyāsvarūpeṇa sarvaṃ sadasadātmanā .
jagad dvayena nirvṛttaṃ tadevaivaṃ vibhajyate ..6.85.77..

sac cit prakāśaṃ vidyādi sūryamagniṃ vidur budhāḥ .
asaj jāḍyaṃ tamo 'vidyādyāhus somaṃ maṇīṣiṇaḥ ..6.85.78..

vahnir vāryātmanas somādudetīti mune śrutam .
somasyotpattimadhunā vada me vadatāṃ vara ..6.85.79..

agnīṣomau mithaẖ kārye kāraṇe ca svasaṃsthiteḥ .
paryāyeṇa samau caitau prajāyete parasparam ..6.85.80..

janmāṅga bījāṅkuravat tathā divasarātrivat .
sthitiś chāyātapasamā kevalā caitayor bhavet ..6.85.81..

tulyakālopalambhā hi mithaś chāyātapasthitiḥ .
kevalaikopalambhā syāt sthitir divasarātrivat ..6.85.82..

kāryakāraṇabhāvaś ca dvividhaẖ kathito 'nayoḥ .
sadrūpapariṇāmottho vināśapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.83..

ekasmād yad dvitīyasya sambhavo 'ṅkurabījavat .
kāryakāraṇabhāvo 'sau sadrūpapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.84..

ekanāśe dvitīyasya yad bhāvo dinarātrivat .
kāryakāraṇabhāvo 'sau vināśapariṇāmajaḥ ..6.85.85..

sadrūpapariṇāmasya mṛdghaṭakramasaṃsthiteḥ .
akṣopalambhāditarat pramāṇaṃ nopayujyate ..6.85.86..

vināśapariṇāmasya dinarātrikramasthiteḥ .
abhāvo 'pyekavastūttho gato mukhyapramāṇatām ..6.85.87..

svanāśe nāsti kartṛtvamityādyā yuktivādinaḥ .
avajñāya bahiẖ kāryās svānubhūtyapalāpinaḥ ..6.85.88..

pratyakṣavadabhāvo 'pi pramaiva raghunandana .
agnyabhāvo hi śītasya pramāṇaṃ sarvajantuṣu ..6.85.89..

agner dhūmatayā bhāgo yaḫ prayāti payodatām .
sadrūpapariṇāmena tadagnis somakāraṇam ..6.85.90..

agnir nāśātmakatayā śaityādaptāṃ prayāti yat .
vināśapariṇāmena tadagnis somakāraṇam ..6.85.91..

saptāmbudhipayaḫ pītvā dhūmodgāreṇa vāḍavaḥ .
payodatāṃ prayātena tadeva janayatyalam ..6.85.92..

arkaḫ pītvā niśānāthamamāvasyāṃ punaḫ punaḥ .
udgiratyamale pakṣe mṛṇālamiva sārasaḥ ..6.85.93..

pītvāmṛtopamaṃ śītaṃ prāṇas somaṃ mukhāgragaṃ .
abbhāgamāpūrayati śarīre 'pānatāṃ gataḥ ..6.85.94..

jalādaṇutayā bhāgo yaḫ prayātyarkaraśmitām .
sadrūpapariṇāmena taj jalaṃ vahnikāraṇam ..6.85.95..

nāśātmakatayā toyamauṣṇyād yāti yadagnitām .
vināśapariṇāmena tat toyaṃ vahnikāraṇam ..6.85.96..

agner vināśe sadrūpaḫ pariṇāmo niśākaraḥ .
indor nāśe nigharṣotthapariṇāmo hutāśanaḥ ..6.85.97..

hutāśo nāśamāgatya somo bhavati vai tathā .
divaso nāśamāgatya rātrir bhavati vai yathā ..6.85.98..

tamaḫprakāśayoś chāyātapayor dinarātrayoḥ .
madhye vilakṣaṇaṃ rūpaṃ prājñairapi na labhyate ..6.85.99..

sandhirapyābilo yas syādetayoreva tad vapuḥ .
bhāvābhāvau yathaikasya śliṣṭāvetau tathaiva hi ..6.85.100..

dvābhyāṃ caitanyajāḍyābhyāṃ bhūtāni prasphuranti hi .
yathā tamaḫprakāśābhyāmahorātrā mahītale ..6.85.101..

cidrūpajaḍarūpābhyāmārabdheyaṃ jagatsthitiḥ .
jalāmṛtābhyāṃ miśrābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tanurivaindavī ..6.85.102..

prakāśamanalaṃ sūryaṃ cidrūpaṃ viddhi rāghava .
jaḍātmakaṃ tamorūpaṃ viddhi somaśarīrakam ..6.85.103..

citsūrye nirmale dṛṣṭe tamo naśyed bhavāmayaḥ .
vyomasūrye bahir dṛṣṭe yathā kṛṣṇaniśātamaḥ ..6.85.104..

somadehe jaḍe dṛṣṭe cittejo 'satyavad bhavet .
niśīthe vilasaccandre yathā sauraḫ prabhābharaḥ ..6.85.105..

somaṃ prakaṭayatyagniś cid dehaṃ suciraprabhā .
agniṃ bhāsayatīnduś ca dehaṃ svaṃ rūpamarpayan ..6.85.106..

cin niṣkriyā tvanābhāsā kevalā nopalabhyate .
āloka iva dīpena dehenaivāvagamyate ..6.85.107..

citaś cetyonmukhatvena lābhas saiva ca saṃsṛtiḥ .
niścetyāyās tu no lābho nirvāṇaṃ ca tadeva hi ..6.85.108..

anyo'nyalabdhasattākāvevaṃ kuḍyaprakāśavat .
agnīṣomāvimau viddhi sampṛktau dehadehinau ..6.85.109..

atiśāyini nirvāṇe jāḍye caivātiśāyini .
agnes somasya caivāṅga sthitir bhavati kevalā ..6.85.110..

prāṇo 'gniruṣṇaprakṛtirapānaś śītalaś śaśī .
chāyātapavadityetau saṃsthitau mukhamārgagau ..6.85.111..

apāne śītale sattāmetyuṣṇaḫ prāṇapāvakaḥ .
pratibimbamivādarśe sa ca tasmiṃs tathaiva hi ..6.85.112..

cidagniḫ padmayantrasthaṃ somaṃ vāryātmakaṃ tviṣā .
janayatyanubhūtyeha kuḍyālokaṃ yathā bahiḥ ..6.85.113..

saṃsṛtyādau hi yā kācit saṃvic chītoṣṇarūpiṇī .
agnīṣomābhidhāṃ prāptā saiva sargo nṛṇāmiha ..6.85.114..

yatra somakalā grastā kṣaṇaṃ sūryeṇa ṣoḍaśī .
mukhād vitastimātrāgre tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.115..

nūnaṃ sūryapadaṃ prāptas somo yatra hṛdambare .
nūnaṃ kevalayā sthityā tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.116..

auṣṇyamagniś cidādityaś śaityaṃ soma udāhṛtaḥ .
yatraitau pratibimbasthau tatra baddhapado bhava ..6.85.117..

śārīrasomasūryāgnisaṅkrāntijño bhavānagha .
atra yojanalakṣasthaṃ vastu paśyasi niśyapi .
atra saṅkrāntikālā hi bāhyās tṛṇasamās smṛtāḥ ..6.85.118..

saṅkrāntimuttaramathāyanamaṅga samyak-
kālaṃ tathā viṣuvatī yadi dehavātaiḥ .
antar bahissthamiva vetsi yathānubhūtaṃ
tac chocasīha na punaḫ paramabhyupetaḥ ..6.85.119..

aṇutāṃ sthūlatāṃ cāyaṃ yathā gacchati yoginām .
deho rāma tathā samyag vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ śṛṇu ..6.86.1..

hṛdyabjapattrakośotthaḫ prasphuratyānalaẖ kaṇaḥ .
hemabhramaravat sāndhye vidyutkaṇa ivāmbude ..6.86.2..

sa pravardhanasaṃvittyā vātyayevāśu vardhate .
saṃvidrūpatayā nūnamarkavad yāti codayam ..6.86.3..

sandhyābhraprathamārkābho vṛddhimabhyāgataẖ kṣaṇāt .
gālayatyakhilaṃ sāṅgaṃ dehaṃ hema yathānalaḥ ..6.86.4..

jalasparśāsaho yuktyā gālayatyupalādyapi .
bāhya evānalaspanda āntaras tu viśeṣataḥ ..6.86.5..

sa śarīradravaḫ paścād vidhūya kvāpi nīyate .
citkṣobhitena prāṇena nīhāro vātyayā yathā ..6.86.6..

ādhāranāḍinirhīnā vyomasthaivāvaśiṣyate .
śaktiẖ kuṇḍalinī vahner dhūmalekheva nirgatā ..6.86.7..

kroḍīkṛtamanobuddhimayajīvādyahaṅkṛtiḥ .
antassphuraccamatkārā dhūmalekheva tāgarī ..6.86.8..

bisavālavraṇe bhittāvupale divi bhūtale .
sā yathā yojyate yatra tena niryātyalaṃ tathā ..6.86.9..

saṃvittis saiva yadyaṅga rasādānād yathākramam .
rasenāpūrṇatāmeti tan nīhāra ivāmbunā ..6.86.10..

rasapūrṇā yamākāraṃ bhāvayatyāśu tat tathā .
dhatte citrakṛto buddhau rekhā rāma yathākṛtim ..6.86.11..

dṛḍhabhāvavaśādantarasthīnyāpnoti sā tataḥ .
mātṛgarbhaniṣaṇṇeva suṣiktevāṅkurasthitiḥ ..6.86.12..

yathābhimatamākāraṃ pramāṇaṃ ceti rāghava .
jīvaśaktiravāpnoti sumervādi tṛṇādi vā ..6.86.13..

śrutaṃ tvayā yogasādhyamaṇimādyarthasādhanam .
