abhāskaramapūrṇenduṃ śāntaśobhamivāmbaram ..6.89.3..

uttasthau kiñcidāmlānavadanā khedaśālinī .
kusikteva mahāvallī nirutsāhāṅgapallavā ..6.89.4..

na prasannā na vimalā babhūvākulatāṃ gatā .
dinaśrīriva nīhāradhūsarā sā vyatiṣṭhata ..6.89.5..

kṣaṇaṃ śayyopaviṣṭaiva cintayāmāsa cintayā .
kaṣṭaṃ rājyaṃ prabhus tyaktvā vanaṃ yāto gṛhāditi ..6.89.6..

tan mayehādya kiṃ kāryaṃ tatsamīpaṃ vrajāmyaham .
bhartaiva gatiruddiṣṭā vidhinā prakṛtā striyaḥ ..6.89.7..

iti sañcintya bhartāramanugantuṃ samutthitā .
cūḍālā vātarandhreṇa nirgatyāmbaramāyayau ..6.89.8..

babhrāmāmbaramārgeṇa vātaskandhena yoginī .
kurvatī siddhasārthasya mukhenānyenduvibhramam ..6.89.9..

dadarśātha pathā yāntaṃ rātrau khaḍgakaraṃ patim .
bhramantamekamekānte vetāleśamivotthitam ..6.89.10..

tādṛśaṃ patimālokya ruddhā gaganakoṭare .
bhaviṣyac cintayāmāsa sarvaṃ bharturakhaṇḍitam ..6.89.11..

yathā tena yadā yatra yāvat kāryaṃ yathodayam .
yathā ca nirvṛtis sphārā gantavyā tena rāghava ..6.89.12..

avaśyabhavitavyaṃ tad bhartur dṛṣṭvā purassthitam .
tadeva sampādayituṃ gamanāt sā nyavartata ..6.89.13..

āstāṃ mamādya gamanaṃ kālenāticireṇa hi .
mayāsya pārśvaṃ gantavyaṃ niyatereṣa niścayaḥ ..6.89.14..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā praviśyāntaḫpuraṃ punaḥ .
suṣvāpa śayane śambhoś śirasīvaindavī kalā ..6.89.15..

kenacit kāraṇenāsau gatas samprati bhūpatiḥ .
iti paurajanaṃ sarvamāśvāsyātiṣṭhadaṅganā ..6.89.16..

rājyaṃ rarakṣa bhartus tat krameṇa samadarśanā .
yathā kalamakedāraṃ pakvaṃ kalamagopikā ..6.89.17..

tayos tadāvahat kālo dampatyos sthitayos tathā .
adṛṣṭānyo'nyamukhayo rājyakānanapālayoḥ ..6.89.18..

jagāmātha dinaṃ pakṣo māso 'thartuś ca vatsaraḥ .
śikhidhvajasya vipine cūḍālāyās svamandire ..6.89.19..

bahunātra kimuktena varṣāṇyaṣṭādaśāṅganā .
cūḍālovāsa sadane vanakacche śikhidhvajaḥ ..6.89.20..

atha yāteṣu bahuṣu varṣeṣu jarasā vṛte .
śikhidhvaje mahāśailataṭakoṭaravāsini ..6.89.21..

bhartuẖ kaṣāyapākaṃ tadālakṣya phalitaṃ cirāt .
tadā tasyātmakāryasya bhavitavyatayā tayā ..6.89.22..

bhartus samīpagamane mama kālo 'yamityapi .
sañcintya mandaropāntaṃ gantuṃ buddhiṃ cakāra sā ..6.89.23..

cacālāntaḫpurād rātrau tatāra ca nabhaḫpatham .
jagāma vātaskandhena gacchantī khe dadarśa ca ..6.89.24..

kalpavṛkṣāṃśukacchannā ratnastabakabhūṣitāḥ .
nandanodyānanilayā raktās siddhābhisārikāḥ ..6.89.25..

parāmṛṣṭenduśakalān prāleyakaṇakarṣiṇaḥ .
siddhottaṃsāttasaugandhyān sparśayāmāsa mārutān ..6.89.26..

candrabimbāmṛtāmbhodhimahāvīciparamparām .
apaśyan nirmalāṃ jyotsnāmambarāmbaratāṃ gatām ..6.89.27..

meghāntareṇa gacchantī meghalagnāś ca vidyutaḥ .
abhiyuktā svabhartrā sā bhūyo bhūyo vyalokayat ..6.89.28..

uvāca cātmanaivāho yāvajjīvaṃ śarīriṇām .
na svabhāvaś śamaṃ yāti mamāpyutkaṇṭhate manaḥ ..6.89.29..

kadā mṛgendraskandhaṃ taṃ praṇayapravaṇaṃ puraḥ .
paśyāmi kāntamityantar mamāpyutkaṇṭhitaṃ manaḥ ..6.89.30..

mañjarītvaṃ latātvaṃ vā varametās taruṃ patim .
na muñcanti kṣaṇamapi mamāpyutkaṇṭhitaṃ manaḥ ..6.89.31..

yatheyamagragaṃ kāntameti siddhābhisārikā .
tathā kadāhameṣyāmi mamāpīti manas sthitam ..6.89.32..

ime mandāramaruta ete ca śaśinaẖ karāḥ .
vanarājaya etāś ca māmapyutkaṇṭhayantyaho ..6.89.33..

he cittājñavadevāntaẖ kiṃ tvaṃ tāṇḍavitaṃ sthitam .
sā vyomanirmalā sādho kva te yātā vivekitā ..6.89.34..

atha vā citta bhartāraṃ svaṃ pratyutkaṇṭhase sakhe .
tiṣṭhotkaṇṭhāvivalitaṃ kimanutkaṇṭhitena te ..6.89.35..

kiṃ kilotkaṇṭhase vāpi bhartā yāto jarāṃ bhavet .
tapasvī kṛśagātraś ca bhaven nirvāsanas tathā ..6.89.36..

matto rājyāc ca bhogebhyo manye 'syāmūlatāṃ gatā .
vāsanā latikā prāvṛṇnadītaṭagatā yathā ..6.89.37..

ekāntamatirekātmā nīrasaś śāntavāsanaḥ .
manye bhavati me bhartā śuṣkavṛkṣasamasthitiḥ ..6.89.38..

tathāpi citta kotkaṇṭhā bhava votkaṇṭhayānvitam .
patimudbodhya yogena śleṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ gale ..6.89.39..

pramṛṣṭavāsanaṃ bhartus samīkṛtya mano muneḥ .
rājya eva niyokṣyāmi nivatsyāvas sukhaṃ ciram ..6.89.40..

aho nu cirakālena manorathamimaṃ śubham .
ahamāsādayiṣyāmi yad bhartrā samacittatā ..6.89.41..

samagrānandavṛndānāmetadevopari sthitam .
yat samānamanovṛttisaṅgamāsvādane sukham ..6.89.42..

iti cintāvatī vyomnā cūḍālollaṅghya parvatān .
deśānabdān digantāṃś ca prāpa mandarakandaram ..6.89.43..

adṛśyaiva nabhassthaiva praviveśa vanāntaram .
vātyeva pādapalatāspandacihnagamāgamā ..6.89.44..

vanaikadeśe kasmiṃścit kṛtaparṇoṭaje patim .
dṛṣṭvā yogena bubudhe dehāntaramivāsthitam ..6.89.45..

hārakeyūrakaṭakakuṇḍalādivibhūṣitaḥ .
abhavan merukāntir yas tamevātra dadarśa sā ..6.89.46..

kṛśāṅgaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca jīrṇaparṇamiva sthitam .
kajjalāmbubharasnātaṃ bhṛṅgīśamiva nissaham ..6.89.47..

cīrāmbaradharaṃ śāntamekākinamavasthitam .
sthale niṣaṇṇaṃ puṣpāṇi grathayantaṃ jarāṃ gatam ..6.89.48..

tamālokyānavadyāṅgī cūḍālā pīvarastanī .
kiñcijjātaviṣādedamuvācātmani cetasā ..6.89.49..

aho nu viṣamaṃ maurkhyaṃ yadanātmajñatātmakam .
evaṃvidhās samāyānti daśā maurkhyaprasādataḥ ..6.89.50..

ayaṃ sa rājā lakṣmīvān yo mamāpi priyaḫ patiḥ .
hṛdi mohaghuṇakṣuṇṇāmimāmadyāgato daśām ..6.89.51..

tadavaśyamihaivādya nāthaṃ viditavedyatām .
nayāmyenaṃ na sandeho bhogamokṣaśriyaṃ tathā ..6.89.52..

idaṃ rūpaṃ parityajya rūpeṇānyena kenacit .
sakāśamasya gacchāmi bodhaṃ dātumanuttamam ..6.89.53..

bāleyaṃ mama kānteti maduktaṃ na karotyayam .
tasmāt tāpasarūpeṇa bodhayāmi patiṃ kṣaṇāt ..6.89.54..

bhartā kaṣāyapākena paripakvamatis sthitaḥ .
cetasyasyādya vimale svaṃ tattvaṃ pratibimbati ..6.89.55..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā babhūva dvijadārakaḥ .
īṣaddhyānād gatānyatvaṃ kṣaṇādambutaraṅgavat ..6.89.56..

papāta vipine tasmin dvijaputrakarūpiṇī .
bharturabhyājagāmāgraṃ mandasmitalasanmukhī ..6.89.57..

dadarśa dvijaputraṃ taṃ puro yātaṃ śikhidhvajaḥ .
vanāntarādupagataṃ tapomūrtimivāsthitam ..6.89.58..

dravatkanakagaurāṅgaṃ muktāhāravibhūṣitam .
śuklayajñopavītāṅgaṃ śuklāmbarayugāvṛtam ..6.89.59..

kamaṇḍaludharaṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ dāntamanāmayam .
vyāptaprakoṣṭhaṃ dviguṇenākṣasūtreṇa cāruṇā ..6.89.60..

bhūmāvalagnacaraṇaṃ kiṣkumātropari sthitam .
kuntalavyāptamūrdhānaṃ sālimālamivāmbujam ..6.89.61..

bhāsayantaṃ pradeśaṃ taṃ śārīrair dīptimaṇḍalaiḥ .
kuṇḍalābhūṣitamukhaṃ navamarkamivoditam ..6.89.62..

śikhāsamprotamandāraṃ śṛṅgasthendumivācalam .
kāntopaśāntavapuṣamūrjitaṃ vijitendriyam ..6.89.63..

himābhabhasmatilakabhūṣitālikasundaram .
meruṃ hemataṭālīnapūrṇendumiva cañcalam ..6.89.64..

tamālokya dvijasutaṃ samuttasthau śikhidhvajaḥ .
devaputrāgamadhiyā samparityaktapādukaḥ ..6.89.65..

devaputra namaskāra idamāsanamāsyatām .
ityasya darśayāmāsa pāṇinā pattraviṣṭaram ..6.89.66..

dadau ca dvijaputrasya puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ karodare .
candraẖ kumudaṣaṇḍasya prāleyamiva pallave ..6.89.67..

he rājarṣe namas tubhyamiti dvijasuto vadan .
gṛhītvā kusumānyasmād viveśa dalaviṣṭare ..6.89.68..

devaputra mahābhāga kuta āgamanaṃ kṛtam .
divasas saphalo 'yaṃ me yat tvāmadyāsmi dṛṣṭavān ..6.89.69..

idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpānīmāni mānada .
imāḫ pragrathitā mālā gṛhyantāṃ bhadramastu te ..6.89.70..

ityuktvā pādyamarghyaṃ ca mālāḫ puṣpāṇi cānagha .
śikhidhvajas tadiṣṭāyai dadau devyai yathākhilam ..6.89.71..

subahūni paribhrānto bhūtalāyatanānyaham .
tvattaḫ pūjā yathā prāptā mayeyaṃ na tathānyataḥ ..6.89.72..

peśalenānurūpeṇa praśrayeṇāmunānagha .
manye 'haṃ nūnamatyantacirajīvī bhaviṣyasi ..6.89.73..

śāntena manasodāramārādunmuktakalpanam .
nirvāṇārhaṃ tapas sādho kaccit sambhṛtavānasi ..6.89.74..

asidhārāsamaṃ somya śāntaṃ vratamidaṃ tava .
sphītaṃ yad rājyamutsṛjya mahāvananiṣevaṇam ..6.89.75..

jānāsi bhagavan sarvaṃ devas tvaṃ ko 'tra vismayaḥ .
śriyaiva lokottarayā jñāyase cihnabhūtayā ..6.89.76..

etānyaṅgāni te candrād ghaṭitānīti me matiḥ .
anyathā kiṃ samālokādamṛteneva siñcasi ..6.89.77..

asti me dayitā kāntā pāti me rājyamadya tat .
taveva tasyā dṛṣṭāni tānyaṅgānyadya sundara ..6.89.78..

upaśāntaṃ ca kāntaṃ ca vapurāpādamastakam .
śṛṅgaṃ śubhrāmbudeneva puṣpeṇācchādayāmunā ..6.89.79..

niṣkalaṅkendusaṅkāśamaṅgamādityatejasā .
manye te mlānimāyāti sumanaḫpattrapelavam ..6.89.80..

devārcanāyāvacitamidaṃ yat kusumaṃ mayā .
aṅga tvadaṅgasaṅgena tat prayātu kṛtārthatām ..6.89.81..

jīvitaṃ yāti sāphalyaṃ mamābhyāgatapūjayā .
devādapyadhikaṃ pūjyas satāmabhyāgato janaḥ ..6.89.82..

tat kas tvaṃ kasya putras tvaṃ kimāyāto 'syanugrahāt .
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chinddhi vimalendusamānana ..6.89.83..

rājarṣe śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yathāpṛṣṭamakhaṇḍitam .
avarṇanaṃ hi jihmatvaṃ tat satāmatininditam ..6.89.84..

astyasmiñ jagataẖ kośe śuddhātmā nārado muniḥ .
puṇyalakṣmyā mukhe kānte karpūratilakopamaḥ ..6.89.85..

sa kadācin munir meror guhāyāṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥ .
adhityakāyāṃ bhūtānāmadṛśyaś śāntamānasaḥ ..6.89.86..

tatra hemataṭe gaṅgā vahatyurutaraṅgiṇī .
merulakṣmyās sphuradrūpā bhāti hāralateva yā ..6.89.87..

ekadā nāradamunir dhyānānte saritas taṭe .
dhvanadvalayamaśrauṣīl līlākalakalāravam ..6.89.88..

kimetadityasau kiñcijjātaprāyakutūhalaḥ .
helayālokayan nadyāmapaśyal lalanāgaṇam ..6.89.89..

rambhātilottamāprāyaṃ niryātaṃ jalalīlayā .
krīḍantaṃ tyaktavasanaṃ deśe puruṣavarjite ..6.89.90..

kāñcanāmbhojamukulasundarais stanamaṇḍalaiḥ .
parivellitamanyo'nyaṃ phalaiḫ kāntadrumaṃ yathā ..6.89.91..

drutahemarasāpūranirjharābhogabhāsuraiḥ .
kurvantamūrubhiẖ kāmamandirastambhavibhramam ..6.89.92..

nirmalīkṛtacandreṇa vyāptavyomnā vilāsinā .
lāvaṇyarasapūreṇa tarjayantamivāpagām ..6.89.93..

prākārairamarodyāne rathacakrair manobhuvaḥ .
utpathārpitagaṅgāmbunitambataṭasetubhiḥ ..6.89.94..

sarvatra dṛṣṭasarvāṅgaṃ viśvarūpamivāsthitam .
pratibimbitasarvārthamanyo'nyādarśatāṃ gatam ..6.89.95..

kālakalpataror varṣaviṭapāt pakṣapallavāt .
vividhartulatājālād dinaśrīkalikākulāt ..6.89.96..

ālokapuṣparajaso jātād gaganakānane .
sphurajjagatkhagavrātāt saptābdhyekālavālakāt ..6.89.97..

māsastabakavṛnteṣu vṛddhiṃ yāntaṃ rasānvitam .
uddhṛtyoddhṛtya sampūrṇaṃ cālitāmbhodapallavam ..6.89.98..

ālolālakakeśākṣitārakādimadhuvratam .
amṛtāpadvighātāya kośasañcayakāribhiḥ ..6.89.99..

duṣprāpe bhūtasaṅghānāṃ vikasatkanakāmbuje .
padmapallavasañchannaṃ guptaṃ meror guhāntare ..6.89.100..

śītale svardhunītīre yatnotsṛṣṭamalaṃ puraḥ .
candrabimbaphalāpūramekatraivopasambhṛtam ..6.89.101..

straiṇamālokya tat kāntaṃ sahasaiva mano muneḥ .
anāśritavivekāṃśaṃ babhūvānanditaṃ sphurat ..6.89.102..

ānandavalite citte kṣubdhe prāṇānile sthite .
babhūva tasya tuṣṭasya madanaskhalitaṃ tadā ..6.89.103..

phalaṃ rasāpūrṇamiva grīṣmānta iva toyadaḥ .
pratyagraḫ pādapaś chinnalatāvṛnta ivottamaḥ ..6.89.104..

avaśyāyakaṇasyandī śaśāṅka iva vā muniḥ .
bisaṃ dvidhā yātamiva galatsāraraso 'bhavat ..6.89.105..

tādṛśo 'pi bahujño 'pi jīvanmukto 'pyasau muniḥ .
niriccho 'pi nirāstho 'pi nakiñcidupamo 'pyalam ..6.89.106..

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ nityamākāśaviśado 'pi ca .
nārado 'pi kathaṃ brahman madanaskhalito 'bhavat ..6.89.107..

sarvasyā eva rājendra bhūtajāter jagattraye .
devāderapi deho 'yaṃ dvayātmaivaṃ svabhāvataḥ ..6.89.108..

ajñamastvatha vā tajjñaṃ yāvan mattaṃ śarīrakam .
sarvameva jagatyaṅga sukhaduẖkhamayaṃ smṛtam ..6.89.109..

hṛdyādinā padārthena kenacid vardhate sukham .
āloka iva dīpena mahāmbudhirivendunā ..6.89.110..

tucchādinā padārthena duẖkhaṃ kenacideti hi .
tamo meghapaṭeneva svabhāvo hyatra kāraṇam ..6.89.111..

svarūpe nirmale satye nimeṣamapi vismṛte .
dṛśyamullāsamāpnoti prāvṛṣīva payodharaḥ ..6.89.112..

anāratānusandhānādanunmeṣamavistṛte .
svarūpe nollasatyeṣa citi dṛśyapiśācakaḥ ..6.89.113..

yathā tamaḫprakāśābhyāmahorātraṃ sthitiṃ gatam .
tathaiva sukhaduẖkhābhyāṃ śarīraṃ sthitimāgatam ..6.89.114..

ete hi sukhaduẖkhe dve janmakāraṇadarśanāt .
ajñasya lagataś śuklapaṭakuṅkumavad dṛḍham ..6.89.115..

tajjñasya tvaṅga lagato manāgapi citer vaśāt .
yathā śubhāśubhau rāgāvanākrāntāntarau maṇeḥ ..6.89.116..

purassthavastvabhāvena rañjanāṃ sphaṭiko yathā .
tajjñas tyajati he sādho jīvanmuktamatir muniḥ ..6.89.117..

vastu saṃśleṣamātreṇa ghanaṃ rañjitacetasaḥ .
gate 'pi vastuni dṛḍhaṃ durdhiyaḫ paritāpinaḥ ..6.89.118..

gate 'pi kuṅkume bhastrā tadīyamanurañjanam .
na jahāti yathā mūḍhas tathā viṣayarañjanam ..6.89.119..

anenaiva krameṇaitau bandhamokṣau vyavasthitau .
bhāvanātānavaṃ mokṣo bandho hi dṛḍhabhāvanam ..6.89.120..

svotpattikāraṇaprāptau kathaṃ duẖkhaṃ sukhaṃ ca vā .
abhyudetīti vada me dūrasthāyāmapi prabho ..6.89.121..

atyudāramatīvācchaṃ bahvarthaṃ vacanaṃ tava .
śrotuṃ tṛptiṃ na gacchāmi mayūro 'bhraraveṣviva ..6.89.122..

svotpattikāraṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ vastvādāyākṣapāṇibhiḥ .
sukhasaṃvidiyaṃ bālā nūnamullasati svataḥ ..6.89.123..

hṛdgatā kṣobhamāyātā jīvaṃ kuṇḍalinīgatam .
somyamudbodhayatyantas siṃhamabhraravo yathā ..6.89.124..

prāṇāvapūritā nāḍīr jīva ākramati sphuran .
samyaksekaprabuddhātmā raso drumalatā iva ..6.89.125..

sukhaprabodhasañcāre duẖkhabodhagame tathā .
jīvasya niyatā nāḍyaḫ pṛthag dehe sthitiṃ gatāḥ ..6.89.126..

sukhitaḫ prasphuratyeṣa yāsu tāsu na duẖkhitaḥ .
ye hi mārgās suveṣasya kuveṣasya na te śubhāḥ ..6.89.127..

jīvas sadaiva sarvatra dehe tiṣṭhati vai kila .
tasya duẖkhe sukhe vāpi niyataṃ sphuritaṃ kutaḥ ..6.89.128..

yāvatpramāṇaṃ jīvo 'yaṃ saṃśāmyatyaparisphuran .
tāvatpramāṇamevainaṃ muktaṃ muktamavaihi vai ..6.89.129..

yāvatpramāṇamadhikaṃ sphurati kṣubdhamārutam .
tāvatpramāṇamevainaṃ baddhaṃ baddhamavaihi me ..6.89.130..

sukhaduẖkhakalāspando bandho jīvasya netaraḥ .
tadabhāvo hi mokṣas syād bodhāt sampadyate ca saḥ ..6.89.131..

sukhaduẖkhadaśe yāvadānīte nendriyaiś śaṭhaiḥ .
tāvat suptasamas somyo jīvas tiṣṭhati śāntavat ..6.89.132..

sukhamālokya vā duẖkhamakṣānītaṃ caladvapuḥ .
samutphalati jīvo 'ntar dṛṣṭenduriva toyadhiḥ ..6.89.133..

jīvaẖ kṣubhyati dṛṣṭena saṃvidāṅga sukhādinā .
āmiṣeṇeva mārjāro maurkhyamevātra kāraṇam ..6.89.134..

bodhena bodhyate jīva ātmajñānātmanātmanā .

jīvaẖ kṣubdhayati kṣubdhaḫ prāṇādipavanāvalīm .

ādisarge yathā yad yat sphuritaṃ brahma brahmaṇi .

kākatālīyavad vāribudbudotpattināśavat .

asmin svabhāvavaśato jagati prarūḍhe

ātmasvabhāvavaśato jātaṃ jagadidaṃ mahat .

vāsanāṃśaṃ samānīya dharmādharmair na gṛhyate .

atyudāraṃ mahārthaṃ ca vakṣi tvaṃ vadatāṃ vara .

tvadvākyavibhavenādya śrutenānena sundara .
pītenevendunā rāhurantar yāto 'smi śītatām ..6.90.4..

tat samāsena tāṃ tāvadātmotpattiṃ vadāśu me .

tena padmajaputreṇa muninā nāradena tat .

kṛtābhivādanaṃ brahmā pautramādāya taṃ tadā .

sādho so 'yamahaṃ pautraẖ kumbho 'haṃ padmajanmanaḥ .

nivasāmyabjajapure pitrā saha yathāsukham .

yathākāmamaśeṣāṇi jaganti viharāmyaham .

adyākāśapathā gacchan dṛṣṭavāṃs tvāmahaṃ puraḥ .

eṣo 'hamityakhilameva yathānubhūtaṃ

santo hyasaṅkathanamāryasamāgameṣu

ityuktavatyatha munau divaso jagāma

sarge sphuradbhir matpuṇyair manye sampreṣito bhavān .
alakṣyais sambhṛtairadrau prāvṛḍvātairivāmbudaḥ ..6.91.1..

adya tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ sādho dhanyānāṃ dhuri dharmataḥ .
amṛtasyandavacasā yat tvayāsmi samāgataḥ ..6.91.2..

na kecana tathā bhāvāś cetaś śītalayanti me .
rājyalābhādayo 'pyete yathā sādhusamāgamaḥ ..6.91.3..

nirargalatayā yatra sāmyameva vijṛmbhate .
muktarāgādimananaṃ tan na kasya sukhāvaham ..6.91.4..

evaṃvādina evāsya vākyamākṣipya bhūpateḥ .
bhūyaḫ provāca cūḍālā munidārakarūpiṇī ..6.91.5..

āstāmeṣā kathā tāvat sarvaṃ te varṇitaṃ mayā .
tvaṃ me kathaya he sādho kas tvamadrau karoṣi kim ..6.91.6..

kiyatparyavasāneyaṃ tava vā vanavāsitā .
satyaṃ kathaya nāsatyaṃ vaktuṃ jānāti tāpasaḥ ..6.91.7..

devaputro 'si jānāsi sarvameva yathāsthitam .

saṃsārabhayabhītatvān nivasāmi vanāntare .

śikhidhvajo 'haṃ bhūpālas tyaktvā rājyamiha sthitaḥ .

punas sukhaṃ punar duẖkhaṃ punar maraṇajanmanī .

apattro 'pyaphalo 'pyeko nīraso 'pyastasaṅgatiḥ .

imāmakhaṇḍitāṃ samyak kriyāṃ sampādayannapi .

pitāmahamahaṃ pūrvaṃ kadācit pṛṣṭavānidam .

jñānaṃ hi paramaṃ śreyaẖ ka ivaitan na vettyalam .

alabdhajñānadṛṣṭīnāṃ kriyāmutra parāyaṇam .

vāsanāmātrasāratvādajñasya saphalāẖ kriyāḥ .

sarvā hi vāsanābhāve prayāntyaphalatāṃ kriyāḥ .
suśubhāḫ phalavatyo 'pi sekābhāve latā iva ..6.91.19..

ṛtvantare yathā yāti vilayaṃ pūrvamārtavam .

sayakṣavāsano bālo yakṣaṃ paśyati nānyathā .

ākārabhāsurāpyuccair na dadāti phalaṃ kriyā .

yasya maurkhyaṃ kṣayaṃ yātaṃ sarvaṃ brahmeti bhāvanāt .

asrupūrṇamukho vākyaṃ śikhidhvaja uvāca ha ..6.91.35..

aho 'vabodhito 'smyadya cirāt surasuta tvayā .

yadudāratamaṃ vetsi yasmiñ jñāte na śocyate .

ghaṭajñānādayo jñānavibhavās santyanekaśaḥ .

yadyupādeyavākyo 'haṃ rājarṣe tad vadāmi te .

yad vakṣi tadanuṣṭheyaṃ mayā vidhiriva śruteḥ .
avikāritamevāśu satyametad vrataṃ mama ..6.91.43..

yathā bālaḫ pitur vākyaṃ muktahetūpapādanam .

śravaṇānantaraṃ buddhyā śubhamityeva bhāvayan .

svacaritasadṛśaṃ tavodayantyāś

asti kaścit pumāñ śrīmān sthānaṃ nityaviruddhayoḥ .

dantābhyāṃ yatnatas tābhyāṃ muhūrtadvitayena saḥ .

tasyāvacchinnapāśasya mūrdhni tālataro ripuḥ .

śiṣyate sarvasantyāge deho me devatātmaja ..6.97.15..

tadutthāya purassaṃsthabhṛgupātādavighnajāt .

ityuktvā dehamagrasthe śvabhre tyaktumasau javāt .
karoti yāvadutthānaṃ tāvat kumbho 'bhyuvāca ha ..6.97.17..

rājan kimiti dehaṃ tvaṃ nirāgaskaṃ mahāvaṭe .

ātmanyevaiṣa mūḍhātmā dhyānavāniva tiṣṭhati .

kṣobhayatyanya evainaṃ nigrahārho muhur balāt .

sukhaduẖkhānubhūtyā hi nāparādhi śarīrakam .

vātaḫ phalaśikhāpuṣpapātanaṃ kurute sphuran .
taruṇā sādhunā sādhoraparāddhaṃ kimātmanaḥ ..6.97.23..

tyaktenāpi śarīreṇa kila tāmarasekṣaṇa .
sarvatyāgo na te yāti niṣpattiṃ viṣamo hi saḥ ..6.97.24..

bhṛgoẖ kevalametat tvaṃ nirāgaskaṃ śarīrakam .
mudhā kṣipasi no dehatyāgena tyāgitā bhavet ..6.97.25..

yenāyaṃ kṣobhyate deho mattebheneva pādapaḥ .
tat santyajasi cet pāpaṃ tan mahātyāgavān bhavān ..6.97.26..

tasmiṃs tyakte bhavet tyaktaṃ sarvaṃ dehādi bhūpate .
no cen nirdagdhamapyetad bhūyo bhūyaḫ prarohati ..6.97.27..

kenāyaṃ cālyate dehaẖ kiṃ bījaṃ janmakarmaṇām .
kasmiṃs tyakte parityaktaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati sundara ..6.97.28..

sādho na dehatyāgena na rājyatyajanena ca .
na coṭajādiploṣeṇa sarvatyāgo bhaven nṛṇām ..6.97.29..

yat sarvaṃ sarvato yac ca tasmin sarvaikakāraṇe .
sarvasmin samparityakte sarvatyāgaẖ kṛto bhavet ..6.97.30..

sarvaṃ sarvagataṃ sārvaṃ heyaṃ tyājyaṃ ca sarvathā .
sarvaṃ kimucyate brūhi sarvatattvavidāṃ vara ..6.97.31..

sādho sarvakalādhāraṃ jīvaprāṇādināmakam .
na jaḍaṃ nājaḍaṃ bhrāntaṃ cittaṃ sarvamiti smṛtam ..6.97.32..

sarvasya bīje santyakte sarvaṃ tyaktaṃ bhavatyalam .
sambhavāsambhavād bhūyas sarvatyāgo bhavediti ..6.97.34..

sarvaṃ dharmādyadharmādi rājyādi vipinādi ca .

idaṃ vivartate sarvaṃ cittameva jagattayā .

pādapaḫ pavaneneva bhūkampeneva parvataḥ .

sarvabhūtopabhogyānāṃ jarāmaraṇajanmanām .

cittaṃ jīvo mano māyā prāṇaś cetyādibhir mune .

cittaṃ sarvamiti prāhus tasmiṃs tyakte mahīpate .
sarvādhivyādhisīmānte sarvatyāgaẖ kṛto bhavet ..6.97.40..

cittatyāgaṃ vidus sarvatyāgaṃ tyāgavidāṃ vara .
tasmin siddhe mahābāho satyaṃ kenāpi bhūyate ..6.97.41..

asyāẖ kṣetraṃ viduś cittaṃ saṃsṛtes sasyasantateḥ .

cittameva vicitrehaṃ bhāvābhāvavilāsinā .

sarvatyāgasya viṣayo yathaivānyo 'sti te tathā .
tvamapyanyasya bhavasi tyāgin gṛhṇāsi cen nṛpa ..6.97.46..

sūtraṃ muktāphaleneva jagajjālaṃ trikālagam .
sarvamantaẖkṛtaṃ tena yena sarvaṃ samujjhitam ..6.97.47..

yena sarvaṃ parityaktaṃ tasmiñ śūnye 'pi saṃsthitaṃ .
jagat sarvaṃ trikālasthaṃ tantur muktāphale yathā ..6.97.48..

sasneheneva dīpena tena sarvaṃ prakāśitam .
sthitas sarvaṃ parityajya yaś śānto 'snehadīpavat ..6.97.49..

asneheneva dīpena yena sarvaṃ tirohitam .

samastavastuniṣkāse yathā khamavaśiṣyate .

samastavastūdāso hi yathā khaṃ netaran nṛpa .
sarvasantyāga evāṅga tathā nirvāṇamucyate ..6.97.52..

sarvatyāgo hi śūnyātmāpyāśrayas sarvasampadām .
anantānāmudārāṇāṃ khamivedaṃ divaukasām ..6.97.53..

sarvatyāgarasāpānāj jarāmaraṇabhītayaḥ .
na kāścana prabādhante khasyeva malalekhikāḥ ..6.97.54..

sarvatyāgo mahattvasya kāraṇaṃ nirmaladyuteḥ .
sarvaṃ tyajati khaṃ yasmāt tasmāc chuddhaṃ sthiraṃ bṛhat ..6.97.55..

sarvatyāgaḫ parānando duẖkhamanyat sudāruṇam .
ityomityurarīkṛtya yadicchasi tadācara ..6.97.56..

sarvaṃ tyajati yas tasya sarvamevopatiṣṭhate .

sarvatyāgāntarevāsti jñānamātmaprasādakam .

sarvatyāgavaśādeva hatakāle kalāvapi .
śākyena vigatāśaṅkaṃ muninā meruvat sthitam ..6.97.59..

sarvatyāgo mahārāja sarvasampatsamāśrayaḥ .
na gṛhṇāti hi yaẖ kaścit sarvaṃ tasmai pradīyate ..6.97.60..

kṛtvā sarvaparityāgaṃ śāntas svaccho viyatsamaḥ .
somyo bhavasi yadrūpas tadrūpo bhava bhūpate ..6.97.61..

sarvaṃ parityajya mahānubhāva
tyajasyalaṃ yena ca tad vihāya .
tyāgaṃ ca sādānamalaṃ vimucya
vimuktarūpo bhava bhūmipāla ..6.97.62..

evaṃ vadati vai kumbhe cittatyāgaṃ muhur muhuḥ .
antar vicārayan somyo rājā vacanamabravīt ..6.98.1..

hṛdayākāśavihago hṛdayadrumamarkaṭaḥ .
bhūyo bhūyo nirastaṃ hi samāyātyeva māṃ manaḥ ..6.98.2..

jānāmi naitadādātuṃ matsyaṃ bāla ivākulam .
tyāgamasya na jānāmi citramandha ivottamam ..6.98.3..

cittasyādau svarūpaṃ me yathāvad bhagavan vada .
tataś cittaparityāgaṃ yathāvad bhagavan vada ..6.98.4..

vāsanaiva mahārāja svarūpaṃ viddhi cetasaḥ .
cittaśabdas tu paryāyo vāsanāyā udāhṛtaḥ ..6.98.5..

tyāgas tvasyātisukaras susādhas spandanādapi .
ratādapyadhikānandaẖ kusumādapi sundaraḥ ..6.98.6..

mūrkhasya tu manastyāgo nūnaṃ dussādhatāṃ gataḥ .
pukkasasyeva sāmrājyaṃ tṛṇasyeva sumerutā ..6.98.7..

svarūpaṃ vedmi cittasya vāsanāmayamākulam .
tyāgo 'sya manye dussādho vajranirdalanādapi ..6.98.8..

saṃsṛtyāmodapuṣpasya duẖkhatailatilasya ca .
jagadvālamṛṇālasya mohamārutakhasya ca ..6.98.9..

śarīrayantravāhasya hṛtpadmabhramarasya ca .

sarvanāśo 'sya yas sādho cetasas saṃsṛtikṣayaḥ .
sa eva cittasantyāga ityuktaṃ dīrghadarśibhiḥ ..6.98.11..

cittatyāgādahaṃ manye cittanāśas svasiddhaye .
abhāvaś cetaso vyādheẖ kathamasyānubhūyate ..6.98.12..

ahambījadrumaṃ cittaṃ saśākhāphalapallavam .
unmūlaya samūlaṃ tvamākāśaviśado bhavan ..6.98.13..

cetasaẖ kiṃ mune mūlaṃ ko 'ṅkuraẖ kaś ca sambhavaḥ .
kāś śākhāẖ ke ca vā skandhāẖ kathamunmūlyate ca tat ..6.98.14..

ahamarthodayo yo 'yaṃ cidātmā vedanātmakaḥ .
etac cittadrumasyāsya viddhi bījaṃ jagadgatam ..6.98.15..

ahambhāvātmakaṃ vittvaṃ cittabījamudāhṛtam .
paramātmapadakṣetraṃ netraṃ māyāmayasya tat ..6.98.16..

etasmāt prathamodbhinnād yo 'ṅkuro 'nubhavākṛtiḥ .
niścayātmā nirākāro buddhirityeva socyate ..6.98.17..

asya buddhyabhidhānasya yāṅkurasya prapīnatā .

jīvo mithyopalambhātmā śūnyātmāpyupalopamaḥ .

deśād deśāntare dūre deśakālavido 'sya yāḥ .

indriyāṇyatha bhogāś ca bhāvābhāvamayormayaḥ .

īdṛśasyāsya cittasya durvṛkṣasya pratikṣaṇam .

cittadrumasya śākhādeẖ kurvāṇo 'haṃ vikartanam .
kathaṃ karomi mūlasya niśśeṣaṃ kaṣaṇaṃ mune ..6.98.23..

vāsanā vividhāś śākhāḫ phalaskandhādinānvitāḥ .
abhāvitā bhavantyantar lūnās saṃvidbalena te ..6.98.24..

cittadrumalatājālaṃ pauruṣeṇa vikartayan .

kaṭakatvaṃ yathā hemni tathāhantvaṃ cidātmani .

sanniveśaviśeṣātmaśabdārthādi pare pade .

jānannapīti bhagavannahantvamalamārjanam .

etāvanmātrakaṃ vṛndaṃ yadi na tvaṃ mahīpate .

cinmātramahamacchātmavedanaṃ viduṣāṃ vara .

evaṃrūpasya me lagnaṃ nūnaṃ malamakāraṇam .

asadetadanātmīyaṃ pramārṣṭuṃ malamātmanaḥ .
mune yadā na śakto 'smi tena tapye sudāruṇam ..6.98.40..

brūhi kiṃ tan mahābāho lagnaṃ tava malaṃ mahat .
sthito 'si yena saṃsārī satā vāpyasatātha vā ..6.98.41..

cittadrumasya yad bījamahambhāvas sa me malam .
tac ca tyaktuṃ na jānāmi tyaktaṃ tyaktamupaiti mām ..6.98.42..

kāraṇāj jāyate kāryaṃ yat tat sarvatra sad bhavet .
anyat tvasad dvicandrābhaṃ dṛṣṭameva na vidyate ..6.98.43..

kāraṇāj jāyate kāryamahambhāvātmakaṃ tataḥ .
itikāraṇamanviṣya kathayāśu mamātmanā ..6.98.44..

mune 'hamiti doṣasya vedanaṃ vedmi kāraṇam .

citaś cetyonmukhatvena duẖkhāyāhamiti sthitaḥ .

kāraṇaṃ kāraṇajño 'si vedanasya vadāśu me .

vedyavedanarūpasya cetyasañcetanasya ca .
akāraṇaṃ kāraṇatāṃ yad gataṃ tava tad vada ..6.98.48..

cetyacetanarūpasya vedyasaṃvedanākṛteḥ .
iyaṃ padārthasatteha dehādyā kāraṇaṃ mune ..6.98.49..

śarīrāditayodeti vedanaṃ vastusattayā .
asatyābhāsayā spando yathā pavanalekhayā ..6.98.50..

asattāṃ vastusattāyā nāvagacchāmyahaṃ yayā .

vidyate yadi dehādivastusattā tadasti te .

yasyopalabhyate kiñcit svarūpaṃ kalanātmakam .

hastapādādisaṃyuktaẖ kriyāphalavilāsavān .

kāraṇaṃ yasya kāryasya bhūmipāla na vidyate .

padārthānāṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bījamucyate .

avaśyameva yan nāsti nirbījaṃ tan matibhramaḥ .

pitāmahānāṃ putrāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca jagattraye .

ādyaḫ pitāmaho yas syāt so 'pi nāstyeva bhūpate .

tasmāc cidātmakatayātmani cinnabho yan

tenaiva padmaja iti svayamātmanātmā
proktaẖ kharūpa iti śāntamidaṃ samastam ..6.98.71..

ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ yadyayaṃ bhāsate bhramaḥ .
arthakriyāsamarthaś ca tat sthitaṃ duẖkhakāraṇam ..6.99.1..

evaṃ jagadbhramasyāsya tānavaṃ tāvadāgatam .

tanutvaṃ sargabodhasya yat tadeva hi kāraṇam .

anenaiva krameṇainaṃ tvamādipuruṣaṃ nṛpa .

ayaṃ bhūtopalambho hi mṛgatṛṣṇāmbvivoditaḥ .
vicārād vilayaṃ yāti śuktau rajatadhīriva ..6.99.8..

kāraṇābhāvataẖ kāryamabhūtvā bhavatīti yat .

mithyādṛṣṭiḫ prekṣitā ca na kadācana vidyate .

sraṣṭurādyasya paramaṃ brahma kasmān na kāraṇam .
anantamajamavyaktamīśvaraṃ śāntamacyutam ..6.99.11..

hetutvābhāvato brahma kāryatvābhāvatas tataḥ .

akartṛkarmakaraṇamakāraṇamabījakam .

āgulphameva lambāni sampadyante 'mbarāṇi me .

vipine kumbha ityuktvā tūṣṇīṃ khinno babhūva ha .

tataẖ katipayeṣveva divaseṣu gateṣu sā .

śakreṇa saha yac chacyā yal lakṣmyā hariṇā saha .

himaśītāvadātāṅgī jyotsnāprasarahāsinī .

taduttiṣṭha varārohe vedīṃ vaivāhikīṃ svayam .

kalpavṛkṣalatāsūtraiẖ kalpastabakamaṇḍalaiḥ .

devadārulatājālaiẖ kāṇḍapratisarāṅkitaiḥ .

atha sūryāṃśuraṅgeṇa rañjite bhuvanodare .
śikhidhvajāṅganā bhūyo madanī kumbhatāṃ yayau ..6.111.1..

vilesatur vicitrāsu pratyahaṃ vanarājiṣu .

divā priyatare mitre yāminyāmiṣṭadampatī .

māsamekaṃ mahendrādrisānau saralasaṅkule .

hastalabhyoditendau ca mandāravanamālite .

ātmanaẖ kiṃ kṛtā dūrādabhyāgamakadarthanā .
devarāja prasādān me yathāvad vaktumarhasi ..6.111.19..

ime vayamihānītās tvadguṇātiśayena khāt .
hṛdi lagnena sūtreṇa khagā dūragatā iva ..6.111.20..

uttiṣṭha svargamāgaccha tatra sarve tvadunmukhāḥ .

ime rathā idaṃ yānamayamuccaiśśravā hayaḥ .
ayamairāvaṇo nāgo yathābhimatamāśraya ..6.111.22..

pādukāgulikākhaḍgarasādīdamathāpi ca .

ākalpaṃ vaibudhā bhogās tvayā vibudhasadmani .
jīvanmuktena bhoktavyās tena tvāmahamāgataḥ ..6.111.24..

vimānayanti samprāptāṃ na tiraskaraṇaiś śriyam .
nābhivāñchanti cāprāptāṃ tvādṛśās sādhusādhavaḥ ..6.111.25..

avighnamāgatenādya sukhaṃ viharatā tvayā .
svargaḫ pavitratāṃ yātu hariṇeva jagattrayam ..6.111.26..

svargaṃ svargasamācāraṃ vedmi devādināyaka .
kiṃ tu sarvatra me svargo niyato na tu kutracit ..6.111.27..

sarvatraiva hi tuṣyāmi sarvatraiva rame prabho .
avāñchanatvān manasas sarvatrānandavānaham ..6.111.28..

niyataṃ kiñcidekatra sthitaṃ svargakamīdṛśam .
śakra gantuṃ na jānāmi nājñātaṃ ca karomyaham ..6.111.29..

sādho viditavedyānāṃ paripūrṇadhiyāṃ satām .
sajjanācaritaṃ yuktaṃ manye bhogopasevanam ..6.111.30..

deveśe proktavatyevaṃ tūṣṇīmeva sthite nṛpe .
kimevaṃ nopayāmyeva tvāmiti proktavān hariḥ ..6.111.31..

bāḍhamityeva kālena vadatīṣac chikhidhvaje .
kalyāṇaṃ te 'stu kumbheti vadannantardhimāyayau ..6.111.32..

tad devavṛndamakhilaṃ tridaśeśayuktaṃ

kallolajālamiva vārinidhau praśānta-
vāte sphuranmakaraphenaphaṇīndraśabdam ..6.111.33..

tāṃ māyāṃ śamamānīya cūḍālā samacintayat .
diṣṭyā bhogecchayā nāyaṃ hriyate vasudhādhipaḥ ..6.112.1..

śāntas samasamābhoga eva śakrasamāgame .
asambhramamahelaṃ ca kṛtavān vyavahāritām ..6.112.2..

bhūya eva prapañcena vimṛśāmyenamādarāt .
rāgadveṣapradhānena kenacid buddhihāriṇā ..6.112.3..

iti sañcintya sā rātrāvindāvabhyudite vane .
gṛhītamaṇḍanā nūnaṃ kāntā madanikā satī ..6.112.4..

vāte vahati puṣpāḍhye madirāmodamāṃsale .
sandhyājapyapare nadyās tīrasaṃsthe śikhidhvaje ..6.112.5..

santānakalatāgehaṃ nīrandhraṃ puṣpagucchakaiḥ .
śuddhāntaṃ vanadevīnāṃ praviveśa madānvitā ..6.112.6..

tatra saṅkalpite puṣpaśayane mālyamālitā .
kaṇṭhe saṅkalpitaṃ kāntaṃ śiḍgamādāya saṃsthitā ..6.112.7..

āgatyānviṣya kuñjān sa pradadarśa śikhidhvajaḥ .
latāgehe madanikākaṇṭhe śiḍgaṃ manoharam ..6.112.8..

kuntalāvalitaskandhaṃ samālabdhaṃ ca candanaiḥ .
śayanāvṛttivikṣepaparyākulitaśekharam ..6.112.9..

hemābhe dviguṇākāre bālābāhūpadhānake .
magnaikaśravaṇāpāṅgakapolatalakuntalam ..6.112.10..

mithunaṃ tad dadarśātha mithaḫ prahasitānanam .
anyo'nyavadanāsaktaṃ channaṃ kalpalatāṃśukaiḥ ..6.112.11..

ālolamālyaśayanaṃ madanāturamākulam .
aṅgarāgacchalenātmarāgamanyo'nyamarpayat ..6.112.12..

ratyunmukhaṃ ghanānandamuddāmamadamanmatham .
parasparāhataṃ puṣpair vakṣobhyāṃ pīḍitastanam ..6.112.13..

tadālokyāvikāreṇa cetasā sa tutoṣa ca .

tiṣṭhatho 'ṅga yathākāmaṃ sukhaṃ śiḍgau yathāsthitam .

tato muhūrtamātreṇa prapañcaṃ svamupekṣya sā .
niryayau darśayantī svaṃ ratiyuddhākulaṃ vapuḥ ..6.112.16..

upaviṣṭaṃ dadarśainaṃ nṛpaṃ hemaśilātale .
samādhisaṃsthamekānte manāgvikasitekṣaṇam ..6.112.17..

taṃ pradeśamupāgatya lajjāvanamitānanā .
tūṣṇīmāsit kṣaṇaṃ khinnā mlānā madanikāṅganā ..6.112.18..

kṣaṇāc chikhidhvajo dhyānād viratas tāmuvāca ha .
prasannamadhuraṃ vākyamidamakṣubdhayā dhiyā ..6.112.19..

tanvi kiṃ śīghrameva tvaṃ vighnitānandamāgatā .
ānandāyaiva bhūtāni yatante yāni kānicit ..6.112.20..

bhūyas toṣaya taṃ gaccha kāntaṃ praṇayavṛttibhiḥ .
parasparepsitasneho durlabho hi jagattraye ..6.112.21..

ahametena cārthena nodvegaṃ yāmi mānini .
yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ loke tad tad deyaṃ vijānatā ..6.112.22..

ahaṃ kumbhaś ca tanvaṅgi vītarāgāviha sthitau .

evameṣa mahābhāga strīpumbhāvo hi cañcalaḥ .
kāmo hyaṣṭaguṇas strīṇāṃ na kopaṃ kartumarhasi ..6.112.24..

abalāhamanenāsmi krāntā gahanakānane .
tvayi sandhyājapapare kiṃ karomi varākikā ..6.112.25..

abalā vākyamātreṇa tāvan naranirodhanam .

striyās sundara yātāyāḫ parapuṃsāṅgasaṅgamam .
manyur niṣedha ākrandas satītvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati ..6.112.27..

abalā strī tathā bālā mūḍhāhamaparādhinī .
kṣantumarhasi māṃ nātha kṣamāvanto hi sādhavaḥ ..6.112.28..

manyur mama na bāle 'ntar vidyate kha iva drumaḥ .
kevalaṃ sādhunindyatvān necchāmi tvāmaham vadhūm ..6.112.29..

suhṛttvena vanānteṣu pūrvavat samamaṅgane .
vītarāgatayā nityaṃ tapasaiva ramāvahe ..6.112.30..

evaṃ samatayā tatra sthite tasmiñ śikhidhvaje .
cūḍālā cintayāmāsa tatsatyenoditāśayā ..6.112.31..

aho bata paraṃ sāmyaṃ bhagavānayamāgataḥ .
vītarāgabhayakrodho jīvanmukto 'vatiṣṭhati ..6.112.32..

nainaṃ haranti bhogāśā na mahatyo 'pi siddhayaḥ .
na sukhāni na duẖkhāni nāpado na ca sampadaḥ ..6.112.33..

cintitās sakalā eva prayāntyenamaninditāḥ .
manye maharddhayaẖ kāntā nārāyaṇamivāparam ..6.112.34..

ātmavṛttāntamakhilaṃ tadenaṃ smārayāmyaham .
kumbharūpamidaṃ tyaktvā cūḍālaiva bhavāmyaham ..6.112.35..

iti sañcintya cūḍālā cūḍālāvapurakṣatam .
darśayāmāsa tatrāśu tyaktvā madanikāvapuḥ ..6.112.36..

tasmān madanikādehāc cūḍālā nirgateva sā .
babhāvindvamalā muktā nirgateva samudgakāt ..6.112.37..

tāṃ dadarśānavadyāṅgīṃ puraḫ praṇayapeśalām .
kānto madanikāmeva cūḍālāṃ dayitāṃ sthitām ..6.112.38..

samuditāmiva mādhavapadminīm
upagatāmiva bhūmitalāc chriyam .
prakaṭitāmiva ratnasamudgakāt
paridadarśa nijāṃ dayitāṃ nṛpaḥ ..6.112.39..

atha tāṃ dayitāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ .
śikhidhvaja uvācedamāścaryākulayā girā ..6.113.1..

kā tvamutpalapattrākṣi kutaḫ prāptāsi sundari .
kimīhāsi kiyatkālaṃ kimarthamiha tiṣṭhasi ..6.113.2..

aṅgena vyavahāreṇa smitenānunayena ca .
mama jāyā vilāsena cūḍālevopalakṣyase ..6.113.3..

evameva prabho viddhi cūḍālāsmi na saṃśayaḥ .
akṛtrimena dehena labdho 'syadya mayā svayam ..6.113.4..

kumbhādidehanirmāṇas tvāṃ bodhayitumeṣa me .
prapañcaś śataśākhatvamiha yāto vanāntare ..6.113.5..

yadā rājyaṃ parityajya mohena tapase vanam .
tvamagās tatprabhṛtyeva tvadbodhāyāhamudyatā ..6.113.6..

anena kumbhadehena mayaivaṃ tvaṃ vibodhitaḥ .
māyayā na tu kumbhādi kiñcit satyaṃ mahīpate ..6.113.7..

buddho viditavedyas tvaṃ dhyānenaitadakhaṇḍitam .
sarvaṃ paśyasi tattvajña dhyānenāśvavalokaya ..6.113.8..

atha cūḍālayetyukte baddhvā parikaraṃ nṛpaḥ .
ātmodantamaśeṣeṇa dhyānenālamavaikṣata ..6.113.9..

ā svarājyaparityāgāc cūḍālādarśanāvadhim .
sarvaṃ muhūrtadhyānena svātmodantaṃ dadarśa saḥ ..6.113.10..

ā rājyasamparityāgād vartamānakṣaṇakramam .
sarvamālokya bhūpālo virarāma samādhitaḥ ..6.113.11..

samādhivirato harṣavikāsinayanāmbujaḥ .
visārya tarasā bāhū pulakojjvalatāṃ gataḥ ..6.113.12..

galadaṅgaṃ lasatsnehamudyadbāṣpaṃ sphuratspṛham .
āliliṅga ciraṃ kāntāṃ nakulo nakulīmiva ..6.113.13..

tayorāliṅgane tasmiṃs tatra bhāvo babhūva yaḥ .

citrasthāviva paṅkena kṛtāviva galattanū .

muhūrtena galadgharmajālau pulakapīvarau .
bāhū viślathatāmīṣan ninyatus tau śanaiḫ priyau ..6.113.16..

amṛtāpūrṇahṛdayaṃ saṃśūnyahṛdayopamam .
unmuktabhujamāstāṃ tāvalakṣyasthitalocanam ..6.113.17..

ghanānandaẖ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tūṣṇīṃ praṇayapeśalam .
kāntācibukasaṃlagnakaraḫ provāca bhūpatiḥ ..6.113.18..

aho nu madhuras snigdhaẖ kāntaś ca kulayoṣitām .
puṇyaś caritaniṣṣyandas svādavānamṛtādapi ..6.113.19..

kiyatpramāṇaṃ tanvaṅgi tvayā bālendumugdhayā .
anubhūtaś ciraṃ kleśo bharturarthena dāruṇaḥ ..6.113.20..

evaṃ duruttarādasmāt saṃsārakuharādaham .
uttārito yayā buddhyā sā hi kenopamīyate ..6.113.21..

arundhatī śacī gaurī gāyatrī śrīs sarasvatī .
samastāḫ pelavāyante tanvyās sattvaguṇaśriyā ..6.113.22..

dhīśrīkāntikṣamāmaitrīkaruṇādyāsu sundari .

pareṇādhyavasāyena tvayāhamavabodhitaḥ .
kena pratyupakāreṇa tulāmeṣyanti me guṇāḥ ..6.113.24..

mohādanādigahanādanantaviṣamādapi .

śāstrārthagurumantrādi na tathottāraṇakṣamam .
yathaitās snehaśālinyo bhartṝṇāṃ kulayoṣitaḥ ..6.113.26..

sakhā bhrātā suhṛd bhṛtyo gurur mantro dhanaṃ sukham .
śāstramāyatanaṃ dāsyas sarvaṃ bhartuẖ kulastriyaḥ ..6.113.27..

sarvadā sarvayatnena pūjanīyāẖ kulāṅganāḥ .
lokadvayasukhaṃ samyak sarvaṃ tāsu pratiṣṭhitam ..6.113.28..

niricchāyāḫ prayātāyāḫ pāraṃ saṃsāravāridheḥ .
kathamasyopakārasya kariṣye te pratikriyām ..6.113.29..

manye kulāṅganāloko loke sarvas tvayādhunā .

tvāṃ nirmitavato dhātur guṇajālātiśāyinīm .
manye prakupitā nūnamarundhatyādikās striyaḥ ..6.113.31..

satītvarūpasaujanyaguṇaratnasamudgike .
ehi me tvadguṇotkasya punarāliṅganaṃ kuru ..6.113.32..

ityuktvā mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ cūḍālāṃ sa śikhidhvajaḥ .
āliliṅga punar gāḍhaṃ nakulo nakulīmiva ..6.113.33..

deva śuṣkakriyājālapare tvayyākulātmani .
tathābhūvaṃ bhṛśamahaṃ tvadarthaṃ duẖkhitā kila ..6.113.34..

tena tvadavabodhātmā svārtha evopapāditaḥ .
mayā tadatra kiṃ devaẖ karoti mayi śaṃsanam ..6.113.35..

tvayā yathā varārohe svārthas sampāditaś śubhaḥ .
tathedānīṃ satāṃ sarvās sādhayantu kulastriyaḥ ..6.113.36..

buddhyaṃśaikāntaviśrāntajagajjālaka deva he .
adya taṃ prāktanaṃ kaccin mohaṃ samanupaśyasi ..6.113.37..

idaṃ karomi nedaṃ tu prāpnomīdamitas tviti .
antar hasasi tāṃ kaccidāśāpelavatāṃ dhiyaḥ ..6.113.38..

tās tucchatṛṣṇākalanās tās saṅkalpakukalpanāḥ .
tvayi nādyāvalokyante deva vyomnīva parvatāḥ ..6.113.39..

kas tvamadyāṅgasampannaẖ kiṃniṣṭho 'si kimīhase .
kathaṃ paśyasi pāścātyaṃ dehāvasthākramaṃ prabho ..6.113.40..

sumanaḫpūrṇanīlābjamālāsāravilokane .
yasya tvameva tajjñāsi tadevāhamupasthitaḥ ..6.113.41..

nirīho 'smi niraṃśo 'smi nabhassvaccho 'smi nisspṛhaḥ .
śāntāhamartharūpo 'smi cirāyāhamahaṃ sthitaḥ ..6.113.42..

tāṃ daśāmupayāto 'smi yataś caṇpakavarṇini .
pratibhānti mahānto 'pi śocyā harijinādayaḥ ..6.113.43..

nakiñcinmātracinmātraniṣṭho 'smi svastha āsthitaḥ .
bhrameṇālaṃ vimukto 'smi saṃsāreṇālilocane ..6.113.44..

na tuṣṭo 'smi na khinno 'smi nāyamasmi na cetarat .

tejobimbāt prayātena bhittāvapatitena ca .

prasādena viśālākṣyās tīrṇo 'smi bhavasāgarāt .

pratiṣedhaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmyabhivāñchanam .

cetasā vigatecchena yathāprāptamanindite .

sarvatraikyāvabodhena maurkhyakṣayabhuvādhunā .

yādṛgeṣaṇamasmākam tādṛgetadaneṣaṇam .

tasmādādyantamadhyeṣu ye vayaṃ puruṣottama .

sāmprataṃ prakṛtenemaṃ kālaṃ nītvā krameṇa vai .

vayamādyantamadhyeṣu kīdṛśās tarale vada .

vayamādyantamadhyeṣu rājāno rājasattama .

sanṛpā mattavāstavyā nṛtyannavavarāṅganā .

lasadvallyā samañjaryā raṇatṣaṭpadayā samā .

iti cūḍālayā prokte vihasya sa śikhidhvajaḥ .

evaṃ cet tad viśālākṣi svāyattā nas triviṣṭape .

na rājan mama bhogeṣu vāñchā na ca vibhūtiṣu .

na sukhāya mama svargo na rājyaṃ nāpi nākitā .

idaṃ sukhamidaṃ neti manane kṣayamāgate .

yuktamuktaṃ viśālākṣi tvayaitat samayā dhiyā .

sukhaduẖkhadaśācintāṃ tyaktvā vigatamatsaram .
yathāsaṃsthānamevemau tiṣṭhāvas svasthatāṃ gatau ..6.113.72..

iti tatra kathālāpakathanena tayor dvayoḥ .

athotthāya dinācāraṃ yathāprāptamaninditau .

svargasiddhimanādṛtya tasthatuḫ pūrṇacetasau ..6.113.74..

ekasminneva śayane tais taiḫ praṇayaceṣṭitaiḥ .
sā vyatīyāya rajanī tayor jīvadvimuktayoḥ ..6.113.75..

tad bhogamokṣasukhamuttamayos tayos svam
ācetatoḫ praṇayavākyavilāsagarbham .
utkaṇṭhitaṃ praṇayinor ghanatāṃ nayantī
dīrghā muhūrtavadasau rajanī jagāma ..6.113.76..

tatas samudite sūrye vitamasyambare sthite .
samudgakādiva jaganmaṇāvasmin vinirgate ..6.114.1..

vikasatyaruṇopānte cakṣuṣīvāmbujākare .

ātmārāmo vītaśoko nityamantarmukhas sukhī .

sarveṣāmeva jīvānāṃ bhāvanā bhavabandhanī .
vāgureva vihaṅgānāmekāvaṣṭambhakāriṇī ..6.131.11..

ātmatattvādṛte nāsti madīyamahamityalam .
yuktito niścaye rūḍhe nūnaṃ galati bhāvanā ..6.131.12..

māṃsāsthyoghaś śavo dehaẖ khaṃ khamadrigaṇo jagat .
buddhyādayo vikalpāṃśāẖ ko 'haṃ mama kathaṃ ca kim ..6.131.13..

saṃvido 'nantaśuddhāyāẖ kilākalitacetasaḥ .
iyattopaśamaṃ yāti bhāvanāpralaye sati ..6.131.14..

samyagdarśanamevāsyā bhāvanāyā viśāmpate .

atadātmā tadātmā ca jīvaḫ prasphuratīśvare .
jvālāyāṃ tu yathāloko yathā gandhalavaẖ kṣitau ..6.131.17..

yenaikatāṃ bhāvayati jīvas tad bhavati kṣaṇāt .
yaccittas tanmayo jantuẖ kenaitan nānubhūyate ..6.131.18..

brahmabhāvanayā jīvo brahmatāmeti śāśvatīm .

ātmanas saṃvido 'cchasya saṃvedyakalanāmalam .
sampramārjyoditas saṃvidātmā vyavaharānagha ..6.131.21..

svedotthadaṃśayaukāntaṃ bhūtajātaṃ surādyapi .

caturdaśavidhasyāsya bhūtajātasya rāghava .
kiñcit sakāraṇaṃ jātaṃ prāktanairātmakarmabhiḥ ..6.131.23..

kiñcin niṣkāraṇaṃ jātaṃ kacanaṃ sumaṇeriva .
svabhāvato 'dhunā karma kāraṇāttaṃ bhaviṣyati ..6.131.24..

hārdāndhakāramārtāṇḍa saṃśayābdānilaprabho .

kiṃ kathaṃ kāraṇāyātaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ cāpyakāraṇam .
jātaṃ vā jāyate vāpi kathaṃ vāpi janiṣyate ..6.131.26..

dikkālādyanavacchinnaṃ vyomnyavyomni ca saṃsthitam .

kha ivārko 'mbudavyāpto vaṭabīja ivāṅkuraḥ .

kvacit svabhāvajāt spandāt sphuratyagniriva tviṣā .
bhūtatanmātrabhāvena jagattāṃ samupeyuṣā ..6.131.30..

kvacit prākspandasampannabhūtatanmātrarañjanāt .

yathā sattvamupekṣya svaṃ śanair vipro durīhayā .

bhūtāni dvividhānyevaṃ pratisargaṃ sphuranti hi .
adyacitspandajātāni ciracitspandajāni ca ..6.131.33..

tatra ye citsvabhāvotthaspandajās te hi jīvakāḥ .

sakāraṇatvamadhunā gantavyaṃ tais svakarmabhiḥ .
daśāsu bandhamokṣāsu nāśe janmani karmaṇi ..6.131.35..

īśvarāt samupāgatya bhuktajanmāntarās tu ye .

adhunaiva hi sampannā ye jīvā brahmaṇaḫ padāt .

kāryakāraṇabhāvo 'yamīdṛśo jīvakarmaṇoḥ .

kecit puṇyāḫ prajāyante kecid dhanyāś ca jīvakāḥ .

dhanyāḫ puṇyatvamagatā eva kecid vimokṣaṇāḥ .

vīruttṛṇalatāgulmayaukakīṭakhagādayaḥ .
surāsuranarāhīndrapiśācāśīviṣādayaḥ ..6.131.41..

kecid dhanyāẖ kecit puṇyāẖ kecid dhāsyanti puṇyatām .
puṇyatvān mokṣiṇaẖ kecid dhanyatvād vā tato 'pi no ..6.131.42..

yathā ratnasya kacanaṃ spandanaṃ pavanasya ca .

asamyagdarśanotpannaṃ puṃstvaṃ sthāṇau yathoditam .

cinmātrasyātiśuddhasya nissaṅkalpoditātmanaḥ .
anantasya prakāśasya sarvagatvād raghūdvaha ..6.131.45..

khādeva jāyate kaścit kaścid vyomnyeva līyate .

ātmānaṃ samyagālokya yaẖ kha eva vilīyate .
na sa sandṛśyate bhūyo himaṃ tāpadrutaṃ yathā ..6.131.47..

yas tvapaśyan svamātmānaṃ saspandaẖ kalanātmabhiḥ .
karmabhis sa sphuratyuccair vilīno jāyate punaḥ ..6.131.48..

yas saṅkalpaparispandais sthaulyameti jaḍātmakaḥ .
prāvṛṣīva payovāhaẖ kṣīṇakṣīṇo 'pyudetyasau ..6.131.49..

ātmatvāṃśānvitamapi citsaṅkalpaṃ raghūdvaha .
dūrīkuru mahāsiddhyai viṣasiktamivāśanam ..6.131.50..

nirvikalpamanādyantamudāsīnamavasthitam .
sarvātmaikaṃ samuditaṃ cidvyoma bhava bhūtaye ..6.131.51..

akāraṇamupāyānti sarve jīvāḫ parāt padāt .
paścāt kāraṇatāṃ yānti bandhamokṣadaśāsviha ..6.131.52..

saṅkalpitvaṃ hi bandhasya kāranaṃ tat parityaja .
mokṣas tu nissaṅkalpatvaṃ tadabhyāsaṃ dhiyā kuru ..6.131.53..

akāraṇaṃ tvakaraṇāt sarvakāraṇakāraṇāt .
yāvan nimeṣamavyaktāj jīvas sampadyate śivāt ..6.131.54..

tāvan nimeṣa evāsau yāti kāraṇatāṃ svayam .
saṃsṛtau svāsvavasthāsu vīciṣviva calajjalam ..6.131.55..

sāvadhāno bhavātas tvaṃ grāhyagrāhakasaṅgame .
ajasrameva saṅkalpadaśāḫ pariharañ śanaiḥ ..6.131.56..

mā bhava grāhyabhāvātmā grāhakātmā ca mā bhava .
bhāvanāmakhilāṃ tyaktvā yac chiṣṭaṃ tanmayo bhava ..6.131.57..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhasāvadhāno hyanāratam .
akurvan vāpi kurvan vā muktimevānudhāvati ..6.131.58..

grāhyagrāhakarūpātmā hyajño rāma kṣaṇaṃ prati .
navaṃ navamupāyāti bandhanaṃ bhāvanāvaśāt ..6.131.59..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhe rasabhāvanayā svayā .
nimeṣaṃ prati jīvasya bandho gacchati pīnatām ..6.131.60..

grāhyagrāhakasambandhe vinaiva rasabhāvanām .
nimeṣaṃ prati jīvo 'yamātmatāmeti mokṣabhāk ..6.131.61..

ajasraṃ yaṃ yamevārthaṃ patatyakṣagaṇo 'nagha .
badhyate tatra rāgeṇa tatrārāgeṇa mucyate ..6.131.62..

kiñcic ced rocate tubhyaṃ tad baddho 'si bhavasthitau .
na kiñcid rocate te cet tan mukto 'si bhavasthiteḥ ..6.131.63..

asmāt padārthanicayāt sahasthāvarajaṅgamāt .
tṛṇāder devaparyantān mā kiñcit tava rocatām ..6.131.64..

ratir nityamanarthārthamaratiś śreyase nṛṇām .
antavattvād ratir duẖkhairanantair yojayen naram ..6.131.65..

aratis san yadaśnāsi yat karoṣi jahāsi yat .

neha prajāyate kiñcin neha kiñcid vinaśyati .
sarvaṃ śāntaṃ nirālambaṃ cidvyomāmalamātatam ..6.131.67..

santo 'tītaṃ na śocanti bhaviṣyac cintayanti no .

sphuranti jīvapuṣpāṇi jātāni brahmapādape .
tajjānyatanmayānīva phenā iva mahārṇave ..6.131.69..

anyo'nyapratibimbena cidarṇavataraṅgakāḥ .
ekātmakā api dvitvaṃ yānti jīvā jagatsthitau ..6.131.70..

dṛḍhabhāvanayā jīvo manastāmupagacchati .
śītātiśayatas svacchaṃ payaḫ pāṣāṇatāmiva ..6.131.71..

manasi grathitāḫ pāśās tṛṣṇāmohamadādayaḥ .
vāgurāyāmiva khagāḫ methyāmiva ca tarṇakāḥ ..6.131.72..

manasaiva mano rāma cchedanīyaṃ vijānatā .
vivekatīkṣṇenātaptamayaseva balādayaḥ ..6.131.73..

ananyadavikārādijanitaṃ svasvabhāvajam .
vaicitryaṃ śikhipiñchasya yathā bhāti tathātmanaḥ ..6.131.74..

nakiñcit kiñcidapyātmā satyākāro 'pyasadvapuḥ .
ākāśādapyalakṣyo 'sau jagadrūpo 'pyarūpavān ..6.131.75..

sālambe 'pi nirālambo nirvikāro vikāriṇi .
sābhāse 'pi nirābhāso naśyatyarthe na naśyati ..6.131.76..

grāhyaṃ ca grāhakaṃ caiva grahaṇaṃ ca raghūdvaha .

manasaiva manaś chinddhi saṃsārabhramaśāntaye .

amanastvaṃ prayātasya na bhūyas te bhavo bhavet .

sarvaṃ cinmātramātmaiva nāstyanyā kalaneti vā .

sarvaṃ cinmātramātmaiva nāstyanyaditi yā matiḥ .

sati citte 'pyacittatvaṃ yadātmatvaikabhāvanāt .

sarvaṃ ciditi bhāvena rāgadveṣadṛśoẖ kṣaye .

sukhāśayaiti saṅkalpaṃ jīvo duẖkhaṃ tato vrajet .
jīvo hi yatate bhūtyai samprāpnotyāpadaṃ parām ..6.131.84..

mano vicāramāruhya mananānarthamujjhati .

vivekaṃ prāpya cetas svān saṅkalpān nāśayatyalam .

svajanāneva dahati durjanaḫ prathamotthitaḥ .

prasāraṇāt pradṛśyante sṛṣṭayo 'ntargatāś citaḥ .
kadarkakasya vividhā yathā varṇakapaṅktayaḥ ..6.131.88..

samastaśaktikacitamekātma brahma saṃvṛtam .

cinmātrālokitaṃ cittaṃ karotīmāṃ jagatsthitim .
nṛpekṣitaḫ pratīhāras sāmantaracanāmiva ..6.131.90..

cidrūṣitasya manasaẖ karma saṃsṛtināmakam .
rasāsiktasya bījasya pattrapuṣpaphalaṃ yathā ..6.131.91..

atyullasadvividhabhaṅguravastujātaiś

tasyaiva samprati nivāraya cañcalatvaṃ
buddhveha satyamatha vā ghanatāṃ nayasva ..6.131.92..

jīvasya trīṇi rūpāṇi sthūlasūkṣmaparāṇi tu .
tatrāsya yat paraṃ rūpaṃ tad bhaja dve 'pare tyaja ..6.132.1..

asyāsatī tu dve rūpe dvicandratvamivotthite .
vicārādeva naśyete paraṃ rūpaṃ na naśyati ..6.132.2..

jīvasya yadanāśaṃ tu rūpaṃ rāghava tad bhavān .
tatraivācalavad baddhapadamāssva ramasva ca ..6.132.3..

jīvasya yāni bhagavaṃs trīṇi rūpāṇi tāni me .
yathāvat kathayānāśaṃ rūpaṃ vedmi yathāsya tat ..6.132.4..

pāṇipādamayo yo 'yaṃ deho bhogāya valgati .
bhogārthametaj jīvasya rūpaṃ sthūlamiha sthitam ..6.132.5..

svasaṅkalpacidākāraṃ yāvat saṃsārabhāvi yat .
cittaṃ tad viddhi jīvasya rūpaṃ rāmātivāhikam ..6.132.6..

sati cāsati dehe 'smin prāṇavātarathasthitam .
etadasya manorūpaṃ jagad bhrāmyatyavāritam ..6.132.7..

āmodaḫ pavanārūḍhaḫ puṣpaṃ tyaktvā yathāmbare .
bhavatyevaṃ śarīreṣu naṣṭeṣu prāṇagaṃ manaḥ ..6.132.8..

yathā rakṣārthasūtrasya granthayo vividhās sthitāḥ .
yathā veṇulatāyāś ca parvāṇyaṅge sthitāni vā ..6.132.9..

cittatantau sudīrghe 'smiñ śarīrāṇi tathānagha .
utpatyotpatya nāśīni saridrayataraṅgavat ..6.132.10..

ādyantarahitaṃ satyaṃ cinmātraṃ nirvikalpakam .
yat tad viddhi paraṃ rūpaṃ jīvasyādyaṃ tṛtīyakam ..6.132.11..

jagat prajāyate tasmāt tasminneva pralīyate .
manāk sphuritvā tadrūpamūrmijālamivārṇave ..6.132.12..

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptānāṃ bhavanāśodbhavasthiteḥ .
etat turyapadaṃ śuddhamatra baddhapado bhava ..6.132.13..

brahman yeyaṃ vinā nidrāṃ grāhyagrāhakasaṅgadṛk .

jāgradvat svapnakāle yā nidrāyāṃ sphurati bhrame .

bhāvijāgratsvapnadaśā yā dṛṣadvad vimūḍhatā .

samatā svacchatā cāntarekatā nirvikalpatā .

sarva eva mahānto 'pi brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ .

rajjusarpabhramanibhaṃ nātra cittaṃ vivalgati .

ātmārāmāmalānandā saṃśāntasakalaiṣaṇā .

yathā svapne jagadbhānamidaṃ citkacanaṃ tviti .

śāntaṃ samyakprabuddhānāṃ yathāsthitamidaṃ jagat .

ahaṅkārakalātyāge śāntataivānubhūyatām .

akartṛkarmakaraṇamasi cittattvamakṣayam .
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyo bhramas saṅkalpitas tvasan ..6.133.1..

atremaṃ śṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā .

kasmiṃścit kānane kāṣṭhamaunasthitamarindama .

cittaṃ śāntimupāyātamasmākaṃ vananāyaka .

asmākaṃ nāstyahaṅkāro raso vā śuṣkabhūruhām .

tantau muktāphalānīva prayānti samavāyitām .

ahaṅkāramahātantau chinne tvindriyabālakāḥ .

nirahaṅkṛticittāni viśarārūṇi lubdhaka .
mamendriyāṇi kāryeṣu na lagantyapsvivāmbujam ..6.133.14..

mithas saṃśleṣamāyānti na mamendriyabālakāḥ .
vināhaṅkārajatunā śītalāyaẖkaṇā iva ..6.133.15..

na me buddhīndriyaṃ kañcid vetti karmendriyakramam .
citrasthā iva tiṣṭhanti sveṣvartheṣvīkṣaṇādayaḥ ..6.133.16..

sādho yadindriyaṃ vakti tena dṛṣṭo na te mṛgaḥ .
yasya vā darśane śaktir vaktuṃ jānāti tan na naḥ ..6.133.17..

na kānicin mamaitāni galitāhaṅkṛteẖ kila .
tad vyādha kas tvāṃ kathayatvārtimanmṛgadarśanam ..6.133.18..

sarveṣāmindriyāṇāṃ hi paśūnāmiva pālakam .
cittaṃ tac ca vilīnaṃ nas sarvārtharahite pade ..6.133.19..

itaś cetaś ca vikṣiptarūpāṇyetāni tat katham .
kiṃ vā tvā kathayantvaṅga gatānīhaiva pañcatām ..6.133.20..

nirmātṛpitṛko yadvad viśarāruś śiśuvrajaḥ .
tathākṣavṛndamadhṛti nirahambhāvavāsanam ..6.133.21..

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyā daśā vedmi na kāścana .
turya evāvatiṣṭhe 'haṃ tatra dṛśyaṃ na vidyate ..6.133.22..

iti nirvacanībhāvaṃ yathārthakathanena saḥ .
lubdhako muninā nīto jagāmābhimatāṃ diśam ..6.133.23..

ato vacmi mahābāho nāsti turyetarā daśā .
nirvikalpā hi cit turyaṃ tadevāstīha netarat ..6.133.24..

satyaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmabhāvaṃ gate jīve nirarthakam .
dehe bhavantīndriyāṇi citrabhittāvivānagha ..6.133.25..

yatreṣṭāniṣṭasambandhe nodayas sukhaduẖkhayoḥ .
na tac cittaṃ bhaved rāma tat sattvaṃ turyagaṃ viduḥ ..6.133.26..

svapnakāle svapna eva jāgrad vyagrāparigrahāt .
jāgrac ca svapnatāmeti smaraṇīyatayā tayā ..6.133.27..

asatyaṃ jāgrati svapnas svapne jāgradasanmayam .
jāgratsvapnavikārāntā ghanamohā suṣuptabhūḥ ..6.133.28..

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayamaṅga bhramodbhavam .
varatrāyāmivāhitvaṃ vijñāne prasphurat sthitam ..6.133.29..

turyamastyanavacchinnaṃ śuddhacinmātrarūpi yat .
tatraitat sphurati bhrāntyā taraṅgatvamivāmbhasi ..6.133.30..

yathābhūtārthavijñānāt trayametad vilīyate .
jīvanmuktapadaṃ śuddhaṃ turyamevāvaśiṣyate ..6.133.31..

proktaṃ videhamuktatvaṃ turyānta iti paṇḍitaiḥ .
cid brahmetyevamādīnāṃ vacasāṃ tadagocaraḥ ..6.133.32..

jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaṃ trayaṃ rūpaṃ hi cetasaḥ .
śāntaṃ ghoraṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca tryātma cittamiha sthitam ..6.133.33..

ghoraṃ jāgranmayaṃ cittaṃ śāntaṃ svapnamayaṃ sthitam .
mūḍhaṃ suṣuptabhāvasthaṃ tribhir hīnaṃ mṛtaṃ bhavet ..6.133.34..

yatra cittaṃ mṛtaṃ tatra sattvamekaṃ sthitaṃ samam .
tad viddhi jīvanmuktatvaṃ tat turyaṃ tan mahat padam ..6.133.35..

tatraite munayas siddhā brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ .
sattvātmake turyapade jīvanmuktā vyavasthitāḥ ..6.133.36..

yaṃ taṃ muniṃ vane vyādhaḫ pṛṣṭavān mṛgahetunā .
sa saṃsthitas turyapade śuddhasattvodayātmani ..6.133.37..

cittācāraṃ na jānāti mṛtacittas sa kañcana .
śāntāśeṣaviśeṣāṃśamadvaitaikyapadaṃ gataḥ ..6.133.38..

samastasaṅkalpavilāsamukte
turye pade tiṣṭha nirāmayātmā .
yatra sthitās sādhu sadehamuktāḫ
praśāntabhedā munayo mahāntaḥ ..6.133.39..

eṣa evāṅga siddhānto yat kālagaganādyapi .
cinmātrāṃśādṛte nānyaj jagadādyasti kiñcana ..6.134.1..

janayatyacchamābhāsaṃ bhaṅguraṃ sphuraṇāt svataḥ .
jagadrūpaṃ niśāvidyudiva cit kālakhādi ca ..6.134.2..

yatra sphurati cidvidyut taj jagat kālakhādi ca .
sthitaiva yan na sphurati tac chāntaṃ sarvamakramam ..6.134.3..

yāvadālokyate 'mbhodas tāvat satyaiva khe taḍit .
kāraṇaṃ nātra pṛcchāmi citspande kāraṇaṃ vada ..6.134.4..

vaitaṇḍikājñadurbuddhivilāsaṃ dūratas tyajan .
śṛṇvetadīdṛśasyaiva vaktavyaṃ nāpalāpinaḥ ..6.134.5..

tiṣṭhatyeva ghane vidyut sā ca sphurati bhaṅgurā .
ābālametat saṃsiddhaṃ kena nāmāpalapyate ..6.134.6..

nityaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vā vibho hetvanapekṣaṇāt .
citspandasya kathaṃ na syāt spando hīha sahetukaḥ ..6.134.7..

avātāmbudhidīpāde ratnānāṃ kacanasya vā .
vāyor vā śūnyasaṃsthasya spande kasyeha hetutā ..6.134.8..

rāmāsarvātmano 'pyevaṃ tattātattopapadyate .
svatas sarvātmano nityamataẖ kiṃ nopapadyate ..6.134.9..

cidaspandā spandinīti śabde bhedo na vastuni .
brahmaikaghanamadvaitaṃ viddhi vāri yathā dravam ..6.134.10..

yathā muktāvalīhaṃsadarśanaṃ khe svabhāvajam .
dṛṣṭerevaṃ cidacchāyās saṃvitspandāj jagadbhramaḥ ..6.134.11..

yathā nimīlite netre svaprabhāveṇa dṛk calam .
tārākāraṃ paśyatīyaṃ cic cetyaṃ dṛśyavat tathā ..6.134.12..

saṅkalpakalanās tyaktvā sarvā evātmatāṃ gataḥ .
paśya cidghana evācchaẖ kalpāntaikābdhivat sthitaḥ ..6.134.13..

asmadādir janas sādho pāradṛśvā jagatsthiteḥ .
tenaivāsmadvaco grāhyamomityevāstasaṃśayam ..6.134.14..

codyacañcutayā kiñcid vadāmīti tyajan dhiyam .
yadi tiṣṭhasi madvāci tadā yāsyeva tat padam ..6.134.15..

no cet tad vividhānekavikalpakalanāmalaiḥ .
śuddhatārkikatāmetya prayāsi tṛṇagulmatām ..6.134.16..

evaṃ cet tadiyaṃ brahmaṃs tvattāmattāmayātmikā .
tattvatas trijagannāmnī manye na kalanāstyalam ..6.134.17..

lavaṇaindavaśukrādivṛttāntavadupasthitam .
bhrāntimātraṃ jagan manye satyaṃ nāstīha kiñcana ..6.134.18..

evaṃ sthite muniśreṣṭha sarvāpahnava eva vai .
kṛto bhavati tad brūhi yujyate kathamīdṛśam ..6.134.19..

rāma samyakprabuddho 'si jānāsyeva yathāsthitam .
śuddhacidghana evāsti taṃ ca tvamavabuddhavān ..6.134.20..

siddhānto 'dhyātmaśāstrāṇāṃ sarvāpahnava eva ca .
nāvidyāstīha no māyā śāntaṃ brahmedamakramam ..6.134.21..

śānta eva cidābhāse svacche samasamātmani .
samagraśaktikacite brahmeti kalitābhidhe ..6.134.22..

nirṇīya kecic chūnyatvaṃ kecid vijñānamātratām .
kecidīśvararūpatvaṃ vivadante parasparam ..6.134.23..

saṅkalpya jagaducchūnaṃ nītvā ca śataśākhatām .
cālayanti vicāreṇa kecit sāṅkhyamatādikam ..6.134.24..

kecit sarvamidaṃ śāntaṃ brahmeti ghananiścayāḥ .
śuddhacidvyomatāmetya santo 'santa iva sthitāḥ ..6.134.25..

na brahma na jagan nānyaditi niścitya kecana .
ākāśaviśadās svacchās saṃsthitās saugatādayaḥ ..6.134.26..

kecidapyanyathā kṛtvā nānāsaṅkalpakalpanam .
sthitāś śāmyanti jāyante saṃsaranti ca vā na vā ..6.134.27..

samastakalanāhīnamiti nirṇīya cidghanam .
samagraśaktikacitaṃ vivadante hi vādinaḥ ..6.134.28..

ekatra vastuni samastakalāvimukte
saṅkalpya saṅkalanayā vividhābhidhās svāḥ .
svaṃ vāsanāvilasitaṃ samudāharanto
vidyāvivādavibhavair vivadanti vaidyāḥ ..6.134.29..

śarīrendriyabuddhyādicetasāṃ spandanasya ca .
kiṃ kasmāt sāramuditaṃ vyāpakaṃ śreyase bhavet ..6.135.1..

yadidaṃ dṛśyate kiñcij jagat tvamahamādimat .
cittamātraṃ hi tat sarvaṃ jalamātraṃ yathārṇavaḥ ..6.135.2..

dehendriyādibhāvena cittaṃ jagaditi sthitam .
ṣaḍbhir vā pañcabhir dvāraiś cetyaṃ patati dehinām ..6.135.3..

yataẖ kutaścit sampannaṃ cittaṃ dvīnduvilāsavat .
yathā nāneva sampannaṃ taduktaṃ bahuśas tava ..6.135.4..

jīvādisañjñāvalitaṃ dhṛtasaṃsṛtivibhramam .
yathā tat kṣīyate cittaṃ śreyase tadidaṃ śṛṇu ..6.135.5..

ceto bhāvavikārāḍhyaṃ paśyatīdaṃ śarīrakam .
avidyamānaṃ procchūnaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇāmbvivaiṇakaḥ ..6.135.6..

tathā paśyati vai cetaś śarīraṃ spandacañcalam .
abhinnameva svātmatvād dadhirūpaṃ yathā payaḥ ..6.135.7..

utpattisthitināśāntaṃ yathānubhavati svayam .
payo dadhitvamevaṃ hi cetaḫ paśyati dehakam ..6.135.8..

tathā hi bhārgavodanto lavaṇaindavavibhramaḥ .
śrutas tvayā mahābāho cittarūpanirūpaṇe ..6.135.9..

pratibhāṃ jaḍamapyeti cittaṃ sarvagaciccyutam .
anicchāyomaṇiprāptamayaḫ praspandanaṃ yathā ..6.135.10..

nityoditāmalānantacidādityāṃśurañjanāt .
cittapadmo vikasati puryaṣṭakadalāvaliḥ ..6.135.11..

yathā muktāvalī dṛṣṭā śūnye khe sadasanmayī .
sphuratyevaṃ hi cittattve cetas sphurati cañcalam ..6.135.12..

yathā citrodayaś śūnye bhrāntimātramupaplavaḥ .
tathā cetasi deho 'yaṃ gandharvapuravat sthitaḥ ..6.135.13..

yathā cetasi deho 'yaṃ mithyā dvīnduvilāsavat .
indriyāṇi tathā dehe maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.14..

yathendriyāṇi dehasya bālakalpitayakṣavat .
spandas tathaivendriyāṇāṃ jaḍo maitatparo bhava ..6.135.15..

yathendriyāṇāṃ vātānāmiva spando jaḍātmakaḥ .
spandaboddhṛ tathaivāsat sphuratyetac calaṃ manaḥ ..6.135.16..

yathā spandasya tu mano bhramākṛti calaṃ jaḍam .
manaso 'sya tathā buddhir mṛgatṛṣṇā vijṛmbhate ..6.135.17..

yathaiva buddhis svāntasya tathā buddherahaṅkṛtiḥ .
asadrūpā mudhodbhūtā maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.18..

yathā buddherahaṅkāro vallyāḫ puṣpamiva sthitaḥ .
tathaivāhaṅkṛter jīvo maivammātraparo bhava ..6.135.19..

yathaivāhaṅkṛter jīvaś śūnyehāvāsanātmakaḥ .
tathā jīvasya kalayā yuktā cit sacamatkṛtiḥ ..6.135.20..

tadapyanagha saṅkalpavaśān no vastunāpi sat .
maitad bhāvaya kiñcit tvaṃ naitat tenāsya vā bhavān ..6.135.21..

ete parasparaṃ sarve bhramāt kāraṇatāṃ gatāḥ .
taraṅgavad vivartante manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ ..6.135.22..

yathā śūnye mahāraṇye svasaṅkalpabhramākulāḥ .
bhramantyunmattakā evaṃ manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ ..6.135.23..

śarīraṃ saṃsṛtau sāras sāro 'kṣaughaś śarīrake .
sāras tvakṣagaṇe spandas spande sāras smṛtaṃ manaḥ ..6.135.24..

sāro manasi vai buddhis sāro buddhāvahaṅkṛtiḥ .
sāras tvahaṅkṛtau jīvo jīve sāraś cidābilā ..6.135.25..

citi sāras tvacetyatvaṃ cetyasyāsambhavāc chive .
tasmāt sāratarāt sāraẖ kiñcidanyan na vidyate ..6.135.26..

nirvikalpacidābhāsa eva sarvatra kāraṇam .
kāraṇaṃ tasya nāstyanyat tat svato nityabhāsuram ..6.135.27..

tāvanmātraparo nityaṃ bhava pūrvaṃ parityajan .
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ vāpi jagac cinmātrameva hi ..6.135.28..

valitaṃ sarvasaṅkalpair yadi vā yadi vojjhitam .
jagat tadakhilaṃ rāma viddhyetac chuddhacinmayam ..6.135.29..

ityasmāt paramāt sārādajasraṃ saṃvidaṅga te .
rātrindivaṃ na calati yadi tat tvamajaś śivaḥ ..6.135.30..

atra sthitasya tava kecana durvilāsā
rātrāvaheriva na rāma padaṃ labhante .
maināṃ parityaja mahāmṛtakandarāṃ tvam
atraiva tiṣṭha dṛḍhalekhyamivāśmanīti ..6.135.31..

niricchenācchaśāntena cidādityena cetyate .
sargādiṣu svataś cetyaṃ dṛṣṭyā muktāvalīva khe ..6.136.1..

anantaraṃ tadevedaṃ śataśākhaṃ vijṛmbhate .
bhrame kāraṇatāmetya jagajjālatayeddhayā ..6.136.2..

yathā svabhāvāditarat kāraṇaṃ nopapadyate .
śūnyadṛṅmauktikāloke tathā cic cetyavedane ..6.136.3..

ciccetyayor na bhedo 'sti yac cic cetyaṃ tadeva hi .
yaiva dṛk saiva muktālī bījamevāṅkuras smṛtaḥ ..6.136.4..

bījameva phalaṃ viddhi tyaktāśeṣaviśeṣaṇam .
viśeṣakalpanādasya na saṅkalpasya satyatā ..6.136.5..

satyatā yadi saṅkalpe tasmāt tajjā tadeva vā .
sa ca saṅkalpa etasmādādyādevoditaś śivāt ..6.136.6..

tasmād yadeva paramaṃ padaṃ cinmātramavyayam .
tadeva savikalpā cic cetyamādyaṃ tadeva ca ..6.136.7..

tadeva jīvakalanaṃ tadevāhaṅkṛtis sphurat .
tadeva buddhis tac cittaṃ tat spandaś cendriyāṇi tat ..6.136.8..

tad dehas taj jagat kṛtsnaṃ tad diśas tac ca rodasī .
tadadryurvīnadīśādi tṛṇāntaṃ vābjajādi ca ..6.136.9..

jaḍo deho jaḍo 'kṣaugho jaḍaṃ cittaṃ jaḍā matiḥ .
jaḍaivāhaṅkalā ceti tathā praspandanaṃ jaḍam ..6.136.10..

eteṣāṃ yo 'nubhavitā so 'si sarvagato 'si ca .
tac ca niṣkalacinmātraṃ māsmāt svasmāt padāc cala ..6.136.11..

evamādyantarahitamekamevedamātatam .
itthamābhāsate bhāsā svayā nānyāsti kalpanā ..6.136.12..

sarvaṃ śāntaṃ svabhāsedaṃ bhāsate jñaptimātrakam .
tvattāmattājagajjanmamaraṇādi na vidyate ..6.136.13..

bhrāntiṃ parityaja samo bhava nirvikāro
nityodito niravalambanamastabhāvaḥ .
śāntaṃ samastamavikāramanādimadhyam
ityeva satyamapareṇa tavālamastu ..6.136.14..

evaṃ vāsiṣṭhamākarṇya vaco vikasitāśayaḥ .
ucchvasanniva cittena rāmo vacanamabravīt ..6.137.1..

aho nu bhāro bharavāṃś cetasā projjhitaś cirāt .
ayaṃ so 'hamidaṃ me 'dya cetyādis tvagivāhinā ..6.137.2..

svacchatāmupayāte 'yamantaẖkaraṇasaṃsthitiḥ .
śobhate śaradīva dyauś śāntavāridaviplavā ..6.137.3..

ayaṃ so 'hamidaṃ me 'dya iti bhāraṃ mahābharam .
api meror gurutaraṃ dhārayan ko na sīdati ..6.137.4..

śāmyāmi parinirvāmi jāgarmyāśvāsavānaham .
adhvagasyeva me skandhād gṛhītā mahatī śilā ..6.137.5..

etāvantamahaṃ kālamaho nu khalu vañcitaḥ .
yadimāṃ padavīṃ śāntāṃ śītalācchāṃ na labdhavān ..6.137.6..

tadimaṃ saṃśayaṃ śeṣamekaṃ me chettumarhasi .
bhagavan sarvadharmajña prodvijante hi nottamāḥ ..6.137.7..

paramātmamayaṃ sarvaṃ yadi nāma sadaiva hi .
idaṃ kāryamidaṃ neti tat kimarthaṃ kṛtaẖ kramaḥ ..6.137.8..

yathotpannā na votpannā jīvāḫ paramakāraṇāt .
dvaitavanto 'tha vādvaitās tat tāvaj jñātavān bhavān ..6.137.9..

tatra tāvat svasaṅkalpād yeṣāṃ dvaitamalaṃ sthitam .
tais tāvat saṃsṛtau kiñcit saṃsartavyamasaṃśayam ..6.137.10..

tatra kecid bālya eva svacamatkārayogataḥ .
vidanti paramātmānaṃ tiṣṭhanti vigatajvaram ..6.137.11..

anīśvarās seśvarāś ca ye jīvā dehatāṃ gatāḥ .
gṛhītadvaitavistārāẖ kālenāyānti te padam ..6.137.12..

bhavatyevātiviśrāntir nāsti kasyāsti kasya ca .
sucirāt kevalaṃ kaścidacirād vetti kaścana ..6.137.13..

kecid viditavedyatvaṃ yānti rāghava yauvane .
jarāvantaḫ paraṃ vastu vidantīhāpare janāḥ ..6.137.14..

evaṃ tajjñās tathājñāś ca tiṣṭhantyeva yathāsthitam .
asyāṃ vyavahṛtau jīvanmuktā baddhāś ca mānavāḥ ..6.137.15..

idaṃ kāryamidaṃ neti teṣāṃ yadi jagatsthitiḥ .
nonnīyate tat kṣayakṛn mātsyo nyāyaḫ pravartate ..6.137.16..

yāvat kiñcit prasphurati sargas tāvat kadarthanām .
mā yātu mātsyanyāyena kileti vihitā sthitiḥ ..6.137.17..

niṣpuṇyapāpaṃ niścittaṃ nirmamo 'mananakriyam .
kālātivāhanāyaiva jīvanmukto 'vatiṣṭhate ..6.137.18..

māyāgrastamatis tvātmavāsanāvaśataḫ phalam .
prāpnotīhāmutra caiva tadarthaṃ yatate ca saḥ ..6.137.19..

etāvat tāvadābālapaṇḍitāmaramānavam .
avisaṃvādi yad yādṛk cittaṃ tanmayatātmanaḥ ..6.137.20..

svasaṅkalpaikabījāya narakasvargaśākhine .
phalāyājñasya kartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca rāghava ..6.137.21..

yat tu tajjñasya kartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca vā kvacit .
tat prameyadaśāmeti na kadācana kasyacit ..6.137.22..

kartā bhavatvakartā vā mukta evāṅga tattvavit .
bhūyo majjati nājñāne payaḫphena ivāmbhasi ..6.137.23..

kartā bhavatvakartā vā baddha evāyathārthavit .
araṇyakūpāc chvevāsmān mohān nottarati kvacit ..6.137.24..

nirdeho nirmanā maunī śāntas svastho nireṣaṇaḥ .
kurvanneva ca karmāṇi tiṣṭhottiṣṭhasva tatpade ..6.137.25..

jīvo brahmārṇave vīcir jīvāmbhodhāvahaṅkṛtiḥ .
ahaṅkārāmbudhau buddhir buddhyabdhau cittamābilam ..6.137.26..

cittābdhau vāsanā vīcir vāsanābdhau tu saṃsṛtiḥ .
saṃsārābdhau śarīraṃ ca śarīrābdhau ca jīvitam ..6.137.27..

jīvitābdhau ca yuvatā cañcale yauvanārṇave .
vīcirindriyasaṅghātas spandas tvindriyavāridhau ..6.137.28..

spandāmbhodhāvanubhavas svānubhūtyāmbudhau tataḥ .
taraṅgaś citsamullāsa itīdaṃ sargavedanam ..6.137.29..

śabdasaṃsparśarūpādi yenedamavabudhyate .
tac cinmātraṃ jagat sarvaṃ tatsāratvād raghūdvaha ..6.137.30..

akṣubdho 'vyapadeśyo 'sāvasargakaraṇonmukhaḥ .
unnīyate cidambhodhis sadbhir brahmeti kevalam ..6.137.31..

akṣubdhamapi tat kṣubdhamiva cet kṛtavedanam .
tac cidaṃśamupāruhya brahma sarga iti sthitam ..6.137.32..

nāhaṃ kartā na bhokteti sāmānyo 'sāvasaṅgamaḥ ..6.141.17..

na kartāsmi na bhoktāsmi na vaktāsmi na yāmi ca .
prasṛteheśvarecchetthaṃ sāmānyaivamasaṅgatiḥ ..6.141.18..

īśvarārpaṇayā yad yat kriyate muktavāsanam .
sāmānyāsaktitā nāma tadāhuḫ paramaṃ padam ..6.141.19..

asaṃsaṅgo 'yamuktas te sāmānyo raghunandana .
imaṃ śreṣṭhamasaṃsaṅgaṃ śṛṇu śrutirasāyanam ..6.141.20..

anena kramayogena saṃyogena mahātmanām .
niyogena satāmantaḫ prayogeṇa svasaṃvidām ..6.141.21..

pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tāvadabhyāsa uhyate .
karāmalakavad yāvat sarvasāro 'nubhūyate ..6.141.22..

yā yodeti manāgicchā tasyās tasyā nipātanāt .
padamāsādyate sāraṃ kayācin nānyayā dhiyā ..6.141.23..

dṛṣṭe sakalasīmānte trijagatkaṇadīpake .
saṃsārasaritaḫ pāre sāre paramakāraṇe ..6.141.24..

nāhaṃ karteśvaraẖ kartā nāsmi kartā na ceśvaraḥ .
nāyamasmi na cānyo 'hamahamasmītaraś ca vā ..6.141.25..

kṛtvā dūratare nūnamitiśabdārthabhāvanāḥ .
yan maunamāsitaṃ śāntaṃ śreṣṭhāsaṃsaṅga ucyate ..6.141.26..

yan nāntar nāmbare nādho nordhve nāśāsu nāvanau .
na padārthe nāpadārthe na jaḍe na ca cetane ..6.141.27..

āsitaṃ bhāsanaṃ śāntamavāsanamabhāvanam .
anādyantamajaṃ kāntaṃ tac chreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate ..6.141.28..

acittacetanānandaṃ sarvabhāvāntarāsanam .
yad vasantādiravasat tac chreṣṭhāsaṅga ucyate ..6.141.29..

animajjanamartheṣu bhāvanābhāvanaṃ hṛdi .
avedanaṃ sukhādīnāmasaṃsaṅgaṃ paraṃ viduḥ ..6.141.30..

karmasvartheṣu cintāsu vāsanāsvātmatāsu ca .
avedanamamagnatvaṃ śreṣṭhāsaṃsaṅga ucyate ..6.141.31..

ajñānapaṅkapīṭhāyāṃ jñaptibhūmau svabhāvataḥ .
kākatālīyayogād vā kṣayād vā sarvakarmaṇām ..6.141.32..

saṃvijjalavilāsāyāṃ viśaddehamṛṇālakaḥ .
jāto hṛdayasadvāpyāṃ cintāśapharikānvitaḥ ..6.141.33..

santoṣāmodamadhuras satkāryāmalapallavaḥ .
cittanālāgrasaṃlīno 'vighnakaṇṭakasaṅkaṭaḥ ..6.141.34..

vivekapadmo rūḍho 'ntar vicārārkavikāsitaḥ .
phalaṃ phalatyasaṃsaṅgaṃ tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ gataḥ ..6.141.35..

asaṃsaktamanā maunī munir madabahiṣkṛtaḥ .
bhavatyavidyamānābhas tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāmitaḥ ..6.141.36..

samavāyād viśuddhānāṃ samatvād dharmakarmaṇām .
kākatālīyayogena prathamodeti bhūmikā ..6.141.37..

bhūmiḫ proditamātrāntaramṛtāṅkurikaiva sā .
vivekenāmbusekena rakṣyā pālyāti dhīmatā ..6.141.38..

yenāṃśenollasatyeṣā vicāreṇodayaṃ nayet .
tamevānudinaṃ yatnāt kṛṣīvala ivāṅkuram ..6.141.39..

eṣā hi parimṛṣṭāntaranyāsāṃ prasavaikabhūḥ .
pattrāṇāmaṅkura iva tadrūḍho 'nyāsu rohati ..6.141.40..

tṛtīyeyamasaṃsaṅgakāriṇī bhavatāriṇī .
anayoditayodeti bhānubhāseva padminī ..6.141.41..

vijityāvagrahakṣobhaṃ durdeśapramukhānarīn .
susiktamūlā latikā dadātyavikalaṃ phalam ..6.141.42..

asaṃsaktamatir maunī madamātsaryavarjitaḥ .
vṛṣṭaśāradameghābho bhaved bhavyas tribhūmikaḥ ..6.141.43..

viditākhilavedyasya śāntasandehasantateḥ .
naiva tasya kṛtenārtho nākṛteneha kaścana ..6.141.44..

tṛtīyāṃ bhūmikāṃ prāptas sāmānyāsaṅgavāniha .
vicaratyasamunnaddhaḫ paramākalayan padam ..6.141.45..

śreṣṭhāsaṃsaṅgavāneṣa tṛtīye bhūmikāpade .
bhavati proṣitāśeṣasaṅkalpakalanāspade ..6.141.46..

lagatyasaṃsaktamater na karmaphalabhāvanā .
vārīva padmapattrasya ratnasyevoparañjanā ..6.141.47..

nityāsaṃsaktayā buddhyā prakṛtaṃ bahirācaran .
antarakṣobha evāste hṛdayenāparājitaḥ ..6.141.48..

enāmasaṃsaṅgadaśāmavāpya
patatyapīcchanniha saṃsṛtiṃ no .
icchā ca nodeti na rāma te bho
yodeti sā sattvacamatkṛtir hi ..6.141.49..

mūḍhasyāsatkulotthasya pravṛttasya narasya ca .
aprāptayogasaṅgasya kathamuttaraṇaṃ bhavet ..6.142.1..

ekāmatha dvitīyāṃ vā tṛtīyāṃ cetarāṃ ca vā .
ārūḍhasya mṛtasya syāt kīdṛśī bhagavan gatiḥ ..6.142.2..

mūḍhasyārūḍhadoṣasya tāvat saṃsṛtirātatā .
yāvaj janmāntaraśataiś kākatālīyayogataḥ ..6.142.3..

atha vāsādhusaṅgatyā pravṛttasya narasya no .
udeti vairāgyamatir marau puṣpalatā yathā ..6.142.4..

vairāgyamatirevaṃ sā pravṛddhā bhūmikākrame .
niyojayati saṃsāre taṭīmiva taraṅgiṇī ..6.142.5..

kecij janmamahāyogairapyalabdhavicāraṇāḥ .
araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantramivordhvādhaḫparās sthitāḥ ..6.142.6..

prathamāṃ vetarāṃ vāpi yogabhūmiṃ tu yo 'bhyaset .
āyuẖkṣayamavāpnoti punaḫpāścātyajanmane ..6.142.7..

sa tamabhyastamevāntar buddhau parikaraṃ varam .
vahan yāti mṛteḫ pārśvaṃ yathā srotas saridrayam ..6.142.8..

tatra taiś śubhasaṅkalpaiḫ pavitrakalanātmakaḥ .
tādṛgguṇamayaireva mitrabandhubhiranvitaḥ ..6.142.9..

adīnātmā jagadbhāvānakhilānaparāmṛśan .
saṃsmaran parayā bhaktyā jagattaraṇakāraṇam ..6.142.10..

sadvāsanāmanorūpo vijahāti śarīrakam .
vātāvadhūnanādhūtamāmodaẖ kusumaṃ yathā ..6.142.11..

prāṇavātānvito jīvagandho dehasaroruham .
pravihāya samuḍḍīnaẖ kamapyākāśamāgataḥ ..6.142.12..

muhūrtamekaṃ sauṣuptīmavasthāmanutiṣṭhati .
dehabhāraṃ parityajya gāḍhāṃ nidrāmupāgataḥ ..6.142.13..

kṣaṇāt prabodhamāyātas satatābhyastayā svayā .
āpūryate vāsanayā saritkhāta ivāmbhasā ..6.142.14..

saṃsmṛtya svadhiyā sādhus sa svabhāvanayā tayā .
vyomni vyomavapur yasmiṃs tiṣṭhet puryaṣṭakānvitaḥ ..6.142.15..

na tu dūre na nikaṭe vyoma nedaṃ na cetarat .
kāmapyavarṇanāyogyāṃ tāmākāśadaśāṃ viduḥ ..6.142.16..

tatas sa jīvo vyomnyatra prāṇavātamayātmakaḥ .
śanaiḫ prāgbhāvamādatte madhau rasamivāṅkuraḥ ..6.142.17..

bhāvanā yā sadābhyastā tāmeva maraṇāvadhau .
smarañ jīvo jahātīmaṃ bhīmaṃ bhāraṃ kalevaram ..6.142.18..

yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ smaran dehāt sadābhāvitamutplutaḥ .
tasyaiva phalamāpnoti svapauruṣabalārjitam ..6.142.19..

ādehaṃ yat sadābhyastaṃ jīvena tadasau mṛtau .
sarvān bhāvānanādṛtya smaratīdaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ..6.142.20..

yuddharājyasurārāmapāṭharodanavibhramān .
svakarmaphalabhīto 'sau nāgrasthānapi paśyati ..6.142.21..

ya āsannaphalo bhāvas svavaśenāvaśena vā .
sarvabhāvopamardena sa evāgre vilokyate ..6.142.22..

śubhamastu mamedānīṃ ciraṃ māśubhamastu me .
ākīṭāmaramāśaiṣā kṣīyate na kadācana ..6.142.23..

kṣīyate bhāvanaiṣāntaẖ kevalaṃ viditātmanaḥ .
ākāśaviśadaś śānto jñaḫ pranirvāti śāmyati ..6.142.24..

jaḍaś cet tatparo bhāvān mṛtau kāṃścin na paśyati .
ajaḍaś cet tadabhyastair bhāvairākramyate 'vaśaḥ ..6.142.25..

evamākāśarūpo 'sau jīvas saṃvṛtavāsanaḥ .
taṃ muhūrtaṃ jaḍāvastho yugaṃ yātaṃ prapaśyati ..6.142.26..

abhavaṃ prāgahaṃ jantur mṛtas tatrāsmi bandhuṣu .
yugamatra parikṣīṇamabhipaśyati sa kṣaṇāt ..6.142.27..

muhūrta eva sañjāte sa jīvo yuganiścaye .
iha jātu pravṛtto 'smi deśa ityavabudhyate ..6.142.28..

abhavaṃ prāgahaṃ jantur mṛtas tatrāsmi bandhuṣu .
tataẖ kṛtā me svajanaiḫ piṇḍadānādikāẖ kriyāḥ ..6.142.29..

tābhir labdhaśarīreṇa mayā sukṛtaduṣkṛte .
bhukte cirataraṃ kālaṃ jāto 'smyadyetthamutthitaḥ ..6.142.30..

itthaṃ muhūrta evāsau gate pratyayavān bhavan .
svavāsanānusāreṇa dehamātmani paśyati ..6.142.31..

muhūrte suciraṃ kālamaśarīraś śarīrakam .
cinoti paśyatyabhyeti jīvas svapnaṃ bhavāniva ..6.142.32..

aśreṣṭhayā vāsanayā duṣṭātmaphalavānaham .
duẖkhavānadhamo jāta iti paśyati jīvakaḥ ..6.142.33..

pradhānayā vāsanayā pradhānaphalavānaham .
jātaḫ pradhāna eveti cinotyātmānamātmanā ..6.142.34..

jīva evamadeho 'pi sadehatvamupāgataḥ .
deśakālakramaprauḍhaṃ paralokaṃ prapaśyati ..6.142.35..

ayaṃ sa paraloko me dharmarājanarā ime .
ayaṃ nīto 'smi neyo 'yaṃ mamedaṃ tattvamīhitam ..6.142.36..

paralokabhuvas tvetās satyaṃ vacmi purākṛtam .
pṛṣṭo 'smyayaṃ dharmabhṛtā cchāyeyaṃ mama sākṣiṇī ..6.142.37..

sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cedaṃ karma me puratas sthitam .
ayaṃ nīto 'smi gacchāmi svargaṃ narakameva vā ..6.142.38..

evampratyayavāñ jīvo dīrghaṃ saṃsṛtivibhramam .
sampaśyati kṣaṇenaiva saṃvatsaraśatena ca ..6.142.39..

eṣa duẖkhamahāṣaṇḍo vāsanābījakoṭarāt .
ahamityātmano vyaktaṃ durjātādupajāyate ..6.142.40..

niyojito 'smyayaṃ duẖkhe sukhe vā yojito 'smyayam .
ayaṃ me vatsaro yāta idaṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam ..6.142.41..

etat tad duṣkṛtaṃ bhuktametās tās svargasampadaḥ .
yonyantareṣu tiṣṭhan hi sthito 'smyahamiha drumaḥ ..6.142.42..

sthitāsmīyamahaṃ vallī sampanno 'smīha ṣaṇḍakaḥ .
gardabho 'yamahaṃ jātaś śuko 'yamahamāsthitaḥ ..6.142.43..

markaṭo 'smīha sampannas sampanno 'smīha tittiriḥ .
ṛkṣo 'smīha vaṭo 'smīha matsyo 'smīhātha kacchapaḥ ..6.142.44..

iha varṣaśataṃ tiryagiha varṣaśataṃ tṛṇam .
prāpnomi mānuṣīṃ jātiṃ naro bhūyo bhavāmyaham ..6.142.45..

piṇḍadānādibhir bandhukṛtyais satputraceṣṭitaiḥ .
kṣīṇaduṣkṛtasampanno bhavāmi puruṣo 'dhunā ..6.142.46..

ayamasyās striyā garbhe māturasmi niyojitaḥ .
garbhamāsāṣṭake kṣīṇe pitur jāto 'smyayaṃ gṛhe ..6.142.47..

sthito 'smyayamahaṃ bālaḫ prāpto 'smi navayauvanam .
ayaṃ jarāmahamitaś cirādayamahaṃ mṛtaḥ ..6.142.48..

ityādyanubhavañ jīvo nijavibhramajarjaraḥ .
uhyate vāsanāvātyāparāvartaiḫ punaḫ punaḥ ..6.142.49..

vāsanābilakallolair vividhāvartavṛttibhiḥ .
jīvatṛṇyās sphurantīmās saṃsāraikamahārṇave ..6.142.50..

jīvaẖ kvacit suṣuptasthaẖ kvacit sthāvaratājaḍaḥ .
kvacid vyādhiparimlānaẖ kvacidādhibhirāturaḥ ..6.142.51..

sukhī duẖkhī bhavo 'bhāvo naro nāgo 'maro 'suraḥ .
bakaẖ kākaś śukaś śaṅkhas tittirir hariṇo vṛṣaḥ ..6.142.52..

bhavatyabhavyatāmetya duẖkhād duẖkhaṃ bhayād bhayam .
patannāpātaramyeṣu ramate bhogabhasmasu ..6.142.53..

aśarīro nirākāras saṅkalpātmāmbarāspadaḥ .
piśāco 'smīti saṃvittyā kvacid dhatte piśācatām ..6.142.54..

yad yat sarge yathā rūḍhaṃ tat tathā tu niṣevate .
jīvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ tajjñamatajjñamapi vānagha ..6.142.55..

yakṣarakṣaḫpiśācādibhāvanābhramabhedataḥ .
janmanāmatra saṅkhyāṃ na kartuṃ mama samārthatā ..6.142.56..

padārthabhāvanāmātrādatiduẖkhaparamparāḥ .
ahantātmana udyanti satyāsatyaghanabhramāḥ ..6.142.57..

evaṃ kha eva jāyante kharūpās saṃsṛtibhramāḥ .
na deśakālāvaraṇaṃ kurvantyete manāgapi ..6.142.58..

anārataṃ sargaparamparāṇām
arūpiṇīnāmatha rūpiṇīnām .
jaladravānukramasaṃsthitānāṃ
krānto 'smi khe khātmatayoditānām ..6.142.59..

yogabhūmikayotkrāntajīvitasya śarīriṇaḥ .
bhūmikāṃśānusāreṇa kṣīyate pūrvaduṣkṛtam ..6.143.1..

purābhūvamahaṃ jantur mṛto 'haṃ tatra bandhuṣu .
cireṇehāhamutpanna iti paśyatyasau tataḥ ..6.143.2..

evaṃ bhāvanayocchūnaṃ jātaṃ paśyati dehakam .
sarvāvayavasampannaṃ paṅkādiva vinirmitam ..6.143.3..

śarīramabhisampannaṃ paśyan procchūnavāsanam .
paralokamatha sphāraṃ cinotyāśu ca paśyati ..6.143.4..

tataẖ katipayaṃ kālaṃ śeṣaṃ duṣkṛtakarmaṇām .
bhuktvā sukṛtabhogāya yāti puṇyavatāṃ padam ..6.143.5..

tatropari vimāneṣu lokapālapureṣu ca .
merūpavanakuñjeṣu ramate ramaṇīsakhaḥ ..6.143.6..

mandāradaladolāsu punnāgagahaneṣu ca .
pārijātavanāgreṣu ramate ramaṇīsakhaḥ ..6.143.7..

santānakavitāneṣu pāribhadradrumeṣu ca .
kalpapādapakuñjeṣu ramate ramaṇīsakhaḥ ..6.143.8..

yogabhūmigatā ye ye mriyante puruṣottamāḥ .
te kṣīṇaduṣkṛtā mattā ramante surasadmasu ..6.143.9..

svāstīrṇakalpatarupallavasaṃstareṣu
puṣpāvanaddhamṛduhemalatālayeṣu .
samyakkriyās surapureṣu sahāpsarobhir
vidyādharās suratasārasukhaṃ ramante ..6.143.10..

pratyekamevamuditaḫ pṛthaksaṃsāraṣaṇḍakaḥ .
sasurāsurapātālalokāntaradharāmbaraḥ ..6.144.1..

brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrādyā evameva gatās sthitim .
saṅkalpātmāna evemaṃ sargasaṅkalpamāśritāḥ ..6.144.2..

brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrādiḫ pūrvameva manomayī .
māyeyamuditā mithyā sargatā kalpanātmikā ..6.144.3..

yad yadālokyate kiñcin māyāyās tadasan nabhaḥ .
antarantarasārātmarambhāstambhā ivoditāḥ ..6.144.4..

saṅkalpapuruṣā ete brahmarudrendrakādayaḥ .
asatyāś caiva satyāś ca cittvācittvairiha sthitāḥ ..6.144.5..

bhūtaṃ prati pṛthagbhūtas sargo vikasitas svayam .
saṅkalpasvapnapuravan manorājyavadātataḥ ..6.144.6..

sarvagatvāc ca ciddhātor mithaś cānubhavabhramāt .
sargeṣveteṣu sadrūpās samastā bhūtajātayaḥ ..6.144.7..

sammilanti mithaẖ kecin nirāvaraṇasaṃvidaḥ .
sargāḫ pariṇamantyanye tvaparasparavedinaḥ ..6.144.8..

kākatālīyavat kecit sargās sarge patantyapi .
deśamanyamimaṃ prāptā vayamityeva bhāvitāḥ ..6.144.9..

krameṇānena he rāma te svapnapuruṣā api .
saṅkalpapuruṣāś caiva satyāś cittvādakhaṇḍitāt ..6.144.10..

cidghanaṃ cittvasāratvāc cittvamevāvatiṣṭhate .
nāsya vighno na vedho 'sti nānyatā na ca nāśitā ..6.144.11..

saṅkalpapuruṣās satyās satyāś ca svapnavibhramāḥ .
vartamānārthakāritvān neha kiñcidasanmayam ..6.144.12..

parasparamalabhyatvād yan nārthāya na vastu tat .
satyamasmākamapyeṣa deśāntaranaro yathā ..6.144.13..

yad yathā yena yatrāsti tat tathā tena tatra tat .
nātra satye sadasatī tenālaṃ maunavān bhava ..6.144.14..

jagat svabhāvato nāsti yac cedaṃ paridṛśyate .
tat sarvaṃ brahmasattaiva prekṣitaṃ vā na kiñcana ..6.144.15..

bravīmyabhyupagamyāpi sargādi yadi vidyate .
tadetaj jaṭharaṃ brāhmaṃ viddhi tatkacanātmakam ..6.144.16..

yathāntarikṣor mādhuryaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca maricādiṣu .
tathāntar brahmaṇo dṛśyamahantādijagattrayam ..6.144.17..

ahaṃ jagad dṛśyamiti śabdārthaiḫ parivarjitam .
akhaṇḍitamidaṃ satyamidaṃśabdārthavarjitam ..6.144.18..

dyauẖ kṣamā vāyurākāśaṃ parvatās sarito diśaḥ .
sato 'navayavasyāpi bhāgā bahiravasthitāḥ ..6.144.19..

puruṣaṃ prati saṅkalpāt sargo hṛdi vijṛmbhate .
sādridyūrvīnadīśāṃśaẖ kauśe rasa ivāṅkure ..6.144.20..

saṃvit svodarasaṃlīnaṃ khātmakā khātmakaṃ jagat .
yathābhirucitenāntar bhogenāsvādayatyalam ..6.144.21..

na svapne gamyate deśo na deśo hṛdameti vā .
na jāgrati bahirdeśo na jāgrad deśavarti vā ..6.144.22..

nāntastvaṃ vidyate kiñcin na bahiṣṭvaṃ ca vānagha .
nākalpanā nāpi ca vā kalpanākalanāsti vā ..6.144.23..

saṃvin mukulitātmānaṃ trijaganmaṇḍalīmiyam .
yat svādayati tasyaitan nāma svapnābhidhaṃ sthitam ..6.144.24..

yadātmānaṃ vikasitā trijaganmaṇḍalīmiyam .
yat svādayati tasyaitac cihnaṃ jāgraditi sthitam ..6.144.25..

yan na saṃvit svamātmānaṃ kañcit kālaṃ śramādiva .
āsvādayati śānteva tat suṣuptābhidhaṃ smṛtam ..6.144.26..

nirvāṇe vāpunarbhrāntyai yadātmānaṃ na vindate .
saṃvit sthirasamābhāsā tat turyaṃ mokṣa ucyate ..6.144.27..

antaś cetanapadmasya jagadgandho 'styasau bahiḥ .
sphurati prasṛte tasminnantarasphuritātmani ..6.144.28..

na sargasaṃvidor bhedaḫ pavanaspandayoriva .

jāgrat svapnatvamāyāti buddhiśyāmalatāvaśāt .

ghanamohatayā jāgradapi yāti suṣuptatām .
svapnaś cāpi tathaivaiṣa svabhāvo rāma saṃsṛteḥ ..6.153.23..

nidrālorapyanidrālo rāghavaitad daśātrayam .

turyāvasthasya cābhyāsādavasthātritayaṃ śanaiḥ .

turyāvasthāsthito bhūyo nāvasthātrayameti hi .

bhāsurākāramaskandhastambhaśākhādalādikam .

aspṛṣṭadeśakālāṃśamasatyamiva satyavat .

sthūlaṃ karmendriyālabhyaṃ jagat paśyatyasadvapuḥ .

cittabhittigataṃ bhāvi citratantramiva sthitam .

indrajālajalādarśapratibimbamivāsthitam .

dravyabhāvakriyehānāmajñatvān mūkatāṃ gataḥ .

anūḍhamuhyamānātma sthiraṃ calamasac ca sat .

pratibimbitamambhodhāviva nirmajjadeva vā .

jātyandharūpānubhavamiva nāsan na sanmayam .

masṛṇaikamahābhittau saṅkalpollikhitātmakam .

ākāśabhittilikhitamalabdhamapi vāyunā .

dṛśye patatyadṛśye 'pi parayatnāvabodhitaḥ .

nirvāṇadṛśyadahanīyavaśāt praśāntā

āyāntyanantapadametya parāṃ pratiṣṭhām

vicchinnaśaradabhrāṃśavilayaṃ pravilīyate .

pañcamīṃ bhūmikāmetya suṣuptapadanāmikām .

samastaśabdaśabdārthabhāvanābhāvanātmakam .
bījāṅkurasamutsedhasattāsuṣamamāsyatām ..6.154.3..

anahantādimananaṃ samaṃ sarvagataṃ sthiram .
avedyavedanaṃ puṣpavikāsasamamāsyatām ..6.154.4..

advaitaikyaṃ samaṃ śāntaṃ vijñānaikaghanaṃ param .
ākāśakośaviśadaṃ jñaḫ paśyan na vinaśyati ..6.154.5..

bhedabuddhyā purāttānāṃ sampratyadvayabhāvanam .

suṣuptaghanavijñānabhāsurāvaraṇakṣayaḥ .
nāstameti na codeti na tiṣṭhati na gacchati ..6.154.7..

galitadvaitanirbhāsamudito 'ntaḫ prabodhavān .

amanomananaṃ maunamāmīlitavilocanam .
cetamānaḫ payasspandavilāsa iva tiṣṭhati ..6.154.9..

ahantvaṃ cetamānasya na kadācana śāmyati .
hṛtpadmakośabhramarī saṃsṛtyākhyāviṣūcikā ..6.154.10..

naṭo 'tītanarāvasthāṃ yathā nṛtyan prapaśyati .

amanobuddhyahaṅkāramāvartādi yathā payaḥ .
saṃvetti deśakālādi tathā brahma jagattrayam ..6.154.12..

ahantvaṃ cetamānasya na kadācana śāmyati .
ahantvatilatailaśrīs saṃsārograviṣūcikā ..6.154.13..

ahantvamukulasyāntar yat svaṃ saṃsārasaurabham .
tadasya savikāsasya bahir dṛśyatayā sthitam ..6.154.14..

na yathā padmasaugandhye vyatirikte kadācana .
ahantvadṛśye na tathā vyatirikte kadācana ..6.154.15..

ahantvaṃ svasvarūpasya draṣṭṛdṛśyamayātmanī .

prekṣitaṃ san na cāhantvaṃ nāntar na bahirasti ca .

yadasan mṛgatṛṣṇāmbu bhāsate tat parīkṣitam .

draṣṭā dṛśyaṃ darśanaṃ ca mṛgatṛṣṇāmbviti trayam .

iti niścayavānaikyadvaitātītavapuś śivam .

antarmukhatayā tiṣṭhan bahirvṛttiparo 'pi san .

lokasaṃvyavahāre 'smin nāntar na vyomni no bahiḥ .

suṣuptavaj jāgrati dṛśyavibhramaṃ tv
abhāvayan bhāvaparikṣayodayī .
cititvamapyantarasaṃvidannidaṃ
pratiṣṭhate citranaropamo budhaḥ ..6.154.23..

kurvannabhyāsametasyāṃ bhūmikāyāṃ vivāsanaḥ .
ṣaṣṭhīṃ turyābhidhāmanyāṃ kramāt patati bhūmikām ..6.155.1..

yatra nāsan na sadrūpo nāhaṃ nāpyanahaṅkṛtiḥ .
kevalaṃ kṣīṇamananaṃ tadāste gatavāsanaḥ ..6.155.2..

nirgranthiś śāntasadrūpo jīvanmukto vibhāvanaḥ .
sakṛdvibhātā vimalamāste dvaitaikyanirgataḥ ..6.155.3..

jīvanmukto gataraso nirbhedo 'mbarasundaraḥ .

samyagdarśanasampanno jīvanmuktapadaṃ gataḥ .

kurvan na kiñcit kurute gantāpi ca na gacchati .

jāgrati svapnadṛṣṭasya puṃsaẖ kartṛtvabhoktṛte .
yādṛśyau tatsthitī viddhi jīvanmuktasya rāghava ..6.155.8..

samaś śāntamatir maunī jīvanmukto vivāsanaḥ .

nirvāṇamatirātmānaṃ paraṃ cādrimaṇuṃ tanum .

sampannaś śāntamābhāsaṃ paramekamakṛtrimam .

prajñāprāsādamārūḍhas tvaśocyaś śocate janān .
bhūmiṣṭhāniva śailasthas sarvān prājño 'nupaśyati ..6.155.12..

naiva tasya kṛtenārtho nākṛteneha kaścana .

jale jalamiva kṣiptaṃ brahmaṇyevaikatāṃ gataḥ .

carācaramidaṃ viṣvak cetamāno na cetati .

samagragatamapyantā rāgadveṣabhavāmayāḥ .
nākāśamiva cetante samastā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ..6.155.18..

saṃśāntāhantvanīhāraḫ prasannavitatākṛtiḥ .

kṣīvatāyāṃ praśāntāyāmiva somyatvamāgataḥ .

ānandaikanimagnatvādanānandapadaṃ gataḥ .

nirmandara ivāmbhodhir dagdhadāhya ivānalaḥ .

tvaṣṭreva yantrollikhitas so 'pūrvākāratāṃ gataḥ .
ṛtvantare druma iva sa evānyatayoditaḥ ..6.155.23..

upaśāntaś ca kāntaś ca dīpto 'pyālokasundaraḥ .

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ svacchaẖ kacan maṇirivātmani .

syāmityantarahantātmasattāsnehaparikṣayāt .

kiñcidevaiṣa sampannaẖ ko 'pi vā vā na kiñcana .

sabāhyābhyantaraṃ nānyadekameva padārthavat .
sthito dūre 'pyadūre ca prasṛtānantatantuvat ..6.155.35..

sa bahvīṣvapyavasthāsu nityaikātmā samo 'malaḥ .
saṃśāntaguṇabhedaśrīr mahākāla ivākalaḥ ..6.155.36..

ajamamaramanādyaṃ buddhamādyantaśuddhaṃ
śivamamalamajalpaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntamekam .
bahirabahirapīśaṃ jñaṃ vinirmāṇamagryaṃ
kamapi tamupagamyaṃ sāramābhāsamāhuḥ ..6.155.37..

ahantādehatādyarthaś cirameva layaṃ gataḥ .
jīvanmuktasya tenāsau jño 'pi vyomnaikatāṃ gataḥ ..6.156.1..

bhūtānāṃ tac charīrāderaprāptir yā vihāriṇām .
videhamuktatā soktā saptamī yogabhūmikā ..6.156.2..

agamyā vacasāṃ sā tu sā sīmā bhavabhūmiṣu .
saṃsārasarasaḫ pāramapārasyeha sā param ..6.156.3..

kaiścit sā śiva ityuktā kaiścid brahmetyudāhṛtā .

artha ityūhitā kaiścit kaiścit kāla iti śritā .

anyairapyanyathā nānābhedairātmavikalpitaiḥ .

videhamuktairevaiṣā videhaikāntamuktatā .

na sattvasthair na cittasthaiẖ kaiścidevāvagamyate .

asaṃsaktadhiyo ye hi jñatvāt prakṣīṇavāsanāḥ .

etāsu bhūmiṣu padaṃ kuru kāraṇajña

astyanantā sadā mattā mṛdumantharacāriṇī .

rāmecchā nāma kariṇī sedamastvitirūpiṇī .

sukhaduẖkhe surabhayaḫ pṛṣatas spandasampadaḥ .

svargaẖ kalamasasyādi narakaṃ paṅkapīṭhikāḥ .

vāsanehā manaś cittaṃ saṅkalpo bhāvanaṃ spṛhā .

dhairyapadmākaronmāthe prasṛtāmarthahelayā .

tāvat kārpaṇyamihikā yāvadicchābhramaṇḍalī .

etāvāneva saṃsāra idamastviti yan matiḥ .

icchottānamater nāntarupadeśo manāgapi .

prasādakāriṇī svacchā niricche vimalākṛtau .

manāgapyuditaivecchā cchettavyānarthakāriṇī .

icchāvicchurito jīvo vijahāti na dīnatām .

icchācchoṭanacāturyaṃ turyamāhur manīṣiṇaḥ .

padamuttamamajñānāmicchācchedena sidhyati .

sāhantādijagacchāntau bodhe saṃvitkalātmani .

ayaṃ so 'hamidaṃ tan me iti nissnehadīpavat .

lobho lajjā mado moho yenādāviti no jitāḥ .

ahantvaṃ pavane spanda iva yat tvayi saṃsthitam .

asargasaṃvidā sargaḫ pare 'stīti virājate .
sanniveśaviśeṣeṇa durartho 'pi hi śobhate ..6.161.23..

ahamarthaḫ pravisṛtaḫ prakaṭīkurute jagat .

ahamityarthadustailalavo brahmaṇi vāriṇi .

ahamarthe pravisṛte saṃsāro hyanubhūyate .

ahamaṃśe niraṃśatvaṃ nīte śāśvatasaṃvidā .

svasaṃvidbhāvanāmātrasādhye 'smin varavastuni .

svayatnamātrasaṃsādhyādasahāyādisādhanāt .
anahaṃvedanān nānyac chreyaḫ paśyāmi te 'nagha ..6.161.49..

vismṛtyāhantvamāssva pravisṛtavibhavo bhūṣitāśeṣaviśvo

svabhāvamavajityādāvindriyāṇāṃ sacetasām .
pravartate viveke yas sarvaṃ tasyāśu sidhyati ..6.162.1..

svabhāvamātraṃ yenāntar na jitaṃ dagdhabuddhinā .

śuddhe 'lpo 'pyupadeśo hi nirmalādarśatailavat .
lagatyuttānacitte tu nādarśa iva mauktikam ..6.162.3..

atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam .

yadudāramanāyāsaṃ kṣayātiśayavarjitam .

saṃvidātma parākāśamanantamahamavyayaḥ .

acit sacid vā mṛtpiṇḍaś śarāvodañcanādikam .

cidacid vāṅkuro dehe vṛkṣatvaṃ manyate yathā .
